stag btsan sdong gzigs kyis zhang po rgya la dmag 'dren pa'i dmag dpon byas pa'i sdig bshags su rgya'i ha shang lha khang / rbas rgyal po stag rnas bran ka dpal gyi yon tan la skyon phab pa'i sdig bshags su khra sna'i mgon po'i zur gcig khyung po ba khu tshan lnga yis mi mang po bsad pa'i sdig bshags su rgyang ro ra lngags gdong gi lha khang / khyung po grang so lung chen pos nang dme shor bu'i sdig bshags su grang so lung gi lha khang bzhengs/ 'bro thag pa'i blo gros dang / dpal mchog blo gros skyong dang / bka' gros skyong dang gsum gyis ne ne mo'i mgo rgyan bcad pas lcebs shi ba'i sdig bshags su lhan gyi lha khang / snub lha sgra dang / gung klu sgra/ nu bo nan de rin chen gsum gyis rtsa ra skya lnga byung ba bzung nas shar pa'i mtsho skyur ba'i sdig bshags su rmu'i lha khang / tshe spong lha bzang klu dpal gyis rna ne mo spyan longs pa'i bsod nams kyi rten du bo dong bya rgod gshongs kyi lha khang bcas bzhengs pa yin no//de ltar btsan pos bzhengs pa'i lha khang nang / srong btsan skabs bzhengs pa ra sa 'phrul snang dang / rgya stag ra mo ches mtshon mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang thi bas gtsug lag khang gi ming thogs pa sum cu so gcig dang / lha khang dang brag phug gi ming thogs pa bcu drugames ag tshom gyi skabs gtsug lag khang bzhi/khri srong sde btsan gyi skabs bsam yas gtsug lag khang le lag dang bcas pa/pu ne btsan po dang / pu tig btsan po'i skabs gtsug lag khang bya7

gcig dang / lha khang gnyis/sad na legs kyi skabs gtsug lag khang gcigaral pa can gyi skabs gtsug lag khang gcig dang / lha khang gcigabashad grwa dang / khyad grwa/ sgom grwa bsdoms sum cu/ dar ma'i skabs lha khang gcigajo mos bzhengs pa gtsug lag kha gcig dang / lha khang dgu/mchod gnas kyis bzhengs pa gtsug lag khang gcig lha khang nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ blon po bzhengs pa lha khang sum cu so drug dang / mchod rten gcig bcas khyon bsdoms gtsug lag khang dang / lha khang / bshad stogrwa bsdoms grangs brgya dang lnga bcu nga brgyad zin (grangs 'bor 'di la 'phar chag cung zad thon srid kyang he bag chen po 'byung mi srid snyam)pa'i nang gses gtsug lag kha' bzhi bcu zhe gcig gis gtsug lag khang dang / lha khang gi spyi'i brgya cha25 95phrolha khang dang brag phug brgyad cu gya drug gis spyi'i brgya cha54 43lko mchod rten gcig gis spyi'i brgya cha 0 6phro bshad grwa sogs grwa'i ming thob pa sum cu tham pas spyi'i brgya cha 19phro zin pa dang / btsan pos bzhengs pa gtsug lag khang dang / lha khang brgyad cu gya brgyad kyis spyi'i brgya cha55 70phrojo mos bzhenganu/ pa bcus spyi'i brgya cha6 33phromachod gnas kyis bzhengs pa nyi shu rtsa gsum gyis spyi'i brgya cha 14 56phroblon posri bzhengs pa sum cu so bdun gyis spyi'i brgya cha 23 41phrozin pa'i grwangs 'bor thog nas bstan pa snga dar skabs bod 58

du gtsug lag khang sogs ji ltar byung ba'i lo rgyus zhib 'jug bya rgyur dpyad gzhi gal chen thon pa ma zad/ lhag par blon pos bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang dang / lha khang gi bsdur tshad de btsan po phud pa'i bsdur tshad ang dang por slebs pa de'i thog nas bstan pa snga dar skabs sangs rgyas chos lugs la btsan po yum sras dang / dbu'i mchod gnas tsam ma zad/blon po rnams kyis kyang gtsigs cher 'dzin pa des/ skabs der sangs rgyas chos lugs ni mang tshogs khrod bag chags sa/ting zab po yod pa yang gsal bshad byas yod/skabs de'i dge 'dun gyi zhal grangs nges gsal khod pa'i dpyad gzhi rang gi mig lam du ma gyur kyang / khri srong lde btsan sku dus‘‘'tsho ba thams cad bla chen po nas sbyar te tshang mang ke ru gling nas g.yos sa byas te rab tu byung ba sum brgya la zas sna bcu gsum re 'dren pa'i lag dpon jo mo byang chub rjes mdzad/ gdan non pa dang rgyas pa bam po re la shog dril re byas nas 'don te na ma re la 'bum tshar re bka' sgrog go zhes byung ngo / ’’(mkhas dga' lcags par ma3snyo3) nes 'byung ba ni sad mi bdun rab tu byung ba'i rjes kyi dge 'dun gyi zhal grangs 'phel rgyas song ba'i bsdoms 'bor yin par rtsis na chog snyam pa yang de'i dus kyi dge 'dun gcig bsdus lta bur bzhugs pa'i gnas ni btsan po'i pho brang dang nye ba'i sa char yod pas yin pa dang / ‘‘mchims phu'i sgom chen nyi shu rtsa lnga la nas kha'/ lnga bcu rtsa lnga/ spod mar srang brgyad brgya re/ chibs pa re/ na bza' drug paṃs/sa re/ chos grwa'i slob dpon du bsko ba bcu gsum la nas khal lnga bcu bya9

rtsa lnga lnga na bza' phru gar/ re/ chab cha/ra srang brgyad brgya re/ zhes (mkhas dga' deb ngos 39gyi) gsal ba ni mchirma sa phu'i sgom grwa'i dge 'dun gyi grangs tshad dang 'tsho ba bla nas sbyar ba'i grangs tshad yin/ral pa can gyi dus ni bod du sangs rgyas bstan pa shin tu dar ba'i dus la brten dge 'dun gyi zhal grangs kyang ches cher 'phar ba smos snga/ dgos pas gtsug lag khang dang lha khang tshang mar mchims phu'i sgom grwa'i ldab gcig yod par cha bzhag na gtsug lag khang dang / lha khang brgya dang lnga bcu nga brgyad la dge 'dun brgyad stong la nye ba zin pa de skabs de'i dge 'dun gyi grangs tshad mtho mthar rtsis chog gam snyam/skabs de'i gtsug lag khang dang / lha khang khag gi nang nas mdo stod sogs dbus gtsang dang sa khad 'gyang ba'i mtha' khul khag dang / gtsug lag khang dang / lha khang che khag gi sgo la 'dag zhal brgyab ste glang dar dgyes pa dang / nang gi sku rten sogs srung skyob thub phyir btsun pa chang 'thung ba'i ri mo bris te srung skyob thub rigs phud/ de min dbus gtsang gi gtsug lag khang bshig pa dang sku srung thugs rten la gtor bshig tshabs chen phog yod/'on kyang gtor bshig tshabs che chung gi bsdur tshad thad/ sku rten dang / gsung rten gnyis bsdur na gsung rten la gtor bshig phog tshabs che ba byung bar snang / de yang nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyis/ ‘‘slob dpon pad+mas rab gnas mdzad pa'i lha khang mchod rten rnams bshig tu ma btub nas bsam 5sa dang / 'phrul snang la sogs pa rnams sgo la 'dag zhal 60

brgyab/ glegs bam gyi po ti phal che ba lha sa/'i brag lte ba can dang ma/chims phu'i rdza la sbas/ ’mi (chos 'byung me tog snying po lcags par ma deb dzasasku/ 431) zhes dang / ‘‘rgyal po glang dar mas bstan pa ngasnubs dus su/gcung lha sras gtsang ma sgyugs pas/ (skabs 'di'i dgongs pa ni/ ral pa can gyi dus mjug gtsang ma spyugs te sa mthar bzhugs bzhin pas dar mas bstan pa snub skabs yab mes kyi bka' dpe sogs srung skyob gnang ba de yin pas 'phrul bar mi bya'o/ ) yab mes kyi bka' dpe dang / zab chos kyi gdams pa rnams dang / drag sngags rnams dang / rje gu ru pad ma'i gdams pa rnams bsnams nas gshegs nas/ 'od khra snar lo gcig bzhugs nas/ de'i dus su blon po nag po rnams kyis/ gsod pas sdig nas bzhugs su ma ster ba'i dus su/ nyang ting 'dzin bzang po/ bsnubs nam mkha'i snying po/ snyags snya na ku ma ra la sogs pa lo tsā ba chen po rnams tshogs te/ bka' bkros te/ de nas chos thams cad gter du sbas par byar+sā te/ rgyud 'khrugs pa sdeb pa/ lung gcus pa bsrong ba/ man ngag gab pa gsal ba'i ba/nad kyi yi ge la sogs pa rnams snyags snya na la gtad de/ snyan khung thugs rgyud du byas te yi ge mi 'khyams par gtsigs bzung rgyas btab/ ral gcig ma dang dpal mgon lcam sring srung mar bzhagathugs gter du sbas/ po ti rnams la la drang srong srin po ri/ la la dpal chu bo ri/ bzad kyi du ra gdong la sogs par brgya rtsa brgyad sbas/ kha rag la brgya rtsa brgyad sbas/ chos 'khor stod smad kyi gcug lag khang so/ phag gis brtsigs/ lha sku rnam pa du ma sbas/ shangs kyi lha phur ma mo sbas/ ru 61

bzhi'i mtha' 'dul gyi sgrub gnas rnams su gter phran nyi shu rtsa brgyad sbas /bum thang rin po che'i bzhub/sa/ gnas su pad ma'i chos gsum/ yig mdo nyi shu rtsa gsum dang bcas pa sbas/ nyang ting nge 'dzin gyis ba'i ma la'i rdzogs chen rnams dbu ru zha'i skyer tshang du gter rgya dang bcas nas sbas/nam mkha'i snying pos 'kho 'thing lha khang dang / lho brag mkhar chur sbas/ ’ (chos 'byudz+wame tog snying po lcags par ma shog grangs435) zhes gsungs pa'i thog nas mtshon pa ni glang dar rjes 'brang dang bcas pas gsung rab gang rnyed mer bsregs pa dang / chu la bskyur ba/ sa 'og tu sba ba sogs rtsa gtor rang bzhin gyi nyen kha shin tu che bas kho tshos nam yang mi mthong ba'i sar gter du sbas pa la sogasapa'i thabs shes kyis srung skyob gnang dgos byung yod cing / bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung las/ ‘‘de la bod kyi rgyar blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ bod yul du 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad thugs dam du bzhengs te/ lo tsā ba chen po rnams kyis bka' bstan bcos rnams kyi mtshan byang /gzhung tshad/ go rim la sogs pa gtan la phab ste dkar chag tu bkod pa pho brang chen po stong thang snran dkar dang / 'phang thang ka med gnyis na bzhugs pa las dus phyis rgyal po sdig pa'i grogs pos bslus pa dag gis bstan pa nub par byas pa'i rkyen gyis gsung rab de dag 'thor bar gyur to/ miri (bu ston bka' 'bum la pa bstan 'gyur dkar chag shog grangs4na)zhes gsungs pa dar mas bstan pa bsnubs skabs bka' bstan 'gyur gyis mtshon pa'i gsung rab la de bas sdang zug gis rtsa gtor gtong skabs bod 62

kyi mkhas grub spyi dang / lhag par ral pa can gyi dus mjug lha sras gtsang ma spa kro mon yul du sgyugs te 'od khra nar bzhugs skabs khong gis de snga btsan po'i pho brang nas bsnams pa'i gsung rten khag dang / nyang ting 'dzin bzang po la sogs pa'i lo tsā ba chen po rnams kyi sku la nyams nyes ma byung gong thugs nus yod rgus srung skyob gnang dgos byung bas sngar btsan po'i pho brang nang gi thugs dam rten du bzhugagopa rnams sa gnas mang por 'thor gyar byung ba phyis lo paṇa dang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag khag gis rim pas bsdu rub kyis da gzod bod yul du bzhugs pa'i bka' bstan 'gyur skad grags can da lta yang mjal du yod pa'i nang bstan pa snga dar skabs bsgyur ba'i gsung rab mar po gnas thub pa ni btsan po rim byon dang /lhag par bstan pa la nye ba'i 'gag rtsa'i dus skabs su sku srog dang bsdos te srung skyob gnang mkhan lha sras gtsang ma dang / lo tsā ba chen po rnams kyi bka' drin ni gzhal bar dka' zhing / dar ma rjes 'brang dang bcas pa ni mi rigs rang nyid kyi rig sa/nas la gtor bshig gtong mkhan btsan po'i gdung rgyud kyi zhabs 'dren dang / bod mi rigs kyi rkang 'dren mthu lud 'debs pa'i yul nyag cig tu gyur pa gsal por bstan yod/dar mas bstan nga/ snub skabs phyi'i gtsug lag khang dang nang gi sku rten la gtor bshig tshabs chen btang yod rung gsung rten gtor bshig byung ba dang bsdur na cung zadra tshabs chung ba byung 'dra ba de yang mkhas pa'i dga' ston las/ ‘‘lha sa gzhig pa'i phyir mar me mdzad kyi sgo srung phyag rdor gyi mgul la thag pa btags pas de ma thag 'dogs mkhan khrag 63

babyugs nas de gar shi bas 'jig ma nus/ des na rme brtsegs dang 'di gnyis kyis lha sa 'jigs thebs re bskyabs pas byin rlabs lhag par che'o//jo bo rnam kanyis dang byams pa chos 'khor chu la skyur zer ba la blon po chos la dga' ba 'gas bskyur zin pa skad du thabs byas nas so so'i khri 'og tu sbas/ gtsang khang gi sgo brtsigs nas btsun pa chang 'thung ba'i ri mo bris te bzhag bsam yas gzhig par bsgos nas mchod rtem/ ‘rod 'bar yin yang zer/ khams gsum dang dbu rtse'i bar na mchod rten nag po chung ngu zhis yod kyang zer te/ de bshig pas thog babs nas bshig mkhan rnams shi bas 'jig 'phro bcad/ ’’ (mkhas dga' lcags par shog grangs bhe3smo)ces dang / chos 'byung me tog snying po'i nang / ‘‘slob dpon pad mas rab gnas mdzad pa'i lha khang mchod rten rnams bshig tu myo5 btub nas/bsam yas dang / 'phrul snang la sogs rnams sgo la 'dag zhal brgyab/ ’’(chos 'byung me tog snying po lcags par deb ngos 433)zhes gsal ba'i thog nas mtshon pa ni gtsug lag khang dang / lha khang khag gcig gi sgo la 'dag zhal brgyab pa la sogs pa'i thabs la brten nas nyams chag chen po rang ma byung ba rang 'jags bzhugs thub pa mang po byung yod pa'i bden dpang gzhan zhig ni/ bod du kheng log byung rjes‘‘'o bran blo gros dbang phyug la rgya gar tsardo kin+d+ras gshin rje gshed mtheb rgya can la sogs pa gnang ste bsgyur ro/ /de gnyis gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi gzhug mar song ste /de nas gcig kyang 'gyur byang rnams bsgyur ba med do/ /dus phyis gzhan gyis btsal yang dpe cha dam dum 'dra en tsam ma yin pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dang 64

chos gcig kyang ma rnyed de ma byung dus de tsa na dbus/ gtsang na sdom pa dang bshad pa'i gdams ngag bka' chad nas med/ gtsug lag khang thams cad kyi lde mi sa/ ngatsun gzugs dbu gtsug phud can gsham thabs gong ba can gyon pa 'ga' re'i ming gnas brtan dgra bcom par btags pas 'dzin/ ’’ (chos 'byung me tog snying po lcags par ma shog grangs 448)zhes lo rgyus kyi yig lam nang gsal bas de skabs btsun gzugs rnal myo/ dang / dpe cha med kyang gtsug lag khang da dung gnas pa mtshon cing /sngar sku rten gyi khrod du glang dar khrims phog ces dar mas sku rten la gtor bshig gtong skabs gsung byon ma rang 'jags bzhag par grags pa phyis kyang byin rlabs che ba'i tshad du 'jog pa'i sku rten mang po mjal rgyu yod pa dang / srong btsan sgum po dang / khri srong lde btsan sku dus bzhengs pa gzhi rgya che ba'i gtsug lag khang 'phrul snang dang / rgya stag ra mo che/ bsamyo/ yas la sogs pa dang / mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang mang po phyis kyang mjal rgyu yod pa bcas kyi thog nas skabs der gsung rten las sku rten nyams chag chung ba byung ba de mtshon pa bcas bsdoms na glang dar mas bstan pa snub skabs dbus gtsang gtso bor gyur pa'i gtsug lag khang dang / lha khang la gtor bshig phog pa dang gsung rten la de bas tshabs che ba'i gtor bshig phog yod/de bzhin skabs der snyan grags can gyi lo paṇa mang po'i sku la nyams nyes gyung ba'i skor/ chos 'byung me tog snying por/ nam mkha'i snying po mkhar chur gzhig sa/ nyang ting 'dzin bzang po dbu ru zha ru bkrongs/ rma 65

rin chen mchog 'u yul gi chu kha zhig tu bkrongs/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs bkrongs par brtsams kyang bkrongs ma thub/ dar rje dpal gyi grags pa dang / bsnubs sangs rgyas rin po che/ mgo sgom tshul khrims/mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug mchims shākya pra ba/ 'brog mi dpal gyi ye shes/ shud pu dpal gyi seng ge sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ sog po dpal gyi ye shes/ rlangs chung seng ge dpal/ 'o bran dpal gyi gzhon nu la sogs pa lo tsā ba bgres po rnams kyis rgyal po'i log spyod ma zlog par gnas so sor ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs/ gzhan sgrub pa po mang po btsan sa ru bskungs nas yib ces gsal ba ltar snyan grags can gyi lo paṇa mang po'i sku la nyams nyes dang / sku ngal chen po byung ba ma zad/ skabs der dbus gtsang du yod pa'i rab tu byung ba phal cher sa mthar bros shing / ma thar ba rnams khyim par phab/ ma nyan pa rnams bsad/ la la khrid nas rgyal blon gyi rta 'bab 'dzeg gi tshe sgur du bcug nas stegs byed pa tshun chad kyis dma' phab/ la la rnga shang bskur te ri dwags gsod par btang skad bcas de skabs khyim pa gos dkar gyi rten la zhugs te gsang sngags nyams bzhes gnang mkhan mang po'i nang gi de nyid ma rtogs pas nyams nyes ma byung ba dang / sa mthar bros pa dang / yib thub rigs phud de min rab byung ba kun la tshad gzhi 'dra min gyi nyams nyes tshabs chen phog pas dbus gtsang du 'dul ba'i bstan pa sgo kun nas nub cing / de skabs rab tu byung ba la yang gsung rten dang 'dra ba'i nyams nyes tshabs chen byung ba ni dbus gtsang tsam min pa mdo khams la yang de dang 'dra ba byung yod/66

daspar na rma lung rdo rje brag ra an chung gnam gyi yang rdzong gtsug lag khang rgya phibs yod pa dang / dan tig shel gyi yang dgon du (chu bo ri nas bros pa'i dge slong gsum po) byon nas/ phyis dan tig yang dgon las mched pa'i lha khang rgya thabs khyung mgo can brgya lnga bcu byung ba mchis/ sngar gyi btsun chas su zhugs pas/ de na yod pa'i mi kun na re/ a pa pha rgyal po sdig can gyi khrims kyis ma phog pa'i mi yang gda' zer bas/ bred nas skrag ste/ nags su bros phyin pas 'tsho ba med par skung ste bzhugs pa la/dge bsnyen ma gcig gis bag re btegs/ ’ (chos 'byung me tog snying po lcags par deb ngos4bhe1)zhes gsal bas skabs der dbus gtsang tsam ma zad/ mdo khams su btsun chas 'dzin pa'i skye bo mthong ba tsam la skrag snang byid kyang / gtsug lag khang sngar bzhin rang 'jags gnas pas gsung rten dang / rab tu byung bar gnod skyon phog pa lta bu gtsug lag khang la byung med par brtsis na yongs su 'grig pa yin/bsdoms na dar mas dbus gtsang du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sgo kun nas snub skabs gsung rten la gtor bshig dang / rab tu byung bar gnod 'tshe btang ba lta bu phyi'i gtsug lag khang dang / sku rten la gtor bshig byung med pa de'i thog nas skabs de'i blon po gdug pa'i sems ldan la dgos pa ni dbang cha yin pas gsung rab gnas pa dang / de dag nyams len byed pa'i gang zag gnas na rang gis chos lugs dang 'gal ba'i spyod ngan spel mi bde bar brtsis te de dag gi shul yang mi gnas pa bzos te rang gi dbang grags ches cher 'phel thub pa bya rgyu ni dmigs yul 67

nyag cig yin pa las gzhan gtsug lag khang dang / sku rten gtor bshig btang ba la brten nas rang la dpal 'byor gyi khe phan thob pa bya rgyu sogs min pa de ma/ tshon pa gcig tu bsdu na kho tshos sangs rgyas bstan pa bsnub rgyu srid dbang gi gnad don las dpal 'byor dang / chos lugs kyi lta ba gang zhig spel ba'i gnad don la rag ma lus pa de yang gsal por rtogs thub/de ltar glang dar mas lcags bya spyi lo8bhe1 srid dbang bskyangs pa nas re zhig rgyal po tshul bzhin du byas te nang blon du dbas rgyal stag rna can dang / phyi blon du nam khri 'bum rje bskos pa sdig pa'i grogs po de dag gis bslus pa'i rkyen las lo gcig tsam song rjes te chu khyi spyi lo 841 tsam nas dbus gtsang du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa khyon yongs nas bsnubs pa'i bya ngan brtsams te ring por ma thogs pa zla ba phyed bdun song ba'i tshe lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes dar ma lnga ba'i lam du drangs pas/ dar mas srid dbang lo ngo gsum las skyong rgyu ma byung ba lo rgyus yig lam mang por gsal por 'khod pa ma zad/ 'da' kha'i smre sngags su yang na lo gsum gyis sngas/yang na lo gsum gyis phyis zhes pas srid dbang skyong ba'i dus tshod mtshon pa ma zad/ chos mi snub pa'am/ yang na mthar phyin pa bya dgos pa'i go ba yod lugs gsungs pa'ang thos shing / dar mar btsun mo chen ma sna nam bza' dang / chun ma tshe spong bza' btsan rngo 'phan gnyis yod par sras yum brtan dang 'od srung 'khrungs pa'i thad bshad tshul mang tsam mchis pa gsham du dmigs su bkar nas zhu rgyu nas mkhyen thub/dar ma bkrongs rjes kyi dus thur nang blon po chos la gnag pa tshos 68

bstan k+ṣ-ir 'tshe ba'i bya ba mtshams/ 'jog byas med/ de yang ro rgyus yig lamyosko nang / natsā/ myo rngonas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i sdig blon rnams kyis —rgya la po gshegs rjes kya/nga bstan la 'tshe ba brtsam rung rgyal pori skabs ltar ngag mi btsan zhing / mi ring bar lus tshal du mar mngon du zhig nas dus byas pa sob/sa bzod dka' mi srid 'jigaru/ rung gis phal rber kha dag pas mi rnañtsa sa bsngags shing / chos la dkar ba'i blon po rnams kyis yang yang bskul bas shing glang spyi lo8bhe') lor chos la 'tshe ba'i 'phro chad/ ’’ (bod rje btsan po'i gdung rabs/ tshig nyung don gsal bris ma shog grangs 8pa)ces 'khod pa ltar dar mas sangs rgyas chos lugs sgo kun nas bsnubs pa nas lo ngo lnga song rjes gzhi nas bstan pa bsnubs pa'i bya ba mtshams 'jog byas par mngon pa bcaru/ dar ma'i lo rgyus ni rang gzhan gnyis sdug gi sgo nas mjug bsgril ba dang / dar ma'i bang so 'khor lo can zhes pa 'phrul dang rgyal chen bar yod pa rtsig 'phror lus shing / 'di man bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgya'/ po ma byung bas smad sil chad du grags pa lags so//gsum pa/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes dar ma lnga pa'i lam du drangs pa'i skor/lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje mi// 'brom stod gung mo cher (me stag spyi lo 78smolo'am yang na me yos spyi lo gyi8gyi tsam la) 'khrungs/ skya ming stag nya bzang zer/ rgya bod kyi sa mtshams bsrungs te rgya rnams btul/ lan cig go cha phud pa'i klog gi nang na tog gzungs bzhugs pa bklag pas/bra nye la ni gang skyes pa// ca69

rkang mthil me ba dmar po can//tre shi nas dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur//gsungs pa ltar rang gi rkang mthil la de ltar yod pas rkyen byas bsam yas su bi ma la mi tra las rab tu byung / lo bcu bdun par spa gro stag tshang du gu ru pad ma'i zhal mjal nas byang sems kyi sdom pa blangaṭasmu thog mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis rjes su bzung ba dang khong ni snyags dzha na ku ma ra'i slob ma dpal gyi ming can brgyad kyi ya gyal yang yin/ yer pa brag lha'i lha khang bzhengs pa sogs phyag rjes che/ yi dam lha dang bla mas bdud 'dul dpa' bor lung bstan par lhas lung du grags/ lha sras mu rum sku gshegs ma thag skye ba'i nying mtshams sbyar ba bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi lung bstan bka' rgya mar gsal bas me stag me yos gang rigs su 'khrungs dgos pas rgyal po sdig can sgrol dus dgung lo lnga bcu nga brgyad tsam du phebs pa dang / phyis khams su bla chen po dge ba gsal gyi bsnyen rdzogs kyi kha skong gi dge slo nga rgya nag nas hwa shang gnyis 'bad pas btsal ba'i grogs kyang mdzad cing / gnam sde 'od srungs la sman bla bde gshegs bdun gyi mdo chog gi lung phul bar yang grags pa (la la ni mchims phu'i sgom chen lha lung dpal gyi yon tan bya ba yin par bzhed )de ltar na dgung lo brgyad cu lhag nges shig bzhugs par snang (lha lung dpal rdor gyi lo rgyus 'di btsan po'i gdung rabs tshig nyung don gsal bris ma gyiba.ā+o dang mkhas pa'i dga' ston lcags par ma'i shog grangs 3snyolāpar gsal ba ltar gung bsgrigs/ pa yin) zhing / lha lung dpal gyi 7snyi ci

rdo rjes dar ma 'u dum btsan po bsgral dgos pa'i rkyen song kyi sko ra/ mkhas pa'i dga' ston nang / ‘‘de'i tshe lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje yer pa brag lhar rtse gcig tu sgom pa'i tshe 'od dang / sgra dang / sa g.yos mang pos the tshom du gyur te phyir gzigs pas btsun pa rnga gshang thogs te khyi khrid nas lings byed pa mthong bas rgyal pos bstan pa bsnubs par shes te snying rje khyad par can skyes/ dpal mgon po dang / ma gcig dpal lha/ grib kyi rdzong btsan gsum gyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ba'i phyir rgyal po sdig can sgrol cig bdag cag gis grogs bya'o zhes yang yang du bskul/ phod ka dang zhwa nang dkar phyi nag po phyon/ phu thung du lcags mda' lcags gzhu bcugarta dkar sol ba byugs pa la zhon nas phyin/ de'i tshe blon 'bangs chos la dga' ba thams cad 'dus nas ngu 'bod dang mya ngan byas/ rgyal po chen po sangs rgyas kyi bstan si rin po che la 'di lta bu mdzad par mi rigs/yab mes thams cad kyi yig tshang dang dkor mdzod kyi sgrom bu rdo ring gi yi ge thams cad gzigs shig ces mgrin gcig ngu 'bod byas/ rgyal po gla ba'i tshal na mig mangs rtse zhing yod pa 'bangs rnams kyis ngu 'bod byed pa thos pas sems ma bde ba rdo ring gi yi ge klog gin yod pas mthong ste mgon po nag po byung zer skad/ der rta babs rgyal po rdo ring gi rus sbal la rkub stegs su 'dug pa la phyag byed pa ltar bcos te phyag dang po la —phu thung gi nang du mtheb ltong sprad/ gnyis pa la mda' bkang / gsum pa la 'phangs pas smin mtshams su phog ste mde'u ltag par phyung / yang na lo gsum gyis sngas/ yang na lo gsum gyis phyis zhes pa kha nas shor te phyag 74

gnyis mda' la 'jus nas grongs/ der rta la zhon te nga bdud yab bzher nag po bya ba yin/ rgyal po sdig can gsod na de ltar gsod pa yin zer nas bros/ blon po thams cad kyis rjes bsnyegs pas mi nag mtsho la rta gshan ber dang zhwa phyi nang zlog ste nga lha gnam the dkar po bya ba yin zer nas bros pas mi ma yin par dogs nas 'ded mi rnams tshoms/ 'on kyang rgyang de nas ded pas phyogs bzhi kar 'ded rgyu byung ste shar la 'ded mi rnams dga' mo gdong nas sa sros te zin la khad tsam na shor zer skad/lho pa rnams grib chu 'gram/ nub pa rnams shul gyi 'phrang / byang pa rnams mong mkhar gdong nas sa sros te shor zer skad/ der gros bgros pas 'di rdzu 'phrul dang ldan par 'dug pas yer pa'i lha lung dpal rdo sda yin nges zer nas blta bar byas/ lha lung dpal rdor gyis kyang yer par log ste sgrub khang du phug ron gyi rkang pa nas bzung ste 'phur stangs byed bcug pas rdul phab/ mug ma sbar gang gtor te 'gro 'ong gi rjes med par byas nas bzhugs pas lta mkhan rnams 'di la mis phar tshur du ma phyin par 'dug zer nas log mi rig pa can zhig nang du go le byung nas khong gi snying gar lag pa bzhag pas skrag ste snying 'phar ba shes/ nas nag can gyi rma 'di na 'dug ste spyi'i tha pa la sgos kyi gshol mi gcog zer nas song bas skrag ste (mngon pa kun btus/ 'dul ba 'od ldan/ karma sha tam rnams bsnams nas) mdo khames su bros nas sgom zhing bzhugs so/ ’ri (mkhas dga' lcags par mabhe3a+yo) zhes gsal ba dang / deb ther la lar snubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis bskul ba dang / ske ral gris bcad pa la sogs 7lha

pa'i ngazhe— tshul cung tha dad kyang rtsa ba'i don la khyad cher ma mthong ba 'di dag gi thog nas mtshon pa ni/glang dar mas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnubs pa de ni btsan po yab mes kyi dgongs pa dang / skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi bsam pa'i 'khor phyogs dang yongs su 'gal ba ni dar mar blon 'bangs kyis ngu 'bod kyi thog nas mi rigs pa'i mdzad pa de ltar gnang mi rung ba yab mes kyi yig tshang dang / dkor mdzod kyi sgrom bur gzigs nas de dang de'i tshul la 'jug dgos pa dar mar bskul ma zhus pa dang gcig lha lung dpal rdor gyis dar ma bsgral ba ni lha lung dpal rdor sger gyi don min pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mi rigs kyi rig gnas srung skyob kyi gnad don gal cher thug pa der spyi tshogs kyi dbu skyor chen po thob pa/ lha lung dpal rdor gyis rgyal po bkrongs pa'i nyes pa bsags kyang rjes 'ded mkhan gyis phyogs bzhi kar 'dzin la khad du sa sros pas thabs ma byung tshul dang / spyi'i thal ba la sgos kyis gshol mi gcog ces shes kyang ma shes khul gyis khong la shugs nas srung skyob byed pa dang rga/nyis/ dar ma 'da' kha'i smre sngags kyi thos/ nas dar mas srid dbang skyong ba'i dus yun lo gsum las brgal med pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnubs pa'i bya ngan spel zin par 'gyod sems kyi snang tshul zhig kyang shugs nas thon pas dar ma sdig grogs kyis bslus pa'i thad la dpyad gzhi thon pa dang gsum/ skabasdu de'i gca bo'i 'gal ba ni btsan po'i rgya94 srid la zhugs pa'i dar ma ma bkrongs na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mi rigs kyi rig gnas srung skyob mi thub pa'i gnad 73

don la thug pa dang bzhi'o/ /bzhi pa/ glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa'i ngan 'bras ni/de yang mkhas pa lde'us/ nub phyogs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bcad pas rgya gar nas paṇ+ḍi ta 'byon pa'i 'phro chad/ shar phyogs gser lam sum cu skyur bas rgya nag nas nor gyi tshong sgo rgyun chad/ byang phyogs sha lpags skya mo la btab pas hor gyi dmag kha nang du bstan/ 'khrus/ pa byas/ lho dom sgrom nag po kha phye nas lho mon la gnyen btas/sa/ sems can thams cad mi mthun pa'i lam la bkod/ (mkhas pa sde'u'i chos 'byung deb ngos 3smosnyo) ces gsungs pa dang mtshungs par deb ther gzhan la'ang mang po 'khod yod pa rags tsam bsdu na/1 btsan po yab mes kyi bka' drin la brten nas byung ba'i bod khams gcig gyur gyi btsan po'i mnga' thang rgyas shing / dpung stobs dar la drag pa/ mi rnams dga' bde'i dpal la spyod pa'i dus bab bzang po'i bod khams ni yul tshan re la dpon chung res dbang sgyur na sil bur gyur pas phan tshun nang 'khrug la sogs pa 'byung mi 'os pa'i 'khrug zing gi 'jigs skrag sogs mi rnams 'khos mi phebs pa/1 rgya gar la sogs pa nas paṇ+ḍi ta byon pa'i mtshams chad nas re zhig bod kyi rig gnas la 'phel rgyas lta ci/ sngar yul gru phan tshun rig gnas spel res kyis bod kyi rig gnas phul du byung ba grub par gtor bshig tshabs chen phog pa la la da lta yang gso thub med/ dper na/ thu mi bka' drin can gyis da lta'i bod yig gsar btod gnang skabs sgra'i 74 —

bstan bcos brgyad gsar rtsom gnang ba nas da lta bzhugs pa sum rtags gnyis las gzhan ma drug dar ma'i dus nub pa yongs grags ltar/ da lta sum rtags kye gnad don mang po legs sbyar gyi bstan bcos dang zung 'brel ma byas na mi 'grig pa dang / sum rtags kyi gzhung du mi gsal ba man ngag la brten dgos pa'i shugs bstan mang po thon pa lta bu dang /gzhan yang 'dzugs skrun dngos po'i thog nas bshad kyang / srong btsan sku dus bzhengs pa'i ra sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang gi bzo skrun gyi ngo mtshar dang khyad chos lta bu phyis bskrun pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams la'ang mthong dkon pa/ lhag par btsan po'i gdung rgyud na rim gyi bang so'i nang btsan po'i sku'i nyer chas la sogs pa bod mi rigs kyi blo gros las byung ba'i rig rdzas yong srid pa rnams kyang dar ma'i rjes dbu g.yor 'khrug pa sogs la brten nas byung ba'i kheng log dang / bang so 'bru ba'i skabs thor zhig song bas da lta'i char bang so'i nang gi rig gnas dngos po'i thog nas bod gna' rabs kyi rig gnas 'phel rim gyi lo rgyus ji bzhin mtshon dka' ba bcas bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas la gtor bshig tshabs chen phog pa ni lo rgyus kyi bslab bya nam yang brjed mi rung ba zhig yin pa/3 thang bod 'brel ba'i thad la ral pa can gyi dus mjug dbon zhang mjal 'dum gyis phan tshun mdza' mthun gyi 'brel lam bzang po tshugs te tshong zog brje res kyi 'brel ba bzang po'i rgyun yang chad pa/4 bod kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang / spyi tshogs kyi bde 'jags la shugs rkyen ngan pa phog pa/ bcan po'i dus rabs spyi dang lhag par — 75

ral pa can gyi dus skabs bod kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang / mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba ni skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos dang 'tshams thub pa lta bu byung yod pa ni btsan po'i dus skabs kyi dmag dpung gi grangs 'bor dang / g.yul 'gyed kyi 'bras bu nas ma tshon thub/ btsan po'i dus skabs kyi dmag dpung ni thon skyed dang kha ma bral ba'i dmag dpung yin stabs g.yul 'gyed kyi bya bar zhugs skabs rgyags rang khur byed dgos pas mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad nges can zhig med na pha rol dbang du bsdu ba'i g.yul 'gyed nang dmag 'bor chen po yong mi thub ba dang / dmangs sems gcig tu bsgril ba'i nus pa thon mi thub pa la sogs pa'i gnad don mang po 'phrad srid kyang btsan po'i dus skabs nang byung ba'i g.yul 'gyed mang por rgyal kha thob pa dang / skabs de'i g.yul 'gyed kyang phas kyi rgol ba 'dul ba las nang 'khrug cher med pa/ lhag par ral pa can gyi skabs dbon zhang mjal 'dum mngon gyur rjes dmag 'khrug gi yo lang gang yang byung med pas mang tshogs rnams rang rang thon skyed la zhugs thub pa/ de skabs bod la chos byed dge 'dun gyi sde dang /dge 'dun gyi grangs mang po ma mchis khar 'tsho ba bla nas sbyor bas mang tshogs la dge 'dun gyi sder me kha chu len lta bu'i rkang 'gro'i 'khri cha las dpal 'byor gyi 'khri cha gang yang med 'dra ba bcas skabs der mang tshogs kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang / 'tsho ba bcas gang ci'i thad nas mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba dngos dang cung zad 'tshams thub pas mi 'bor 'phel rgyas kyi tshad gzhi yang nges can du slebs yod/ 'on kyang glang dar ma'i 76

rjes bod la kheng log dang / yul tshan re dpon 'go re bzung ba lta ba ༄sil bur gyur khar de dag rnams kyang gcig 'og gcig tu ma bsdus khar/phan tshun dbang ris dang khyab khongs sogs rgyu mtshan sna tshogs la brten nas nang 'khrug bar ma chad pa byung ba dang / hor dmag bod du lhags pa sogs phyi nang gi rgyu rkyen la brten nas sdug bsngal gcig thog gnyis brtsegs byung bas skabs shig ring bod kyi dpal 'byor nyams zhan dang /'tsho ba zhan pa/ mi 'bor chag tshad che ba bcas kyi gnas su gyar ba/ 5 sangs rgyas chos lugs bsnubs pa'i rkang 'dzin mkharwa dbas stag rna sogs dar ma'i blon po chos la mi dga' ba rnams kyang rang rang gi re ba las yongs su ldog ste chos lugs bsnubs pa nas ring por ma thogs pa nyams nyes sna tshogs kyis rang rang gi lo rgyus mjug bsgril mod/ 'on kya/nga btsan po'i srid dbang dang / bod khams spyi'i bya bar lhag bsam rma me da kyi nus shugs 'don mkhan bsngags 'os kyi mi sna mang por gnod 'tshe tshabs chen phog pa kacas so// 77

dar ma'i lo rgyus kyi zhib 'anug la mkho ba'i re'u migosad na leṭa/ ral pa can/ dar ma bcas kyi 'khrungs 'das lo tshiṭa re'u migadebather gang rgyal po/ 'khrungs lo sridabanes 'das lo/ zur don/du gsalab/ — mas/mkhas pa sad na 'brug lo lo bcu gsum bzhi bcu lug lo tshiṭa 'di'i lde'u'i rgya legs/ (chu na srid bzung lor (lcags dpyad pa bod kyi chos 'brug spyi srid lo bco lug spyi lo gsham bkod 'byung rgyas lo 752) brgyad (shing 791)/ myo chan bu dang pa/ trī~Xlto lo spre༈ra gziṭa/ral pa khyi lo(chu lo gnyis na bzhi brgazhe'i gshams can/ khyi spyi lo yab 'das kyāciḍilca rdo shābye bkod myo/chan 782) srid lo 12 spyilam̐ bu gnyis par bzung / 820)/ gzigs/dar ma 'u lug lo lo bcu gnyis so gnyis mchan bu dum btsan (lcaṭa lugapar yab stag lo gsum par spyi lo gshegs srid krongs gzigs/791) bzung(chu rta (chu stagaspyi lo802 spyi lo lor babs)/ 823)/ 78
zur don/ṭīr+sha kā spri gziṭa/༵dīdri bu gziṭa/mchan bu shāṭ+wāṃ ///ra

deb ther gang rgyalnga po/ 'khru ngas srid bzhes lo/ 'das lo/ zur don/du gsal ba/ lo/nyang nyi ma sad na wamedabye (spyi nyi shu rtsa bzhir lnga k+tacu nga mchan bu 'od zer legs/ lo 746) sdid byisdurdos ḍipre ṭā bya bdun par gyi chos ༵py-isnabhetre shāsdudho) gzigs/'byung me bzhi sa tog snying po — bya spyi lo 769 lor babs/ral pa chu 'grug rdzucu(༵spyakā ṭ+wāṃs lcags bya (spyi mchan bu can/ (sbyi lo chu skres tai māṃmo lo 841) brgyad par 812) 823 me bya spyi gzigs/lo 817)dar ma 'u chu yos ṭ+wāṃcu dgu par chu khyi (spyi lo mchan bu dum (spyi lo wad gtad/ 842) dgu par btsan/ 823) (lcags bya gzigs/spyi lo 841)sa chen graṭa sad na shing nyi thu rtso bzhi—ra me bya (spyi lopa rgyal spe legs 'brug ṭ+wāṃdrormi sbyirdos 817)mtshan gya (spyi lo rnodzung (nyer rgyal rabs/ 764) ṭ+wāṃgā shā ༵dhi) //rdoX///// ri

deb ther gang / rgyalapo/ 'khrungs ni— b.rīsalo 'dasalo zurastan/sdu tha/thegakhub tshon / da sheṭa/ dra ga4) pon / / da ca) /sa chen graṭa ral pa me khyi(spyi bcu gas+t+rim rdzub so drug lcaṭa pa rgyal can/ lo806) t+naspya kā/da la bya (spyi lomatshan gyi bskyangs (bcu 841) rgyal rabs/ gsum pa sa khyispyi lo818) dar ma/ chu lug(spyi bcolngadu yab khyi lo(chu khyi lo803) lhapy-iswā ༵/snar spyilo842) (bco lnga me bya817so dgu lcaṭa bya841)ne'u par+ghaṃ sad na shing 'bruganyen+d+rabaspyor me bya(spyota'i chos legs/ (spyi lo ṭ+wāṃdro kā rnyirdos lo817)'byung sdon 764) dro~Xng(nyer gyi gtam me bsne me cis tog phring ba/ spyi lo787)ral pa me khyi(spyi dṛhāpy-i ṭ+wāṃswā ༵ba so drug lcaṭa mchan bu can lo806) nyeram̐ bsnye ) bya(spyi lo bcu par bskyangs(bcu 841) gzigs/kānyis me )bya spyi /bye)1—77 /)/

/ sdobatheragangargyal po/ 'khrungs srid bzhes lo/ 'das lo/zur don/du gsal ba/ lo/sdo lnge— co rdze—dar ma 'u chu lug shādadṛṭ+wāṃsdo/rakhyi lochu khyidum btsanaspyi di gcunga'adas 842)803 (bco lngar me bya spyi lo817so tārnyiralo lcapy-i~X 1)pa lde khri chuyos bhe zhime me~Xsnadanams nga / spyilo bcu ba nga ṭ+wāṃ bya mchan sbya rgyal mtshan 763) 'brug(spyi lo ( lo bcu gag gyis mdzad 776) 817) paṭ+wāṃ pa rgyal rabs gags/ṭ+wāṃkāl ba'i nga/ bcuganyisayab so —bheral pa me khyi/ 'dasasrid drug lcaṭa can/ (phyi lo me bya/ spyilo806 bskyangs bya841)lo817) r+ṣakhodar ma/ sa spyoshā lcags byaspyi sriṭ+wāṃ so brgyaspyo ༵ bcu gadhos ) dī~X) spyaṭ+wāṃ6) par 82 809 gzigs/

1(( tshob////ཿpa//sa/ (bye/ 1do/rgyal / lo srid ba sa lo/ 'das lo/ zur na/sad na shing lug nyer bzhir nga bzhi me spre mchan bu legs/ (spyi lo gcen grongs (spyi lo bcu gnyis755) sriduloso 816) par /spratrī ṭā/dā gzigs/rta spyi lo778)ral pa me khyi(spyi bcu gnyis yab so drug can/ lo806)'das nas srid lcags bya(spyi bskyangs(me bya lo841)spyi lo817)dar ma/ chu lug mchan bu (spyi lo r+shat+t+waṃm 803) par lnge— gluṭ+wāṃspu/k+ṣiṃpy-i ṭāng sadan shing bzhi par gcen nga bzhi me byadapal 'byor legs/ 'brug grongs srid (spyi logyis mdzad (spyi lo bzhes(bzhi 817)༵shāṭā ༵nga 764) par me lugadi'abyed/ spyilo767) 83

'khrungs srid bzhes lo/41 me khyi(spyi bcu gnyis srid lo806) bzhes lo nyer bzhi bzung (bcu gnyis me bya spyi lo817)chu lug(spyi lo dgu par lo803) ral pa can grongs(lcags bya spyi lo841)me khyi(spyi bcu gnyis pa lo806) me bya(spyi lo817) chu lug(spyi so dgu pa lo803) lcags bya/ (spyi lo841)

1she—thegabasdotha/sprang 'o//spyoḥsebazhi khrag cen lnga/durīg/ sal ba/ rgyal po/ lo/ byud ba sa lo/ 'das lo/ zur —na/ge daram/ chulug sbya/kyābye chu khyi (spyi lo(803) (spyi lo841) 842)ngor chen sad na lo bzhi la rgyal —dkon mchog legs/ srid bskyangs/na grub kyi chos 'byuṭā ༵ ṭ+wāṃspyadro — 'jug pa'i gru chen/ ral pa me khyi(spyi bcu gnyis yab so drug lcaṭa can/ lo806)'das rgyal sar bya(spyi lobarton/ me bya 841)(spyi lo817)dar ma/ chu lug(spyi so dgu pa lcaṭa chu khyi/ (spyi —lo803) bya/ (spyi lo lo842)841)86

rī——thoXpe rngo||rto — —da wa tre ladab — —d+ku rgyal po/ 'a sa srid bzhes lo/ 'das lo/ zur don/ du gsal ba/ lo/kyāshāshā kāk+to sad na shing stag shing lug (spyi dus mdzad legs/ (spyi lo lo815)༵ ༵/ ༵'i 774)gdung rabs tshig nyung don gsal /ral pa chu rta (spyi bcu bzhi par zhe gcig cam/ lo 802ki srid bzhes lo lcags bya(spyi / 7 nyer bdun lo 841)bskyangs(bcu bzhi pa shing lugasbyi lo815) dar ma/ shing lug ṭīr+shabyināspya dṛṭa chu phag (spyi lo(spyi lo hūṃdhorasna bdurno 843)815) lcaṭa bya841)sngam pa ye dar ma/ me 'brug lo lcags bya —shāṭ+wā / dh+ril srid bzung nas (spyi lochos 'byung 7 lo drug bskyangs 841)dpag bsam (spyilo836)na bzang /87

lo tshigs re'u mig nang gsal bar dpyad pa'i mchan bu/dang po/ mkhas pa lde'u'i bzhed pa/ sad na legs kyi 'khrungs 'das lo rtags rang bzhed ltar bzung na srid bskyangs lo bco brgyad min pa sride lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad bskyang dgos pa/gnyis pa/ ral pa can gyi lo tshigs skabs rang bzhed yab sad na legs lcags lug spyi lo 791 lor gshegs skabs ral pa can dgung lo bcu gnyis la phebs dgos pa las dgung lo gnyis pa ra bzhag na mi 'grig pa dang / ral pa can gyi dgung grangs/ la gzhigs na dgung lo bcu gnyis la srid bzhes pa'i dbang du btang rung srid bskyangs lo nyi shu rtsa dgu yin dgos pa las srid lo bcu gnyis la bzhag na mi 'grig pa/ gsum pa/ dar ma 'u dum btsan gyi skabs bltams lo nas rtsis pa'i dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i skabs yab sad na legs gshegs nas lo bcu gcig song zin pas rang bzhed 'khrungs 'das lo tshigs 'dir gzhigs na sad na legs gshegs pa'i lo der dar ma 'khrungs dgos pa/bzhi pa/ mkhas pa sde'u'i chos 'byung gi sad na legs kyi srid bskyangs lo'i skabs dgung 'o nyer gsum na yab gshegs nes pa shing stag spyi lo774lor babs pas lde'u rang bzhed yab khri srokyire lde'u btsan lcags glang spyi lo 7smo1lor babs nga sa khri srong sde skubatsan sku 'das nas lo bcu gsum song zin pas 'khrungs 'das 89

lo tshigs 'di rang la gzhigs na dgung lo bcu gsum la srid bzung nas srid so sum cu so bdun bskyang dgos pa lta bu dang mu no btsan po'i skor chad pa'i skyon bcas so//lnga pa/ ral pa can gyi srid bskyangs lo'i lo tshigs skabs ral pa can dgung lo nyer gnyis pa chu lug spyi lo 803 lor babs pas de skabs sad na legs gshegs nas lo bcu gnyis song bas sad na legs gshegs skabs ral pa can dgung lo dgu pa dang /de nas srid lo sum cu so bdun bskyang dgos pa/drug pa/ dar 3/'e lo tshisgre/sa skabs lo dgu pa'i skabs sa sbrul spyi lo 789dang sum cu'i skabs lcags byi spyi lo820so drug skabs me lug spyi lo 827bcas la babs pas rang bzhed sad na legs dang /ral pa can gyi 'khrungs 'das lo tshigs la gzhigs na yab 'das pa las lo brgyad 'dis phyi ba dang / ral pa can 'das pa las lo bdun gyis snga ba/ dar ma rang nyid gshegs lo las lo ngo gsum gyis snga ba'i skyon/bdun pa/ nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyi chos 'byung gi sad na legs kyi skabs 'das lo me byar cha bzhag na spyi lo 817la babs pas dgung lo bdun cu bzhugs dgos pa dang / dgung lo lnga bcu nga bzhir cha bzhag na 'das lo sa yos spyi lo799la babs pa gang yin brtag dgos pa'i gnad don 'di 'das lo me bya nas yar k+ṣ-ireded byis 'khrungs lo shing 'brug spyi lo764lor babs pa 'di ni 90

rgyal rabs gzhan dang mthun che la skabs 'di'i 'khrul gzhi yang sel thub/brgyad pa/ ral pa can gyi skabs dgung lo bcu gnyis par rgyal sar bton skabs yab gshegs nas lo bdun song ba'i skyon gyis rang bzhed lo tshigs ltar na dgung lo lnga par srid skyong dgos pa/dgu pa/ dar ma'i skabs 'khrungs 'das lo tshigs kha gsal med pa srid lo bcu dgu par bzung ba'i tshig 'gros nas 'khrungs 'das lo tshigs bkod pa yin/bcu pa/ ne'u chos 'byung gi lo tshigs sa chen rgyal rabs kyi rjes su 'brang ba zhig yin 'dug cing / sa chen gyis ral pa can gyis srid lo — bcu gsum par bzhes pa zhib rtsis skabs lo gcig gi khyad zhugs pa de dgung lo bcu gnyis par yab 'das zhes zhib cha gnang 'dugabacu gcig pa/ rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long nang ral pa can sogs ldeng khri'i sras su bzhed pas sad na legs kyi tshab tu sdeng khri'i lo tshigs 'god gnang mdzad pa/bcu gnyis pa/ yar lungs jo bo'i chos 'byung gi sad na legs kyi lo tshigs skabs bltams lo shing lug spyi lo 755lor bzhag tshe dgung lo lnga bcu nga bzhi pa ni lcags stag spyi lo 810 lor gshegs dgos pas gshegs lo me bya zhes pa spyi lo 817lor babs pas dgung grwangs nas brtsis na lo khyad drug zhugs pa des gshegs lo me bya 91

der cha bzhag ste yar 'ded byas na bltams lo sa yos spyi lo739lor babs pa 'di dang gcen grongs srid lo sum cu so gnyis baspya ngas pa yang mthud thub/bcu gsum pa/ yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed nang gi sad na legs kyi lo tshigs skabs lo bzhi par gcen grongs srid la bkur zhes pa me lug spyi lo 767 lor babs pa dang rang bzhid mu no btsan po cha ra stag spyi lo 762 lor 'khrungs te dgung lo so dgu pa lcags 'brug spyi lo 800 lor babs pa'i lo tshigs gnyis mi mthun pa bcas la zhib tu dpyad par zhu/ 9lha

dar ma'i sku mched dang chos bsnu bas nga 'i sgyen/ 1re/ 1jo /reshā ༷༷/ba ra gang sku ma da ba ba/ gzhon gyi go chos bsnubs pa'i rkyen/du gsal ba/ rim /mkhas pa lhan rje lhun dar ma ni the rang srin po la sogs pa'i skye ba ldo'u'i chos grub/ dang / blon po'i ngan bskul 'og rgyal khrims 'byung / ral pa can/ chos kyi dbang du shor dgos pa/gtsang ma/ —dar ma/ rilde'u jo sras lha rje lhun grub/ rgyal blon gnod sbyin spun bzhi'i skye ba log chos 'byung / ral pa can/ smon gyi mthu dang rje snyan tshud la dgyes shing gtsang ma/ zhang blon khe rngam che ba'i snyan phra/ rgyal srid dar ma/ chos la shor dogs nas rje mis chos spangs pa/chos 'byung ral pa can/ bod 'bangs chos la gnag pa kun gyis me tog snying gtsang ma/ dbas to re chos pa mi dga'e ba sogs phyi po/ dar ma/ nang gi blon por bskos pa tshos khrims dang lha rje lhu na grub/ 'gal ba mang du byas/ lo gcig chos dang khri chen 'de'u/ mthun pa tsam byung ste btsan po sku dbang skyes pa dang 'gyur te blon po dang chos bsnubs pa'i gros byas/dzi— — sbyo/()

deb ther sku mched bgres gang du gzhon gyi go chos bsnubs pa'i rkyen/gsal ba/ rim/ —sa chen rgyal gtsang ma/ bar ma glang dar ma sprel mgo mi sdug la glen rabs dar ma/ pa/ zla ba drug tshul ngan gyi rgyal po byas/ral pa can/ lcags bya'i mjug dam chos bsnubs/no'u chos gtsang ma/ zla ba drug rgyal po tshul bzhin byas/ dus 'byung / dar ma/ der lha sar sad ser dang mi phyugs la nad ral pa can/ byung bar bsnyad btags/ lcags bya chos bsnubs/rgyal rabs gtsang ma/ sdig blon dbang che bas bdud kyi sprul pa/gsal ba'i ral pa can/ chos la mi dga' ba sdig pa'i sems ldan glang me long / dar ma/ dar 6la por bskos te chos bsnubs/bu ston chos ralapa can/ dbas to re sogs blon pos chos khrims dngasdi 'byung / gtsang ma/ 'gal ba mang du byas/ btsan po nar son pa dar ma/ dang thugs su gdon gsol te chos bsnubs/lha rje lhun grub/deb ther khri chen po/ glang dar ma rgyal sar bskos te re zhig tshul dmar po/ gtsang ma/ bzhin byas kyang blon po sdig la dga' ba dar ma/ rnams kyis kha bsgyur ba dang nu bo ral pa can ral pa can/ rgyal sar bskos pa'i snying nad kyis chos 94 lharjelhunagrub/ bsnubs/

deb ther sku mched bgres gang du gzhon gyi go tshos bsnubs pa'i rkyen/gab/shā/ ba/ rim/ riyar lung jo ༷༈dī ma/ glang dar ma rgyal sar bton pas/ dbang bo'ichos wa~X ༵ can/ stag rna can la sogs pa sdig blon rnams kyis 'byung / lhun rje lhuṅge bslus te rgyal po'i thugs su gdon gsol grub/ nas bsnubs so// rirgya bod yig gtsang ma/ rgyal srid bzung nas lo gnyis rgyal po tshul tshang mkhas daram/ bzhin byas/ chu phag lo gzhug nas thugs pa dga' ral pa can/ la gdon gsol/ blon pos kha bsgyur/ sngar zengasne lhun rje lhun nu bo la rgyal srid bskos pa'i snying nad bcas 7 sne grub/ kyis bstan pa bsnubs/ gyol rabs gtsang ma/ dar sdig blon rnams kyi 'dod pa bzhin rgyal sar 'phral gyi lde ma/ ral pa bton/ the'u rang dbang rgyal to re na blon mitrī can/ lhan rje du bskos/ btsan po'i thugs su gdon / ‘myun grub/ gsol nas chos bsnubs/mkhas pa'i gtsang ma/ ba lang gi sha chu gas 'dra zhing / mkhyen pa chung dga' ston/ dar ma/ la rgyud gyong bas 'bangs kyis glang dar mar ral pa can/ btags/ blon po dbas stag rna can gyis byas/ lo gnyis rgyal po tshul bzhin byas/de'i tshe sad ser nad yams byung bar bsnyad btags nas chos bsnubs/95

deb ther sku mched bgres gang du gzhon gyi go chos bsnubs pa'i rkyen/gsal ba/ rim/ bstan rtsis lha rjelhun grub/—srid lo gcig dang phyed bskyangs pa'i lo phyed gsal ba'i gtsang ma/ nas rgyal po gdon gyis bslus te chos nyin byed/ dar ma/ bsnubs/ ral pa can/bstan pa'i — the'urang dbas rgyal to re nang blon du bskos rgya mtshor pa de la sogs pas chos khrims dang 'gal 'jug pa'i ba mang du byas/ btsan po rang rgyud ngan la gru chen/ thugs la gdon gsol/ mtha' mjug zla drug tshul ngan pas bstan pa bsnubs/rgyal raṭ+wāṃs gtsang ma/ rgyal blon gyi thugs la mu stegs bram ze lta ba nga/ser — ral pa can/ log pa'i phung 'gong zhugs te chos bsnubalas/phreng ba/ dar ma/ bod rje lha ral pa can/ grogs stobs kyis dar mas kyang 'bri yi btsan po'i dar ma/ gtsug lag khang sogs bzhengs/ srid thob gdung rabs nas lo gcig 'jig rten phal spyod rnal ma tshig nyung dang / de nas sdig grogs kyiṭa4 gdon gyis don gsal/ bskyod cing gdon gyis bslus nas tshul ngan 96 / spyod pa zladrug de nas bstan pa bsnubs/

1de/ 1jo /remi ༷dro/ba ra sku ma da ba sdo/ nga du gzhon gyi go chos bsnubs pa'i rkyen/gsal ba/ rim/ chos 'byudz+wa ral pa can gyis rab tu byung bar srid zhu dpag bsam gnang bar khros nas glang dar dang sdig blon ljon bzang / sba stag sogs kyis lha sras mon la smyugs/ral pa can bkrongasu pa'i lo der srid byāzung bas log smon gyi mthu grub ste chos bsnubs/ —dpyid kyi gtsang spa/ —dar ma khrir bkod/ sbas stag rnas nang blon rgyal mo'i glu lha rje lhun grub/ byas te sad ser nad yams byung bar bsnyad dbyangs/ dar ma/ btags chos bsnubs/ral pa can/ dar rgyas ral pa can/ —dbas rgyal to re nang blon du bskos pa sogs gsal sgro na/ dar ma/ kyes chos khrims dang 'gal ba mang du byas/btsan po na lon pa dang thugs la gdon gsol nas chos bsnubs/ grangs dpal sku bsrungs la bzhag pa ma gtogs bon gyi bstan pa yang med/ 97

skabs bzhi pa/ pod si la bu'i dus skabs kyi btsan po'i gdung rgyud mnga' bdag 'od srungs dang yum brtan gnyis kyi 'khrangs dus skor/dang po/ mnga' bdag 'od srungs dang yum brtan 'khrungs dus skor/bod kyi lo rgyus deb ther nang khri dar ma 'u dum btsan pos btsun mo che ba sna nam bza' (la lar 'bal 'phan bza' mar 'bod) dang / chung ba tshe spong bza' btsan mo 'phan zhes bya ba gnyis snga rjes khab tu bzhes pa'i sras yum brtan dang / 'od srungs gnyis yab grongs pa'i snga rjes su'am/yang na dus mnyam du 'khrungs par bzhed pa/ mang che bar yum brtan ni dar ma'i sras ngo ma ma yin par smra ba sogs bzhed tshul ci rigs 'byung ba 'di ni smad sil chad kyi btsan po'i gdung rabs kyi mdzad pa dang / skabs de'i lo rgyus la zhib 'jug byed par gal che ba'i lhu tshigs dang / gnad don rnyog 'dzing shin tu che ba nges par thag gcod dgos pa'i don zhig (spun/ci 1 lo rgyus dum bu 'di'i thad deb ther khag gi banaid pa 'dra min 98

skor/cimakhas pa lde'u dang / lde'u jo sras kyi chos 'byung nang 'od srungs ‘‘sprel lo yun bu bla sgang du bltams’’zhes dang / 'od srungs yum gyi mngal na gnas pa'i tshe yab grongs pa'i rjes la song bas rngan byung gi dogs nas blon po rnams kyis nub mo mar me sbrar nas ting khri'i khar yum cheno btsan mo 'phan gzim du bcug ste srung skyob byas nga/sa mtshan yang gnam lde 'od srungs su btags pa dang / yum brtan ni 'od sungar bltams pa'i nub mo 'bal bza' 'phan rgyal te sna nam bzas sngon nas rang gi gsus par 'beb glan nas sbrum byaṣ+ka te skabs der bu chung gcig nyos pa skyes ma thag pa ma rnyed pas se'u tsheg ge ba zhig byung ba de rang la bltams khul byas par blon po rnams kyis bltas pas se'u tsheg ge 'dug pas mdang bltams pa'i sras la so dung so 'khor ba mi srid de yum gyi bka' brtan du chug ces mtshan yang yum brtan du btags pa/ khong gnyis mnyam por phyes pa'i khul du byas nas phu bo su byed la ma 'chams par dbu g.yor 'khrugs (mkhas pa lde'u'i chos 'byung lcags par 4shog grangasashāsnyo9) pa'i skor 'khod/sa chen rgyal rabs nang // 'od srungs yum brtan dag ni spun yin te//'ong/ srungs chu mo phag la 'om bur skyes//(rgyal rabs bris ma shog grangs gyin) zhes gsal ba dang / ne'u parnye ta'i bzhed pa yang de dang sa/cig mthun yin pa/— 99

rgyal rabs gsal me'i nang ‘‘rgyal po sdig can bkrongs pa'i rjes su btsun mo chung ba gcig la gdung rgyud kyi sras ltor byung ba dang / btsun mo che pha'i bsam pa la 'dis bdag gi mnga' thang la gnod par nges bsams te lus la gos kyis dkris te nga la'ang sras lto bor cig yod do zhes bu chung che rdzun byas so/ /der btsun mo chung ba'i zla dus thim pa dang / gdung tshorgyud yin nges kyi sras 'khrungs te sku shin tu gces pas nyin mo ni mis bskor/ mtshan mo ni mar me'i 'od kyis bsrungs phas mnga' bdag 'od srungs zhes zer ro/ /der btsun mo che bas kyang sprang po'i bu chung skyes ma khad cig nyos nas sha la sbyar te/ nga la'ang 'di skyes pa yin no zer bas/thams cad the tshom za bar gyur kyang / yum btsum/ mo dbang che bas smra ma nus te yum ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin brtan du chug pas mnga' bdag yum brtan zhes zer ro’’/ / (rgyal rabs gsal me lcags par ma shog grangs 338)zhes dang /bu ston thams cad rma khyen pas ‘‘glang dar ma'i btsun mo chen mas nga sras sbrum pa yin byas te/ bu chung btsal nas nga la mdang skyes pa yin byas te bstan pas/ blon po rnams na re/ mdang skyes pa'i bu chung la so mi 'byung ste/ yum gyi bka' brtan du chug gsungs pas yum brtan zhes grags mi zhes dang / btsun mo chun mar sraṭa gcig shing mo glang la 'khrungs/ chen mas bsad dam phrogs kyis dogs nas nyin mo nyi ma'i 'od dang mtshan mo mar me'i 'od rgyun mi 'chad par byas te bsrungasashrī pas 'od sru ngas su grags te rgyal sar bton te lo drug cu rtsa gsum la 'das 100

so//’’ (bu ston chos 'byung shing par ma shog grangs 14snyon)zheso dang /btsan po'i gdung rabs tshig nyung don gsal nang / ‘‘be'u (khri dar ma 'u dum btsan por be'u zhes 'bod pa ni 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ sa srungs dang ni be'u dang / /'od ldan nyid ni phyi ma yin/ ’’zhes lung bstan par grags pa'i be'u ni glang dar mar ngos 'dzin pa yin) dar ma la sras kyi btsun mo gnyis mnga' ba'i chun ma tshe spong bza' btsad mo 'phen la lcags bya lor mngal du chags pas chu khyi 'char ba na khye'u mtshan dang ldan pa zhig btsas pa chen mas 'phrog gam bsad par dogs nas mel tshe dang / mtshan mo mar me'i phreng bas bskor nas bsrung bas mtshan yang 'od srungs su chags / 'od srungs bltams pa'i lo phyi ma rgyal po be'u gshegs skabs sna nam bza' la khye'u zhig byung ba blon po rnams la bstan pas skyes ma thag so yod pa the tshom yang yum gyi bka' btsan pas brtan du chug smras pas mtshan yang yum brtan du chags’’/ (btsan po'i gdung rabs tshig nyung don gsal bris ma shog grangs 8ba)zhes 'khod yod pa bcas so//3 bzhed tshul de dag la dpyad pa/ sras gnyis 'khrungs pa'i dus tshod thad/ deb ther phal mo cher yab dar ma gshegs rjes sras gnyis 'khrungs par bzhed cing / la las 'od srungs yab ma gshegs gong 'khrungs pa dang yum brtan yab gshegs rjes 'khrungs par bzhed pa'i skor mkhas pa so sos sgrub byed rgyu mtshan mang du gsungs par bsam gzhigs dgos pa gzhir bcas kyang / sras gnyis po'i mtshan bla dwags ma yin pa 'brel ba rgyu mtshan can la dpyad na 'od 101

srungos dang / yum brtan gnyis dus mnyam la 'khrungs pa min pa gsal por snang zhing / 'on kyang snga rjes kyi khyad par de nyim/ gcig gam/ yang na zla gcig tha na lo'i khyad par gang zhig chas/sa/ pa der thug pa dang /'khrungs dus snga phyi'i khyad par de la brten nas 'od srungs kyi sku phywar 'tshe ba 'byung dogs kyi mel tshe bya dgos pa byung / de yang blon po ngan pa'i g.yo sgyu'i dbang du song ste btsun mo chen chun thugs snang mi mthun pa'i snang tshul tshabs che ba dar ma ma gshegs gong du yang yod pa mngon gsal che/dper na chen ma sna nam bza'‘‘dbang che ba’’dang chun mar sras 'khrungs pa ‘‘'dis bdag gi mnga' thang la gnod par nges bsams te gdung sras rdzun ma bzo lugs/ lhag par 'od srungs mar me'i 'od la bsrung dargas pa‘‘ chen mas bsad dam 'phrog par dogs’’nas mar me'i 'od dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bsrungs pa'i bshad tshul 'di dag gis 'od srungs kyi sku la 'tsho ba 'byung ba'i gzhi chen mar thug pa 'di ni lo rgyus dngos shig yin snyam/spyir rgyal po'i btsun rma phal che bas 'byung 'gyur rang gi gnas bab dang / mnga' thang gi ched rang la rgyal po'i rigs sras yong ba'i re ba dang de dag gi thabs la 'bad pa/ rigs sras byung na rang gi srog las gces par bzung ste gso skyong byed pa/ rigs sras ma byung na mya ngan byed pa dang / gdung sras bltams pa'i btsun mo gzhan la phrag dog byed pa/ tha na tshul min gyi spyod pa 'dzin pa 'ga' zhig gis btsun mo gzhan gyi rigs sras med par bzo ba'i thabs la 'bad pa bcas ni ha las datho/sa pa'i don min la gnad don phyi ma gnyis phud pa'i gzhan ma rnams ni spyir btang gi snang 10lha

tshul yang yin/ lhag par sna namā bza'i spyod pa dang sbyar na 'od srungs mar me'i 'od dang bcas te bsrung dgos byung ba de yang lo rgyus kyi don dngos shig yin shas kha ba des sras gnyis 'khrungs dus la khyad par che tsam yod pa gsal bshad thub pa bcas skabs de'i gnas tshul mang por zhib tu dpyad na 'od srungs dang yum brtan bltams pa'i dus ni kaḥ thog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus btsan po'i gdung rabs tshig nyung don gsal nang bstan pa ltar/ 'od srungs bltams pa'i dus ni yab dar ma ma gshegs gong ste chu khyi spyi lo 84kra lor yum bu bla sgang du bltamasdo pa dang /yum brtan ni yab dar ma gshegs pa'i lo ste chu phag spyi lo 843lor bltams pas khong gnyis dbar dgung khyad lo gcig yod par bzhed pa ni 'thad ldan yin pa rgyu mtshan mang po nas gsal por mthong thub/(1) bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas chos 'byung gsung rab rin po che'i mdzod nang yum brtan gyi 'khrungs lo gsal bar ma gsungs kyang /lo rgyus smra ba mang pos dar mas srid bskyangs lo drug tu bzhed pa ltar bu ston gyi bzhed pa yang de tsho dang mthun 'dra bas 'od srungs ni dar ma ma gshegs gong 'khrungs par rtsis chog de yang bu ston chos 'byung las/‘‘glang dar ma'i btsun mo chen mas nga la sras sbrum pa yin byas te bu chung btsal nas nga la mdang skyes pa yin byas te bstan pas blon po rnams na re/ mdang skyes pa'i bu chung la so mi 'byung ste/ yum gyi bka' brtan du chug gsungs pas/ yun brtan zhes grags te ’’/ zhes dang / ‘‘btsun mo chun ma'i pug la sras gcig shing mo glang la 'khrungs/— 103

chen mas bsad dam phrogs kyis dogs nas nyin mo nyi ma'i 'od dang /mtshan mo mar me'i 'od rgyun mi 'chad par byas te bsrungs pas 'od srungs su grags te/ rgyal par bton te ’’ (bu ston chos 'byung shing par ma shog grangs 145da 1bhesmo bar )zhes 'byung ba rnams dkyus gcig tu bsgrigs nas dpyad na/ yum brtan thog mar gsungs pa ni sras gnyis kyi bgres gzhon mtshon pa min la btsun mo che chung gi dbye bas chen ma'i sras sam/ che srid kyi gnas tshul sngon du gsungs pa dang / de yang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa'i gnas lugs 'phros mtshams yum brtan 'khrungs pa'i skor gsungs pa de'i bgros nas dar ma gshegs rjes yum brtan byung ba mtshon pa/ 'od spungs skabs 'khrungs lo gsal por gsungs pa de ni dar mas lcags bya srid bzung nas lo lnga 'gro skabs 'od srungs bltams/phyis rgyal sar bton pa'i gnas lugs nas 'od srungs gcen po yin par the tshom ma dgos pas 'od srungs dar ma ma gshegs gong bltams pa'i sgrub byed nus ldan thon pa/ —(2) dar ma gshegs rjes 'od srungs rgyal srid la bton pa/'od srungs dang yum brtan gyi bgres gzhon ni 'od srungs gcen po dang yum brtan gcung por grub pa yig rigs 'ga' nas mtshon pa dang /spyir btsan po'i rigs sras la gcen gcung gi khyad par las bltams ma thag tu 'di ni mchog go 'di ni dman pa'o zhes pa'i dbye ba byar med kyang / yum gyi ngos nas bshad na bdag po'i brtsi mthong dang / phyogs gtogs blon po'i dbang grags/ btsun mo'i rang gshis kyi khyad par sne04

bcas 'a/sa 'tsho ba dngos nang sras la brtsi mthong gi khyad par 'byung srid pa dang / lha/ga par yum mi gcig pa'i rgyal sras rgyal sar 'don skabs sras bgres gco/na byi 'os bab kho nar rag ma lus sdo gnad don gzhan gyi shan zhugs srid nga/ ni smos ma dgos shing / lhag par spyi tshogs thog yo 'khyom chen po thebs pa ste dar ma'i dus mjug la ni de bas kyang shugs rkyen che ba thebs rgyu gor ma chag gzhan yang dar ma'i btsun mo gnyis kyi nang nas chen ma sna nam bza' ni dbang shugs che la dar mas bstan pa snub skabs dar mar rgyab nas bkod jus gtong ba dang ngan skul byed kyi yod pa dper na/ chos 'byung mab/ sa pa'i dga' ston nang drangs pa yig tshang rnying pa khag cig las ‘‘ rgyal pos da ni chos thams cad ngas bsnubs so zhes nga rgyal du mu cor smras pas btsun mo chen ma na re/ da dung gtsang rong snubs yul na snubs sangs rgyas ye shes bya ba'i sngags pa nus pa can 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa dang / yer pa'i brag khung na lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa po dngos grub thob pa yod de rgyal pos sngar bsad spyugs phab pa thams cad las de gnyis lhag go zhes smras pas khros te gnyis ka la pho nya btang ste bkug pas snubs sangs rgyaṭa/ ye shes bya ba la khyod su yin/ las su ci byed pa yin dris pas/ nga dkon mchog sngags pa bya ba/ las su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ba yin byas pas/ 'o na bstan pa ngas bshig zin gyis khyed la nus pa ci yod zer bas ngas sngags bzlas pa'i nus pa 'di la gzigs shig ces sdig mdzub gnam du 'phyar bas sdig mdzub kyi steng na 105

lcags kyi sdig pa nag po g.yag grus po tsam dgu brtsegs su 'dug pa mthong bas rgyal po skrag ste dkon mchog sngagaso pa'i sku la mi bsdo'o chos mdzod cig zer/ da dung nus pa 'di la gzigs shig zer nas sdig mdzub kyis thog phab ste pha ri'i brag la bsnun pas tshal bar song / der rgyal po 'jigs shing skrag nas khyed 'khor bcas la gnod pa mi byed do zer nas btang /khong gis yer par phyin te ngas rgyal po sdig can skrag par byas yo/pa / kyis khyod kyis sgrol cig zer nas bskul te bkrongs zhes kyang 'byung ngo ’ / /(mkhas dga' lcags par ma shog grangs bhe38)zhes dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas gzhan lugs su gsungs pa 'idi'i thog nas sno nam bza' yang blon po gdug pa'i sems ldan dbas stag rna can la sogs pa'i phyogs khag der gtogs par the tshom ma datho/sa la dar ma rang nyid kyang btsun mo des kha lo bsgyur thub pa gsal por mtshon/des na dar ma bkrongs rjes dar ma'i sku mched gzhan med pa'i gnas tshul 'og btsun mo chen ma'i gnas bab dang bcas de bas kyang rgyal srid la jus gtogs byed srid par the tshom med/ gal srid dar ma'i sras gnyis po 'khrungs dus mnyam pha'am/ yang na de skabs yum brtan 'khrungs zin yod na chen ma sna nam bza'i bkod jus 'og yum brtan rgyal sar 'don pa las 'od srungs 'don mi srid pa tshig thag bcad nas bshad choga'on kyang dar ma gshegs rjes btsan po'i khri la 'od srungs 'ardon par sna nam bzas 'gog rkyen gang yang bzo thub med pa de'i thog nas yum brtan da dung 'khrungs med pa ra 'phrod gsal po byung zhing / btsun mo che bas 106

rang gi lto bar yod pa'i gdung sras 'phral ma nyid du bltams na snyam pa'i re ba dang / rang gi lto bar yang gdung sras yod pa'i gnas lugs rgya cher bsgrags pa ni skabs de'i don dngos yin/'o na lo rgyus yig lam nang ‘‘gcen la ma 'chams dbu g.yor 'khrug’ ces 'byung ba ci yin zhe na/ 'di ni sras gnyis ka dar ma gshegs rjes 'khrungs pa'i bzhed pa 'thad ldan du 'dzin pa dang / de yang khong gnyis 'khrungs dus mnyam pa lta bur ngos 'dzin gyis dbu g.yor 'khrug pa'i rkyen ni sras gnyis gcen po sus byed pa'i gnad don la thug par gsung mod/'on kyang don dngos ni khong gnyis po'i 'khrungs dus ni yab gshegs ma gshegs kyi dus tshod kyi dbye bas gcen po sus byed kyi gnad don yot+na mi srid pas de ni 'od srungs kyis rgyal srid 'dzin bzhin du gnas pa gang zhig yum brtan phyogs gtogs kyis yum brtan yang btsan po'i gdungs sras gcig pa yin par bsnyad de 'od srungs kyi mnga' thang 'phrog rtsis byas pa'i 'gal ba rno ngar can la brten nas thog mar yum brtan rgyud kyis g.yo ru logs bcad kyis bzung bas phyogs khag gnyis chags pa dang / de rjes phan tshun drag po'i dpung shugs spyad de dbu g.yor gyes shugs je cher song mthar 'od srungs phyogs gtogs la pham nyes byung ba dang / rang bzhin bzang ba'i 'od srungs kyi yum tshe spong bza' btsan mo 'phan dbu rur bzhugs bzod mi bde bas dbu ru'i byang phyogs bros phebs pa lo rgyus yig lam mang por gsal po 'khod pa bcapa kyis sras gnyis po bgres gzhon gyis bab nas yum brtan la gcen po'i gnas bab thob thabs med 107

rung / yum brtan snyogs gtogs kha dbang dang dpung stobs che bas btsan po'i srid dbang kho tshos bzung thub par thabs brgya jus stong byas pa de mtshon pa yin/ gal srid sras gnyis po 'khrungs dus mnyam pas gcen gcung shan ma bye ba dngos 'brel yin na sna nam bza' dang de'i phyogs gtogs blon po dbang shugs che bas yab gshegs rjes srid dbang yum brtan gyis 'dzin rgyur the tshom yod re skan/'o na yum brtan dar ma'i sras ngo ma yin min la rtsod pa 'byung gzhi gang yin zhe na/spyir bod kyi mi rigs ni rang gi rigs rus cho 'brang gang yin gyi khungs la gtsigs cher 'dzin pa dang lhag par btsan po'i gdung rgyud ni gzhan las khyad par 'phags par brtsi ba'i gnas tshul 'og gdung sras rdzun bzo bya rgyu ni shin tu dka' ba'i gnas yin/ 'on kyang lo rgyus yin lam mang por dar ma 'u dum btsan gshegs rjes sna nam bzas thabs 'phrul du mas sa/dung sras rdzun bzo byas pa dang / blon po rnams kyis zur za'i gtam dang bcas te yum gyi bka' brtan du chug ces mtshan la yang yurna brtan zhes bya bar thogs pa btsan po'i gdung rabs su bzhag pa dang / de las gyes tshe'i lo rgyus mang po gleng du yod pa ni 'gal ba rno ngar can gnas pa skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul dmigs bsal can la brten nas ya mtshan can gyi bshad tshul de rigs 'byung bar lo rgyus kyi rgyu rkyen gnyis yod/(1) yum brtan bltams pa'i dus ni yab grongs pa'i rjes la song 108

ba'i rkyen gyis gdung rgyud ngo ma yen min la the tshom skye ba'i gzhi byung ba/(3) blon po'i khrod kyi 'gal ba tshabs chen de btsun mo chen chun dbar shugs rkyen chen po thebs pas sna nam bza' la sras 'khrungs par kha gtad phyogs kyis klan ka bya yul btsal te gdung sras dngos min pa'i rgyu mtshan du bltams ma thag pa'i khye'ur se'u tsheg ge yod pa la sogs pa rdzun bzo byed srid pa'i rang bzhin yong srid pa bcas yin/rgyu mtshan der brten skabs der yum brtan 'khrungs pa'i skor mang tshogs khrod bshad tshul ci rigs byung ba phyis lo rgyus smra ba'i khrod du yang bshad tshul de rigs bden par 'dzin dang mi 'dzin gyi bzhed pa khag gnyis rang bzhin gyis chags par mngon/ kho bos lo rgyus dum bu 'dir zhib tu dpyad pa'i sdom tshig ni bo rgyus smra ba'i gtsug rgyan sa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / dpū' bo gtsug lag phreng ba la sogs pa'i bzhed pa ni don la gnas pa yin/ de yang sa chen gyis/‘‘'od srung yum brtan dag ni spun yin te//'od srung chu mo phag la 'om bur skyes//zhes gsungs pa yang bskyar dran gso byas te‘‘spun yin’’pa zhes pa'i spun la pha spun dang / ma spun soṭa nye 'gyangs ci riṭa la bshad du rung yang /sna nam bza' dang tshe spong bza' ni rus tsho tha dad yin pas skabs der sa chen gyis gcen gcung gi spun rang la ngos 'dzin gnang ba dang / da dung de bas tshig thag chod pa dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas dar ma 'das rma 'i ‘‘phyi lo me mo yos la bcun mo chun ma tshe spong bza' btsan rma 'phan la lto 109

bor gyi sras gcig byung ba chen mas bsad dam phrogs kyis dogs nas 'od dang ma bral bar bsrungs pas gnam lde 'od srung du thogs/ de'i tshe chen ma sna nam bzas kyang bu chung so skyes pa zhig nga la mdang skyes so zhes bstan pas blon po rnams na re mdang skyes kyi bu chung so ni tseg ge tseg 'on kyang yum gyi bka' brtan du chug zer bas khri lde yum brtan du thogs zhes yi ge mang po las 'byung zhing / yum brtan gdung rgyud ma yin par grags na'ang rje tshan dgu po phal cher yum brtan gyi rgyud yin la gdung rgyud min na rje'i so kha gtor bar mi 'gyur bas cherne chun gyi sras gnyis gdung rgyuglu) khyad med du snang la yi ge de dag kyang 'od srung la zhen pa rnams kyis bris par zad do//’’ (mkhas dga' lcags par ma shog grangs 430) zhe gsungs pa ni don la gnas pa'i dpyad pa yongs su yid rton rung ba zhi ga yin/ gal te sna nam bzas dbang shugs spyad nas so 'khor mo skyes zin pa'i bu zhig mdang nga la skyes pa'i btsan po'i sras yin zhes rdzun bzo byas pa dngos 'brel zhig yin na/ 'bangs gyen ldog gi rjes su dus rabs de rang gi mang tshogs tshos dbus gtsang gi yul gru phal che bar yum brtan gyi gdung rgyud rang rang gi rje bor bkur ba'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni de dag bod btsan po'i gdung rabs yin pa kho na'i don du zad pas de lta bu yong mi srid pa ma zad/ chos 'byung rgyal rabs dag gi nang du'ang yum brtan gyi gdung rabs 'dren pa'i dgos pa de bas kyang yong ga la srid/ 'on kyang 'brel baṃ rgyu mayo+on gyis yum ba rtan gyi mtshan thogs stangs la bltas na yum brtan 'khrungs dus ni yab gshegs rjes kyi dus tshod cung phyi ba'am yang na gdung rgyud 110

min pa'i glan ka zhig byung nges la sna nam bzas gdung rgyud ngo ma yin pa'i khungs skyel zhig gnang dgos byung 'dra ba dang yum gyis gdung rgyud dngos yin pa'i gnas lugs ji ltar gsu/ngas pa de ltar don la brtan du chug ces gleng bar ba rtan nas mdz+wan yang de ltar thogs par ngos 'jin byas na 'grig/ tshogal srid yum brtan gdung rgyud ngo ma min pa'i bzhed pa de dag 'thad ldan yin na/ nyi lde nam mkha' bzang pos mdzad pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar snang ba me tog chun po'i nang ‘‘glang dar ma'i btsun mo chen mas mo rang gi ming po'i bu gcig lon pa la nga la bu btsas pa mdang skyes pa yin byas pa blon ngo/ rnamaṭa4 na re/ mdang skyes pa'i bu chung la so mi 'byung ste yum gyi bka' brtan du chug zer nas yum brtan zhes grags ’ / zhes 'byung ba dang / rgya'i thar yi sa/ rnying mar ‘‘btsan po la sras med pas mchims bza'i phu bo zhang yan li bya ba'i sras yum brtan (chi li hu'u ) bya ba btsan por bskos/ dgung lo gsum las so/na med pas btsun mos srid bskyangs ’’/ (thang yig gsar rnying las byung ba'i bod chen po'i sred lugs lcags par ma'i shog grang 33gyi)zhes 'khod pa yum brtan ni yum gyi rgyud par gtogs pa'i bu zhig rang la skyes pa yin khul du brdzus pa'i bshad tshul de dag la dpyad gzhi byed rin 'dug snyam pa skabs 'dir zhar la 'phros pa'i gtam tsam lags so//11sne

skabs lnga pa/ mnga' bdag gnam ldi 'od srungs dang dbu g.yor 'khrug pa'i skor/mnga' bdag 'od srungs ni khri dar ma 'u dum btsan dang khong gi btsun mo chun ma tshe spong bza' btsan mo 'phan gnyis kyi sras su chu khyi spyi lo 843 lor yum rbe bla sgang du 'khrungs/chu phag spyi lo 8bhe3 lor yab dar ma 'u dum— btsan lha lung dpal rdor gyis bkrongs rjes btsan po'i rgyal srid la dbang bskur zhing / blon po dgu khri thog sgra dang / rngog dpal gsum sgra che/ rngog rgyal to re rgyal rnams kyis byas/ dgung lo bzhi pa shing glang spyi lo 845lor phebs skabs chos la gnag pa'i blon po rnams kyis dar ma bkrongs rjes bstan pa la 'tshe ba ri bya ba mu mthud byas par rkyen ngan mang po 'phrad de shi ba la sogs pas phal che ba rtsa med du song ba dang / chos la dkar ba'i blon po rnams kyis kyang bskul bar brten bstan pa bsnubs pa'i bya ba mtshams 'jog thub pa sogs btsan po'i gdung rabs tshig nyung don gsal nang 'byung ba ltar lags/dgung lo lnga pa ‘‘me stag (spyi lo8bhegyi)la 'od srungs dang yum sne 11lha

brtan yang rten gyi spyan sngar skyabs 'gro khas blangs nas dkon mchog gsum lo mchod pa byas/ (btsan po'i gdung rabs tshig nyung don gsal bris ma shog grangs 93 na ) zhes dang / ‘‘de'i tshe mu ge dang yams nad byung / chos bshig pa'i blonatsho po rnams kyang bka' chad mi 'dra ba mang pos gum pas chos bshig pas lan par kha 'chams nas jo bo mched gnyis/byams pa chos 'khor rnams khri thog tu spyan drangs nas mchod pa byas/ rtaṭa rang gis blangs nas sham thabs gong ba can gon/ skra gzhan bregs gtsug phud bzhag pa dbyar zla gsum dbyar gnas byed zer nas gtsug lag khang du bsdad nas gtan khrims lnga srung / de nas dgag dbye byed zer te grong du khyim thab byed/ ming dgra bcom/ gtsug phud can zer ba mang po byung nas skye bo'i mchod gnas byed/ mi dar ma shi na 'bum/ gzhon pa la nyi khri/ byis pa la brgyad stong pa 'don/ klog mkhan shes rab che ba 'da' zung gis ṭika bklags nas dmar po 'di don bsdus pa de yin par 'duganag po 'dis de rgyas su 'chad par 'dug yug chung 'dis de la dogs pa dpyad par 'dug zer nas stsal bshad byed pa bag re byung / sngags pa phal cher yang sgrub thabs 'chad gdang / sgom pa med par bon po'i cho ga la mig ltos byas te sgrub/ gzhung ngag 'don du gyer nas grong chog 'grim/ sbyor sgrol dang bam sgrub dar bas mi la gson sgrol byed pa zhig byung / (mkhas pa'i dga' ston lcags par ma shog grangs bhekāX)zhes gsal ba ltar lta sgom cha ma tshang ba'i chos tshul tsam gyis 'tsho ba don gnyer byid mkhan gang sang khyab gdal chen po zhis/ byung bar mngon/113

de rjes gnam lde 'od srungs la lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes sman bya bde gshegs bdun gyi lung phul ba dang sman bla'i mdo chog la yi dam gyi snying por mdzad pa/ dkon ma4ོ ga gsum la gus pa chen po byas zhes gdung rabs tshig nyung don gsal (bris ma shog grangs brgyad pa dang dgu par gsal )nang 'khod pa gdung rabs dang / rgyal rabs gser gyi phreng ba'i nang du yang / ‘‘glang dar ma'i sras 'od srungs khong gis lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje nas sman bla'i mchod thog zhus nas smon lam btab/ sman bla'i byin rlabs kyis rgyal srid kyang zin/ mes gong ma rnams kyi bka' drin ltar chos khrims dang / chos gtsigs dam du bzhes te mnga' res chos bzhin du bskyangs so// ’ (rgyal rabs gser phreng bris ma shog grangs1rdzob)zhes 'od srungs la lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes sman bla mdo chog gi lung phul ba gcig mthug tu gsungs 'dug kyang 'thad par ma mthong ste lha lung dpal rdor gyis dar ma bkrongs nas khams su bros phebs pas 'od srungs sku nar son rjes chos 'bul ba'i skabs ga la yod/ nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyis/bstan pa'i me re bslangs pa'i skabs/ ‘‘de ltar tshul ji ltar bslangs na/dar ma'i sras khri gsham lde 'od srungs/ de'i sras dpal 'khor btsan/ de la bsam yas mchims phu'i sgrub pa po lha lung dpal gyi yon tan bya bas/mdo sde thar pa chen po'i phyag mchod/ spang skong gi phyag mchod/ de pa nin gshegs pa sman bla'i mdo chog rnams gtad ma/sa/ khyed sngon yab mes kun gyi bkra shis bde legs thams cad 'di las byung bas sgrubs shig gsungs nas gnang ngo //’’ (me tog snying po lcags par ma shog grangs 114rī

95smo)zhes dpal 'khor btsan gyi skabs su gsungs pa lha lung dpal gyi yon tan dang / lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje gnyis 'phrul gzhi byung bar mngon pas gang ltar nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyis gsungs pa'i 'od srungs kyi sras dpal 'khor btsan skabs kyi mchims phu'i sgrub pa po 'di la ngos bzung na khungs che bar mthong ngo //'od srungs dgung lo sum cu so drug pa sa phag spyi lo 879lo'i dus mdo khams su bstan pa cung zad dar/ de yang mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtshos/‘‘de ltar khri 'od srungs kyi dus su khams su bstan pa byung ba ji ltar zhe na/chos la 'jug pa'i sgo lar+sā / rgyal po de'i sras gnam sde 'od srungs dang /mched zla yum brtan gyis rgyal srid so sor bskos te/ de gnyis kyi sku ring la mdo khams rma lung rdo rje'i brag ra dan tig gi yang dkon na/ gtsang rab gsal dang / g.yo dge 'byung dang / smar shākya mu ne zhes bya ba'i dge slong gsum bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mdo smad de nyid na bon po'i rigs su gyur kyang / mes pas spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mo dur dgongs pa rab gsal zhes bya ba byung ste/ de sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad de/ sngar gyi dge slong gsum dang / rgya'i ha shang ke waṃ dang / kau phag dang / rnga po dang bcas pa las bsnyen par rdzogs par byas so/ /de dag la sogs te mdo smad kyi khams gsum du bstan pa cung zad dar bar gyur to/ /zhes baya/da pa las shes so (bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyin byed lcags par ma shog grangs phyo4)zhes gsu/ngas pa ltar lags/bsdoms na 'od sgangs dgung na phra mo'i dus nas sangs rgyas chos 115

lugs la dad mos gnang ba 'di'i thog nas yab kyi tha shal gyi mdzad spyod der spyi tshogs kyi rmang gzhi med pas rgyun rin gnas ma thub pa mtshon cing /lhag par 'od srungs kyis yab kyi mdzad rjes su ma 'brang ba de ni skabs cho de'i spyi tshogs kyi bsam pa'i 'khor phyogs dang / yum dang / blon po chos la dga' ba rnams kyi shugs rkyen thebs pa nus ldan gyi gsal bshad thub/'od srungs kyi sku tshe'i smad tsam la mdo khams su smar g.yo gtsang gsum las bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyis rab byung dang / bsnyen rdzogs bzhes pa sogs smad 'dul dar ba'i 'go tshugs pa tsam las/ gzhan dbus gtsang du 'od srungs yum brtan phyogs khag gnyis su gyes te mnga' ris la rtsod pa'i nang 'khrug kho na'i dbang du song ste bstan pa slar gso ba'i bya bar nus shugs gang yang 'don thub med/'jig rten srid phyogs nas bshad na/ dar ma 'u dum btsan pos sangs rgyas chos lugs bsnubs pa dang dus mtshungs sngar yab mes kyi srol —gtod dar spel gnang ba'i khrims srol khag rnams kyang nyams dmas su btang bas skabs shig ring spyi tshogs khyon yongs su lhing 'jags med pas mi rnams bzos mi bde ba dang / lhag par ‘‘btsun mo gnyis so so'i byogs blon 'bangs tha dad kyis bzung ste yum brtan kyis dbu ru dang / 'od srung gis g.yo ru bzung nas dbu g.yor 'khrug pa byas/ de'i phyogs bod yul phal cher la khyab ste yul gru re rer yang che srid chung srid mang chan nyung tshan gser pa g.yu pa sha zan rtsam zan zhes sde gnyis gnyis su chad de 11pu

rtsod/ nya’ (mkhas pa'i dga' ston lcags par shog grangasabhe31)ces dang / ‘‘mnga' bdag 'di gnyis sku nar ma son kyang / blon po chos la dga' ba rnams kyis zhus te/ jo bo rnam gnyis dang / byams mgon rnams sa 'og nas bton nas/ rang rang gi khri la bzhugs nas mchod pa byas/ lha khang zhig pa rnams slar gsos so/ /de nas srid la ma 'cham pas/'od srungs kyis g.yo ru bzung nas 'khrug pa byas so//’ (rgyal rabs gsal me lcags par ma shog grangs3shā8)zhes gsal ba ltar khong gnyis kyis bstan la phan pa'i bya ba 'ga' zhig bsgrubs thub na'ang / dbu g.yor gyi dus zing byung zhing / de nas rim bzhin 'khrug zing de bod yul phal cher la khyab ste yul gru rer yang yum brtan phyogs gtogs la che srid dang /'od srungs phyogs gtogs la chung srid ces pa btsun mo chen chun gyi srid lo thogs pa'i ming du zad cing / de min yum brtan phyogs gtogs blon po mang bas mang tshan dang / 'od srungs phyogs gtogs nyung bas nyung tshan/yum brtan phyogs gtogs blon po'i de snga'i thob thang zhan tsam mam yang na yum brtan rang nyid 'od srungs las gnas bab dma' ba gcung po yin pas gser pa dang / 'od srungs phyogs gtogs kyi thob thang de snga yum brtan las mtho bas g.yu pa yum brtan phyogs gtogs kyis dbu ru 'dzin pas skabs mude'i dbu ru'i srid 'dzin sa khongs zhib tu phye ba'i yig cha ma mngon rung 2/ srong btsan sgam po'i sku dus bod yul ru chen lnga ru bye ba'i srid 'dzin sa khongs kyi dbus tshad lha sa ra mo che la byas pa'i shar 'ol kha'i shug pa spun bdun zhes pa 'ol kha rdzong khongs la gnas pa/ lho rma la la brgyud 1 17

ces pa gtsang chabs dang skyid chu'i bar gyi ri rgyud/ nub gzhu snye mo zhes pa snye mo rdzong khongs gzhu/ byang prags kyi glang ma gur phub ces pa'i sa khul de ni g.yas ru'i shar gyi mtshams su yang brtsi ba tshod dpag byas na 'dam gzhung gi rgyud du yod par cha bzhag na 'grig gam snyam pa deng dus kyi srid 'dzin sa khongs la mtshon na rtsa ba'i cha nas grong khyer lha sa'i khyab khongs tsam la cha bzhag na 'grig gam snyam pa'i sa khul 'di rnams btsan po'i dus skabs su 'brog las shas che bas khul de tsho'i mang tshogs gyi 'tsho ba'i nang sha rigs spyod che bas sha zan dang / 'od srungs kyis 'dzin pa'i g.yo ru ni/ dbus tshad yar lung khra 'brug sne gdong rdzong khongs su yod pa dbus tshad du bzung ba'i shar kong yul bres sna zhes ga kong po nying khri rdzong khongs su yod pa/ lho sha 'ub/ ltag sgo zhes sa mtsho sna rdzong khongs legs po chus sha 'ug grong tsho/ nub kha rag gangs rtse zhes pa sna dkar rtse rdzong khongs dpal de chus kyi kha rag byang rma la la rgyud ru mtshams su brtsi ba deng dus la mtshon na rtsa ba'i cha nas lho kha sa khul la rtsis chog pa'i yul gru de tshor btsan po'i skabs nas zhing las gtso bar byed pas mang tshogs kyi 'tsho bar rtsam sa spyod shugs che stabs rtsam zan zhes thog ma dbu g.yor la thogs pa bcas ming de dag rjes su rim bzhin yul gru gzhan du yang phyo gas khag so sor de dang de'i ming gis mtshon par byas nas sde gzar yongs khyab tu byung bar mngon/'on kyang phyogs khag gnyis su gyes pa'i gnas tshul 'di ni dbu g.yor 'khrug pa'i thog ma'i dus skabs kyi gnas tshul yin/ 'di'i skabs 118

('od srungs phyogs gtogs blon po'i stobs shugs zhen pa'am nyung ba la sogs pa 'od srungs la pham kha byung ba mtshon kyang skabs de'i btsan po'i rgyal sa lho khar gnas pa da dung 'od srungs phyogs kyis 'dzin pa gsal por mthong thub/dbu g.yor 'khrug zing gi me lce de yul gru gang par khyab rjes dbus gtsang gyes shugs ji cher song ste mthar 'od srungs kyi sku tshe'i mjug g.yo rur gnas pa'i stobs shugs de yang brtan gnas ma thub pa gtsang phyogs su rim bzhin 'pho skyas byed dgos byung ba de dang kheng log dbar yang 'brel ba nges can zhig yod pa kheng log skabs kyi lo rgyus dmigs su bkar te gsham du brjod rgyu'i thog nas gsal lo/ /'od srungs kyi yum tshe spong bzang btsan mo 'phan yang dbu rur bzhugs bzod mi bde ba byung nas byang phyogs su bros byol gnang dgos la thug pa dang / btsan po'i rgyal rabs yab mes kyi gtsigs che ba'i dngos rigs te lo rgyus yig lam nas/‘‘nor sna bco brgyad ’’ces pa la sogs pa yang bsnams long ma byung ba yum brtan phyogs kyis 'khyer bar grags/ dbu g.yor 'khrug zing gi dus bde zhod 'jags med pa'i skabs de dang bstun nas 'od srungs dgung lo nyer drug pa sa glang spyi lo8snyo9lor 'bangs gyen log byung ba dang / dgung lo so bzhi pa me bya spyi lo87gyi lor btsan po rim can gyi bang so brus pa bcas kyi skor gsham du zhib tu 'phros par bya'o/ /btsan po 'di'i skabs phyi'i so kha shor ba yang / tshal pa'i deb dmar nang rgya'i thang yig las drangs par/ ‘‘me pho stag (spyi lo 845)la hon 119

dzung sgo bu gsum pa/ dz+ran dzung bskos/ de nas bod kyi sa cha thams cade/phal cher rgyas blangs/ dang po thang gi rgyal khams kin jang hu nas bod kyi bar la sa/ le bar stong tsho dgu dang dgu brgya yo da/ phyis dzung dzung nas bzung ste bod la mkhar mig sum brgya shor/ phyis thang gi thams cad thob/ drwan dzung lo bcu bzhi srid bzung / lo lnga bcu pa sa mo yos la 'das/ lcags pho 'brug (spyi lo 8a+yosgro)la de'i bu che ba k+shi dzung bskos/ de phyin chad bod la 'brel chad/ ’ (deb dmar lcags par ma shog grangs1kā)ces dang /‘‘bod kyi mnga' 'og na rgya'i sa cha mkhar mig sum brgya tsam yod pa yang rgya'i rgyal po rang la shor/ gzhan yang rgyal khams mang po mnga' 'og na yod pa thams cad la yang mnga' thang med/ mi (lo rgyus ngo mtshar chun po bshus deb shog grangs 'a3)ces dang / ‘‘me mo yos (spyi lo 8bhe7)thang zhon tsung li khrin/ ta krung khri lo gsum pa/ thang dmag gis lung yug gi rma chu dang / tsong chu'i rgyud kyi sa cha dbang du bsdus/ lcags pho rta (spyi lo 850) thang zhon tsung li khrin/ ta krung khri lo bzhi pa/ krang dbyi khra'o bya bas bkwa' krig dang / hra krig sogs krig bcu gcig thang gi dbang du tshud par byas/ zhes dang / lcags mo sbrul (spyi lo8phyo1)krang dbyi khra'o bya bas leng krig sa cha gong mar phul/ (thang yig gsar rnying las byung ba'i bod chen po'i srid lugs lcags par ma shog grangs 3kā7)zhes sogs bod rgya yig lam khag nang gsal bas 'od srungs dgudā lo bdun brgyad la phebs pa'i skabs nas bzung sngar btsan po'i skabs dbang du bsdus pa'i shar phyogs dang byang phyogs kyi sa cha rnams g.yul 'gyed kyi yo 120

lang gang yang ma dgos par thang dmag gis rim par dbang du bsdus pa dang thang bod 'brel ba'i rgyun yang re zhig chad par mngon no// skabs 'dir gsal bshad dgos pa zhig la 'od srungs kyi mdzad pa'am/ skabs de'i bya ba che rigs chos srid khag gnyis su gung sgrig pa'i rkyen gyis 'od srungs kyi dgung grangs dang / snga phyi'i go rim 'khrugs pa lta bu yong ba 'de dag dkyus gcig tu sgrig na/ 'od srungs dgung lo bzhi par yab kyis bstan pa bsnubs pa'i bya ba 'di skabs mtshams 'jog thub pa/dgung lo lnga par 'od srungs kyisasnarten gyi spyan sngar skyabs 'gro khas blangs nas dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa byas pa/ dgung lo bdun brgyad skabs thang dmag gis bod kyi shar phyogs dang / byang phyogs kyi sa cha dbang du bsdus pa/ dgung lo nyer drug pa'i skabs 'bangs gyen ldog byung ba/dgung lo so bzhi pa'i skabs bang so brus pa/ dgung lo so drug pa'i skabs mdo khams su bstan pa cung zad dar ba bcas so//'od srungs kyi sras dpal 'khor btsan 'khrungs pa'i skor bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba mchis pa gsham du re'u mig zur bstar bzhin skabs 'dir nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyi chos 'byung dang / sa chen rgyal rabs sogs kyi bzhed par bstun na lo tshigs 'grig che ba gsham du 'das lo'i skabs zhib tu 'phros rgyu ltar 'od srungs kyis cog re bza' rgyal mo khab tu bzhes par 'od srungs dgung lo lnga bcu pa chu glang spyi lo893 lor yar lungalha'aphang thang du sras dpal 'khor btsan 'khrungs pa yin/ 'od srungs sku gshegs pa'i lo tshigs la yang deb ther khag nang bzhed tshul mi mthun pa yod kyang dgung 13/
