lo drug cu re gsum lo la gshegs par bzhed pa de 'thad par mthong / de yang 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal gyis mdzad pa'i deb ther sngon po dang / thu bkwan chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa lcang rkya rol pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar nang bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal chu byi spyi lo 833 lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu pa lcags bya (spyi lo841 lor dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa sa phag spyi lo8gyi9lor tan teg tu phebs te smar g.yo gtsang gsum dang mjal te rab tu byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa/ de nas to/ tig tu lo sum cu so lnga bzhugs mthar dgung lo brgyad cu gya bzhi shing phag (spyi lo91'a)lor sku gshegs zhes gsal ba dang / mang thos klu sgrub kyi 'od srungs skabs khams su bstan pa dar ba'i lo rgyus gong du 'phros pa'i lo tshigs myo/thud thub la yum brtan 'das lo dang yang mthun la nye ba bcas sa chen rgyal rabs dang / ci bu ston chos 'byung sogs kyi bzhed pa ltar dgung grangs drug cu re gsum pa me yos spyi lo907lor yar stod 'phang thang du sku gshegs pa lags so//ma/spas pa rde'us/ ‘‘gsham ri 'od srungs rtse ros dug gis bkrongs/rgyu mtshan chen chun ma mthun pas so//(mkhas pa sde'u'i chos 'byung lca/gas par ma shog grangs37smo)zhes gsungs pa blded 0/ dmigs bsal can lta bur ma thong yang spyi tsho gas nang 'gal ba tshabs chen gnas pa'i skabs de'i lo rgyus dngos la gzhis/sa na de ltar yin srid pa'i rang bzhin che zhing / 'od srungs byi/ bang 132

so ni/'od srungs gral ni 'phrul rgyal rgyab na yod//ming ni skyes bu lha bsten bya ba lags//(mkhas pa lde'u'i chos 'byung lcags par ma shog grangs37smo)zhes gsungs pa ltar lags shing / btsan po'i bang so brtsigs pa'i srol yang de nas nub skad bcas bang so 'di ni btsan po'i bang so mtha' ma yang yin no//bsdoms na 'od srungs kyis srid dbang 'dzin pa'i dus skabs su sangs rgyas chos lugs la 'tshe ba'i 'phro chad pa dang / yab mes kyi thugs dam rten jo shāka rnams gnyis dang byams pa chos 'khor rang rang gi khri thog spyan drangs pa sogs bya ba bzang po mi nyung tsam bsgrubs yod mod/ 'on kyang dbu g.yor 'khrug ste rgyal srid dum bur gyes pas mi rnams 'khos su mi phebs pa dang dmag 'khrug gi rkyen pas thon skyed nyams rgud khar sad ser la sogs pa'i rang byung gnod 'tshe dang / mi nad phyugs nad kyang thengs kha mar byung ba sogs lo rgyus deb ther mang che ba'i nang dar ma pha spad gsum la bsod nams zad pa'i rgyal po zhes grags so/123

mnga' bdarga/ 'od srungs kyi 'khrungs 'das lo tshigs re'u migadeb ther/ —zid wad — tshis/sa/d+ngha ——da 'khrungs lo ba//ngas lo/ 'das lo/ gsal bshad/mkhas pa sprel (srid zhe lnga pa glang rang bzhed lo tshigs lde'u'i chos (lcags (lcags glang 'di la dpyad dgos 'byung / sprel spyi lo bzhes/ ) spyi lo pa mang / rtse ros dug 840) 881) gis bkrongs/we jo sas sprel (lcags bltams ma lngabacu nga lnga da ོsne sde spre'/ spyi lo thag srid glang (chu glang chas 'byung / 84sgro) bzung spyi lo 89kā)chos 'byung chu mo phag (shing glang 'das lo 'di dpal me tog (spyilo spyi lo 'khor btsan gyi sming po/ 843) 90lā) 'khrungs lo dang /rmo srid bzhes lo nas rig 'ded byas pa/124

rngo/spre'u1glesproṭa/ zlo1— :mitha/rdog/dgung grangs 'di yig sum cu so nor las sa chen gyi bltamyo/sa myo/ bzhed pa dngos ni sa chen rgyal chu phag(spyi gsum shing dgung grangs drug cu thag sing gsum par gshegs pa ru/ 7ni+o yin/ gal srid sum cu rabs/ lo 84shā) glang(sbya ra so gsum la shing lug bzang / spyilo87'alor babs ༄ rdzo05) pas shing glang gsungs pa dang 'gal/tre 4 //nyer bzhi (nyer rang bzhed dpal sngan pya sa phag yab 'dazhi5 'khor btsan bltams rī mu srid bzhes bdun)shing lor gzhigs na tha/taca/ ma (/lha 'otho cas tha/bsdum ོmas 'dz+was glang(spyi lo 'khrungs 'das la tog phreng ba/ 81rdzo) hūṃnye ra dz+razhi 84meki tshigs 'di rnams la chu khyi spyi lo tsho dpyad dgordo ni pa'i 841) gnad don mang /rgyal rabs me stag blta/mas lo 'di rang rī tshospe lge bzhed yab bkrongs gsal ma/ (sbya la pa'i po dus ltar 84lā) bkod pa/ 125

deb ther/ lo tshigs/'khrungs lo/ sri~X/bskyangs 'das lo/ gsal bshad/bu ston chos shing glang drug cu re 'byung / (spyi lo /sngu ༵ ༵ 84'a) — spyilo907)yar lung jo zing lug so dag rang bzhed sras dpal —'icho hūṃsbyilo / ( kyi༄ — 'khor btsan gyi srid tho— —sa — —chu bya sbyi bzhes lor gzhigs 'byung / 815) lo 8྾nywa) na bltams lo 'di'i dbang thang 'khrug pa tshig thag bcad chog pas rang bzhed sa lug spyi lo 839lor d+dhiltams pa ༵nga me bya ༵ ༵ rno/77 ra 'das rgya bod yig shing lug so dgu lo tshigs 'di ni yar tshang mkhas (spyi lo lung jo bo'i bzhed pa'i pa dga' 81lā) sor bzhag yin pas byed/ dpyad pa gong du song /126

deb ther/ lo tshigs/rgyal rabasaphushing slong—shesmre drug cu/ rang bzhed yab krongs 'phrul lde/ lo 8bhe') pa'i lo der bskos/mkhas pa'i me yos so dgu pa — (spyi lo shing sbrul(spyi dga' ston/ 8bhe7) lo885)bstan rtsis chu khyi re gsum gsal ba'i (spyi lo shing byi (spyi nyin byed/ 8bhe3) lokha0bhe)bstan pa'i chu phag bol sar re gsum rgya mtshor 7ri ོ/ rjo4na shing glang 2risdu rga/ pa'i khupya ༷ ta—/ (spyilogru chen/ 843) 90'a)lo rgyus ngo /d+ngha ༵ga rgyal sar trī py-i༈ṭ+wāṃ ṭā tshar snang ba/ 8blon) bton/ 917)btsan po'i —rmye /byi chu phag (spyi so dgu lcaṭa smrahā~X tshig (spyi sdo lo843) byi (spyi lonyung don 843) rgyal sar 880)gsal/ bton/gong gsal re'u mig nang sgor rtags bkod pa rnams lo rgyus sgrig pa pos gaṭashrī' /—spru byas pa las deb ther so so'i dngos bstan min lags/127

skabs drug pa/ bod du 'bangs gyen log byung ba'i skor/sngon gyi lo rgyus yig rigs nang bod du kheng log ste 'bangs gyen ldog byung ba'i dunu/ ni btsan po'i gdung rgyud su'i skabs yin pa dang btsan po de dag dgung grangs gang la phebs pa'i lo tshigs thad lo rgyus smra ba mkhas pa so so'i bzhed tshul gcig gyur min pa 'ga' zhig yod kyang sa mo glang lor kheng log byung ba dang / me mo bya lor bang so brus pa'i lo khams la mi mthun pa med/ skabs 'dir kho bos lo rgyus kyi gnad don mang por dpyad skabs kheng log dang / bang so 'bru ba'i bya ba gnyis ka mnga' bdag 'od srungs kyi sku dus byung bar bzhed pa de dag khungs che bar mthong / de yang mnga' bdag 'od srungs dgung lo nyer drug pa sa mo glang spyi lo 8smordzolor kheng log byung ba dang / de nas lo brgyad song rjes 'od srungs dgung lo sum cu so bzhi pa me mo bya spyi lo 8gyi7 lor btsan po'i bang so 'bru ba'i bya ba byung ba'i 'tho/ tshugs par mngon/dang po/ kheng log gi 'byung rkyen skor/ bod kyi lo rgyus yig lam nang kheng log 'byung rkyen gyi gtam rgyud ci rigs yod pa'i nang la la phar bltasani na lha thong lta bur snang mod/ 'on kyang gnad don de tshor bsam blo zhib tu bta nga na lo rgyus kyi dngos don gson nyams ldan pa mtshon thub pas thog mar kheng log 'byung rkyen gyi gtam rgyud 'ga' zhig spro bar bya ste ral pa can gyi sku dus blon chen po bran ka dpal yon nyes med du bsad pa'i 128

rjes su pags/ pa rlu/nga bur bshus te gsob tu brgyangs/ nye du rnams kyis ro lhag ma bsdus te yer par bsregs pas du ba'i nang nas 'od dkar po rdza ma tsam zhig nam mkha' la je mtho je mthor song bas khong rang gi sring mo zhig gis ngus shing bos te blon chen po khyed gar 'byon/ dgras nyes med du bsad pa la lan ci yang mi 'jal lam zhes bos/ 'od de je dmar babs pa dang rlung dmar chen po zhig tu gyur te sa rdo ri brag ldeg pa tsam du byung ste de ma thag las kyi gnod sbyin chen po 'jigs su rung bar skyes te phyis jo bo rjes btul nas yer pa rdzi khang gi srung ma byed cing gsob kyang snye thang rgya ring na 'khyams skur yod cing yul lha byed do/ ’’ (mkhas pa'i dga' ston lcags par ma shog grangs tre11) zhes gsal ba dang / mkhas pa lde'u'i chos 'byung nang ‘‘bran ka gsod khar da khyod la kha chems 'dra ba med dam byas pas bran ka na re/gnam mthing bas sngo bar shogs bya bas dmar bar shogarje kheng log par shogargyal po'i gdung chad par shogazer nas/ der bsad nas yar phyin pa dang / blon po 'gos na re/bran rka/ bsad dam byas pas/ e sha mi gsod pa yin pa la/ kho na re ci zer byas pas/gnam mthing bas sngo bar shogs byu bas dmar bar shag129

rgyal po'i gdung chad par shogarje kheng log par shog zer/mdung shing la sogs pa tsho khyog zer na yang dgos pa mi 'dug byas pas/ blon po 'gos na re/ khos ma lan pa'i rtags yin/ myo/dung shing bya bal ma dgos pa de/ nga'i sems mdung shing bas srong bya ba'i rtags yin/ gnam mthing bas sngo bar shog bya ba de gnam la than pa byung nas/sa la rtswa mi skye ste bya bas dmar bar 'gro/ rgyal po gdung chad nyen yod/rje kheng log kyang 'gro/ de ma legs zer/ ’ (mkhas pa lde'u'i chos 'byung shog grangs3smo1) zhes bran ka dpal yon 'da' kha'i kha chems dang /yang mkhas pa'i dga' ston nang /‘‘kheng log byed pa'i rtswa mkhan mes po ni/bran ka dpal gyi yon tan kho yis byas/mi bas sas kyang rje ru ma theg nas/spyir na lha 'dre pha tshan kun gyis byas/mna' tho 'ug pa thang du 'dun ma tshogs/de tsho bran ka dpal gyi yon tan kho/lcags kyi spyang ki sngon po bzhen nas ni/lcags kyi ber kas sa la rdung bzhin du/lha 'dre kun la zhu ba 'di skad gsol/rje blon gcig kyang ma lus bsad par zhu/yang na so kha brgyad du gtor bar zhu/130

de tshe mar lha sham po la sogs pas/dpal kyi yon tan kho la zhu ba phul/lha ri'i rtse (lha re'i rtsa ) ru rje dpon tshan re zhus/lha 'dre pha tshan 'dun ma de la 'chams ’’zhis (mkhas pa'i 'ga' ston lcags par ma shog grangs 431) bran ka dpal yon gnod sbyin du skyes nas kheng log byed dgos pa'i bskul ma byas pa'i skor 'khod pa rnams la zhib tu dpyad na/ btsan po /khri lde srong btsan sad na legs dang / khri gtsug lde btsan ral pa can gdung rabs sa/nyis kyi bka' yi blon po btsan pos kyang bsngags brjod tshad med gnang ba rdo reng dang / bka' gtsigs yi ge'i nang gsal por 'khod cing /rang srog la brten nas btsan po'i sku phywa dang / chab srid srung skyob gnang mkhan blon po'i nang gi phul du byung ba'i mi sna de lta bu mthar bod khams gcig gyur gyi rje'i so kha dum bu mang por gtor ba'i byed gter gyur 'dra ba'i gnas tshul 'di ni lo ngo sum cur nye ba 'das shing / btsan po'i gdung rabs 'phos pa'i skabs yang bskyar bran ka dpal yon mtshon byed mi snar byas pa'i gtam rgyud 'di nas don dngos gang zhig mtshon yod ce na/ btsan po'i chab srid lar rgya dgung la 'degs pa'i— byas pa can gyi blon po ma nga po zhig dar ma rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i tshul min byed par brten nas blo pham yid chad kyi sa/nas su gyar ba dang / tha na zhe blo gting nas ma log ka med kyi gnas su gyar ba de dag gsal por mtshon pa yin /spyir btsan po'i skabs rgyal khams kyi bya ba chen po'i rigs rgyal blon 131

'dun gros kyi thog nas thag gcod gnang ba las btsan pos srid dbang sger gcod mi gnang ba btsan po'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i nang nas gsal por rtogs nus kyang / ral pa can sku bkrongs pa'i rjes dar mas srid skyong skabs blo dang ldan pa'i blon pos blo gzu bor gnas pa'i sgo nas btsan po yab mes kyi mdzad pa'i rgyun skyong dgos pa'i snyan lcag ji ltar zhus kyang mgrin bzang gi thos 'dzin nang gser blug pa'i ngang tshul thams cad yal bar 'dor bas tsan dan gtsub pa mer 'gyur ba'i tshul bzhin rang gi rje bor blo log skye ba'i gnas tshul thon srid pa dang / blon po rigs bod yongs su ming dang dbang grags ldan pas kho tsho'i 'dod phyogs spyi tshogs thog khyab pa des mi rnams kyi bsam blo'i 'phel phyogs la 'gyur ldog gtong srid pa ltar mi rnams kyi bsam blo 'khrugs pa de lha 'dre'i cho 'khrul du ngos 'dzin byas pa mtshon zheng / blon po la la smra bcad kyi brgyus zhugs bzung nas sdod pa des tshul min spyod pa'i blon po rnams kyi 'gog rkyen rang bzhin du med par chags te kho tsho bya ngan spel bde po byung bas rim bzhin 'od srungs dang / yum brtan phyogs khag gyes shugs je cher 'gro ba'i brgyud rim ste dmag 'khrug lo ngo mang po byas pa'i nang rang gi stobs shugs srung skyob dang / kha gtad kyi stobs shugs nyams zham/ du gtong ba de'i thad spyi tshogs kyi stobs shugs gzhan ma rnams kyang bed spyod gtong ba'i nang rang rtogs dang / rang rtogs min pa'i kheng log 'byung gzhi byung ba/ lhag par phyogs khag gyes pa'i sde gre/zar rgyun ring nang rtsa/nga tshogs kyi 'tsho ba je zhan je sdug 'gro bas dmag 'khrug 132

dang mu ge 'phrog bcom gsod brdung sogardo5 mi 'dod pa'i rgud tshogs char bzhin 'bab pa dang / rang byung gnod 'tshe byung ske / bar+sha/ de dag 'gog pa'i dus tshod dang / stobs shugs kyang dmag 'khrug gi dbang du gyur te zhing 'brog thon skyed la yang shugs rkyen ngan pa tshabs chen phog pa/ lhag par dar ma'i skabs nas bzung bod khams gcig gyur gyi khrims srol bzang po rnams brtsi med du btang bas dmag dpon dang blon po'i khrod du khrims lugs kyi 'ching rgya gang yang med pas rang gi khe phan phra mo'i ched mang tshogs la sngar med pa'i 'phri cha 'gel ba la sogs pa'i mnar gcod tshad med gtong ba/ mang tshogs kyi 'tsho bar sems 'khur byed ma/ba na med la dmag 'khrug la brten pa'i sdug sbyong mang po myong dgos byung ba/rje 'bangs dbar gyi dbang khyad je cher gyur pa dper na/ mkhas pa lde'u'i chos 'byung nang /‘‘spyir ni rje kheng dbang khyad ches pas lan/ (mkhas pa lde'u chos 'byung lcags par ma'i shog grangs shā73)zhes 'khod pa 'di ni kheng log 'byung gzhi'i rgyu rkyen gtso bor mngon pa bcas skabs der mang tshogs rnams dngos 'brel bzod bsran ma thub rkyen gson lam 'tshol ched 'bangs gyen log byed srid pa ni smos ci dgos/kheng log gi dpe bya la byas pa dang / g.yo ru'i kheng log skabs 'be mo'i gtam rgyud brngos gson nyams ldan pa'i mtshon dpe de tsho'i thog nas mthong ba ni rang nyid sdug bsngal las thar ba bya rgyu'i thabs lam 'ba' zhig ni 'bangs gyen log bya rgyu de yin par mthong nas mang tshogs rnams kheng sgo33

log nang hur brtson gyis zhugs pa las/sa/ — — 'on kyang sngar bod du byung ba'i kheng log gi 'bras bu'i thog nas mtshon pa ni yul khams gzhan du byung ba'i 'bangs gyen ldog dang mi 'dra ba bod la dmigs bsal gyi gnas tshul zhig yod pa ni/ nga tsho'i rlabs chen kyi mes po btsan po srong btsan sgam pos sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi blang dor gyi rim pa dang / skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs sogs la zhib 'jug gnang ste lha chos dge ba bcu dang mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug la soṭa pa kun spyod kyi gnad don la thug pa'i khrims srol mang po gtan 'be+eb gnang ba de dag ral pa can yan gyi btsan po rim byon rgyes rang dpe gzhan ston gyi sgo nas phyag bzhes gnang ba de dag mi'i sems su gting rab zug pa'i sems khams /khyad par can zhig chags pa des kheng log gi bya ba'i nang btsan po'o gdung rabs kyis srid dbang 'dzin rgyur ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu mi byed pa btsan po'i gdung rgyud 'di'i dbang sgyur la ngo rgol byas te btsan po'i gdung rgyud de'i dbang sgyur 'dzugs pa/ kheng log nang gtor rgyu yang btsan po'i rgyud pa'i dbang sgyur yin la 'dzugs rgyu yang btsan po'i rgyud pa'i srid dbang yin pa don mdor bsdus na btsan po'i gdung rgyud kyis bod khams yongs la gcig gyur du dbang bsgyur ba de sil bur dbang bsgyur ba'i srid dbang 'dzugs pa'i khyad par tsam du zad pa gsham du gnas tshul mang po nas mthong thub/gnyis pa/ kheng log byed par 'dzoms dgos pa'i gnad don/lde'u jo sras kyi chos 'byung nang / ‘‘kheng log dpe dang lag dpon 134

rgyu mtshan gsum/ phywa mkhan 'dun sa 'dzin mkhan lha dang drug yul rer rje dpon tshan re chags dang bdun/ ’’ (lde'u jo sras kyi chos 'byung lcas/sa par ma shog grangs1bhe4) zhes gsal ba ltar na kheng log byed par 'dzoms dgos pa'i cha rkyen bdun pa ni/ dang po kheng log byed pa'i dpe gang zhig la bzhag pa/ gnyis pa lag dpon te kheng log byed skabs gdong len sne 'khrid mkhan zhig dgos pa/ gsum pa kheng log byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan nges pa can ldan dgos pa/ bzhi pa phywa myo/khan ste jus gzhi 'don mkhan legs po zhig dgos pa/ lnga pa 'dun sa 'dzin mkhan te kheng log skor bsam gros bsdur ba'i gros tshogs khang zhig dgos pa/ drug pa kheng log gi bya ba lam lhong yong bar 'go ba'i lha zhig dgos pa/ bdun pa btsan po'i gdung rabs kyi rje bo dang / de'i blon po'am/ srid 'dzin gyi bya ba sgrub pa'i dpon po bcas rje dpon tshan pa re dgos pa bcas gsal por bstan yod pa'i nang nas mtshon pa ni gzhi rtsa'i thog yul gru so so'i kheng log ni kher rkyang du byed pa dang / stes dbang du byung ba zhig min la phan tshun gzhogs 'degs dang / gros 'char yod la go rim dang dmigs yul cha tshang ldan pa de lags/'od kyang yul gru so so'i kheng log gi brgyud rim la gzhigs na sa khul so sor 'phrad pa'i gnad don 'dra min la brten nas byung bas tshang mar cha rkyen dang go rim de ltar brgyud dgos pa'i nges pa yang med/ dper na g.yo ru'i kheng log 'byung gzhe khyim thab ko long gis rkyen byas pa lta bu'o// kheng log skabs rje dpon tshan pa zhes pa'i ‘‘rje bo’’ni btsan po'i 13bya

gdung rgyud che ge mo yin par som nyi ca/ dgos kyang kheng lob/ gi thog ma'i dus btsan po'i gdung rabs yul gru mang por gyes pa'i gnas tshul med pa phyis 'od srungatra/ dang / yum brtan rgyud yul gru mang por gyes te rje dpon chags rabs shig byung ba'am/ yang na sngar thang mtshams su phab pa'i gdung rgyud ga ge mo sa gnas mang por yod par rje'u zhes nga/ rje phran lta bu'i tha snyad thogs pa'am/ yang na kong dkar po'i rje'i rgyud pa/ sngar rgyal phran sil mari dus kyi rgyal phran gyi rgyud par rje bo'am rje'ur btags pa/de bzhin btsan po'i skabs kyi blon po'am mi drag gi rgyud par phyis rje bor 'bod pa gang yin brtag dgos pa lta bur snang yang / kheng log dus kyi rje dpon tshan pa'i rje bo ni/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phring bsayode ltar rgyal rgyud sil chad 'di rnams rje sku lha so so'i bsten yul du bgos pas rje tshan rnams pa dgu/ chos 'khor bsam yas kyi rkyen du rje lhu gcig dang bcu zhes grags pa yin la rgyal rgyud ma nyams pa yin phyin yon tan du mas khyad par 'phags/ (mkhas dga' lcags par ma shog grangs bhe39)zhes dang / bod sil bur gyur pa dang / yum brtan 'od srungs las gyis pa'i rje phran yul gru rer mang mang du gnas/ zhes gsungs pa des mtha' dpyod legs par grub cing / kheng log byung ste dus tshod ring po song rjes bod kyi dbang gyur gral rim pa'i gnad don 'gyur ldog mang po byung yod pa ni kheng log dang 'brel ba cher med pa'i gnad don gzhan du ngeṭa/ pa zungs shig /gsum pa/ yul tshan so so'i kheng log gi zhib phri'i gnas tshul skor/136

mkhas pa'i dga' ston nang / ‘‘btsan po gnyis lo nyer gsum re lon pa'i sa glang nas bzung ste 'bangs kyi kheng log rnams rim par byung ste de yang bar snang gi bya gcig la bya kun rub pa mthong ba la dpe byas dang po dba'as kho bsher legs steng gis lag dpon byas te mdo khams su kheng log byas/ ’ (mkhas dga' lcags par ma shog grangs bhe31)zhes dang /yang ‘‘gtsang lha bu dar lha yis zhu ba byas/grom pa lha rtse btsan pa'i mkhar la brten/'bro dang cog ro gnyis kyis ma khya/ ra bya/gtsang stod yul du rje dpon tshan gcig chags/kha rag khyung btsun lha yis zhu ba byas/'brang mkhar bye btsan btsan pa'i mkhar la brten/byang dang snang gis ma phyar byas nas ni/ru mtshams gzhu snyer rje dpon tshan gcig chags/thang lha ya bzhur lha yis zhu ba byas/grwa dang dom pa btsan pa'i mkhar la brten/sgro dang rma yis ma phyar byas nas ni/'phan yul za gang rje dpon tshan gcig chags/yar lha sham po lha yis zhu ba byas/rna mo mar rtse mar rtse gnyis la brten/mchims gnyags gnyis kyis ma phyar byas nas su/137

yar lung stod du rje dpon tshan gcig chags/gtam lha spun dgu lha/ yis zhu ba byas/bya tshang gung snang btsan pa'i mkhar la brten/snye ba shud pus ma spyar byas nas ni/gtam shul lho brag rje dpon tshan gcig chags/'chos lha dkon pa lha yis zhu ba byas/khu gud co mkhar btsan pa'i mkhar la brten/khu gnyags gnyis kyis ma phyar byas nas su/'chos su rje dpon tshan gcig chags so skad/ ces sogs nas/‘‘de ltar rje dpon rje tshan rnams pa dgu/chos 'khor rkyen du rje lhu gcig dang bcu/lha yis zhu ba byas nas chags pa yin/ ’’(mkhas pa'i dga' ston lcags par ma shog grangs bhe31)zhes dang / yang /‘‘mnga' bdag 'od srung sras po dpal 'khor btsan/lha khang 'ga' bzhengs stag rtse gnyags kyis bkrongs/de sras mched gnyis stod kyi phyogs su byon/mnga' ris bskor gsum la sogs mnga' mdzad de/stod du rgyal khrims zhwa tsam chags zhes grags/de yi gdung rgyud 'ga' zhig smad du chad/138

mdo smad tsong kha'i yul chen mnga' mjad pas/smad du rgyal khrims lham tsam chags so skad/bar du dbus gtsang ru bzhi sil bur gyur/yum brtan 'od srung las gyes rje phran ni/— yul gru rer yang mang du gnas par gyur/'on kyang rgyal rgyud ma nyams yin nges rnams/gzugs dang blo gros gzhan las khyad par 'phags/ya rabs spyod bzang skye bo mgu bar byed/ de phyir dam pa rnams kyis bsngags pa'i gnas/(mkhas pa'i dga' ston lcags par ma shog grangasabhe3kā) zhes 'khod pa zhib par phye na 'di lta ste/1 kheng log gi dpe bya la byas pa ni/ bar snang gi bya gcig la bya gzhan rub ste med par bzo ba mthong ba dper byas pa'am yang na sre mong 'ug pa'i gtam rgyud dang sbyar ba mkhas pa lde'u chos 'byung nang / ‘‘gzhung las/ de'i dus su dus log kheng log byung skad pa/ kheng log gi dpe bya la blangs te/ bya srin bya bya ba la khol po sre mong gis gsang dus su ma drangs na/ srin byas skad btab pas sre mong gi rmig brul ba yin pas/gsang dus su 'dren pa la nang ma gcig gsang phyis nas/ srin bya skad 'don par 'a do da pa la sre mong gis skad 'don long med par srin bya yi ske bcad pas/ dpe de la blangs nas kheng log go/ ’’ (mkhas pa lde'u'i chos 'byung lcags par ma shog grangs 371) zhes 'khod pa gtam rgyud 'di'i 139

thog nas skabs de'i dbang sgyur mkhan che ge mo rjes 'brang dang bcas/ pas mi ser la mnar gcod tshad med btang ba bzod mi thub pa'i gnas tshul 'og stobs shugs gcig sgril gyis/ mnar gcod de dag las thar ched kheng log byas pa'i dpe ni kheng log yongs la sbyar chog pa gson nyams ldan pa zhig yin/ 3 yul gru so sor kheng log rim par byung ba dang / 'a/ga dpon/dmigs bsal gyi rgyu mtshan bcas skor/dba'as kho bsher legs steng gis lag dpon nam sne khrid byas te mdo khams su kheng tsholog dang po byung ba de'i gnas tshul dbus gtsang du khyab pa 'di dang / dbu rur 'bro sbas 'khrugs pa la brten nas dba'as lo pho lo chung gis lag dpon byas te kheng log byas pa 'di sa/nyis ni 'od srungs btsan po'i khri la bzhugs pa'i mnga' thang la yum brtan rgyud kyis rtsod pa'i gnas tshul dang 'brel ba dam zab yod/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang kheng log de gnyis ka dba'as sam blon po sbas kyis lag dpon byas pa gcig mtshungs yin pas so//de yang 'bro sbas gnyis ni 'od srungs dang / yum brtan phyogs so so'i blon po gtso che ba'i gras yin/ bod kyi lo rgyus thog ming ngan yongs su grags pa ral pa can sku bkrongs pa'i lag dmar ba dang / dar mas chos bsnubs pa'i skabs kyi gdong len mkhan sbas stag rna can ngo ma kheng log skabs 'das zin na'ang / de'i bu rgyud kyi pha shul bu 'dzin yum brtan phyogs su langs srid pa ni smos ma dgos pa dang / 'od srungs kyi blon po 140

ba/tso che ba'i gras su 'bro rigs las byung ba ming gsal ma mthong yang /'od srungs kyi sras dpal 'khor btsan gyi blon po 'bro tsug sgra lha sdong gis byas pa de las 'bro ni 'od srungs kyi phyogs la zhen pa'i blon po yin pa mtshon thub/ spyir 'adz+ra sbas gnyis ka btsan po'i blon po rnying khungs yin la 'bro'i rgyud pa ni gtsang stod lha rtse nas byung ba dang / sbas ni dbu rur byung ba yin/btsan po 'od srungs dang yum brtan dbar gyi 'gal ba dang / blon po 'bro sbas 'khrugs pa'i lo rgyus 'di'i thog nas bod du kheng log byung ba'i skabs dang bstun nas yum brtan phyogs gtogs blon po sbas kyis dbu g.yor 'khrug zing rgya cher phyin te 'od srungs phyogs gtogs glaganu/ mi rnyed pa'i skabs sbas lo pho lo chung gis 'od srungs kyi phyogs gtogs 'ga' zhig grogs su bkug nas 'od srungs kyi khongs gtogs rnams yum brtan phyogs la mgo gtad de sngar rang gi rje bo 'od srungs la kheng log gis yum brtan rgyud kyis dbu rudza phyogs yongs la dbang sgyur byed par kheng log gis nus pa chen po thon pa mtshon cing / dbus gtsang sa gnas gzhan du byung ba'i kheng log rnams kyang 'di dang 'brel ba dam zab bam 'di dang 'dra ba'i gnas tshul 'byung srid par brtag dpyad bya dgos pa'i khungs sne zhig rnyed pa yin/dbu ru'i kheng log skabs snubs sangs rgyas ye shes la sras drug yod pa las bzhi kheng log gis bkrongs pa dang / gcig zla yar/ gcig khrel med du shor/ zhes/ (nyang chos 'byung shong grangs bhe4gyi) gsal ba sras /4lha

bzhi bkrongs pa dang / gcig zla bo dang kha bra⑫ dgos pa byung ba/gcig ma rabs kyi spyod pa'i dbang du song 'dra ba dang / snubs sangs rgyas ye shes sprang por brdzus nas bal yu' la phebs dgos byung ba bcas skabs der mkhas pa tsho gcig la yang thag zhor 'breng 'drud kyi gnod 'tshe byung ba de go ba len thub pa zhig yin/de ltar dbu rur kheng log byung rjes yum brtan rgyud kyis rje bo dang /blon po sbas kyis dpon byas pa'i rje dpon tshan pa gcig chags pa yin/ de yang dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas dbu g.yor 'khrug pa dang / de'i phyogs bod yul phal mo cher khyab pa/ yul gru rer yang che srid dang /chung srid sogs sde gnyis gnyis su chad de 'thab rtsod byung ba'i lo rgyus dang / yang 'od srungs yum brtan sa/nyis/ po sku mched yin min gyi dpyad pa'i nang / ‘‘rje tshan dgu po phal cher yum brtan yin la gdung rgyud min na rje'i so kha gtor bar mi 'gyur bas chen chun gyi sras gnyis gdung rgyud khyad med du snang / ’’ zhes gsungs pas gnad don 'di thag gcod byed par nus ldan gyi khungs shig bstan pa lags/ gal srid skabs de'i kheng log ni dbang sgyur gral rim pa yod tshad dam/ yang na btsan po'i spu/dung —rgyud kho na gtor ba'i las 'gul zhig yin na kheng log byas rjes yul tshan so sor btsan po'i gdung rgyud min pa'i rje bo re dgos pa de ltar yang /bod kyi lo rgyus yig la— 4 gang du yang skabs de'i lo rgyus/ la de lta'i lo rgyus mi snang ba de ni bod kyi 'bangs gyen log la zhib 'jug bya rgyu'i dpyad gzhi gal chen zhig yin snyam/ bod du byung ba'i kheng log gis gtor sgyu yang 14lha

btsan po'i rgyud pa'i srid dbang yin la 'dzugs rgyu yang btsan po'i rgyud pa'i srid dbang yin pas don du btsan po'i rgyud pas bod khams yongs la gcig gyur gyi dbang sgyur ba de sil bus dbang sgyur ba'i tshul la 'gyur ldog btang ba dang / kheng log gis btsan po'i rgyud pa'i phyogs khag gcig gi srid dbang gtor ba dang / phyogs khag gcig gi srid dbang 'dzugs rogs byed pa'i khyad par tsam du zad/de rjes g.yo rur kheng log byung ba'i skor/ g.yo rur zhang rje gsas sde btsan ('di btsan po'i rigs / rgyud ci yin gyi yig cha ma mngon rung /btsan po'i rigs sras thang mtshams phab pa'i rgyud dam/ yang na kong rje'i rgyud pa ci yin dpyad dgos/ )gyis rang gi dbon po g.yu sne bsad cing /g.yu sne'i rtse zla gnyis yod pa las gcig rang gi chun mar blangs/ gcig shos kyi ming la 'bo bza' 'a mo skyid dam/ 'bo bza'aci wa mo gzhung zhes bya bar 'bod pa de gsas snes btsun mor ma blangs pa'i phrag dog yod bzhin pa'i skabs der gsas sde btsan gyi khul de'i ri'i mgul pa'am ri'i ngos la zhing chu 'dren pa'i yur ba gsar bzo byed bcug pa'i khral 'ul gyis mi ser rnams la khag sbyong chen po byung ste ci bya gtol med kyi gnas su gyar ba'i gnas tshul de 'bo bzas zhang rje gsas sner 'phen lan glan pa'i skabs bzang po zhig tu mthong nas mang tshogs la ri mgul las mi mgul gcod pa sla zhes dka' sdug de 'dra myong mi dgos pa'i thabs shes bzang shos dang / las sla shos ni mi mgul gcod pa ste zhang rje gsas sne bsad na ri'i ngos yur bu bzo mi dgos pa rang bzhin gyi chags thub ces bkod /43

jus bton par kha 'cham shing kheng log gi lag dpon nam 'go 'dzin mchims kong mi drug ni/ skye tshe/ tshe brtan/ sle'o lha la bsten/ snye ba bstan rnam/ mon phrug thong chung / g.yu ne myang bcas kyis byaṭashaṃ te lha'i gong gsum bya ba'i sa gnas star sdong zhig gi 'og tu kheng log gi gros bsdur byas thog de yang star kha'i me tog srod la 'char ba'i tshul la blta bar bsnyad nas dpal 'bar thogs te gyen log byas pas ming yang 'od 'bar kheng log tu grags/ skabs de'i gros sar 'bo bzas rwa che na dga' mod/ khur chung ma/ skyid mod ces btsan po mnga' thang rgyas na legs mod/ de las nyams chung rnams khral 'ul nyung na skyid ces 'bo bza'i gtam de bden par ngo/ nas tshang mas zhang rje gsas sner kheng log bya rgyur gros thag bcad de mchims yul gting nas kheng log byas pas zhang rje gsas sne btsan mchirma sa yul du sdod ma nus pa kong yul bre snar bros pas re zhig glags ma rnyed pa'i skabs der slar yang 'bo bzas/ nga yis mkhar sgor bro brdung glu len pa'i tshul gyis nyul zhib bya yi/ zhang rje mkhar nang ma phebs bar du lag pa phyir g.yob byed nang du g.yob na zhang rje phebs pa'i rtags yin pas de dus sgo drung zhang rje gsod la shog ces smras pa bzhin zhang rje bsad/ kong yul bre sna 'bo mo'i g.yo sgyus phab pa 'di yang don du mchims kong du zhang rje gsas sne btsan gyis mang tshogs la mnar gcod che tsam btang ba 'bo bzas khyim thab kyi zhe 'khon de mang tshogs las 'gul nang be+ed spyad pa lta bur mngon/de rjes gtsang stod dang / snye mo/ 'phan yul sogs su kheng log trī44

rim par byung ba'i tshul la yul lha dang / btsan mkhar rje dpon tshan pa'i dpon gyi rus khungs gang yin pa dang / de ltar gnas pa'i yul gyi ming la ci zer ba gsa'/ por bstan rung / yul de'i rje tshan su yin rga/sal por bstan med pa phyis kyi lo rgyus smra ba tshor gnad don 'di nyid skabs de'i lo rgyus dngos dang mthun pa'i stong cha kha skong dgos pa'i 'gan zhig phrag par babs med/(1) gtsang lha bu dar lha yis zhu ba byas lugs skor 'byung ba yang mnga' bdag gnyis po'i phyogs khag 'khrug ste 'od srungs kyi sras dpal 'khor btsan gyi skabs rang gi stobs shugs dbus khul gnas ma thub pa gtsang phyogs 'pho bskyas byas pa'i rjes su skabs shig mnga' thang cung zad 'phel bas grom pa lha rtse'i brag la pho brang ngam btsan mkhar bskrun pa dang /sgrol gyi sman lung la sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa bcas dpon mnga' thang che na g.yog sdug thang che ba'i dpe bzhin mang tshogs rnams la gtser bsun che tsam byung ba dang / lhag par rang gi srid dbang brtan gnas ched mi ser gnas spo'i gnas tshul tshabs che tsam byung ba mkhas pa lde'u'i chos 'byung nang /‘‘mnga' bdag dpal 'khor stag rtse snyags kyis bkrongs//rgyu mtshan snya gas byed gtsang du shug par byas pa dang //gtsang gi 'bre phyed mar yar klungs su dbab par byas pas so 7(mkhas pa lde'u'i chos 'byung lcags par ma shog grangs 3gyisnyo)zhes gsal ba g.yo rur dbang sgyur ba'i skabs yar klungs pa skags 145

kyi rus las byung ba nas rang gi bkod 'og mi 'dus pa tsho gcig gtsang phyogs rgyang 'bud btang ste khral khrims 'khur len byed bcug pa dang /nyang ro dang grom pa 'bre'i khul nas blos 'khel ba'i mi ser tsho gcig yar klungs su gnas spro sa byed du bcug ste yar klungs pa byings la blta skul gyi nus pa 'don spel byed du bcug pas yar klungs su rang gi stobs shugs phran bu gnas thub pa dang / gnas skabs ring gtsang stod khul yum brtan phyogs khag gi stobs shugs med pa bzos te dpal 'khor btsan gyis rje bo dang / 'bro cog gnyis kyis dpon byas pa'i rje dpon tshan pa zhig chags te srid dbang skyong bzhin pa'i skabs gtsang du rgyang 'bud btang ba'i snyags pa rnams la dpon phyogs nas mthong chung dang / mi ser nang khul du yang blta stangs mi 'dra ba 'dzin pa sogs phog thug chen po 'khel ba ma bzod pas mthar stag rtse snyags kyis dpal 'khor btsan/grom pa lha rtser (la lar shar kha rgyal rtses dang / yar klungs sham por mchu nag snyags kyis bkrongs par bzhed ) bkrongs te dpal 'khor btsan gyi sras gnyis gnas der gzhis chags ma thub pa mnga' ris la phebs dgos byung ba yin/(2) kha rag khyung btsun zhes pa la sogs pas gzhu snye mo ru 'brang mkhar bye btsan la btsan mkhar byas shing / myang dang snang gi rus rgyud kyis dpon byas pa'i rje dpon tshan pa gcig(3) 'phan po zwa dam du btsan mkhar byas shing / sgro dang rma yi rus rgyud kyis dpon byas pa'i rje dpon tshan pa gcig146

(4) yar klungs stod du sna mo yar rtse mar rtse gnyis la btsan mkhar byas shing / mchims dang snyags kyi rus rgyud kyis dpon byas pa'i rje dpon tshan pa gcig(5) lho brag gtam shul du bya tshang gung snang la btsan mkhar byas shing / snyi ba shud pu gnyis kyi rus rgyud kyis dpon byas pa'i rje dpon tshan pa gcig(6) 'phyongs rgyas phyogs su khu gud co gar la btsan mkhar byas shing / khu dang snyags kyi rus rgyud kyis dpon byas pa'i rje dpon tshan pa gcig sogs rje dpon tshan pa dgu chags lugs khu ston gyi lo rgyus che mo la sa drangs pa mkhas pa'i dga' ston du 'phros nas rje tshan gsum sogs sgra'i khongs bsdus shing / lde'u chos 'byung du yang rje tshan drug po 'di las gzhan rnams gsal kha mi che zhing / chos 'khor rkyen rje lhu gcig ces pa ni bsam yas kyi bcad po rnams yin par mngon te/ de yang mkhas pa lde'u'i chos/ 'byung nang / ‘‘khri lde mgon btsan gyi rgyud 'di bsod nams che ste rje'i can du dgu dang / chos 'khor bsam yas la sogs pa 'od srungs rgyud la med pas/ mnga' bdag dpal 'khor go ma chod pas lan pa yin skad/ (mkhas pa lde'u'i chos 'byung shog grangs 373) ces dpal 'khor btsan gyi lo rgyus skabs 'phros pa 'di dang / gong du yang de'i skor gsal bas mtha' dpyod legs par grub pa yin/ kheng log rgya cher 'gro ba dang dus mtshungs rje dpon tshan pa'i dbar gsar du byung ba'i 'gal ba yang je cher phyin te gang sar dus bde lhing 147

'jags med pa'i gnas hūṃl 'og skabs de'i dporno tshan gyi gras su gtogs pa snyi ba bsam po zhes bya bas rje 'bangs bsdums pa'i gnas tshul yang byung myong bar snang / de yang mkhas pa'i dga' ston nang /‘‘sa de nase bran ka dpal gyi yon tan gyis//snyi ba bsam por sprul nas rje 'bangs bsdums/ / (mkhas dga' lcags par ma shog grangs 433)zhes gsal ba snyi ba bsam pos bran ka dpal gyi yon tan gnod sbyin du skyes pa khog par brlam pa'i rdzu la brten nas spyi tshogs lhing 'jags yong ched rje 'bangs kyi dbar ram/ yang na rje dpon tshan pa phan tshun dbar bsdum 'grig byas par grags/3 btsan po'i bang so rnams bgos nas 'ga' zhig brus pa'i skor/chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston las/ ‘‘kheng log nas lo dgu pa me bya la shud pu stag rtse sogs bzhis gros byas nas bang so rnams bgo ༈ bsha' byas phal cher brus te/gnyags kyis don mkhar mda' yi bang so brus//shud pus seng ge can gyi bang so brus//'phrul rgyal bang so greng 'phyos khu yis brus//sngo bzher snyi bas thob ste 'bru 'phror lus//srong btsan 'bro cog gnyis kyis thob ste lus//ces snang ngo / / (chos 'byung mkhas dga' lcags par deb ngos 433)zhes gsal bu ltar spyi lo8smo9sa glang la kheng log 'go tshugs pa 148

nas lo dgu song ba spyi lo87gyime bya lor shud pu dang stag rtse gnyags sogs rus tsho che bzhis mnyam du gros bsdur byas nas btsan po'i bang so rnams gyen log byed mkhan rus tshan so sor bgo bsha' brgyab ste phal cher brus/de yang gnyags kyi rus tshos don mkhar mda' yi bang so ste/ spu rgyal gdung rabs khri gnyan gzung btsan dang / stag ri gnyan gzigs/gnam ri srong btsan sogs kyi bang so brus pa dang / shud pu'i rus tshos seng ge can te khri lde gtsug brtan gyi bang so brus/ gring / 'phyos/ khu bcas kyi rus tshos 'dus srong mang po rje 'phrul gyi rgyal po'i bang so brus/snyi ba'i rus tshos btsan po mang srong mang btsan gyi bang so sngo bzher hral po thob ste 'bru 'phror lus zhes sa 'di ni/ gong du snyi ba bsam pos rje 'bangs bsdums bya ba dang 'brel ba yod par mngon te khong gis kheng log gi zing cha 'jags thabs byas pa la dpags na/ snyi ba rus tshan la thob pa'i mang srong gi bang so yang dang thog sngog 'og btsugs kyang de nas sngog mtshams bzhag pa yin snyam mo/ /srong btsan gyi bang so 'bro dang cog ro gnyis kyi rus tshor thob kyang ma sngog par lus pa ni /bong gi mdzad rjes dang mtshan snyan bod 'bangs kyi snying la gting zab zug pas 'bangs gyen ldog gi zing cha'i dus su'ang sus kyang sngog ma nus pa gor ma chag go/bod du kheng log byung ste rje tshan mang pos dbang ris bcad bzung byas pa'i gnas tshul/dbus gtsang du kheng log byung ba nas phal cher lo ngo brgya yas mas nang yul gru so sor rje tshan rim banan chags pa dang / rje dpon tshan pa 149

de tshos sa khul bcad bzung gis dbang sgyur byed pa'i skabs der bod la —bcan po'i gdung rgyud kyis gcig gyur gyi dbang sgyur byed pa'i lo rgyus mjug sgril kyang / sa khul che chung la ma ltos pa'i da dung rje 'bangs kyi go rim ma zhig pa bod khams sil bur dbang sgyur bya yul yod pa ma zad/mdo smad dang mnga' ris su btsan po'i dbang sgyur mu mthud gnas shing /dbus gtsang du kheng log rjes rje dpon tshan pa de tshos sa khul cha shas re dbang sgyur skabs tshan pa de'i rje bo ni sngar btsan po'i skabs ltar rgyal po dang / dpon po ni blon po'i gnas bab tu brtsi ba'i srol byung / gal srid de ltar min na rje dang dpon zhes pa'i rim pa dgos don med pa gzhir grub/de nas mi thog 'pho 'gyur dang / spyi tshogs thog kyang gcig gyur gyi khrim/sa lugs sogs med par brten rje dpon tshan pa phan tshun dang /tshan pa nas khul yang 'gal ba mang po cha gas nas phan tshun 'khrug rtsod dang /tha na dpung shugs la brten dgos pa bcas dpung pa su bzang lta bus bod dbus gtsang thams cad yul tshan re dpon 'go res bzung ste de bas sil bur gyur te mthar sa za'i dus bod khams gcig gyur skabs sngar kheng log skabs btsugs pa'i rje dpon tshan pa'i nang nas rje tshan phud pa'i dpon tshan gyi nang nas mu mthud dbang sgyur rgyun 'dzin thub pa khri dpon nang phal cher mthong rgyu med 'dra ba 'dis gnad don de ltar yin pa'i gzhi 'dzin sa byung ba yin/'o na bod khams ches sil bu'i dus ma ldug bod kyi dbang sgyur gral 150

rim pa'i grub cha ni ji lta bu yin zhe na/ sngar btsan po'i skabs dbang ris 'jags gnas byas pa'i 'go pa tsho gcig rang 'jags gnas thub pa dang / phal che ba snyan grags can gyi bla ma re rang gi bkur yul lamyo/ brten yul du 'dzin pa'i 'go pa dang / mchod gzhis la gtogs pa'i dbang ris bcas gnyis su gyur pa de ni bod la sangs rgyas chos lugs bskyar dar byu nga ba de dang srid dbang 'dres pa chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs tsam po ba zhig chags/de lta bu'i dbang sgyur mkhan grub stangs ni/ 'go pa'i nang nas tsho gcig kheng log skabs rje dpon tshan pa'i gras su mi gtogs rung / kheng log la sogs pa'i sde gzar nang dmag don la sogs par 'jon thang yod pa'i mi sna dang / btsan po'i skabs kyi blon po rnying khungs grags can/'ga' zhig gi sngar btsan po'i skabs dbang ris rgyud pa dang bcas pas 'dzin chog pa la la 'khrug zing nang do phog cher ma byung ba bcas la brten nas grub pa dang / mchod gzhis la grub cha khag mang tsam mchis pa/ de yang snyan grags can gyi bla ma'i 'phrin las la brten nas dgon gnas 'debs yul sa gnas dang / rten gsum gyi mchod pa dang dge 'dun pa'i thug tshul gyi thebs rtsa dang / rang rang mos pa'i sgrub mchod sogs kyi mchod rgyun/ 'das son la dmigs pa'i mchod rgyun bcas su dbang ris sbyor 'bul zhus pa/ la la bla mas dgon gnas 'debs pa'i sa gnas sa bdag nas nyos pa dper na 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos jo bo gdong nag pa nas sa skya'i dgen gan sa 'debs yul kos pa lta bu bcas las grub pa 151

bcas so//kheng log la 'dzoms dgos pa'i 'dun sa 'dzin mkhan gyi gan sa lugs skor/bang so 'bru ba'i gros bsdur byung tshul sogs las skabs der sa khul mang por kheng log byung bas gcig gyur gyi bkod 'doms mkhan yong mi srid kyang / kheng log tshan pa so sos ngo rgol bya yul dang / kheng log byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan mthun dang mi mthun gyi khyad par 'byung yang tshan pa khag dbar phan tshun 'gal ba gnas la cha shas kyi gnad don thad gcig gyur gyi rang bzhin yang gnas pa bcas 'gal ba ni so so'i bsten yul rje dpon tshan pa'am/ lhag par rje bo mi 'dra ba de tsho'i dbar 'gal ba tshabs chen gnas pa gzhir bcas kyang / kheng log byed mkhan gyi ngos nas bshad rang gi kha gtad dbang sgyur gral rim pa tsho khag gtor rgyu'i thad mthun cha yong srid pa bcas kheng log tshogs pa so so'i sne khrid pa'i dbar phan tshun 'brel gtugs byed pa dang / gal che'i skabs mnyam 'dzoms gros mol gyi thog nas kheng log pa nang khul 'gal ba chen po mi chags pa'i thabs la 'bad pa bcas kheng log gi bya ba dngos nang mang tshogs kyi mos phyogs cung cha tshang ba lag len bstar ba mtshon rung / phyis bod khams ches sil bur song ba'i dus su rang 'go gang thon las phan tshun 'brel gtugs kyi dgos pa yang rang bzhin gyis med par chags pa brucus so//bzhi pa/ kheng log la brten nas bod kyi spyi tshogs thog phan gnod kyi 'bras bu gang thon pa/152 pa

1 pan pa'i skor/(1) bar skabs mang tshogs la dka' ngal tshad medz+wa/ byung ba kheng log byas pas dbang sgyur gral rim pa tshos mang tshogs kyi 'tsho tshis la bsam shes mi bya mthu med la thug pa des spyi tshogs bde 'jags med pa dang zhing 'brog thon skyed lam lhongs med pa'i gnas tshul 'og re zhig mang tshogs 'tsho genas la phan pa byung ba/ bran g.yog lam lugs kyi rjes shul mang nyung la ma ltos rme zhig rang bzhin gyis sel ba dang / rus rgyud tsho pa'i shul bzhag gi bsdom sa khrims kyang thor zhig tu song zhing / rus tshan phan tshun dgra sha glan pa'i srol ngan sogs kyang rim bzhin med pa chags/ mi mang phal mo che'i rang dbang shayocher song nas rang rang 'tsho thabs kyi ched dam/ chos kyi don sogs la gang dgar 'gro sdod byed pa sogs ni/ rje btsun mi la sogs skabs de'i sngon byon bla ma dang / lo tsā ba mang po'e gsung rnam gyi nang don la dpyad na shugs kyis gsal rtogs byed thub pa ltar yin/(2) ral pa can yan btsan po yab mes kyis gsar btod mdzad pa'i rig gzhung 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i bya ba bar skabs mtshams chad de hro/ brgyab pa'i gnas tshul de mjug sgril te btsan po yab mes kyi dgongs pa sngor bas don thog 'khyol ba dang / sngar bas 'phel rgyas song bas rgya gar dang / li yul riṭa sa/sa nas ma khas pa mang po bod du phebs pa de la yang phyi'i rgyu rkyen dang / nang gi rgyu rkyen gnyis yod/khyi'i rgyu rkyen ni bod kyi rab byung dang po'i lcags 'brug spyi lo1040k+ṣebyabye

lor jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha bod la phebs pa'i rjes tsam nas bzung hin rdu'i sa khul dkyil rgyud la tā sig a la po'i dmag dpung gis btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug bslangs te rgya gar gyi lho rgyud sa khul phud de yin sa khukha mang che ba btsan bzung byas par brten rgya gar gyi dkyil rgyud la yang tā sig gi chos lugs dar nas sangs rgyas chos lugs nyams 'tho/ tshugs rjes a sam dang bal yul rgyud bod du bros phebs pa tshos bod kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas la mdzad rjes rlabs po che bzhag pa ni phyi'i rkyen yin/nang rkyen ni bod sil bu'i dus dkyil stod smad nas 'dul ba'i bstan pa dar rgyas byung bas jo bo rje la sogs pa bod du gdan drangs pa/lha bla ma byang chub 'o da kyis bskul nas lo chen rin bzang la sogs pa rgya gar la phebs pa/ bskul ba so med par mar pa chos kyi blo gros la sogs pa rgya gar la lan mang po phebs pa sogs bstan pa phyi dar skabs bod kyi mi rigs rig gnas kyang sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi grub mtha' khag mang 'phel ba dang dus mtshungs sngar bas 'phel rgyas song ba 'di'i thad sngar btsan po gcig pu'i thugs brtson la rag lus pa de phyis mang tshogs rang bzhin can du 'gyur ba/(3) bod sil bu'i dus dkyil du bod khams yongs la zhing 'brog thon skyed la gong 'phel che tsam byung ba dang chabs cig sa gnas kyi lag shes bzo las dang / tshong las kyang 'phel rgyas che tsamyoska byung ste gtsang gi tshong 'dus mgur mo dang / ding ri/ gnya' nang bcas su —tshong rwa chab /sa 154

'tho/ tshugs shing / stod mnga' ris kyi gu ge dang / byang gi lo deng zhul gser gyi gter kha thon pa/ lho kha dang ngam ring gnyis su dkar yol bzo ba'i lag rtsal dar ba bcas dpal 'byor gyi gnas tshul legs pa'i phyogs 'gros 'go tshugs pa bcas so// /3 gnod pa'i skor/ (1) dbus gtsang du kheng log byung ba des bod khams sim bu nas sil bur 'gyur bas bod khams spyi'i bya bar sne khrid dang / bsam gzhigs byed mkhan med pas bod khams spyi'i bya ba mang po bag la zha ba/ bod khams kyi dbang ris phyogs mtha' dag nas khul pa lta bu/(2) kheng log gi yo lang skabs zhing 'brog thon skyed kyi gnas tshul zhan pa'i khar rang byung gnod 'tshe yang mang tsam byung bar 'gog shugs skyob bcas kyis yul lung mang por mu ge dang / nad yams sogs byung bas dbus gtsang gnyis kyi mi mang po zhig mdo smad sogs zhing 'brog thon skyed kyi cha rkyen cung bzang sar mug byol bya dgos la thug pa/ lhag par sde gzar nang gnod 'tshe tshabs chen phog pa bcas skabs der mi shi khyim stongs kyi gnas tshul tshabs chen byung ba phyis kyang yul gru mang por khang khyim stongs ro dang / sa zhing rtsi rengs su lus pa'i rjes shul mang tsam mthong kyu yod pa bcas skabs shig ring bod kyi dpal 'byor nyams zhan dang / mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul ches zhan pa/ mi 'bor chag tshabs che ba bcas so//(3) rig rdzas la gtor bshig tshabs chen byung ba/ kheng log gi 155

thog ma'i dus skabs btsan po'i bang so/ brus te rig rdzas mang po gter bshig btang ba/ dar mas bstan pa snupa skabs gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcakhu/ par sri zhu med pa ma gtogs nyams chag cher ma byung ba yul gru so sos gnas pa rnams la yang gtor bshig phog pa/ mkhas pa mang por yang tshad gzhi mi 'dra ba'i rdung deg 'khel bas rang gnas su bzhugs bzod mi bde ba tha na phyi phyogs la zhal gzigs nas phebs dgos pa'i gnas tshul yang byung ba/ dper na chos 'byung me tog snying po'i nang /‘‘de nas dab ru'i kheng log byang / de'i dus su snubs —sangs rgyas ye shes dming dmi la sras drug yod pa las bzhi kheng log gis bkrongs/ gcig zla yar/gcig phrel med du shor de nas rgya gar du gshegs so/ / (nyang chos 'byung lcags par ma shog grangasabhe47) zhos gsungs pa ltar lags so//sne56 rī

skabs bdun pa/ 'od srungs kyi gdung rgyu da skor/dang po/ 'od srungs kyi sras dpal 'khor btsan gyi skor/ dpal 'khor btsan gyi 'khrungs 'das lo tshigs 'di yang bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba cung mang ba'i gras shig yin mod/ skabs 'dir yab 'od srungs sku gshegs pa'i lo tshigs sa chen rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i bzhed pa gnir bzung ba bzhin mnga' bdag 'od srungs dang / cog ro bza' rgyal mo gnyis pyi/ sras su dpal 'khor btsan chu mo glang spyi lo8rdzo3lor yar lung 'phang thang du 'khrungs/dgung lo bcu gsum pa shing glang spyi lo 90melor yab 'od srungs sku gshegs rjes gtsang gi grom pa lha rtser gshegs rdzongs chos 'khor rgya cher bskor ba dang dus mtshungs rgyal rgyud kyi khri la 'khod de srid lo bco brgyad bskyangs/ blon po 'bro tsug sgra lha snang dang cang 'a pho chananyis kyis byas/dgung lo bcu drug pa sa 'brug spyi lo9d+ngha8 lo ste srid bskyangs nas lo gsum 'gro skabs‘‘yab mes kyi bang so la thigs tshags byas nas wa btsugs mi’ (mkhas pa sde'u'i chos 'byung shog grangs kā71) zhes 'khod cing / 'di ni kho da du btsan po'i bang so brus pa'i gnas chu la byung nas lo ngo sum cur nye ba 'das zin pas yab mes kyi bang so/ zhes pa srong btsan gyi bang so sogs lhag mar lus pa rnams bar skabs bdag gces byed mkhan 157

mi byung ba nyams chag dang / nyams chag 'gro gzhi'i rigs dpal 'khor btsan gyis dbo kha gsar du bcos pa dang nyams gso byas par mngon zhing / gzhan yang sman lung la sogs pa lha khang brgyad bzhengs par grags pa'i sman lung 'di rgya bod yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed nang / ‘‘sgrol phu'i sman lu nga la sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang brgyad bzhengs/ ’’zhes dang /‘‘gsu nga rab dang / bris sku la sogs pa byas/ chos bag re mdzad kyang / rje thugs gnag pas dkon cog gi dbu yogs byung ste/ rje'i blon po snya rga/sa thog po bya ba'i go chod shos gcig rkun mas brkus nas bsad/ ro gangs kyi steng nas byung / blon po khri mdung mang btsan bya ba nad kyis zin te hreng nas gum/ dpal bzang dge 'dun byang g.yag gis bsad nas ro brag srub tu tshud nas sems sdug gis nyi ma gcig la rgas nas shi zer/ rje 'bangs thams cad skyid pa'i g.yung drus zad nas sdug pa'i res mos la babs te/mnga' bdag gi sras dpal 'khor/ jo mo skyid khrod dang bshos ’’(mkhas pa lde'u'i chos 'byung lcags par ma shog grangs 3gyi1)zhes gsal zhing deb ther la lar/ mes kyi spyod pa la dmad cing / chos la gus pa cig byung / ’’ (lo rgyus ngo mtshar snang ba bshus shog54)zhes dang / rgyal rabs gser phreng nang / ‘‘stod mnga' ris kyi gtsug lag khang la sogs pa gtsug lag khang brgyad bzhengs/ 'bum la sogs pa gsung rab kyang mang du bzhingasda nas chos gtsigs kyi dbu snyung ba yin/ 7 (bris ma shog grangs 30na)zhes gsal ba ltar mes kyi spyod pa la dmad pa dang / chos la gus pa cig byung lugs gsal ba de ni don dngos dang mthun las che/158

khong gis mes po dang mi 'dra ba chos phyogs nas sman lung la sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang / sku tshe'i mjug gtsang du byon te grom pa lha rtse'i(gzhis rtse sa khul lha rtse rdzong gnas yul)brag la pho brang mdzad nas bzhugs so//’’ (chos 'byung me tog snying po lcags par ma shog grangasatre5gyi) zhes gsal ba de snga'i lha rtse rdzong mkhar thog ma 'di dus byung 'dra ba bcas la gzhigs na kheng log byung rjes g.yo ru'i mnga' thang phal che ba shor te gtsang du 'pho bskyas gnang dgos byung rjes da dung gtsang du mnga' thang mi dman tsam dang / phyag rjes kyang ston rgyu yod pa zhig byung bar snang /khong dgung lo nyer drug son pa sa stag spyi lo9bhe8 lor bod du rab byung sogs las kyi cho gsang / klog pa thos bsam gyi 'go tshugs pa bstan pa phyi dar dbu brnyes par snang / de yang mang thos klu sgrub kyi bstan rtsis nang sa lugs ston pa'i‘‘'das lo sum stong nga gcig lon pa/ bstan pa bsnubs pa'i lcaṭa bya nas lo don bdun 'das pa'i don brgyad pa sa pho stag yi/ lo'am(spyi lo918) dpal 'khor btsan gyis rgyal srid bzung nas lo bcu bzhi lo na pa'i stag gi tshe/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sogs las kyi cho ga dang / klog pa thos bsam gyi 'go tshugs pa'i phyi dar gyi dbu brnyes so zhes kho bo smra ste/ chos la 'jug pa'i sgo las/ rgyal po 'od srungs kyi sras dpal 'khor btsan gyi sku ring la rma lung la sogs pa gtsug lag khang brgyad brtsigs so/ /de'i dus su gtsang pa mi gnyis dang / dbus pa mi gnyis mdo khams smad du byon nas sdom pa blangs te lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug dang /tshong ge shes rab seng ge dang / klu mes tshul khrims shes rab dang / 'bri 159

rje yon tan rdzi dkar ba rnams te de dag gis dbus gtsang du bstan pa 'ongs so/ /zhes bshad pas/ dpal 'khor btsan gyi sku'i ring la dbus gtsang du bstan pa 'ongs par ches gsal ba'i phyir dang / bstan pa 'ongs pa'i sa pho stag lo de/ 'das lo nas sum stong lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa dang /dpal 'khor btsan gyis rgyal srid bzung ba'i lo bcu bzhi pa yin pa yang /chos la 'jug pa'i sgo las/ shing mo glang gi lo la gtsang gi g.yo ru btsad po khri dpal 'khor btsan grom pa lha rtse nang bzhugs nas/ yab kyi mdzad pa'i cidus rtsis nas sum stong sum cu so bdun lon no/ /zhes bshad pas shes te 'od srungs drug cu rtsa gsum pa shing bya'i(byi'i) lo mjug la gshegs nas/shing glang gi lo 'go tsam la dpal 'khor bcan lo bcu gsum pa zhig gis grom pa lha rtser yab kyi gshegs rdzongs chos 'khor rgya cher bskor te rtsis pa na 'das lo nas sum stong so bdun lom/ par(spyi lordzo04) bshad pa yin pas lo de nyid la khong gis rgyal srid kyang bzung / ’’ (bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyin byed bris makāphyonalcags par65)zhes 'khod pa ltar lags pa ma zad/ gsung sgros dum bu 'di'i nang lo tshigs la sogs pa dang 'brel ba yod pa'i gnad don gal chen du ma mthong nas cha tshang bris pa yin/mthar dgung lo so gcig pa chu lug spyi lo93kālor grom sa lha rtser stag rtse snyags kyis bkrongs pa yin/ de yang dpal 'khor btsan gyis sngar g.yo rgyu ra dbang sgyur gnang skabs rang gi stobs shurges dang / srid dbang brtan srung yong ched g.yo rgyu'i khongs su rang gi bkod dbang la mi gnas pa'i stag rtse snyags kyi rus tsho 'bangs mi mang po btsan shed kyis zhe160

gtsang stod khul rgyang 'bud lta bur gnas spo byed btsug pa dang / gtsang stod nas rang la blo dkar ba'i mi ser tsho gcig g.yo rur gnas spos byed bcug pa de rnams kyis g.yo rgyu'i mi ser byings mar tshod 'dzin dang /btsan por kheng log byed mi rung ba'i nus pa 'don spel byed pa'i thabs lam spyad pas skabs der nus pa nges can thon te rjes su g.yo ru 'od srungs rgyud kyis mu mthud 'dzin thub par rmang gzhi bzang po chags kyang /g.yo ru nas gtsang stod du rgyang 'bud btang ba rnams la dpon phyogs nas gnon shugs dang / mang tshogs nang khul du yang mthong phyogs mi legs pa lta bus 'tsho ba dngos nang 'khos bag mi phebs la tha na dmigs bsal gyi mnar gcod kyang myong dgos byung 'dra bas mthar thug de'i 'khon lan glan ched stag rtse snyags kyis gyen log byas nas bkrongs pa yin/ de yang mkhas pa lde'u'i chos 'byung nang gsang ba phyag rgya can gyi skabs/ ‘‘mnga' bdag dpal 'khor stag rtse snyags kyis bkrongs/ rgyu mtshan snyags phyed gtsang du bshugs par byas pa dang / gtsang gi 'bre phyed mar yar klungs su dbab par byas pas so/ / (mkhas pa lde'u'i chos 'byung shog grangs kāgyitsa) zhes 'khod pa ltar lags/dpal 'khor btsan gyis btsun mo gnyis khab tu zhes pa'i chun ma mchims bza' btsun ne la gcen khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal dang /chen ma sna nam bza' legs btsun la gcung skyid sde nyi ma mgon gnyis 'khrungs pa sku nar son pa na gcen khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal gyis nyang stod rgyul mkhar rtse bzung ba dang / gcung skyid nyi ma mgon gyis mnga' tsā6snye

ris su phebs/ (deb ther la lar mnga' ris su sgyugs par bzhed)dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas/ ‘‘'di gnyis kyi srid phal cher yum brtan gyis khyer bas stod du byon te bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal la stod du bzhugs/ nyi ma mgon mnga' ris su byon/ mi’ (mkhas pa'i dga' ston lcags par ma'i shog grangs4kā4) zhes gsungs pa der gzhigs na sras gnyis sku na son pa'i skabs yab kyi mnga' khul de yang yum brtan rgyud kyis phrogs te stod phyogs phebs dgos byung bar mngon/dpal 'khor btsan bkrongs rjes g.yo ru'i 'bangs rnams gros byas te sras gcig gtsang nas spyan drang ngam byas pas/ yum brtan rgyud kyis thugs gnag byas dogs nas dbu ru nas rje khri lde mgon btsan spyan drangs nas 'phyos kyi rjes rnams kyis snyan g.yu ral la sogs pa phyag tu phul nas/gong du mnga' bdag mes dbon rnam gsum la sogs pa yab mes bka' drin can rnams kyi dbon sras su gyur pa dang / gnyis pa na 'bangs g.yung drung pa rnams la nyang stod kyi 'bre rtags la bka' drin can du gyur pa dang / gsum pa bka' lung rgyal khrims nyams kyang rgyal thabs ya rabs dang mtshungs pa mdzad pas rje de bla sgo dang por 'phangs kyis bzhag skad/de ltar lags pa'i stobs kyis rgyal srid la mi dbang ba'i rgyal po gcig la khri lde mgon btsan gyi rgyud 'di bsod na mas che ste/ rje'i can dgu dang /chos 'khor bsam yas la sogs pa 'od srung rgyud la med pas/ mnga' bdag dpal 'khor go ma chod pas lan pa yin skad/ ’ (ca/khas pa lde'u'i chos 'byung lcags par ma shog grangasakā71) ces gsal ba kheji log ma /6lha

byung gong gi gnas tshul du bzhed med/ 'on kyang dpal 'khor btsan gshegs rjes khong gi sras gtsang nas spyan ma drangs pa dbu ru nas yum brtan rgyud kyi sras khri lde mgon btsan spyan drangs/ khong gis rgyal thabs yang radidi kyi tshu'apre dang mthun par bskyangs sa bcas so da~Xl 'khor btsan gyi 'khrungs 'das lo tshigs re'u mig deb ther/ lo tshigs / wa da /ṭā / ba/ 'khrungs lo/ sri da bskyangs lo/ 'das lo/ /kāsdo /lo bcu gsum na sum cu pa stag rtse snyags mkhas pa spe r+sha ོ yab gshegs srid lug (sa kyis bsdongasbyi lde'u'i chos sa/ bya spyo la lo bco brgyad sku'i gye n+d+rang bzhadu la 8a+yo8 (lcags glang spyi lo lug sbya la ༵py-idī py-i/ra 'byung 881srid bzhes ) 899) dgosakyi pa/ lde'u'i jo glang (sa losdocu gas+t+rimaXb so gcig sras chos shāka ngaspyi lo /py-i dī/kāsbyakā rdzugs pa (sa luga'abyung / 8phyo9) glang spyi lo wari/1) spyi lo 899) /163

deb ther/ lo tshigs/ gsal bshad/chos 'byung chu glang bcu gsum na rgyal me tog (spyi lo sar bton(shing snying po/ 8rdzo3) glang spyi lordzo0'a)bcu gsum yab so gcig sa chen chu glang (spyi 'das rgyal sar lo bco brgyad(bcu chu lug(spyi rgyal rabs/ lo893) gsum shing glang905) lordzo33) —sngon gyi bcu gsum shing so gcig gtam me chu lug (spyi lug srid bzhes lo ྈ ——7d+ku to ga rnge+o nga lo8kha3) bco brgyad bskyangs gluri(myab/ (spyi lo8gyi5) lo8rdzokā)bhe zi—ོ bcu gsum rgyal shing bya balhams lo rang bu rton sharidzesda sar bcom sidz+wa lo bzhed yab (spyi lo ོ ( / rngoru) (spyi lo gshegs lo nas chos 'byung / bca brgyad(ma rdzorka') rig 'ded byas 89'a) yosardzo0gyi) ra 7 pa/tre 164

/——ba ——1the——bi rwasgro rngo— — ———— ——————— ——— —tsho—rda/ bye chags/ gas/lnga bshad/yar lung jo shing bya ḍisdok+ta sbyi~X/ ༵dro bo'i chos (spyi dhi+o bton(me bya spyi lo 'byung / 8phyo5 877) —tram̐/ṭāḍiṭ+wāṃ shīng bya so gsum papa dga' (spyilo (me sbrulabyed/ 8phyome) spyi lo 897)mkhasapa'i shing bya nyer gcig yab so gcig (spyilo lor(shing dga'aston 'das rgyal sa yos spyi lo / 8smo') mdzad/ 89me)bstan rtsis chu glang shing glang nas lo so gcig 'i (spyilo co pa (chu lugagasal ba ) /pyi ṭ+wāṃrgyad ) spyilo nyin byed/ ri93 sa 9༷'a 933)ཿ65

’ deb ther/ —tho 4ོ —— /de tshe nas// thosnye nga /sa snye/'a baṅged/bstan pa'i sum cu pa yab so yi/cig sbrid+mā trīkyā~X rnyim rgya mtshor rdidzoX 'das rgyal srid lo pa chu lug ṭāsdosaya rnos yig 'jug pa'i (sbya la bco brgyad (rtsi/nga ( spyi lo skyo n+t+ra yin rang 8rdzo3) chi bzhad bcu gru chen/ glang spyi lo 9sgro') 933) sprun+dishā ༵ra// yab lo rgyus ngo shing glang bcu gsum pa me so gcigad+ngha tshorī mtshar stsong (mi lo glang yab 'das pa shing li riste srid lo bco brgyad lug (spyi ba/ 9༷5) bzung (spyi lo91gyi) lo 93྾)btsan po'i lcags so lnga sa —gdung shing bya tsho'i lasarabs tshig (spyi lo glang (sbya ༄ /nyung don 8smo') lo881) (spyi lo ba/thag95/ 89ba9ba)16 6

gnyis pa/ khri bkra shis baṭā gas pa dpal dang skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyi skor/yab mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyi btsun mo chun ma mchims bza' btsun ni la gcen khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal dang / chen ma sna nam bza' legs btsun la gcung skyid lde nyi ma mgon 'khrungs/dpal 'khor btsan gyi sras gnyis po 'khrungs dus zhib cha 'khod pa'i yig lam ma rnyed rung yab byi/ 'khrungs 'das lo tshigs la gzhigs na spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu pa'i lo rabs bcu nas nyi shu'i bar la rim bzhin 'khrungs par mngon/1 gcen khri bkra shis brtsegs nga/'i skor/khri bkra shis brtsegs pa sku nar son rjes khong gi mnga' ris phal cher yum brtan phyogs kyis phrogs pas gtsang du phebs te nyang stod rgyal mkhar rtse bzungs/ btsun mo cog ro bza' mgon dpal khab tu bzhes par sras dpal lde dang / 'od lde/ skyid sde bcas smad kyi lde gsum du grags pa rim bzhin 'khrungs/yab dpal 'khor btsan stag rtse snyags kyis bkrongs rjes sras 'di rgyal srid la dbang bskur ba 'di'i thad/ lo rgyus yig lam nang bzhed pa mthun min cung zad 'dug lde'u jo sras chos 'byung nang / ‘‘glang lo la kheng log byung / mtha'i rgya drug rgod du shor/ lha sras(dpal 'khor trī67

btsan) nyid kyang stag rtse snyags kyis bkrongs/ lha sras mched gnyirdo / gtsang du bros/ ’’ (lde'u ngo sras chos 'byung lcags par ma shog grangs1bhe3)zhes dang / bu ston dang / ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub bzhed pa mthun par bkra shis brtsegs pas rgyal srid bzung zhes dang / sa chen rgyal rabs nang bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal gyis dbus gtsang gi rgyal po byas zhes bkra shis brtsegs pas yab gshegs rjes rgyal srid bzung bar bzhed pa mi mthun pa med med/ dus tshod thad lde'u jo sras kyi bzhed pa ltar na yab bkrongs rjes sras gnyis gtsang du bros pa dang / de'i rgyun mthud pa lta bur 'bangs rnams bgros nas sras gnyis gtsang nas spyan 'dren rtsis byas par yucha/ brtan rgyud gyis thugs/ gnag byas dogs dbu ru nas khri lde mgon btsan spyan drangs pa'i 9lo rgyus 'di gnyis cung zad 'gal bar snang ba des na dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas 'di gnyis kyi srid phal cher yum brtan gyis khyer bas stod du byon te bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal la stod du bzhugs/ nyi ma mgon mnga' ris su byon par bzhed pa'i 'gros ltar gong du smos pa ltar bkra shis brtsegs dpal nyang stod rgyal mkhar rtse bzung ba'i skabs yab dpal 'khor btsan gshegs te mtshan tsam gyi dbus gtsang rgyal po'i srid la dbang bskur ba dang / de rjes la stod du bzhugs pa'i pho brang gi yab kyi sku dus bzhengs pa grom pa lha rtse'i brag dmar yin no/ /khri bkra shis brtsegs pa nam gshegs kyi lo tshigs nges pa rnyed pa'i yig cha ma rnyed rung yab mched gyes pa'i lo tshigs(mang thos klu sgrub kyi bzhed pa ltar na chu 'brug spyi lordzo93 lo)la gzhigs na dgung lo bdun cu brgal skor zhig 168

pazhugaku4 'dra/ kra spyid lde nyi ma mgon gyi skor/skyid sde nyi ma mgon sku nar son rjes khong gi srid phal cher yang yud+dha/ brtan rgyud kyis khyar bas bzhugs bzod mi bde ba byung ste mnga' ris su byon khar‘‘yab kyi zhal nas/ lho mon dong kha phye ba 'dra ba dang / 'bru sha dang / sbal ti dang / sa sgang gi grog mo la sogs pa mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa mang po yod pas/ yi dam dang srung mar mdo sngags kyi cho ga 'di rnams gyis shig gsungs nas gnang bas/ mnga' ris kyi brtsad po rnams chab srid dang / mnga' ris mtho bar byin rlabs che ba yin ‘‘ (chos 'byung me tog snying po shog grangasabhe'agyi)zhes lo rgyus yig lam nang 'khod yod/mnga' ris su byon skabs blon po zhang pa tshab rin chen lde dang /cog ro legs sgra lha legs gnyis kyis gtsang gi bye ma g.yung drung bar phebs skyes du phyin pa dang / sa tshab kyis spyang thul gyi nang bza' dang / cog ros dre'u gcig phul nas 'bral mi phod pa ngus par skyid sde nyi ma mgon gyis nga mnga' ris su 'apyo/ra rjes rgyal srid 'dra zin srid na khyed gnyis kyis nga'i khab tu bu mo re brdzang par zhu gsungs te mnga' ris su byon nas thog mar ma ①ོ myo/ pham gyi byang du bzhugs/skyid lde nyi ma mgon mnga' ris su phebs pa'i skor bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas/ ‘‘chung ba skyid sde nyi ma mgon mnga' ris su sgyugs pas su rangs su sku mkhar nyi gzungs brtsigs te chab srid bzung’’ (bu ston chos 169

'byung shog grangs14snyob)zhes gsungs pa dang / rgyal rabs gser phreng nang‘‘skyid lde nyi ma mgon ni/ bod kheng log gi 'bal ma zug gar khyung dpal ldan grub dang / me nyag pa ā kā badz+ra gnyis kyis ba/tso byas pa'i rta pa brgya snyang mnga' ris su phebs pa'i lam khar/ nya dang sgo nga gsol dgos pa byung nas/ der ras kyi phur nas drangs pas/ da lta kha myad ras bod rgyal po'i lugs su song ba yin no//’mi (rgyas rabs gser phreng bris ma shog grangs30na) zhes 'khod pa'i lo rgyus dum bu 'di rnams dkyus gcig tu sgrig na skyid lde nyi ma mgon ni kheng log gi tshogs pa che ge mos mnga' ris su rgyang 'bud btang 'dra bas phebs khar yab thugs phreng ba'i rnam pa dang bcas phyin chad gnang sgo'i bslab bya zhib mo gnang ba dang / blon po gnyis po gtsang stod bar phebs skyel la phyin te nang bza' dang / bzhon drel phul ba/ rgyang 'bud du phebs skabs lta srung du 'bal ma zug gar khyung gis gtsos pa'i rta pa tsho gcig yod pa/ phebs lam gyi gsol chas kyang khong gi thugs su mi 'bab pa'i nya sgong gsol dgos pa bcas kyis skyid lde nyi ma mgon mnga' ris su sgyugs par bzhed pa de skabs de'i lo rgyus ngo ma yin par kha tshon bcad chogade nas ra la'i rgyud du phebs/ khong ni spyod lam legs shing blo gros che bas khul de'i mi tsho'i brtsi bkur thob pa dang mnga' thang yang gang 'tshams 'phel rgyas song bas rta'i lo('di'i dbang thang gsal po med kyang yab gshegs pa'i dus nas rig 'ded byas na shing po rta spyi lo934lo)la ra la kha dmar brtsigs pa dang / de'i phyi lo shing lug spyi lo935rtse tho rgya ri 170

brtsigs nas dam lag gi gzhung rnams la yul dang grong khyer mang po gsar du 'dzugs pa'i dgongs pa bzhes shing / mar yul la gnod pa ma mdzad/de'i dus su mar yul khongs la dwags stod ge sar gyi rgyud pas 'dzin cing /la dwags smad rnams rang dgar sil bur gnas yod ces lo rgyus yig lam du 'khod pa ltar lags/de rjes skyid sde nyi ma mgon gyis mnga' ris skor gsum gyi gnas tshul zhib 'jug byed par blon po shes rig ldan pa gsum sgor gsum sa zhul so sor btang bas su rangs phyogs rtog zhib byed mkhan blon po phyir 'khor nas rje la phyag byas bsnyun thed zhus shing / rjes su rangs kyi gnas tshul ci 'dra 'dug bka' 'dri gnang bar su rangs kyi lung pa ni rta bshas pa'i khog pa gangs kyis bskor ba 'dra la mi ni srin po 'dra ba zhig mchis zer/gu ger 'gro mkhan blon pos gu ge lung pa ni nya lto dkar gyi khog pa 'dra ba g.ya' yis bskor ba zhigs mi ni lug 'dra ba gda' zer/mar yul du 'gro mkhan blon pos mar yul ni yul kotremog chab kyis gang ba gangs kyis bskor 'dra ba dang / mi ni sbal pa 'dra ba zhig gda' sogs zhus pas de rnams kyi gnas tshul gsal pos rtogs/ rang re rje blon rnams kyis bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa 'bul ba dang / gsol ba smon lam legs po btab ste sa gnas de tshor rim bzhin bskyod pas chog ces thog mar su rangs su phebs nas tshong 'khos kyi thabs tshul 'e/nga po mdzad thog yul de'i mi rnams zas kyis tshims par mdzad pa sogs kho tsho'i sems mgu bar mdzad pas kho tshos skyid lde nyi ma mgon la dad mos thob pa 171

byung nas rim bzhin skabs dang sbyar ba'i khrims lugs gsar bzo dang 'brel bar su rangs dbang du bsdus shing / de nas dmag shugs la brten nas gu ge yang mnga' 'og tu bcug de rjes dpung stobs dang bcas ma ra yul du phebs te mar yul dbang du bsdus shing / mar yu la du yang 'os 'tshams kyi khrims srol bcas thog khong gi bka' la mi gnas pa rnams las nyes pa chen po rang med pa tshor rang gi nyes pa khas len du bcug pa dang / rang nyes ji bzhin khas mi len pa 'gog rgol gyi rnam pa tshabs che ba'i stes can 'ga' zhig gi mgo bregs pa sogs 'jam rtsub ci rigs pa phyag bstar gyis mnga' ris bskor gsum khyon yongs la dbang sgyur ba'i mnga' ris kyi rgyal po mdzad cing / su rangs su sku mkhar nyi zung zhes bya ba brtsigs(mkhas pa sde'u'i chos 'byung shog grangasabhe'askya nang gsal ba ltar sgrig)pa 'di ni stod du rgyal khrims zhwa tsam chags zhes gsungs pa de yin/sku mkhar nyi zung grub pa'i zhal spro'i skabs nam mkha' nas lung bstan pa'i sgrar/ ‘‘sems can spyi mthun las la legs grub pa//nyi ma zhes bya de yi grogs su ni//pu rong zhes byar bod kyi rgyal khab byung //sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyi ma deng 'dir shar//’’(btsan po' gdung rabs tshig nyung don gsal bris ma shog grangs 13na)zhes kun gyis thos par grags pa 'di'i thog nas mtshon pa ni kheng 172

log rjes btsan po'i gdung rgyu+od kyis 'dzin pa'i sa khul srid dbang khyab rgya che la khrims lugs dang btsan mkhar ram pho brang sogs cung cha tshang ba'i rgyal rabs shig mnga' ris su tshugs pa mtshon cing / blon po ni mang dkar dang / khyung pos byas/ de rjes blon po zhang pa tshab rin chen sde dang / cog ro legs sgra lha legs gnyis kyis skyid lde nyi ma mgon sngar mnga' ris la phebs skabs khas len zhus pa bzhin blon po gnyis pos rang rang gi bu mo re btsun mor phul bas tshab ma (la lar stag gzig bza' zhes 'bod)la sras ca/ 'khrungs pa dang / cog ro bza' zangs kha ma la sras che ba dpal gyi rig pa mgon dang / bar pa bkra shis lde mgon/ chung ba lde gtsug mgon gsum rim par 9skrukhrungs pas sku na son rjes yab kyi sras gsum por mnga' ris skor gsum so sor bgo bsha' gnang ba ni/che ba dpak+ṣa gyi rig pa mgon la mar yul dang / 'bangs gzhu nag can/ shar ru thog dang / gser kha 'gog lad kyi sde mchog dkar po/mtshams kyi ra ba dmar po/ wam le yi mig gi pha bong la mgo bar/ nub kha che'i la rtsa/ rdo bub sa can yan chad/ byang gser kha 'gog po tshun chad kyi sa rgya la gtogs pa rnams/bar pa bkra shis lde mgon la zhang zhung dang / ya rtse/chung ba sde sa/tsug mgon la zangs dkar sgo gsum/ spri ti/ spi rtsog dang bcas pa rnams yin/mnga' ris dum bu gsum du bgos pa'i skos la dwags rgyal rabs trī7bye

nang 'a/lo da pa ltar ba kod ci nga / sa chen rgyal rabs dang / mkhas pa'i dga' ston nang gsal ba dang cung mi mthun/ de bzhin btsukhu/ mo'i skor la dwags rgyal rabs dang / rgyal rabs gser phreng bzhed pa mthun pa lta༈ra na dge bshis bkra shis btsan gyis pu rangs su 'bro bza' 'khor skyong btsun mor phul ba khab tu bzhes par stod kyi mgon gsum 'khrungs par bzhed pa dpyad gzhir bstar ba bcas so /gsum pa/ spad kyi lde gsum skor/dpal 'khor btsan gyi sras khri bkra shis rtsegs pa dpal dang patsun mo cog ro bza' mgon dpal la sras dpal lde dang / 'od lde/5 skyid lde bcas smad kyi lde gsum grags pa rnams rim par 'khrungs/chu pho 'brug gi(spyi lo993)lo yab mched so sor gyes nas lde gsum po grom pa lha rtser gdan phab ste gtsang phyogs la mnga' myo/dzad pas smad kyi lde gsum du grags te/de yang dpal lde'i rgyud kyis zam pa gsum dbang mdzad pa ni/ lha rtseri nas zam sngon mo/ gling bu'i sha zam dmar mo/ mang yul gyi gser zam ser po'o 'od lde'i rgyud kyis sgo gsum la dbang mdzad pa ni/ drin dang gnya' nam rdzas kyi slo// bud mkhar ra shing gi sgo / zar ltag sna ngatsos5 kyi sgo'o//skyid lde'i rgyud kyis byang gi ma/dzod gsum la dbang mjad pa ni/ byang g.yu ma tsho sngon mo tshware mdzod/ byang kha sna brgyad sha'i ma dzod/ ku lang ko lha74 spre

po gser gyi mdzod/ ces grags pa'o//’’ zhes bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyin byed(lcags par ma shog grangs71) nang gsal por 'khod pa dang /lo rgyus yig lam gzhan du 'khod pa'i dbar phra rags tsam gyi khyad par las ma mthong ba bcas ni sras gsum po'i gzhi rtsa'i gnas tshul yin cing / bye brag gi gnas tshul gdung rabs khag phye nas zhu rgyu gsham gsal/1 dpal lde'i rgyud pa'i skor/dpal ldes cog ro bza' 'ba' re khab tu bzhes par sras gcen 'od zer lde dang / gcung snyarma tsakra gnyis 'khrungs shing / gcen 'od zer lde mnga' ris smad mang yul gung thang du phebs te gdung rabs chags par gung thang rgyal po'i gdung rabs zhes bya bar grags pa lags/ mang yul gung thang zhes bya ba'i ming 'byung tshul ni/ nyi sras nam bya/kha' nyi ma'i gung du slebs pas gung thang dang / srid pa'i ma mo bdun dang / grub pa'i gnas chen mang du yod r+pās mang yul zhes bya bar grags/mang yul gung thang du btsan po'i rgyal rabs thog ma 'byung stangs ji ltar yin zhe na/ bar skabs bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal po med par 'od srungs yum brtan 'khrugs te bod sil bur song ba'i rjes gung thang gi yul mi rnams bgros nas 'u cag thun mong skyong ba'i rje bo zhig dgos pa 'dug ces dpal lde —4 btsun mo cog ro bza' 'bar te khab tu bzhes pa'i sras gnyis kyi gcen po 'od zer lde zhes bya ba gung thang du spyan 'dren par meṭa / po stod kyi khri rje dang zhang brjid ldan ring cho/ bya ba gnyis phyin te 'od zer 17 5

lde gung thang du gdacha/ drangs thang sto da tho le zhes par gdan phab nas sku mkhar brtsigs shing / spyan 'dren mkhan gnyis kyis blon po byas te chab srid bskyangs pa de nas gung thang gi rgyal rabs byung /'od zer lde'i sras dbang po lde/ de'i sras dung dkar lde/ de'i sras btsan lde bcas rim par byung zhing / de rnams kyis srid skyong ba'i skabs sde sgo bzhi btsad chung khab pa dang lnga zhes yul tshan re dpon res bzung ba'i 'go dpon mnyam 'dzoms kyi 'du tshogs gyes long gdong du byed cing / de skabs grags pa'i btsad chung phab pa ni dpal sde'i gdung rgyud la grags pas de skabs mnga' thang mi che/btsan lde la sras gsuca/ ste/ gcen lha mchog sde'am 'dol le/bar pa dkon mchog lde/ gcung 'od lde'am rtse mo zhes bya ba rim par byung ba'i tha chung rtse mo'i rgyud pa ni jo bo 'jad pa yin zhes dang / phal mo cher sde pa tsha mda' ba yin zhes kyang brjod/sa/cen lha mchog lde'i sku ring la mnga' thang sngar dang mi 'dra ba yar rgyas/ song zhing / gshongs dbus nub ri steng po che dar yol bres pa lta bur pho brang phying khab ngo/nga du grags mi sku mkhar lcags ri 'ob dang bcas pa byas shing / 'di'i sku dus rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun mi la ras pa yang grub pa ba rnyes te za 'og phug tu phebs pa dang dus mtshungs pas (rje btsun mi la ras pa ni lcags 'brug spyi lo 104༷ lor 'khrungs pa dang chu yos spyi lo 1133lor sku gshegs) phal cher spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu 176(——

gcig pa'i mjug tsam la yin par snang /gcung 'od lde'i sras dbang phyug lde/de'i sras skyob pa lde/ de la sras mo gsum dang / sras mgon po sde'am phyag la sha mtshan dmar po yod pas dpung dmar zhes kyang grags shing / de'i sku ring la spang zhod chos grags kyis ye tshe'i yul nas mon gyi dmag drangs pa dang 'thab pas ma thub par mgon po sde skyid grong du bros phebs pa sa mtshams nas pha rol pos zin te khab kyi sku mkhar mthong sar bkrongs shing / khong gi dbu khyer ba'i khrag thigs zags pa'i sa la mchod rten re re yang bzhengs par grags/ khong gi btsun mo dngos la sras med cing / ra la'i btsun ma byang chub 'dren zhes bya ba mkhan chen (gnyos ston byang chub) gzungs kyi dbon gyi sras mor gyur pa zhig dang 'brel ba la mngal chags nas yod pa pha rol po la 'jigs te bros pas klong rtser slebs/ der btsun ma brgyad kyis gzeb kyi nang du bcug ste rgyab tu khyer nas dpal mo skyid phug tu bskyal bar phu ris rang gi khu bo mkhan chen gnyos ston byang chub gzungs kyi spyan sngar phyin/ mkhan pos kyang gdung rgyud 'di shin tu gces pa yin zhes phu ri dang gyam gyi dge 'dun rnams la sku rim sgrub tu bcug pa bzhin rgyal bu mtshan dang lda na pa zhig lug rar bya ther nang du 'khrungs/ yang/ gshegs pa'i lor btsas pa'i khye'u la dbus su lto bor dang / mnga' ris su sgro spangs su 'bod la/ rgyal bu sgro spangs de btsun pa'i chas su bcug nas 177

ming btsun pa ldir bstogs/ de skabs rgyal srid kyi bya ba ni de no chung shos btsun mar bzhugs pa lha rin chen mtsho zhes pas byed cing / khong ni dgra gnyen la ngar thon zhing blo gros kyi lang tsho brtas pa zhig ste gcenu mo lha gcig mdzes ma bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyi gcung zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi btsun mo'i gras su(zangs tshas snga rjes su btsun mo lnga khab tu bzhes pa) yod pas sngar nas gnyen stabs dang de'i(zangs tsha'i)sras mo tsha bo btsun pa sde'i khab tu gnyen brtsegs te sa skyar phyag rten btang zhing 'phrin las bcol nas dmag khyer chen pos ye tshe'i phyogs la dgra sha glan byin mi mang du bsad/ de'i sdig sbyong la khab gong gi lha khang dmar po dang / 'or gnas gsar gyi lha khang dang / de dag tu ka ṇi chen po re re/gzhan yang mchod rten phra mo mang du brtsegs/ chos mkhar du rgyud brtag gnyis dang / 'om phug tu rgyud gsang snying gi bshad grwa btsugs/ sgos gzhis gdung phug tu mdzad de der mdo mang glegs bam bzhi bcu bzhengs shing gsung sgrog na mar btsugs pa dang / tshe smad thugs dam la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba sogs bud med gcig la ya rabs kyi dper 'os pa byung /khong gis sa skya dang gnyen brtsegs pa'i tshul ni rang nyid skye ba dman zhing tsha bo sku na phra bas gnyen dpon zhig btsal dgos snyams pa na/ rang gi gcen mo zangs tsha'i btsun mo mdzes ma la sras mo bsod nams 'bum dang / nyi ma 'bum gnyis yod pa'i nyi ma 'bum chu mig sde dpon gyi btsun mor gshegasge na 8 smi sras mo zhig 'khrungs kyang thugs ma song nas stod gtsang so thang chung ba shākya seng ge'i snyan pa gsan nas rang gi ming po chos rgyal 178

'phags pa la skyid grong gi jo bo wa ri mjal ba'i zol gyi gnang ba zhus par 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ma zhag gtsang po'i phyogs 'di//long gtam tshig la smra lce bde//la stod lho yi phyogs 'di//ar kun jag pa'i 'jigs pa che//skyid rong bal po'i phyogs 'di//zas skom btung bcas tshad pa che//zhes gsungs shing don du zhal zhes gnang nas yar lam thang chung du byon kyang shākya seng ge'i thugs 'dod med par rig nas gung thang du gnyen 'phrad dang 'phags pa wa ri mjal bar byon pas khab kyi chu tshan khar rgyal bu dang mjal/sru mo lha rin chen mtshos tsha mo nyi ma 'bum dgung na phra yang / sa paṇa khu dbon rgya hor rgyal po'i mchod gnas su gyur pas stobs che ba dang bcas skabs su babs par dgongs nas/ rgyal bu btsun pa lde dang mtshams sbyar nas khab tu bzhugs par byas/ de'i tshe 'gro mgon 'phags pas la lce la mar yong dgos pa'i pho nya spra na par nyi ma 'bum gyis zhu yig tu gsol bar/skyid grong bal po'i yul 'di tshad pa tsha gsung ba ltar gda' bas bdag skom nas chu mig gcig nas chu 'thung pas nye'u zhig khog par shor ba'i rkyen gyis kho mo myur du yong thabs ma byung bas de la brtse ba'i bslab bya zhig zhu zhes par/ chu mig legs par brtags la gyis/ nya chung la gces spras 'tshal/tsā79

re zhig der sdod na rung / zhes gnang ba bzhin bdag mo nyi ma 'bum la chu mo glang gi lor(spyi lo13me3) btsun pa lde yi sras su khri rgyal 'bum sde mgon 'khrungs/mnga' bdag 'od srungs las gyes pa'i gdung rabs dpal 'khor btsan(spyi lo93kālor ) gshegs pa nas khri rgyal 'bum lde mgon(spyi lo 1kra53lo ) 'khrungs pa'i bar lo339song jing / khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal gyi sras gcen po dpal sde nas chig rgyud btsun pa lde bar gdung rabs bcu gcig song ba'i nang 'tsho gzhes lo rgyun rang shos ni khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal dgung lo bdun cu skor bzhugs 'dra ba de yin par sems 'bum lde mgon dgung lo dgu pa shing glang(spyi lo13smome) lor 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa hor gyi rgyal po'i ti shrir gyur te bod chol kha gsum dbang sgyur ba'i lung dang bcas sa skyar phebs skabs yum sras gnyis kas phyag rten bzang po dang bcas mjal phebs shing / skabs der sa skyar chos khri thang du khrom tshogs shin tu che ba 'dus pa'i sar khong la zhe sa dang gus bkur byed mkhan gcig kyang ma byung bar thugs ma drangs nas g.yas kyi dong pa nas mda' zhig blangs te nam mkha' la 'phangs pas gar babs gtol med pas khrom tshogs rnams ca co sgrog bzhin phar bros tshur bros byed pa dang sa skya ba'i tsha bo 'di glang dang 'dra ba 'dug ces gleng skad/ de'i sang nyin chos rgyal 'phags pa thog mar mjal skabs sku zhad dang / sa skya'i zhal ngo rnams la zab gos kyi gdan brtsegs ma brgyab yod rung / 1skyu 0

dbam̐n mnga' bdag sras chung rang la sbol grum zhig las med par gzigs nas der yang cung zad ma rangs pas 'gro mgos 'phags pa la phyag ma byas par bsnyun gsol bas 'phags pa'i zhal nas kha sang khrom la mda' brtegs pa dang / de rang nga la phyag 'bul mi byed pa'i tsha bo 'di glang sha stag tu 'dug ces gsungs shing / khong gi mdzad spyod der gnas skabs skye bo gzhan gyis smod pa ltar gyur kyang don du dpa' bo dor thabs can zis spyis gnon pa'i snyems pa 'chang ba zhig tu thams cad kyi yid yul du 'jags par byas/de skabs 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas tsha bo 'bum lde mgon la skabs su babs pa'i dbang byin rlabs dang / dngos po'i gnang skyes gya nom pa/ de bzhin lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya bdud rtsi lta bu bstsal ba dang / lcam gyi rdzongs su chags pa'i pha gzhis dud chen brgya sde don du stong 'khor gnang nas/ yar byon khar sku tsha gzhon nu 'di la lo gsum ma smyo na grags pa'i gtam mi thob ces pa yin pas khyod kyi yid la ji ltar 'dod pa de ltar byos shig pa'i bka' shed bskur du brtsal/ rgyab gnyer dpon chen shākya bzang po dpung dang bcas pa mngags nas yum sras mnga' ris gung thang du phebs/skabs der gung thang sde sgo bzhi zhes brten dbang shed shin tu che bas sngar mnga' dmeng du ma bsdus pa thog mar de rnams dbang du bsdu bar dgongs nas sde sgo bzhi'i mkhan po bzhi bkug sde khab gong gi sgo buzhir an bcug ste/ hor gyi khrims srol ltar khrims rnga brdungs/ tho rtags phyar/181

rnga thug sgreng nas nga ro chen pos tsham rngam 'jigs 'jigs ltar du 'de skad ces/ ‘‘kyai thams cad nyon cig gnam la nyi zla zung gcig sa la gong ma mchod yon zhes snyams pa 'brug ltar du sgrog pa de ma thos sam/ da lta'i gung thang khab pa 'di bod rgyal po'i gdung rgyud dri ma med pa cho teno rgya‘ra srong btsan sgam po dang / khri srong lde'u btsan/ khri ral pa can sogs kyi rgyud pa mang pos bkur ba'i rigs yin par ma go'am/ de la deng sang sgo bzhi bcad chung khab nga/ dang lnga zhes ngo mthon du smra ba khrims chen po dang 'gal ba mi bzad pa yin pas chad pa sna dgu thob pa go dgos/ (gung thang btsad po'i gdung rabs bris ma shog grangasabheb)zhes khrims bsgrags shing / de nas khrims tshig tu bsgrags pa des pha rol por lan cha ji byung rtog zhib byed par gsang ba'i sgo nas nyan rna rtog chen pa btang bar/ban de tsho na re/ 'o cag gi mkhan po rnams kyi sku la nyes pa byed na bzod thabs med pas nga tshos srog dang bsdos te rgol bar bya'o// /sdig mo tsam byas nas 'jags la 'gel na deng sang sa skya pa'i kha gtad sus kyang mi chog pas ci zer nyan pa las 'os med ces zer ba go nas/ de'i sang nyin khrims gtam du 'o lags so/ /khyed rnams kyi sngar gyi byed par dpags na khrims ci nga nga thob par snang med/ nged kyi chori 5/ rje nyid zhi la khyams pa'i thugs mnga' zhing / khyed rnams kyang rab tu byung ba'i tshul can du 'dug na da lam nyes med du 'jog pas phyin chad rgyal rje khab pa'i zhabs spyi bor longs/ bkaspru gsung ci ci / sdo/ dad gus kyi zho sha phul cig gal srid de las 'gal na drag po'i gzher yong nges yin pas yid la 'jaka/sa pa gyis 182

zhis don gnad la phab pa'i gtsigs sam yi ge blangs shing / zang zing gis kyang kho tsha'i yid mgu bar byayo pas kho tshos sngar gyi tho co'i spyod pa spang shing / gus pa lhur len pa'i 'bangs su byas pa bcas de ltar mnga' 'og sde tshan ming du brgya tsho zhes 'bod kyang don du stong tshor sgrile ba bcu gsum du gtan la phab pa ste/ gung thang(da lta'i rdzong kha khul)skyid grong / nub ri/ (dus phyis gor khongs) ma zhang rgya tshang pa dang bzhi ni rtsa ba'i mi sde rnam bzhir 'khod pa dang / glo stod dang / glo smad/ (dus phyis gor khongs)dol gru bzhi/ bzang rgyud pa bzhi la ral gris bcad pa'i sde bzhir 'bod pa/ gnyos dang / dngul/ phu ri mtsho 'khor/ gtsang po bzang tsha ba bzhi la gus pas btud pa'i mi sde bzhin 'bod pa bcas brgya skor bcu gnyis khar/ lcam gyi rdzongs la byung ba pha gzhis chags kyi brgya sko ra bcas yin/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa lcags rta (spyi lo1370)lor phyis kyi gdung rabs rnams kyi 'phral yun gyi dgos pa du ma'i ched du me rdo thang du pho brang zhig btab par dgongs te sa de'i bdag po yang thog par sa rin la rin po che'i phreng ba/ dngul gyi ga ṭa/ rta rgod ma dkar po/ dar yug bzang po bcas gnang ste rgyal po'i khab bkra shis khyung rdzong dkar po btsun mo'i slas khang lcags ri dang bcas nga/ da lta mnga' ris rdzong dkar du grags pa brgya tsho bcu gsum bskul nas bsgrun pa dang / de nas 'gro ba rnams kyi bsodari nams kyi zhing dang / yab yum gyi dge rtsar dngo/ngas nas bkra shis sgo 'i /ra gi gtsug lag khang ka ba drug cu'i khyon yod pa'i phugs na gtsang /tsāng rka// ba nyer bzhi dang / mdo khyams gtsug lag khang chen pos ka 183
