bo sum cu so drug yod pa bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa bzhengs shing /de'i nang du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis lung bstan par grags pa mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang bal po'i bzo bo u pa sitis gtso byas pa brgyad kyis sa skya rin chen sgang gi mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang dang cha mthun par bzhengs pa'i gzungs bzhugs su badzña 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyal drug gi ya gyal slob dpon chen po ba su bal yul du zhi bar gshegs pa'i dbu thod bal po'i rgyal po'i mdzod du bzhugs pa mnga' bdag 'bum lde mgon gyi phyag tu 'byor pa rin po che'i sgrol bur bzhugs su gsol ba la sogs pa byin rlabs kyi mtshan kha 'bar bas mtshon pa'i sku gsung thugs rten mang po bzhugs pa dang / de bzhin gser bris kyi yum che mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam bcu drug bcas gtsug lag khang dang gsung rten 'di rnams gung lo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa me mo glang(spyi lo 13gyi7)lor grub/dus tshod 'di'i yas mas su phyi rabs kyi gdung rgyud la sman pa'i slad du rnam par rgyal ba'i btsan rdzong bcu phrag lhag 'debs par mdzad pa de yang ji skad du/gu ge pu rong kha gnon du//dkar dum gnam gyi khyung rdzong brtsigs//phyi 'brog men zhang kha gnon du//bya rtsi rnam rgyal thar po dang //mtsho dbar nye ba'i glo stod du//184

ni ri g.ya' rdzong dkar po brtsigs//glo bo mtsho bzhi'i kha gnon la// dhegatsang rong bya pho'i ze ba brtsigs//ta mang se mon kha gnon du//glo smad mu khun srin rdzong brtsigs//dol po mon gyi kha gnon du//dol po'i yi ge drug ma brtsigs// la stod byang gi kha gnon la//la ru'i gad rdzong dkar po brtsigs//la stod lto yi kha gnon la//khun tsho gad rdzong dkar po brtsigs//skyid rong sgo bzhi gnas 'jim khar//rag mar gyad non thar po dang /skyid rong mthil du seng ge rdzong //glang mkhar gsal ba'i yang rtse brtsigs//rgya bal gnyis kyi kha gnon la//bal po rdzong gi rdzong dmar brtsigs//snyi shong rong gi kha gnon la//khong tshegs gnam gyi ka ba brtsigs//nub ri mtha' 'khob kha gnon du//rod kyi brag rdzong nag po brtsigs//k+ṣe8bya

phyag pa ya bzhi'i btsan sa ru//chu dkar rdzong chung 'dzum shor brtsigs//’’(gung thang btsad po'i gdung rabs bris ma shog grangs8na)zhes rdzong che+o / bcu gnyis/ po/ dgung lo bcu bdun nas nyer lnga'i bar lo brgyad kyi dus tshod nang brtsigs pa'i khongs nas skyid rong glang seng gi mkhar sogs 'ga' zhig/ gdung rabs phyi mas brtsigs par bzhed pa yang yod/mnga' bdag 'di ni gung thang btsan po'i gdung rabs gyes/ tshun chad la byung ba'i gung thang btsan po mdzad pa 'phrin las la brten nasdo/ chab srid dang mnga' thang gang thad gzhan gyis 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba zhig byung ba ma zad/ dus rgyun mdzad pa'i nang yang chen por 'os pa'i bya ba rnams la thugs snang chen po gnang mkhan zhig yin/ dper na 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i spyan ltos dang bcas chen por 'os pa'i las tshan bcu gsum yang sgrig par mdzad pa ste dam gnyer gnyis/ gsol gzim gnyis/mjal yig gnyis/ skya rnga gnyis/ thab 'dren gnyis/ rta mdzo gnyis/gdugs 'dzin pa dang bcu gsum mo//khong gis se ma 'bum skyong rgyal mo khab tu bzhes par khri rin chen bzang po 'khrungs shing / gzhan yang sras khri lde 'bum dang / bsam sde gnyis kyang rim par 'khrungs/ yig cha la lar khri lde 'bum gcen yin yang zer ba yum mi gcig par 'khrungs pas lo khyad cher med pa lta bur mardon/khri rgyal krābum lde mgon ni 'jig rten phyogs kyi 'phrin las rgyas pa tsam ma zad/ rnam par dge ba'i mdzad bzang gi phyag rjes mang po mnga' 186

ba gong du rags tsam smos pa ltar dang / da dung byang chub mchog gi nye lam nang du yang dag 'jog la thugs gzhol bar bzhed nas chab srid 'phrin las kyi mdzad pa skyong ba'i thugs gseng gang byung la lingo nga brag dmar du bzhugs pa'i zhang sgom ri pa chen po dang / ron mda' rdzong sgo glang ri grub pa'i skyes bu brtson 'grus rgyal po gnyis kyi zhabs la gtugs nas smin byed kyi dbang dang grol byed kyi lung legs par shes te de dag gi don la rtse gcig mnyam par bzhag pas nyams rtogs kyi yon tan yang ches che ba dang ldan zhes yongs su grags pa bcas mthar dgung lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa rab byung lnga pa'i lcags 'brug (spyi lo138du)lor 'bangs mi srun pa zhig gis gsol ngan gyi sbyor bas sku gshegs/ de'i sras lha rin chen bzang po ste des yon tan bkod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan mi tshad rin po che'i phra rgyan du mas mdzes pa gsar du bskrun pa sogs rnam dkar la thugs gzhol ba'i mdzad pa ci rigs mdzad cing / rgya nag tu hor gyi rgyal po'i pho brang du lung las rtags zhu bar bzhed de rgya yul du phebs pa der sku gshegs/lha rin chen bzang po rgya nag tu phebs skabs thog mar sa skyar phebs pa'i tshe shar pa kun dga' rin chen pas da lam khyed yul thag ring du phebs skabs sku tsher bar chad yong nyen la des na bang gi gdung rgyud chad na phangs pas nga'i khyim bdag mo 'di la sras gcig 'tshol zhes mtshams 3sbyar ba ltar ma gcig lha mo 'bum dang rtsen pas ring por ma thogs pa lha rin chen bzang po gshegs pa'i lo ste lcags 'brug (spyi lo1380) lor 187

sras sgro spangs su 'khrungs par mtshan chos skyong lder btags/khri rgyal 'bum gyi sras 'bring pa mnga' bdag khri lde 'bum rab byung lnga pa'i sa 'brug (spyi lo13phyo8)lor 'khrungs shing / khong ni snying stobs dang / blo gros phun sum tshogs pas rgyal srid kyang yun ring tsam bskyangs shing / yab kyi dgongs rdzogs su sangs rgyas shākya seng ge'i sku brnyan dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i tshad dang ldan pa gsar bzhengs dang lo zla dus kyi mchod pa'i rgyun yang btsugs/dgung lo bzhi bcu pa rab byung lnga pa'i me lug(spyi lo13d+nghagyi)lor hor gyi rgyal po'i lung las zhu bar rje blon brgyad ta'i tur phebs te o la ja du rgyal po nas/ ‘‘khyed rang bod la dbang bsgyur ba'i rigs rgyud chen po yin 'dug pas gnam gyi shed mong ster ba'i 'os su snang zhes bod shing sgo btsugs pa'i rgyal po du dben sha gsum gyi bdag po mnga'u ris tsho bcu gsum gyi mnga' thang la dbang bsgyur ba'i mnga' bdag gi ming dang / rin po che las grub pa'i tham ka gling bdun ma/ tham g.yog tham shu bcas rgyal thabs mi 'gyur sa/yung drung rin po ches spras pa'i gser yig mar 'bod nga/'i 'ja' sa tho sta che rtags gnang skyes khyad par 'phags pa bcas tshegs med par thob’’ (gung thang btsad po'i gdung rabs bris ma1༷na) nas bod du bde bar 'khor zhing khong dang khong gi gcung po gnyis la sras mi mnga' bas yar lam sa skya nas gcen po khri rin chen bzang po'i srame chos skyong lde la bdag rkyen mdzad de gung thang du phebs shing / de skabs kyi zhabs 'bring ngam blon po ni/ 'dzangs kyi go che tshangs pa/ lha rigs go 188

che tsha ngaca/ pa/ gnyan rgyud tho/ che tshangs pa dang gsum yin zer/lha sras chos skyong lde'i btsun mor sa skya nas bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal ba'i sras mo kun dga' 'bum khab tu bsus par khri bkra shis sde 'khrungs shing / mthar dgung lo don gcig pa rab byung lnga pa'i chu 'brug ( spyi lo1353)lor sku gshegs/chos skyong lde'i sras khri bkra shis lde 'khrungs pa'i lo tshipo/sa nges gsal mi che yang /‘‘khyad par mang yul sku lha'i byang shar du//sa mkhar dung gi so mang 'dra ba 'byung //de ru rgyal rigs bong thung byang sem/sa can//choṭashaṃ rgyal bkra shis lde zhes bya ba dang //gter 'di 'phrad na bod yul bstan pa ne//mi lo lnga bcu rtsa rga/sum bsring nus so//(gung thang btsad po'i gdung rabs bris ma10ba)zheṭa/ lung bstan nga/'i lo tshad krādi nga nga khong gi 'tsho gzhes dgung gangs la spya ra na rung snyam pa de ltar na 'khrungs dus chu byi(spyi lo1313)lor babs/dgung lo so dgu pa chu 'brug(spyi lo1353)lo ra yab mirkashegs rjes rgyal thabs kyi khri la mnga' gsol zhing / dbang kun dga' legs pa'i sras mo bco/da nam 'bum khab tu bzhes par rab byung drug pa'i sa stag( spyi lo13kā8)lor sras khri phun tshogs lde 'khrungs/yab chos skyong lde sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su ston mchog shākya 189

sing ge'i sku brnyan dang / yum gyi ched du sgrol ma'i sku brnyan gnyis ka mi tshad las ches mtho 'ing g.yu rnying khyad par can sogs rim po che'i phras mdzes par brgyan pa bzhengs shing / gzhan yang rdzong dkar gyi lcags ri phyi ma dang / lcags ri rten po'i lcags skor/ stag tshang dpe'u chen gyi lcags khang lcags ri'i 'og sa 'og nas rgyang ring por thon pa'i gsang sgo dpe'u rdzong gi dbus dang / chos lde'i nang du khron chu bzang po bton pa dang / rdo kyong chen po sogs nye bar spyod pa'i rigs zhib tshal/sa du ma ma/dzad/de skabs mnga' thang yang gong du 'phel zhing / lhag par sdod gangs ri ti si'i shar phyogs dra la dang nye bar dra lung ring por bud med rgan mo zhig gis shing thun zhig gi gra ma'i sdong po 'then pas gser thigs chen po zhig rnyed pa la brten nas gser kha bzang po brdo'/ te khri dpon byir ma gser dpon du bskos pas/ des gser sil ma ka ṭa ra chen po zhig phyur bur bkang ba'i steng du gser chen po rwa mchin tsam zhig bzhag ste phukha4 bas mnga' bdag dgyes nas gsung 'phros kyi mthar sal 'di tsam ster phod pa khyod la ci tsam yod gsungs par khri dpom/ gyis phyag btsal te nged la 'di las lhag nges shig yod mchis zhus pas drang por smra ba mi yi dam pa yin gsungs nas sku la gsol 'phro'i ber phyam gcig gis mtshon gnang skyes bzang po bstar/de ltar gser gyi 'byor pa chen po mnga' ba de dag don dang ldan par bya bar dgongs te dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la dkon mchog sri zhu gang du btang na phan slebs che zhes bka' 'dri gnang ba bzhin bstan 190

khrirtsos 'gyur ro 'tshal gser gyi yang bzhun gyi khu bas bzheng rgyur thugs thag bcad de mkhas pa'i khyu mchog mkhan chen byang chub rtse mo dang / bo dong lo tsā ba shes rab me lce dpon slob la sogs pa mkhas pa du ma zhus dag mkhan chen por spyan drangs nas bzhengs pa'i bstan bcos kyi glegs bam mtha' dag la gser chus byug pa'i glegs shing dang / si tha hu'i glegs thag zab chen gyi na bza' phyi ras bzang po na bza' gsum sbrags bcas bskrubs nas chu mo yos(spyi lo1kāsnyo3)lor rab gnas kyang legs par grub par mdzad pa ma zad/ da dung bka' 'gyur yang gsar banengs mdzad rgyu'i dgongs pa gtad de skyid rong du shog bu gra sgrig grub pa'i mtshacha/sa te rab byung drug pa'i shing sbrul(spyi lo1shāphyo5)lor sku gshegs/khri bkra shis lde'i sras khri phun tshogs lde ni rab byung drug pa'i sa stag (spyi lo1kā38)lor 'khrungs/khong gis yab gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku brnyan mi tshad bsgrun pa sogs rnarma dkar gyi mdzad pa mi dman tsam bskyangs pa dang / sa skya dang sku gnyen rim can stabs srid 'phel 'dun ma gcig pa'i bca' yig gna' sgrig kyang mdzad/khri phun tshogs lde sa skyar bzhugs skabs jo mo te mda' ma dang mthun par sras khri mchog grub lde 'khrungs shing / btsun mo dngos byang pa tā dben gyi sras mo nam mkha' 'bum khab tu bzhes/ btsun mo dngoṭa— kyi gyod po tā dben gyis log pa'i bsam pas ngan bskul byas te zhang rta tshag pa smon lam rgyal mtshan gyis khri phun tshogs lde dgung lo sum cu so gsu ma pa 191

lcags khyi(spyi lo13gyiX) lor bkrongs shing / de'e lo phyi ma lcags phag los tā dben gyi sras mor khri rgyal bsod nams lde rab byung drug pa'i lcags phag (spyi lo13gyi1) lor 'khrungs/ de skabs tā dben gyis gung thang gi rgyal srid lo lnga bzung ste sgo mang mthil la rda ra byas/ gung thang la shin tu 'tshe ba che zhing mthar tā dben rang yang skyid grong du bskyod skabs rong pa rnams dang 'khrug ste mda' dgu lus la zug nas tshe'i dus byas/skabs der gung thang gi blon po lha rje chos zu+ong dang / chen po snang mdzad sogs blon po bzhis gung thang du yod pa'i tā dben gyi rgyud pa bya nga pa bton nas lha btsad po'i sras sku mched rgyal sar bzhugs su gsol 'i/nga / mi yi dbang po mchog grub lde yis mang yul mnga' bdag ras chen gyi sras mo bdag mo ras chen zhes pa khab tu bzhes kyang sras ma byung bas khong rang yul du ldog skabs der bsod nams lde dang / sku mched gnyis kyang cung zad thugs ma mthun pas gcung khri rgyal bsod nams lde pu rong du 'byon par bzhed de yar phebs pa de'i tshe khri mchog grub lde chibs bcag sa tho le thang khar byon pas chibs kyis bskyur te sku gshegs/ gcung stod du phebs pa spyan 'dren po'i pho nya mngags pa bzhin phebs te gcen khri mchog grub lde'i gshegs rdzongs legs par bsgrubs/gcung khri rgyal bsod nams lde 'di ni thugs dgongs zab cing /phas kyi rgol ba gzhom la dpa' zhing chab srid skyong bar shin tu mkhas par grags pa dadza / lhag par dam pa'i chos la dad gus che ba zhig lags/192

khong thog mar rgyal thabs kyi khri la bzhugs pa na sngar yab mes nas sku la bsdo ba'i phas kyi rgol ba la stod lho byang sher pa sogs btul nas sngar mi lde phyi gyar song ba rnams kyang tshur bsdus pa ma zad/ gsar du pu rangs kyang mnga' 'og tu bsdus shing / pu rangs dbang du bsdu ba'i dmag dpon byir ma'i gcung chos skyong 'bum la gzengs bstod pa'i ched glo bo dol po'i mi dpon du bskos pa'i rigs rgyud glo bo rgyal por grags pa'i rgyud pa rgyun ma chad par byung ba de yin/ khri rgyal bsod nams lde 'dis mnga' 'og rnams bzhi tshor bcad cing / dbul zhiro phongs pa rnams sdug bsngal gyi gnas las grol phyir mi sde rnams dkul phyug lan gsum gyi bar du snyoms par grags/dgung lo bcu dgu pa sa sbrul(spyi lobhe38rdzo)los gter ston rig 'dzin chen po rgod ldem can spyan drangs nas mang yul ri bo dpal 'bar gyi dgon gnas gzhis bcas phul/khong gis yongs su 'dzin pa chen por bo dong mkhan chen lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gtsug gi nor bur kur/ gzhan yang rje seng ge bzang po dang / lo tsā ba ngag dbang grags pa/ re mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros rnams bla mar bsten/dgung lo nyi shu pa lcags rta (spyi lo1kā9༷)lor mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ma mdzad pa dang bcas gung thang du bshad grwa dang 'brel ba'i chosdoshaṃ sdo chen po grwa tshang bcu drug gi grangs dang ldan pa legs par bskrun/ mnga' bdag rang nyid kyi bzhugs gnas mthil ma rdzong si/sa 193

dbus chos sde'i dbu rtse 'du khang / dge 'dun 'dus tshogs so so'i spyi khang la sbyar zhing / mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan chos dpon du mnga' gsol/ dbyar chos zhag bzhi bcu/ dgun chos zla gcig rnams kyi gzhisarkyen 'brog nag tshang / chos zhag rnams la yang tshugs bar grol gsum gyi ston mo/ tshad 'bras blo bskyed/ dge 'dun nyi shu'i spyi sgyur gyi bsnyen bkur sogs gzab rgyas dang / grwa tshangs so so'i mchod gzhis la khral chag dang bcas te sbya ra/ btsu na pa rnams bslab khrims las mi 'da' ba'i bca' khrims dang / sha ba tson gsod nges pa yang chos sde'i sgo nang yan srog thar bas shrīthar pa gling du mdzad/da dung chos rje seng ge bzang po'i bzhugs gnas bsam gtan gling dang / chos rje re mda' ba'i bzhugs gnas skyid grong me tog mdangs can sogs bzhengs pa'i mthun rkyen yang dag pa mdzad cing / yum gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su shākya thub pa'i sku mi cha da las lhag pa/ dus kun sku gzugs bris 'bur du ma dang / gsung rten ches mang po bzhengs/gu ge nas mnga' bdag ma chen mo chos skyong rgyal mo khab tu bzhes par sras gnyis 'khrungs pa bcas mthar dgung lo sum cu rtsa bzhi rab byung bdun pa'i shing sprel(spyi lo1bhesgro4)lor sku gshegs/khong sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs ched bdag mo chos skyong rgyal mos sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan sngon ma rnams dang mtshungs pa dang / gser chos bka' 'a gyur dang / bstan 'gyur cha tshang bzhengs/mnga' bdag khri—rgyal bsod nams lde'i btsun mo chos spyong rgyal mor sne94

mnga' bdag lha gcig ces mtsha na dngos bsod nams rgyal mtshan 'khrungs kyang dgung lo bcu gnyis par gshegs pa dang / mnga' bdag lha btsun zhes bya ba zhig byung ba yang gzhon nur gshegs/mnga' sdidag khri rgyal bsod nams ldes chos rje lha mdun pa'i dbon mo skya bo'i skabs 'jam dbyangs dang / phyis tshas zhus/sa gnang ba'i mchan la sangs rgyas byang sems bzang mo dang 'dus par gshegs khar sras gcig sbrum yod pa yum 'jigs nas nub ri lha mdun du bros par sgro spangs su rab byung bdun pa'i shing sprel(spyi lo1bhe0bhe)lor sras khri lha dbang rgyal mtshan 'khrungs pa de dgung lo bco lnga pa'i skabs yum dang bcas gung thang du bsus shing / dgung lo bcu drug pa sa phag (spyi lo1419)lor rgyal srid la mnga' gsol/khong gis bla chen chos dpal bzang po dang / bzang po rgyal mtshan/lhag par bo dong thams cad mkhyen pa rnams bla mar sten cing / chos dpal bzang po 'di ni khri mchog grub lde dang yum gcig pa'i sku mched yin/ khri lha dbang pas thung thang gi pho brang byang thog drug ma rtsa ba nas brtsigs/ bkra shis sgo mang chen mo'i dbu rtse steng 'og tu sku brnyan ches mang po dang / sngags khang thog tshad ma bcas bzhengs nas der bla chen chos dpal gnyug mar bzhugs su gsol zhing / bo dong thams cad mkhyen pa'i bzhugs gnas chos sde dkar po rten dang brten par bcas pa gsar bzhongs dang / chu byi(spyi lo14kā3)los bkra shis nam ling 'debs 195

pa'i sbyin bdag mdzad pa/ gzhan yang pho brang phyi nang kun tu lha khang du ma dang / rdo rje 'chang gi sku thog tshad/ bka' bstan 'gyur cha tshang / cho 'phrul dus mchod/ lo mjug bstan rim bsgrubs pa'i 'cham chas rnga rol dang / g.yag se'i 'cham gsob sogs du ma bzhengs pa/ spyid grong jo bor gser gyi galji ra/ khul de'i lam 'phrang khag la zam pa 'dzugs pa sogs mdzad pa rgya che ba bskyangs mthar dgung lo drug cu rtsa gcig rab byung brgyad pa'i shing sprel(spyi lo14a+yobhe) lor sku gshegs/ khri lha dbang rgyal mtshan gyis btsun mo lha rgyal mo khab tu bzhes par sras lcam dral gsum byung ba'i sras gnyis ni khri rnam rgyal lde dang / nam mkha' nor bu/ lcam sring ā grol chos kyi sgron me yin/sras kyi thu bo khri rnam rgyal lde ni rab byung bdun pa'i chu stag (spyi lo1433) lor 'khrungs shing / dgung lo bco lnga pa me 'brug (spyi lo1tre3smo)lor khrir phebs shing / khong ni gzhon nu'i dus nas thugs kyi 'char sgo gsal la 'phong dang sgyu rtsal la mkhas pa/ snying stobs che ba bcas yod kyang gzhon nu'i skabs thugs rgyud rtsub pas mdzad pa mi legs pa cung zad byung bar brten lho bdag sgrol ma skyabs dang / byang bdag la yang mjal phyag gnang dgos byung ba dang / ding ri sgang dkar khri tshang du lo shas bzhugs dgos byung rung / slar gung thang du rgyal srid skyong bar spyan drangs pas lugs gnyis mdzad pa yar zlar 'gran pa byung bas rong sher sogs rgol ba skya btsun rnams tshar bcad cing / de rnams kyi sa khang zhing gang yod la dpya khral bsdu ba'i gtsigs phab pa sogs bar skabs mnga' thang 196

cung zad bri ba slar gso bar mdzad cing / btsun mo lha mtshamyo/sa rgyal mo khab tu bzhes par sras lcam sring gsum 'khrungs/ khong gis 'jig rten gyi bya gzhag de tsam gyis chog par gzigs nas phyi ma'i don du bla ma zhig 'tshol zhes bo dong thams cad mkhyen pa rtsa ba'i bla mar bsten thog gung thang chos sde'i chos dpon du yang mnga' gsol zhing gzhan yang mkhas grub dpal ldan sangs rgyas dang / grub chen rgyal mtshan 'bum/ gtsang smyon lha ru ka sogs kyang gus pas mchod/gung thang chonu/ sde'i 'du khang ka ba drug cu re bzhi pa logs ris zhing bkos phun surngo/ kho+oXgs pa/ rig lung gi grwa rgyas par spel ba dus dus su dge 'dun brgya phrasau/ gi sgrub mchod 'dzugs pa sogs rnam dkar gyi ma dzad pa rgya che zhing / mngon dga'i bde chen rab rgyas 'debs pa'i mthun rkyen yang dag par mdzad/rdzong dkar lha khang dmar mor rgyud lde'i lha tshogs rab 'byams kyi sku brnyan dang / gser bris bka' 'gyur cha tshang gcig dang / skya bris tshar gnyisri 'a so kas pa dang / yum dang / nor bu lde/ btsun mo lha mtshams dang / sangs rgyas rgyal mo bcas kyi dgongs rdzogs rten bzhengs rgya chen po dang / bsnyen bkur dang mchod pa'i rgyun rgya chen po 'dzugs pa/ nya stong brgyad gsumyog la mnga' 'og kuzudi tu ri rgya klung rgya bsdems pa dang /zam 'phrang lo bstar chags su bcos pa'i thebs rtsa 'dzugs pa sogs mdzad 'phrin ches/ che ba dang ldan pa bcas mthar dgung lo brgya da cu gya gcig pa rab byung brgyad pa'i chu phag (spyi lo1'a0kā)lor sku gshegs/197

madrume bdag rnam rgyal ldes btsun mo gnyis rim hūṃr ༵zhes pa'i dang po bdag mo lha mtshams rgyal mo la sras gnyis dang / sras mo gcig 'khrungs pa'i gcen po chos rgyal nor bu lde ni rab byung brgyad pa'i lcags rta (spyi lo1bhe50)lor gung thang du 'khrungs shing / phyis sku naracison nas rgyal srid du mnga' gsol ba'i btsun mo zur 'tsho nas bdag mo rin chen dpal sgron khab tu bzhes pa'i btsun mo dngos la sras med kyang zur du bltams pa lha btsun kun dga' rnam rgyal zhes dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhig byung / chos rgyal nor bu ldes rnam dkar mdzad bzang la gcig tu dgyes pa sgo mang du lam 'bras lha khang dang / sa skya bka' 'bum gyi glegs bam bzhengs pa/ sde gnyis chos bzhin du skyong ba'i mur gzhon nu nas sku gshegs/chos rgyal nor bu lde'i gcung khri rgyal bsam grub lde rab byung brgyad pa'i sa yos(spyi lo1bhe'9) lo ding ri sgang dkar du 'khrungs shing / btsun mor zur 'tsho bza' bdag mo bzang dkar ma khab tu bzhes/khong gis gzim khang lho gsar du bcos shing / dkon mchog gi sku brnyan mang po dang / dngul las bris pa'i sa skya gong ma'i gsung 'bum/tha/ser thang / gos thang so/rga/sa mang po bzhengs shing / gtsang spyon he ru ka dang / mkhas grub dpal ldan seng ge bla mar bsten/bdag mo zur 'tsho ma la sras mi mnga' bas kan pa bza' shes rab rgyal mo shabab tu bzhos pa'i sras lha/cen khri bkra shis dpal 'bar dang /3 98

bar pa lha btsun nam mkha' dpal mgon/ tha chung gong ma kun dga' blo gros gsumyo/ rim par 'khungs/ nor bu lde dang / bsam lde gnyis dang yab yum gcig pa'i lcam sring don grub rgyal mo sne gdong dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi btsun mor byon/khri rnam rgyal lde yi btsun mo gnyis pa sangs rgyas rgyal mor sras lcam dral gsum rim par 'khrungs pa'i gcen gang ma shes rab dpal bzang dang / gcung kun dka' rnam rgyal lde gnyis mang yul skyid grong glang po mkhar du bltams/ tho/nga ma shes rab dpal ni dpa' zhing brtul phod pa zhig byung ba des gung thang gi mnga' 'og nas brgya dpon pa ngo log ste nag tshang par mgo btags rtsis kyis gung thang nas thon par nag tshang nas bsu mi sto bas che ba dang bcas byang du bkrod pa'i rjes ded shes rab dpal rang nyid kyis dmag tshan nyung ngu zhig khrid de bhā byang rgyab kyi bar du bdas te nag tshang gi mgo mi rgyal skyes g.yul ngor bsad/ pha jo lha phrug sogs mang po zhig btson du bzung / brgya dpon rang gnas su khrid par mdzad pa de lta bu ches mang zhing / phyis skyid grong jo bor gser gyi rgya phibs shig bskrun par dgongs pa'i gra sgrig tre2nga ma grub rjes sku gshegs/khong gi gcung po kun dga' rnam rgyas ni lung gis zin pa'i skyes bu dam pa zhig yin par grags shing / sku btsas ma thag tu sgo bzhi'i skyes pa gang yod la btsas ston phye mar phul te gnang ba dang / khong mi/ sku gzhon sne99

ci nu'i skabs tha mal ba'i spyod tshul las 'das shing / dgung lo brgyad pa'i skabs su tshad ma rigs gter dang / mngon rtogs rgyan sogs kyi tshig don gnyis kar legs bshad spro nus pa byung /sku nar son nas rgyal srid la dbang bskur zhing / btsun mos gu gi bdag mo dkon mchog bzang mo khab tu bzhes/chab srid chos bzhin skyong ba dang dus mtshungs yongs su 'dzin pa gnas pa nor phun tshogs dang / kun dga' bzang po/ dpal ldan bkra shis sogs spyi bor bkur zhing / yab kyi dgongs rdzogs su mngon dpyo/'i mkhan po rnams dang / mnga' ris su gnas pa'i dge 'dun mchis so co ba/ nas nyin ltar kun rig gi sgrub mchod bsgrubs par bsnyen bkur mang 'gyed shin tu zab pa dang / phyi rten du ka ni'i lha khang tshar du dngar ba dang /nang rten dngul bre bcu gsum las grub pa'i rdo rje 'chang gi sku bsnyan thog tshad ma/ gser zangs zhe gcig gi lam 'bras bla rgyud khru tshad ma sogs khyad du 'phags pa dang / de min gyi mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa/gser zhun kho nas bsgrubs pa'i sa skya gong ma'e gsung 'bum sogs bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa/ skyid grong dge rgyas lha khang gi rgya phibs mdun mar gser zangs sgron 'bul/gzhan yang rang byung 'phags pa'i zhabs tog dang / lho kha tshar gyi srid 'dzin du dgongs skyid grong tshong 'dus kyi zong mkhar rtse la khams sasum rnam rgyal zhes pa'i rdzong mkhar brtsigs pa/ chos sde thang du grags pa'i sa cha rnams gsar sbol gyis rmo zhing bzo ba sogs lugs zung gi mdzad 200

pa rgya che ba zhig byung /khong dang yab yum gcig pa'i gcung mo mkha' 'gro rgyal mo zhes bya ba byung ba de la stod lho bdag po kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi btsun mos byon nas rigs rgyudā phyis rgyal mkhar rtse'i bdag por gyur/ )rko/zhan yang khri rnam rgyal lde la yum mi gcig pa'i sras mang du yod par snang zhing / gong du smos pa'i sras bzhi las nor bu lde yab kyi sngon du gshegs/ gzhan gsum so sor gyes te gong ma bsam ldes pho brang lho dang / gong ma shes rab dpal bzang gis pho brang byang bzung / gong ma kun dga' rnam rgyal lde dge ldan du bzhugs nas mnga' zhabs kyang khag gsum du bgos/ lho byang zhal ngo thugs mi mthun pas blon po dbu rtse bdapon brtson grub pa sogs kyi dbyen sbyor la brten nas gong ma—shes rab daphal bzang bkrongs pas bar skabs mi legs pa'ang byung 'dugagong ma khri kun dga' rnam rgyal lde yis btsun mo gu ge ma dkon mchog bzang mo khab tu bzhes par sras khri kun bzang nyi zla grags pa'i lde rab byung dgu pa'i shing khyi (spyi lo1'a14)lor 'khrungs pa 'di yang lung gis zin pa'i skyes bu dam par grags/ dgung lo bcu drug pa sa glang (spyi lo 15phre9)lor rgyal srid la dbang bskur/ khong gis ra sa 'phrul snang gi jo bo shākya mu ne'i spyan sngar gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang / dngul gyi rgyal srid sna bdun/ skyid grong 'phags pa rang byung la gser gyi sa ta ka shin tu che ba/ gung thang bkra shis sgo mang du slob dpon chen po pad+ma sasnya'i sku rgyal thog gi tshad dang mnyam pa/ gser 201

chos bka' 'gyur dang / skya bris bstan 'gyur cha tshang bcas bzhengs pa/ da dung pho brang dga' ldan dang bkra shis rab brtan gnyis bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa brtsigs pa/ gung thang chos sder mdo sngags rab 'byams kyi grwa bskor ba'i bka' srol bzang po btsugs pa sogs lugs zung gi mdzad pa rlabs po che bskyangs pa ma zad/ yongs su 'dzin pa yang rig 'dzin chen po mchog ldan mgon po dang / gter ston bstan ga nyis gling pa gtsug tu bkur zhing / gzhan yang bsam yas dkar chen kun dga' grags pa dang / ol mo ba shākya bzang po/ sngags 'chang gsang sngags rdo rje sogs kyang mchod gnas su bkur/sku tshe'i smad gong ma bsam lde'i sras khri bkra shis dpal 'bar sku mched la mnga' thang phog nas gsol thab gcig tu dril ba'i nyams bzhes kyis re zhig rang nyid gung thang sgo mang gi chos dpon mdzad pa dang / phyis 'da' med gsum gyi mtshams bcad dam po kho nar bzhugs nas nyams rtogs khyad par can 'khel ba'i sgo nas dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa rab byung dgu pa lcags sprel (spyi lo 1྾a+yosgro)lor sku gshegs/khri kun bzang nyi zla grags pas yar 'brog sna dkar rtse nas lcam tshe ring rgyal mo khab tu bzhes par sras lcam sring gsum rim par 'khrungs pa'i gcen ldang ma shes rab kun dga' chung ngu nas sku gsheshas/gcung lha kun bzang rnam 'phrul rgyal po'i bdag mor glo bo nas bsod nams rgyal mo khab tu bzhes kyang / lha rnam 'khrul te nyid gzhon nu nas sku gshegs/202

lcam sring bde legs bzang mo glo bo sde par gnas/yang phyis yum mi gcig pa sher bza' zhig lnga/ byung ba'i sras mo phun tshogs rgyal mo byang pa bdag po nam mkha' rgyal po'i btsun mor phebs nas byang pa'i gdung rabs spel ba'i ma mar gyur//khri rgyal bsam grub lde'i sras kyi thu bo bkra shis dpal 'bar gyis rong sher sogs phas rgol rnams tshar bcad cing / la stod lho yang mnga' dbang du bsdus/ gser chos kyi bstan 'gyur cha tshang bzhengs pa dang / bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad bzhengs pa sogs rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa rgya che/de'i gcung lha btsun nam mkha' dpal gyis mngon dga' chos rje dpal ldan dar la rab tu byung zhing lung rtogs yon tan mngon par mtho ba zhig byung / tha chung kun dga' blo gros bar skabs gung thang sgo mang gi chos dpon mdzad cing / sku gsung thugs rten mang du bzhengs pa sogs rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa rgya che/gong ma kun dga' rnam rgyal lde sku gshegs pa'i rjes khri kun bzang nyi zla grags pa dang / bsam grub sde'i sras sku mched de rnams la mnga' ris phog pas snga sor gzim chung mnga' zhabs te sku sger so sor dbang ba'i mnga' ris thams cad gcig gyur kyis bskyangs te bzhugs pa la khri kun bzang nyi zla grags pa'i yum gu ge bza' dkon mchog bzang mo dang / khri bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dus pa'i sras mo dkon mchog chirgyal mo bltams pa phyis rgyal mkhar rtse'i bcun mor gnang / 203

de rjes khri kunadaga' blo gros dang yum gu ge ma rtsen pa'i sras kun bzang rdo rje grags pa rab byung dku rngapre'i sa byi(spyi lo 1lā38)lor 'a/khrungs pa 'dis thog myo/ra ngakra shiṭa5 nam ling du 'jam dbyangs kun dga' 'phel gyi drung du skuchos mdzad de dge 'dun gyi bya ba rnams kyang rim bzhin bgyis te chos dpon dang ma/span po'i bya ba yang mdzad/ phyis gdung rgyud rigs sras dkon zhing gzhan rkyen du mas lha rnam 'phrul rgyal po'i krogs su /khyim na gnas te rgyal thabs kyi bya ba mdzad dgoṭaṭa shar/ de yang shing stag (spyi lo 1lā'abhe)lor bdag mo yar 'brob / ma'i thugs la gdon zhugs nas mi ngan gzhan dang ngan 'brel gyis bdag mo gu ge ma bkrongs/ khri nyi zla grags pa dang / kun bzang grags pa rdo rje gnyis kyang bkrongs te gung thang khab rdzong dkar ba gtsang gi gzhis ka/ rin spungs pa la sprod rgyu byas te gshed ma bkyes kyang / sgo mang dang / nam ling / phu lag pa gsum gyis ra mda' btang ba dus thog sleb sa pas gong ma sku mched gnyis bkrongs ma thub/ bdaka mo gu ge ma bkrongs pas de'i sha lan du pha rol po'i mi thams cad drag sbyor la btang / bdag mo yar 'brog ma rang yul du slog pa sogs zhabaru 'gyur yang dag zhus nas rdzong dkar gyi tsho zin pa byas/de'i lo rjes ma shing yos (spyi lo 1lā྾྾)lor slar yang bdag mo yar 'brog mas gzhis ka rin spungs pa'i dmag drangs te dpal khud bar du bcom/ la stod lho yang dbang du bsdus par gong ma kun bzang rdo rje grags payoni pung gi tshogs dang bcas te g.yul zhugs pa'i zhubs rogs 204

tsha mda' sde pa bsod nams rgyal pos zhus te rin spungs pa'i dmag rdams pham nyes btang thog lho bdag po'i rgyal bu gnyis snga sor rin spungs pas mi gter nyar ba dang / lho shel dkar rdzong bcas rin spungs pa'i lag nas blangs te rgyal bu bgres pa byams pa la stod lho yi bdag por bsko sa/rgya9ra bu gzhon pa nam mkha' lhun grub rgyal mkhar rtse'i bdag mo dkon mchos/ rgyal mo'i mag par gnas pa sogs jus 'gro ches bzang ba byung zhing /de snga mnga' bdag bkra shis ldes bzhengs pa'i bstan 'gyur gser gyi gad pa zer ba de byang pa tā dbe+en pas mnga' ris bzung skabs khyer ba de'i nang nas dus 'khor pu ste gsum ma gtogs cha tshang ba de dag gung thang du spyan drangs te sgo mang du bzhugs su gsol ba dang / stod go gsum yang mnga' ris rdzong dkar gyi khongs yin rung / bar skabs gzhan la shor ba rnams kyang 'di skabs tshur banes pa sogs g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dge mtshan dpag tu med pa byung ba lugs zung 'phrin las rgyas pa'i mur dgung lo sum cu so brgyad pa rab byung dgu pa'i shing glang (spyi lo bhe lam̐snyolā)lor sku gshegs/kun bzang rdo rje grags pa dang / lha rnam 'phrul gyi btsun mo glo bo bdag mo bsod nams rgyal mo 'dus pa las sras lcam dral bzhi rim par 'khrungs pa'i sras kyi thu bo khri rgyal bsam grub sde 'di lha rnam 'phrul rgyal po'i sras yin yang zer/ de'i gcung lha sras lhun grub rgyal po zhes sgo mang gi mkhan po pi /nang mkhan zhig dang / gzhan gcig byung ba sku chung ngu nas gshegs shing/ / lcam sring gcig byung ba gro bor gnang yang gzhon nu nas 205

'das/gcen khri rgyal bsam grub ldes rgyal sri da yun ring bskyangs shing / de skabs skyid grong the/ra pa ngo log ste zir bun bslangs sar sa lug (spyi lo 1྾'a9)lor gung thang dpung gis sher spyi mkhar phab/ sher pa drung chen sogs log par spyod pa kha shas lnga pa'i lam la bkod nas re zhig dus bde bar gyur pa'i lo der khri rgyal bsam grub lde sa skyar phebs te/ bdag chen kun dga' rin chen gyi spyan snga nas dbang lung gdams/ pa ci risas gsan cing / khong gi sras mo rin chen sgrol ma btsun mor bzhis ste gung thang du phebs/de la sras khri rgyal bsod nams dbang phyug lde rab byung bcu pa'i me glang (spyi lo 1lāgyigyi) lor 'khrungs shing / de nas lo shas dus bde zhod 'jags dang mnga' thang yang 'phel ba byung /de rjes dus kyi 'gyur bas mnga' thang cung zad bri ba'i dus dpon btsun he ru sogs skyid grong pa ngo log ste gor rdzi dpon du bkur// rag ma'i rdzong bzung nas lo dgu'i ring se pa tsho re nas dmar zong sum cha ce re bsdus pa'i tshul khab pa'i thuganu/ su ma 'jug pas dpon btsun he ru sogs rdzong dkar bcug ste btul/ bdag mo sa skyar phebs te khri chen bsod nams dbang po spyan drangs nas gung thang du lo gcig bzhugs/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor cing bsnyen bkur gyis dgyes par byas nas khri chen sa skyar phyir phebs/de nas lo shas song ba rab byung bcu pa'i chu sbrul (spyi lo 1'ardzo3)206

lor khri rgyal sam grub lde dang bdag chen ma yab yum gnyis ka sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su khri rgyal bsod nams sdes dngul gyi mchod sdong bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa bskrun pa sogs rnam dkar gyi bya ba rgya chen po bsgrubs/de rjes khri rgyal bsod nams dbang phyug lde rgyal thabs kyi khrir bzhugs pa'i btsun mo dpal ldan shar kha ba'i rigs lhun po rtse nas bdag mo dbyangs can bsod nams sgron khab tu bsus te mnga' thang yang dar rgyas byung /de skabs lcang sher rong gsum gcig tu dril nas spang zhing dmag gis bskor ba sogs bsnyad tshol du ma byung bar me rta (spyi lo1smo5a+yo) lor rje blon gyi dpung hrag gis mar spyod glang bu mkhar bzung / dol por dmag bcug ste sher pa'i bla mkhar phab/ sher pa dang / lcang pa'i mi gtso bo rnams/ rdzong dkar mi gter nyar/ de skabs skyid grong du zla ba drug lhag bzhugs nas me lug (spyi lo1snyo0gyi) lor lcang sher rnams kyis gus btud kyi phud zhu zhal dkar phul bar sher pa'i gtsug lag khang du bzhes nas mnga' ris bde bar mdzad/mnga' phadag 'di ni mi mdzad mthu med byung na ma gtogs drag po'i bya bar mi dgyes shing / rnam dkar gyi mdzad par gcig tu gzhol ba dang / yongs su 'dzin nga 'i gtso bor kun dga' lung rigs bsten cing /gzhan sa skya khri chen bsod nams dbang po/ yol mo sprul sku nam mkha' brgyu byin sogs bsten cing / snga sor sku na phra mo'i dus ri bo dpal 'bar lha07

chodu kyi rdor gyi bsnyen chen sogs ci rigs mdzad cing / sku tshe'i smad yol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu nas bka' chos ci rigs gsan/bar skabs khab pa la 'tshe ba byed pa mang du byung ba kun thabs mkhas kyis 'dul bar mdzad kyang mthar nang blon kha cig blo las su ma rungs bas gtsang stod rgyal po dang sel bcug ste rab byung bcu pa'i lcags sprel (spyi lo 1a+yo30) lor gtsang stod rgyal po phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi dpung gung thang rdzong dkar bskor ba de lan bcar na mi mang po'i srog la thug pa thugs kyis ma bzod par babs mdzad pas gtsang pas la stod shel dkar rdzong du spyan drangs pas lo ngo gcig tsam nas sku gshegs//khri bsod nams dbang phyug lde'i btsun mo dngos la sras mo lha gcig las ma byung zhing / de ni phyis yol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu'i rigs rme ra gyur pa de la sras mo ma cig zhwa ma'i sprul par grags pa nor 'dzin dbang mo 'khrungs pa dgung lo nyer lnga'i skabs sku gshegs/bsod nams ldes thang chung brag nag chos rje'i sras mo zhig dang rtsen pa'i zur sras chos rje kun bzang zhes grags pa phyis gtsang pas spyan drangs nas gshegs/chos rje kun bzang gis gung thang zhol nas sras mo tshe ring rgyal mo bzheṭ+wāṃg par sras rdo rje bdud 'dul zhu ba dang / phyis chos sgor zhugs nas gzhung lugs smra ba'i rab 'byams par gyur pa'i mtshan rab 'byams/ pa rgyal dbang seng ge zhes su grags/ sku tshe'i smad khyim btsun tshul dutshosku tshe ring rab bzhugs te mthar rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa byi (spyi lo1phyo48) lor 208

gshegs/ d+ngha chos rje kun bzang la yang sras mo zhig las ma 'khrungs pas gung thang btsad po'i gdung rabs 'di yan gyis rdzogs pa yin no//de ltar khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal nas khri bsod nams dbang phyug lde 'di yan khug pa'i dbang du byas na mang du yod kyang rkyang par byas na dpa' lde'i sras dmar po lde bgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / de ma bgrangs na rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum song ba'i lo rgyus 'di rnams kaḥthog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa 'brug (spyi lo 1748)lor gung thang rgyal rabs rgyas bsdus mang po'i nying khu phyung ba'i mang yul rgyal rabs 〈〈bod rje lha btsan po'i gdung rabs mnga' ris smad mang yul gung thang du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul deb ther dwangs shel 'phrul gyi me long 〉〉zhes bya ba shin tu yid rton rung ba'i gnas su mthong ba dang deb ther de nyid dpe rgyun shin tu dkon pas deb ther der gsal ba'i lo rgyus gtso che ba rnams go rim bsgrigs te bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi dpyad gzhi'i slad du cung zhib pa dang cha tshang tsam 'phros pa lags/da dung deb therari der ma gsal ba mnga' ris paṇa chen sku mched kyi rnam thar nang khong rnams gung thang rgyal po'i gdung rigs las byung bar bzhed pa de yang mnga' bdag rnam rgyal lder sras mang du byung ba'i thu bo nor bu sde glo bor yun ring bzhugs dgos byung skabs kyi sras 'jam dbyanganu/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan la sras bdun byung ba'i gcen 209

mnga' ris paṇa chen ni rtsod meni kyi gter ston che po tshe ril po dge slong gi bcas pa lhur bzhes/ gcung legs 3na nam mnga' ris rig 'dzin grags pa yang gter ston yin la/ sras pad+ma rgyal po zhes pa byon rung de nas gsung ma 'phel/ sku mched bar pa kha cig gi rgyud glo bo ma thang gi dbon rgyud rgyun phra mo gnas pa de rnams kyang gung thang rgyal po'i gdung rigs su rtogs dgos so//dpal lde'i sras gcung dharma tsakra'i rgyud pa ni lha rtse ba/ glang lung rtsad skor ba/ klu rgyal ba/ spyi pa rnams yin par grags pa las/ de dag gi lo rgyus zhib par 'khod pa'i yig rigs ma rnyed do//3 'od lde'i rgyud pa'i skor/khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal gyi sras 'bring po 'od lde la sras pha wa de se dang / khri lde/ stag lde/ khri chung rnams rim par 'khrungs pa las pha wa de se dang / khri chung gnyis kyis sngar yum brtan rgyud la shor ba'i rnar sna khyad par can dgu zhes pa ste/ phas phog pa'i gser khri chu dar can/ gud pa bang so can/ gser sku chu ris can gsum dang / mas phog pa'i zangs lte ba can/ dngul skyogs sha ba can/ me tor ti lig can gsum/ spun zlas phog pa'i mtshon bshan thung ste mig can/ sring mos rtags phog pa'ici mchur g.yu 'chang ba can/ ber dmar ke tshe byi sked can bcas can dwagu tshur len par 'dod nas dbus su 'ongs te mnga' bdag khri chung gis yum brtan nyi 'od dpal mgon gyi rgyud pa mgon ni phying nga rtse khung bur bzhugs pa la gyod btsugs te can dgu tshur phrogs nas — 210

yar lungs sagazhis chags shing / pha wa de ser dngul gzhong phor kha can (la las dngul skyogs sha ba can du bzhed )thob nas gtsang du phyir — phebs/pha wa de se'i sus dar ma rā dza/de'i sras dar ma btsan po/de'i sras khri 'bar/de'i sras khri btsan 'bar dang / bkra shis lde/bkra shis lde'i sras btsan srong / de'i sras btsan po sde 'bar/de rnams kyi rgyud pa snubs yul rong dang / g.yag sde/ nyang stod stag tshal bcas kyi yul rnams la mnga' mdzad/khri lde'i rgyud pa'i skor/ mkhas pa lde'u'i chos 'byung ltar na khri lde 'od kyi sras lha rgyal ba/de'i sras dar lde/de'i sras dar ma lde/de rnams kyi rgyud pa myang stod kong bu sna'i btsan por bzhed cing /yar lungs jo bo'i chos 'byung dang / mkhas pa'i dga' ston la sogs pa'i lo rgyus yig lam phal mo cher khri ldo mdo khams su byon te tsong kha yul chen bco brgyad la sogs pa mdo smad phal cher la mnga' mdzad pas smad du rgyal khrims lham tsam chags zhes grags shing / spyan snga don chen la sogs pa'i tsong kha'i rgyal rgyud rnams zhes 'khod pa'i bzhod pa gnyis byung ba'i bzhed nyu1 1

pa phyi ma 'di dag par mngon/ gal srid bzhed pa sngon ma yin dbang la cha bzhag na tsong kha'i rgyal rgyud rnams thog ma gdung rgyud gang las gyes pa'i khungs 'ded yul med pas so//nyag lde'i rgyud pa rnams ni g.yas ru'i zin mkhar btsan po la thugakhri chung gis yar lungs su byon/ 'bangs kyis pho brang brtsigs nas phul ba'i 'bangs brtsigs dang / sku mkhar phying nga stag rtse bzung /de'i sras 'od skyid 'bar/de la sras bdun rgya gcen zhang rje tsha khri lde 'bar/ gcung gtsang tsha spun drug ces pa ni lha spyan g.yu spyan gnyis/ da ra cu na po gnyis/'od btsan gung btsan gnyis/ te drug yin/gcen zhang rje tsha khri lde 'bar la sras drug yod pa'i g.yu thog la sras gsum ste nam sde dang / jo dga'/ rtse lde'o//nam lde'i sras jo phag dang / 'bum lde sogs druga'abring po jo dga'i sras kyi rgyud pa sna mo ba dang / phying nga ba/ don mkhar ba/ thang 'khor ba rnams so//bye chuja lha sgom dang / gung lde/ khri thog thag gsum gyi spu/dung rgyud chad nas med/ zla ba'i sras thog brtsan dang / sde 'ju/ de dag gi rgyud pa rta shags pa dang / pra na sna ba'o//bzhengs can 'bar la sras gnyis gcen po rab tu byung / chung ba ji ma lod kyi rgyud pa mon mkhar ba dang / zhang mda' ba/ spun bdun thang 212

pa so sas kyipen /'od btsan 'bar la sras gnyis brang nga lha lde dang / brang chung /braja3 chung gi sras dbon mon mkhar na yod/gung btsan 'bar la sras gnyis gcen lha ston ring mo dang / gcung lha 'theng ngu gnyis ka rab tu byung nas gdung chad ces mkhas pa lde'u'i chos 'byung nang gsal rung / yar lungs jo bo'i chos 'byung dang / mkhas pa'i dga' ston so gas bu gung btsan ni rgyud pa bzhugs pa'i gras su gsal ba brtag dgos/lhun po 'bar la sras gsum ste jo mtho/na dang / jo khri/ 'brug chung lde'o// 'brug chung sde la sras bzhi ste 'od lde/ dpal sde/ khri po/ gru— pa bcas so//'od sde la sras gsum ste jo bo 'jig rten gdung chad/ se ru bsnyu na gyis zin/ nor dga' bcas so nor dga'i sras jo khrom dang / jo 'bag sa/nyis/jo khrom gyi sras shag khri/de'i sras jo bo dgos pa/de'i sras jo bo khri mgon/cho 'bag gi sra sa 'od mdzes/dpal lde'i sras jo bo dga' dga'/de'i sras khri 'od/213

de'i sras khri 'bum/de'i sras lde bdun/lha btsun khri po gdung chad/ grub pa la sras med/gtsang tsha drushā gi nang nas dang po lha spyan gdung chad cing / phyi ma bzhi ste da ra dang / lhun po/ 'od btsan/ gung btsan rnams kyi rgyud pa khra 'brug dang / bying pa/ chu —mig gog po na yod pa'i btsan po rnams yin no//dzi btsan po g.yu can gi gar mi yon tan g.yung drung gis bya sar spyan drangs 'di na sa yar lungs jo bo'i gdung rabs 'go tshugs pa yin/de'i sras jo dga'/de'i sras gsum gyi che ba bya sa lha chen gyis bya sa'i lha khang so ma bzhengs par rgya ma'i dbon ston gyis rab gnas mdzad/ dpal phag mo gru pa bla mar bsten/gcung po'ang rab tu byung ste lha zhi bar grags pa lo mo sgom khang du bzhugs/bar pa khri dar ma/de la sras bzhi byung ba ste gtsug lde/ khri gtsug ldi/ rnal 'byor/smon lam bcas rim par 'khrungs pa las gtsug lder sras med/ khri gtsug gis bya sa dang do sngon sogs bzung ste yar mda'i btsan po rnams byung /smon lam rab hūṃ byung ste pu gu de'i gzim khang dkare po brtsigs te chos khrims dang bstan pa'i bya ba du ma mjad/214 —

dzo bo rnal 'byor gyis 'bangs brtsigs su rgyal sa bskyangs te sku mched 'di rnams kyis rje spyan snga ba dang / rgyal ba thog brdugs pa'i sbyin bdag mdzad/ rnal 'byor la sras gsum rim par byung ba'i brdo pa lha chen po'am/lha lung gi dbang phyug tu grags pa rab tu byung nas lcil bu'i gdan sa mdzad/gcung po lha ngam shod pas 'bri khung gcung rin po che las lha btsun ma dzad/gcen jo 'bag gis rgyal sa mdzad/ gcen jo 'bag la sras lnga rim par 'khrungs pa las/gnyis pa lha 'gro mgon du grab/sa pa rab tu byung ste lcil bu'i gdan sa mdzad de ngo mtshar mtha' mas pa mnga'/gsum pa lde bos 'bangs baphyigs bzung /de'i sras shākya rgyal gyis g.ye che chung la dbang mdzad/de'i sras shākya dpal gyi blo gros bzang po bla ma 'phags pa las rab tu byung ste nye gnas mdzad/bzhi pa lde chung gzhon nur gshegs/lnga pa jo rgyal po 'dur phogade'i sras jo 'phel/ de'i sras chab lha zur khang pa ste lci'/ bu bzung / gcung po'i rgyud khrom po ba rnams yin/215

jo 'bag gi sras che ba shākya mnan/ gcung rnams so sor phog ste khong rang gis pho brang gnas chung btab/ mnga' thang rgyas shing sa skyu pa zhi ta'i sbyin bdag byas/ de'i sras shākya bkra shis kyis pho brang rnying ma btab/de'i sras che ba lcil bu'i lha brag kha ba dang / chung ba grags pa rin chen gyis thog mar rgyal ba thog brdugs pa'i nye gnas dang / de rjes 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i nye gnas mdzod de rgya yul du byon/ se chen las dam kha blangs te pho brang brag kha la sogs btab/ sku gsung thugs rten 'ga' bzhengs/ jo stan tshogs pa'i chos bzhi gtan du 'degs pa'i srol mjad/ dgung lo nga gsum pa la sras shākya mgon po la sri da rga/tad de thugs dam la gzhol te dgung lo bdun cu rtsa bzhir gshegs/de la sras bzhi byung ba las che ba lcil bu blo gros 'od yin/ rigasum pa lha btsun tshul khrims bzang po phag mo grur rab tu byung /bzhi pa 'bal gzhon nur gshegs/gnyis pa shākya mgon pos srid bskyangs te yar lungs lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan bsten/ pho brang yum bu bla sgang la gtsug lag khang bzhengs/chos 'khor du ma'i sbyin bdag mdzad nas bstan pa la phan par mdzad pa bcas 'di rnams nas bzung ste yar lungs jo bo'i gdung rgyud zam mi chad par byon pa rnams rigs gzugs dang yon tan khyad par 'phags par grags so//'od lde'i rgyud pa'i lo rgyus 'di rnams yar lungs jo bo'i chos 'byung 216

dang / rmekhas pa'i dga' ston/ mkhas pa lde'u'i chos 'byung sogs la dpyad gzhi byas te de dag las byung ba'i lo rgyus rags bsdus tsam brjod zin to//3 skyid lde'i rgyud pa'i skor/ gcung skyid sde 'jad rta nag tu phog/ sras drug byung ba'i lnga byang du gshegs te 'bro'i btsad po dang / g.yas ru ru lag gi btsad rnams dang / mus pa/ 'jad pa/ rta nag na yod pa rnams so/ /sras gcig gi rgyud pa btsan po rgyal ba 'od la thug go/ rgya bod yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed sogs las 'byung ba lta ra/ sras gcig gtsang grom pa dang /shab srad/ nyang stod smad du byon pas de la nyang khul du sras gsum byung ba'i che ba la khyung btsad/ bar pa la 'bre btsad/ chung ba la lce btsad bya bar grags shing / khong gsum gyis srid skyong ba'i yul ni phu gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po (rgyal rtse rdzong lung dmar chus khongs ) nas mda' bcug pa yu ba sa/dong (gzhis rtse grong khyer khongs phag grong chus khongs ) ste nyang gser gzhung ring mo sku mched so sos mnga' mjad yul bod 'brog cha snyoms pari yul sde chen po sa/sum du phye ba ni/gcen khyung btsad gyis mnga' dbang sgyur ba'i sa khul gyi sa mtshams phu byang shar ri nang spang mkhar la gtad/ mda' lho nub gangs ye sham bur bstan pa'i sa dbyibs gseg 'gros su yod pa'i yul sde chen po gtsang gad brag /ba rmin(nyang chos 'byung nang mda' gsham phu rtse dgu la gtad ces gsal) yin par grags shing / (deng dus la cha mtshon na rtsa ba'i cha 217

nas rgyal rtse rdzong / khang dmar rdzong / gam pa rdzong bcas kyi khul yin 'dra/ ) yul sde chen po 'di'i phu na/ gam ru/ rgyang ru/ nying ru nes bya ba'i 'brog sde chen po gsu/ma yod/ bar na tshong 'dus chen po gcig yod pa sngar gyang ro sa ma na yod pa phyis gnas snying du spos pa/ khul de tsho'i nang gshis ka mi 'dra ba'i mi khag gnyis yod pa ste/ drag pa rnams shes rab che la dge ba'i las la brtson pa/ khyung rin chen grags la sogs pa mkhas grub mang po rim par byon pa/ zhan pa rnams sdig shas che ba nya dang ri dwags rngon pa/ zong sna mi gcig pa gsum yod pa ni/ zhwa mo dang / rnam phrug phad phyar dang gsum yin/ khul de'i yul sde ni phu'i 'brog sde rgya che ba dang / mda'i zhing sa khyon chung ba zhing 'brog cha ma snyoms pas sha se khog tu nyo tshong byed pa byung ba bcas so//bar pa 'bre btsad kyis mnga' sgyur ba'i sa khul ni/ gtsang gad brag kha man nas sna'o brag rdog yan la yul sde chen po gcig tu byas pa'i phu byang shar sa la btu dang / mda' lho nub gab phyi dkar la bstan pa dbyis gseg 'gros su yod pa(deng dus la cha mtshon na rtsa ba'i cha zhan pa rnam rdzong khongs la gtogs pa rnams yin)yul sde de'i phu'i 'brog sde chen po gsum ni/rgyang mkhar dang / skyi na ma/bar/ ma ngag gsum mo/ /bar na tshong 'dus chen po gcig yod pa sngar thu gur yod kyang phyis 'dus byung du byed/ mi gshis mi 'dra ba sa/nyika ༷ 3 pa/sa pa'i drag pa rnams blun la rang 'dod che rung phyus/ shas che/ zhan pa rnamase spyang grung 'dzoms la smra mchu rgod rung dbul shas tsha/ thrang ni mi radra ba gsum yod mi ni/ sle'u dang / grum ze/ 218

phying pa gsum mo/ /phu'i 'brog sde dang / ma da 'i zhing sa rgya khyon cha snyo mas pas sha phyed tshong du byed pa bcas so//chung ba lce ba tsad kyis mnga' dbang sgyur ba'i sa khul ni/ sna'o brag rdog man nas bcug pa yu ba gdong yan la yul sde chen po gcig byed pa de yi preng phu byang shar 'khor stong la kha dang / mda' lho nub phyug sgo gzhung la bstan pa'i sa dbyibs gseg 'gros su yod pa (deng dus la mtshon na rtsa ba'i cha nas gzhis rtse rdzong khongs rgya mtsho shar chus dang sa/zhis rtse grong khyer/de bzhin chu mig chus kyi shar lho dang phag grong chus kyi lho rgyud cha shas bcas yin)yul sde chen po de'i phu na 'brog sde chen po gsum yod pa ni sgrol dang /lcags/ ra gsum mo/ /bar na tshong 'dus chen po gcig yod pa sngar tshong 'dus mgur mo na yod kyang phyis zhwa lu ru 'dus pa dang / de rjes bsam grub rtse ste gzhis ka rtser tshong 'dus chags pa 'aridi yin par grags/mi gshis mi 'dra ba gnyis yod pa'i drag pa rnams mdzangs la des shing /zhan pa rnams khram shas che/ zong sna mi 'dra ba gsum yod pa ni/ gtsang ther dang / dar skyegs/ lham zon rnams so/ /phu'i 'brog sde rgya chung zhing / mda'i zhing pa rgya che bas sha gzugs tshong du byed par grags pa bcas so//btsad po mched gsum gyi yul bgos byas pa de cha snyoms par byung na'ami / gam ru'i g.yam pa legs po de spyod sgo che la mi 'dzad pa'i gter dang 'dra ba byung / za dang / g.yam pa'i rgyal po zer ba khyung g.yam du grags pa khyung ba tsad la thob pa yin/ dus phyis btsad po mched lha19

gsum gyi gdung rgyud la dar gud byung ba'i dbang gis yul sde tshan po gsum ste nyang stod smad bar gsum lce btsad gcig pos bzung ba yin/ sngar khyung btsad skabs nyang stod kyi gzhung ste klung thang phal che ba'i zhing ga la chu med pa thal 'debs byed dgos par phyis lce btsad thugs blo zab ciri /'byor stobs che bas sa khul 'di tshor sde tsho bcos thabs dgos pa 'dug gsungs nas nyang stod kyi byang rgyud du rtsa gnam gyi rgyal rka dang / lho/ rgyud du spang yul zheng gi 'od rka bya ba/ nyang smad byang du spa tshab rka mo che dang /lhor rna rka chen bcas rka chen so sos sa zhing son khal khri tsho re'i 'debs chu sogs chu'i dgos mkho skong thub rmer byas shing / rka mo che bzhi gsar du bskrun pa rnams sra brtan ma chags bar rka srung pa sdod pa'i sa mkhar bzhengs pa ni stod du rgya grong lce mkhar dang / smad du pa rnam lce mkhar gnyis gsar du bzorme pa rim bzhin phul de tshor grong tsho rgya chen chags pa phyis kyang gnas pa bcas/ de lta bu'i zhing las thon skyed rgya cher spel thub pa'i 'gag rtsa srid pa'i rka mo che bzhi dang / mkhar grong gnyis bcas gsar du bsgrun pas lce btsad kyis chu bed 'dzugs skrun dang / mkhar grong 'dzugs skrun la mdzad rjes rlabs po che bsub thabs med pa zhig bzhag yod pa ma zad/ bstan pa phyi dar skabs kyi dgon sde chags snga ba lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gis nyang smad rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang btab pa'i sbyin bdag gi gtso bo yang lce btsad kyis mdzad pa lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul mang po las rtogs thub/ dper na/ 〈〈myang yul stod smad bar gsum gyi ngo mtshar gtam gyi legs bshad mkhas pa'i 'jug ngogs 〉〉zhes bya ba'i nang /220

de dus zhwa lu pa che ba rnam pa bzhi zer ba yod de/ las ka bzhi yin pas che/ yon bdag btsad po yin pas che/ sdom pa rgya gar ma yin pas che/rus pa lce yin pas che/ (myang chos 'byung lcags parā byum shog grangs 1ā+o1) zhes 'khod pa'i dang po zhwa lu pa'i ka ba bzhi/ gasdung ma brgyad/byang du seng ge ral pa can dang dgu/ lcam bdun cu tham pa zhes yongs su grags pa'i ka ba bzhi ni/ dga' sdong dam pa chos kyi ka ba/ ku ri bya skyus kha brag dpung gi ka ba/ g.yus sgyu ma nor gyi rka/ ba/ ne ser mthu'i ka ba bcas so/ /gdung ma brgyad ni shar du kyi gru sha/ byar tshal/ lhor 'or mug pa/ 'bri mtshams/ nub tu ldog za rkang bo/ byang du gnyan rje 'bangs/ cog ro pan bcas so/ /byang gi seng ge ral pa can ni 'u yug gos sngon can gyi lung pa sogs la ngos 'dzin par grags pa bcas las ka bzhi ste zhwa lu pa'i mchod gzhis lha mi'i sde dgon sogs la ngos 'dzin pa'i che ba dang / yon bdag btsad po yin pas che zhes pa ni lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gis rgyan gong phyag btab pa dang / de'i nye gnas lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas kyis zhwa lu gser ya/ nga phyag btab pa sogs kyi sbyin bdag lce bcad kyiṭa/ mdzad pas dgon pa'i sbyin bdag kyang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba btsan po'i sa/dung rgyud kyisdoshu mdzad pa'i che ba/ sdom pa rgya gar ma yin pas che zhes lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas kyis zhwa lu gser khang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs grub pa'i rjes su ‘‘lce btsun gyis rgya gar rdo rje gdan la byon/ rdo rje gdan pa chen po slob dpon a bha ya ka ra la sdom pa blangs chos mang po zhus/ spyan ras gzigs kha sar pa ṇi spyan drangs/ pas 221

rgya gar gyi lha srung rnams ma dga' nas/ chu bo gaṅgā la spyan ma 'drongs/ der lce btsun gyis dkon mchog la zhag gsum gyi bar du gsol ba btab pas/ mon pa'i mipo tha mal bas nyis 'gyur gyi che ba gcig byung nas rnal 'byor pa khyod sku 'di rger spyan 'dren yin zer/ bod na zhwa lu zer ba'i gtsug lag khang gcig yod/ de ru spyan 'dren pa yin byas pas/ 'o na ngas 'phur gyis gla bya'am zer/ bod gyi zhwa lu tshun bskyal gla ji tsam dgos pa ster gsungs nas spyan drangs par grags/ zhwa lu'i gtsug lag khang gi rten gyi gtso bo la bzhugs te da lta rang byon gyi sku rkyab na bzhugs/ ’ (nyang chos 'byung lcags par ma shog grangs 1tsa1)zhes gsal ba lce btsun nas brgyud pa'i sdom rgyun 'di rgya gar gyi a bha ya nas thad kar bzhes pa'i che ba/rus pa lce yin pas che zhes pa ni lce btsun nas bzung khong gi rgyus pa na rim gyis zhwa lu dgon gnas 'dzin kyo/nga spel gsum gnang ba de'i thog ma'i lce'i rus rgyud 'byung stangs skor/ 'od gsal gyi lha nas mched pa ‘‘gnam rim pa bcu sa/sum gyi steng nas 'brug lta bu'i lce dang sa mer gyis zhu ba lta bu'i btsun mo bshos pa'i sras la lha gan rtse rgyal po byung / de'i gdung rgyud la lce'i ming thob/ lha gan rtse rgyal po dang klu bza' btsun mo bshos pa'i sras la lce nyi zer 'phrul gyi rgyal po byung / de las sras bdun gyi tha chung shel gyi skas las babs te stag gzig gi yul dang / de nas hor/de nas rgya yul/ de nas yar rim 'khyud kyis yar lung du phebs so’’//zhes myang chos 'byung / (lcas/ sa par ma shog grangs 1a+yo3)nang gsal ba ltar lce'i gdung rgyud thog mar byung ba nas rim par chos rgyal srong btsan 222

sgom po'i nang blon lce dbang tshan rma dang / /ṭī srong ldo btsan dang / sad na legs kyi nang blon lce khyi 'brug dang / dzā na sirta sogs kyis nang blon dang sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba chen po byung ba sogs nas bzung lce'i gdung rgyud rim par byon pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi gdung rgyud kyi che ba brjod pa'o de ltar zhwa lu ba'i che ba bzhi'i nang du yang thog mar zhwa lu'i rmang gzhi dpal 'byor gyi gnas tshul bkod ma tharga/ steng gi bkod pa'i thog ma kho nar zhwa lu'i sbyin bdag btsad po'i che ba brjod pa'i gnas tshul 'di'i thog nas nyang stod smad bar gsum bdag si//ra bzhes pa lce btsad kyis zhwa lu'i dgon gnas phyag btab rjes sbyin bdas/ gi bdag rkyen chen po gnang ba mngon gsal du thon par byas pa 'di ni lo rgyus kyi don dngos ngo ma de yin/ ('on kyang rgya bod yi ga/ tshang mkhaṭasdo pa dga' byed nang / ‘‘zhwa lu ba'i dpon rgyud 'di gdung rus btsad po lcertebatsad kyi rgyud par byed cing /de nas gdung rabs mang rab song ba'i bod du bti /na pa phyi dar gyi thog ma la dbus ba/rmyeng tri / yi bcus mdo smad du byon/ bla chen dgongs pa rab sa/sa la las rab tu byung / bsta/cha/ pa'i me ro smad nas bsla ngas pa'i dus lo ston rdo rje dbang phyub/ gis nyang smad rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ choṭagi lde/ ba tsu shāsgro/ḍā / de la slob ma bu cher/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi byung ba'i nang na mgo mag bo/(thung drung bya bas sbre lha khang bzhengs/ rgyan gong du bzhugs/ de'i dngos slob bu chen lce btsun sher 'byung gis ma khan po la sa dmigs zhus nas zhwa lu nga mo/'i gtsug lag khang bzhongs/ chos sde 223

btab/ khong rang gis rgya gar du byon/ sdom pa bskyar ma dang zab chos mang du zhus/ tshur phebs nas sde mnga' zhabs kun mched zla 'dzin bcug ste bstan pa'i bya ba kho na don du gnyer bas slob ma grags thon pa/ la/ bzhi gdung drug bya ba byung bas da lta'i bar du zhwa lu ba'i chos lugs zer ba 'di dar 'dug/ ’’ (lcags par ma shog grangs 3smo8) ces gsal ba'i nang lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas lo ston gyi yang slob yin pa dang / lce btsun nas zhwa lu ba'i chos lugs byung tshul sogs la dpyad pa dgos pa'i gnad don mchis rung / gsham du bstan pa phyi dar skabs dbus gtsang mi bcu la sogs pa'i lo rgyus nas gnad don ngo ma gang yin gsal por mkhyen rgyur re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag)'on kyang skabs 'dir zhwa lu ba'i dpon rgyud btsad po'i gdung rgyud dang / de yang lce brgyud yin pa'i tshul 'di ni dpyad dgos pa'i don zhig tu snang / don dngos ni khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal gyi gdung rgyud yab gcig pa'i sras gsum gyis bdag gir bzhes pa'i mnga' ris sa khul gsum gyi 'bangs mang che ba'i rus ming gnas la chags pa de slar btsan po'i gdung rgyud so sos sa khul de'i bdag po mdzad pa mtshon par byed phyir khyung btsad dang / 'bre btsad/ lce btsad ces nges bzung bde ba'i mtshan mi 'dra ba thogs pa zhig yin pas lce btsad dang lce'i gdung rgyud ni yongs su tha dad yin pa'i gnad 'di dor bar bya ba bcas sdo//224

( khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal/dpal sde/ 'od sde/ skyid lde/'od zer lde/ dharma tsakra/dbang po lde/ 'di'i rgyud pa ni lha rtse ba/ glang lung rtsad skor ba/ klu rgyal ba/dung dkar lde/ spyi pa rnams yin par grags/btsan ram̐/lha mchog ldo'am 'dol le/ dkon mchog lde/ 'od lde'am rtse mo/dbang phyug lde/skyob pa lde/sras mo gsum dang / sras mgon po lde'am dpung dmar/ btsun pa lde/khri rgyal 'bum lde mgon/ (1353da 138d+ngha) khri rin chen bzang po/ khri lde 'bum/ bsam lde/(da 1380) (13a+yo8)—dze 225

chos skyong lde/ (1380da 13'a1) 3khri bkra shis lde/ (1kā13da 13a+yolā) khri phun tshogs lde dpal bza| po/ (1kā38da 2370)khri mchog grub lde/ khri rgyal bsod nams lde/ (13a+yo1da 140bhe)bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang rgyal mtshan/ (140bhed 1shisnyo4)khri rnam rgyal lde/ (1433da 1503) nam mkha' nor bu/ lcam sring ā grol chos kyi sgron me chos rgyal nor bu lde/ (1bhe'0da ) khri rgyal bsam grub lde/ (1bhe'9da ) lcam sring don grub rgyal mo bcas dang / sangs rgyas rgyal mor 'khrungs pa sras shes rab dpal bzang / kun dga' rnam rgyal/ mkha' 'gro rgyal mo/chos rgyal nor bu lde'i sras/ lha btsun kun dga' rnams rgyal/ slo bor bzhugs skabs kyi sras 'jam —dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/mnga' ris paṇa chen/ gcung legs ldan/pad+ma rgyal po/226

khri rgyal bsam grub lde'i sras/ khri bkra shis dpal 'bar/ lha btsun nam mkha' dpal mgon/gong ma kun dga' blo gaus/ sras mo dkon mchog rgyal mo/ 1 kun bzang rdo rje grags pa/khri rgyal bsam grub lde/ lha sras lhun grub rgyal po/ da dung sras gcig dang /(da 1593)lcam mo gcigakun dga' rnam rgyal gyi sras/khri kun bzang sdu zla grags pa/ (1'a19da 15a+yo0)ldang ma shes rab kun dga'/ lha kun bzang rnam 'phrul rgyal po/ lcam sring bde legs bzang mo/ sras mo phun tshogs rgyal mo/khri rgyal bsam grub sde'i sras /khri rgyal bsod nams ḍibang phyug lde/ (1lāgyi7da )chos rje kun bzang / sras mo no ra 'jin dbang mo dang / gzhan gcigardo rje bdud 'dul//sras mo gcig bcas so// 227

'od lde/ pha wa de se/ khri lde/ nyag lde/ khri chung /dar ma rā dza/ lha rgyal ba/ 'di'i rgyud pa/ 'od skyid 'bar/g.yas ru/dar ma btsan po/ dar lde/ skyin mkhar/btsan por/khri 'baḍi/ dar ma lde bcas so// thugakhri btsan 'bar dang bkra shis lde//btsan srong /btsan po lde 'bar bcas so//'od skyid 'bar gyi gras gcen zhang rje tsha khri lde 'bar/ gcung gtsang tsha drug ste/lha spyan/ g.yu spya/na/ da ra/ lhu/ po/'od btsan/ gung btsan/jo dga'/ 'di'i rgyud pa/gsham du mthud/ mtshams dang por/gzigs/228 —gedhe

shāṅge'i rgyud pa gsham 'di'i rgyud pa gsham du du mthud mtshams mthud mtsham gsum gnyis par gzigs/ par gzigs/ /gcen zhang rje tsha khri lde 'bar/g.yu thog bye chung lha sgom/ gung lde/ khrithog thag zla ba/bzhengs can 'bar/nam lde/ jo dga'/ rtse lde/ zla ba'i srasdu/ bzhengs can 'baḍi gyi sras/thog btsan/ lde 'ju/ gcen rab tu byung ba/ ji ma lod/nam lde'i sras/ g.yu thog jos dgar sras gcig/jo phag dang 'bum sde sokas drug/— g.yu can jo dga'i sras/bya sa lha chen/ khri dar ma/ lha zhi ba/sa/tsug sde/ khri gtsug lde/ rnal 'byor/ smon lam/jo 'bag/ lha chen po/ lha ngam shod pa/shākya mgon/ lha 'gro mgon/ lde bo/ lde chung / jo rgyal/229

shākya brgyal/jo 'phel/shākya bkra shis/ chab lha zur khang pa/gcung po'i rgyud khrom po ba rnams yin/lha brag kha ba/ grags pa rin chen/blo gros 'od/ shākya mgon po/ lha btsun tshul khrims bzang po 'bal/shākya rgyal gyi sras/shākya dpal gyi blo gros bzang po'o//mthud mtshams dang po/ lhun po 'bar gyi sras/jo mgon/ jo khri/ 'brug chung lde/'od lde/ dpal sde/ khri po/ grub pa/jo bo snye'ajig rten/ se ru/nor dga'/jo khrom/ jo 'bagashag khri/ 'od mdzes/ snye 230

jo bo dgos pa/ jo bo khri mgon bcas so//dpal lde'i sras/jo bo dga' dga'/khri 'od/khri 'bum/lde bdude ba cas so//mthud moḥms gnyis pa/ 'od btsan 'bar rgya sras/—brang nga lha lde/ brang chung /mthud mtshams gsum pa/ gung btsan 'bar gyi sras/lha ston ring mo/ lha 'theng ngu /bzhi pa/ stod kyi mgon gsum skor/mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyi sras chung ba(la las sras bgres par bzhed)skyide lde nyi ma mgon mnga' ris su phebs pa'i sras stod kyi mgon gsum ste/ rig pa mgon(dpal mgon)bkra shis mgon/ lde gtsug mgon gsum rim par 'khrungs shing / sras gsum gyi dbang sgyur 23shā

gnang yul gyi sa khul gang yin dang / mgon gsum las gyes pa'i gdung rabs 'khor re dang / srong nge'i yab gang yin skor bod kyi lo rgyus yig lam nang bzhed pa gcig gyur med pa skabs 'dir gtso che ba'i deb ther 'ga'i bzhid pa smos na/mkhas pa lde'u'i chos 'byung nang / ‘‘dpal mgon la mang yul gtad/ bkra shis mgon la pu rangs gtad/ gtsug lde la zhang zhung gtad pas stod mnga' ris skor gsum de tsho lags / ‘‘che shos dpal mgon gyi sras la spa tshab tsha 'od kyi rgyal mtshan te/ de dang bkra shis lha lde btsan gnyis te gcen kho re yang zer ro’’ (lde'u chos 'byung lcags par ma shog grangs 38༷)zhes dang / chos 'byung me tog snying po'i nang / ‘‘che ba dpal gyi mgon gyi rgyud ni/ yar lungs dang / spu rangs yul gyi btsad po rnams yin no/ /bar pa bkra shis mgon gyi rgyud pa rnams ni zhang zhung phyi nang dang spu rangs dang / ya rtse'i rgyal po'i rgyud rnams yin zer ro//mon yul na ci rigs pa yod do/ /chung ba lde gtsug mgon gyi rgyud ni/khum bu ba/ ding ri ba/ mon yul ci rigs pa yod do zer ba rnams lags/ bkra shis mgon gyi sras kho re dang / srong nge byon/ (me tog snying po lcags par ma 958)zhes gsal/sa chen rgyal rabs nang / ‘ dpal gyi mgon gyis ru thog pa'i btsad po bgyis te sme btsad pa'i mes po lags so/ /chung ba lde gtsug mgon gyis pu rangs pa'i jo bo bgyis te mnga' bdag stag tsha'i mes po lags so//bar pa bkra shis mgon gyis rgyal bzung ste de'i sgas kho re dang / srong nge 232

gnyis so//’’ (rgyal rabs bris ma shog grangs rdzon) /mkhas pa'i dga' ston nang bu ston chos 'byung dang / yar lungs jo bo'i chos 'byung gi bzhed pa ltar 'god gnang—mdzad pa yin k+ṣi/sa gsal kha gnang ba/ ‘‘dpal gyi rig pa mgon gyis mang yul bzung / bar pa bkra shis lde mgon gyis spu rangs bzung / chung ba lde gtsug mgon gyis zhang zhung bzung / lde gtsug gi sras srong nge dang / 'khor re gnyis ’’(mkhas dga' lcags par ma shog grangs bhe3pho)zhes dang / yang gzhan lugs gsung skabs/ gzhan las lde gtsug mgon gyis mang yul bzung zhes sogs dang / bkra shis mgon gyi sras khor re dang / srong nge zhes sogs snang ngo / / (mkhas dga' lcags par ma shog grangs bhepāsmo)zhes 'khod pa'i bzhed tshul de dag gsal por gzigs bde ba'i re'u mig bstar ba gsham gsal/deb ther dpal gyi rig bkra shis lde lde gtsug khor re dang mu pa mgon gyi mgon gyi mgon gyi srong nge'i yab mang / rgyud pa/ rgyud pa/ rgyud pa/ su yin pa/mkhas pa dpal lde'u'i chos mang yul/ pu rangs/ zhang zhung / skyi4 /'byung / mgan233

chos 'byung / zhangazhungaspu khumabubad wa 'ime tog snying yaralung dang rang ya rtse ding ri ba bkra shas ོ pu rangs/ ོ ོ mgon/pa/ man yul/ man yul/sa chen rgyal ru thog pa'i rgyal sa parangs/ bkra shis rabs/ btsad po/ bzung / sto mgon/bya//babazhing/:rno — 'e/ba/rbetsub/ dga' ston mang yul/ pu rangs/ zhang zhung / mabon/shāt+nangalugs/ da dge / jo bo'i rjes bkra shis 'brang gzhan mang yul/ mabon/(sprub/25/ / bod rje btsad mar yul spepo'i gdang 'aza sha'i zhang zhung zangs dkar bkra shas rabs//cu badro/ ya rtse/ sgo gsum/ mgon/kho bo'i blta stangs ni kaḥthog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus mdzad pa'i bod rje btsad po'i gdung rabs tshig nyung don gsal nang gsal ba gzhi rtsar bzung ba ste ‘‘che ba rig pa mgon gyis mar yul 'bru sha'i bar dang / 'bri ba bkra shis mgon gyis zhang zhung ya rtse dang bcas pa/ chung ba lde gtsug mgon gyis zangs dkar sgo gsum bcas bzung zhes pa 'di ni 234

zhungs dang ldan pa ste/ gzhan gu ge dang / pu rangs gnyis su mgon gnyis phog pa de ni ma yin no/ /bkra shis mgon gyi sras srong nge dang /'khor re gnyis/ srong nges gu ge dang / 'khor res pu rangs bzung / ’’(gdung rabs bris ma shog grangs 13na)zhes gsungs pa ni 'thad ldan du mthong / spyir rig 'dzin chen po 'di nyid ni bar skabs byon pa'i lo rgyus smra ba'i gtsug rgyan mkhas pa'i dbang po zhig yin pas khong gis mdzad pa'i lo rgyus deb ther ni ches yid ston rung ba zhig yin pa ma zad/ lhag par mnga' ris skor gsum gyi lo rgyus la de bas nang byan chud pa zhig yin 'dug khong si/sa 〈〈bod rje btsad po'i gdung rabs tshig nyung don gsal〉〉rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing glang spyi lo1745lo brtsams pa nas lo bzhi song ba rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa sbrul spyi lo1gyibherdzolo bal yul mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi zhig gso rgya chen po gnang ba'i skabs mang yul gung thang za 'og phug tu lo gcig bzhugs ring gung thang rgyal rabs kyi yig cha mang po'i snying bsdus gnang ba〈〈bod rje lha btsad po'i gdung rabs mnga' ris mang yul du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul deb ther dwangs shel 'phrul gyi me long 〉〉zhes bya ba gsar rtsom gnang ba'i snying bsdus geng du dpal lde'i sras 'od zer sde'i skabs zhus pa ltar mang yul dang mar yul gnyis ni yul gru tha dad la rig pa mgon gyi rgyud pa blo gros mchog ldan gyis phyis gu ge dbang du bsdus te dpya' sogs mang po bsdus pa'i lo rgyus nas kyang gong du sdom tshig 'jog gnang mdzad pa der 'khrul pa med pa'i gsal bshad thub pa yin/ sgyu235

che ba rig pa mgon la mnga' ris mar yul/ 'bangs gzhu nag btsan/ shar ru thog dang / gser kha gog lad kyi bde mchog dkar po/ mtshams kyi ra ba dmar po/ wam le yi mig gi pha bong sa/yag lde rdo bug pa can yan chad/ byang gser kha 'gog po/ nub kha che'i la btsas la gtogs pa rnams yin no//bar pa bkra shis mgon gyis zhang zhung dang / ya rtser dbang mdzad/chung ba lde gtsug mgon gyis zangs dkar/ sgo gsum/ spi ṭī/‘spi lcog dang bcas pa la mnga' mdzad pa yin no//dang po/ sras che ba rig pa mgon gyi rgyud pa'i skor 'di rgyal rabs gser gyi phreng ba dang / la dwags rgyal rabs gtso bor bzung nas bkod pa 'di lta ste/ rig pa mgon gyi sras 'gro mgon dang / chos mgon gnyis/'gro mgon gyi sras bla chen grags pa lde/de'i sras bla chen byang chub sems dpa'/de'i sras bla chen rgyal po/ de'i dus su klu dkyil gyi dgon pa btab nas dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ gangs ri mtsho gsum du mang dus sgrub pa po lnga brgya tsam dang / nyung dus brgya tsam re bzhugs pa la 'tsho ba'i yo byad sbyar/de'i sras lha chen ut+pa la/ de'i skabs la dwags stod gsham ba/nyis kyi dmag drangs nas nyung ti la brgyab pas nyung ti rgyal po pham nas gangs ti se nam bzhu dang / mtsho ma pham nam skam bar te ji srid bar rgyal 236

por mdzo dang lcags la sogs pa'i khral dang dpya' 'bul ba'i mna' gan bzhag pa lag bstar rgyun 'khyongs byas pa dang / da dung glo bo/ pu rangs man chod/ lho phyogs bre srang gi yul chu la me 'bar tshun chod/ nub phyogs ra shan 'greng shing / stag khu tshur chad/ byang phyogs ka brus phan chod mnga' 'og tu bsdus te lo star dpya' khral 'bul ba dang / rgyal po'i zhal mjal zhu bar yong rgyu'i chod kha byas pa sogs rgyal po 'di'i dus su mnga' thang rgyal la dpung stobs btsan pa byung /de'i sras lha chen nag lug rgyal po 'dis stag gi lo la ban le'i mkhar dang / 'brug gi lo la kha la rtse brtsigs so//de'i sras lha chen dge ste dang / dge 'bum/dge 'bum gyi sras lha chen ngo rdor/de'i sras bkra shis mgon/de'i sras lha rgyal/ rgyal po 'dis gser bzhun gyi khu bas rdo rje rtse mo dang / ngan song pyong rgyud/ rgyud 'bum cha tshang bcas bskrun/de'i sras lha chen jo dpal/ rgyal po 'di'i chos srid mdzad pa gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa byung bar grags/de'i sras lha chen dngos grub/ rgyal po 'di'i dus su rab tu byung ba dbus gtsang du 'chad nyan la 'gro ba'i srol btsugs nas yab mes kyi gtsug lag khang rnams la zhig gso mdzad pa dang / khyad par du chos rje 'bri gung pa 'jig rten ca/ gon po/ (rab byung gnyis pa'i chu phag spyi lo 1143lor 'khrungs/ rab byung bzhi pa'i me glang spyi lo 1317lor 237

gshegs/ ) mjal bar phebs nas gser dngul la sogs pa rin po chabargya 'bul zhus pa/ gzhan yang bka' 'gyur tshar gnyis dang / gsang sngags kyi dkyis 'khor yang mang po bzhengs so//de'i sras lha chen rgyal bu rin chen/de'i sras lha chen shes rab/ rgyal po 'di'i ring la sa bu'i hang rtse mo zhes pa'i kha la grong khyer seng ge sgang zhes pa brtsigs nas mar yul sa bu spyang mkhar du btags so//de'i sras lha chen khri gtsug lde/ rgyal po 'dis gle ru mchod rten brgya rtsa dang / sa bu ru brgya rtsa gnyis bcas bzhengs so// de'i sras bla chen grags pa 'bum lde dang / grags pa 'bum gnyis 'khrungs pa las grags pa 'bum sdes gle la sogs pa la mnga' mdzad nas rgya ma'am phyag rjes su gtsug lag khang dmar po bzhengs nas de'i nang bzhugs su gsol rgyu'i sku rten rgyal ba byams pa madzhan po dgung po brgyad pa'i sku tshad dang / g.yas g.yon gnyis su 'jam dbyangs dang / phyag na rdo rje thog tshad re/ gtsug—lag khang gi logs bris la bde bar gshegs pa'i sku brnyan mang po bris yod pa bcas gtsug lag khang de thog so sum brtsegs mtho ling gi dpe zla lta bu dang / gsung rten du gzus 'bum chen mo dang /dko/na brtsegs/ lang dkar gshegs pa la sogs pa bzhengs/thugs rten du de'u ser po gle'i yul la gnod pa zhig yod pa de btums nas/ phyi mchod rten gyi tshul la nang lha khang brgya rtsa bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa bzhengs pa de'i mtshan la te'u bkra shis 'od 'phro zer/238

gzhan yang gle'i mdo de na de'u glang po che 'dra ba yod pa la rgyal pos ri ma gi la dge slong bzhi sde'i sgrub grwa zhig btsugs zin na nga shi yang 'gyod pa med gsungs pa'i dus der snyigs dus kyi kun mkhyen tsong kha pa chen po blo bzang grags pas rang gi shangs khrag la 'khrungs pa'i tshe dpag med mtheb tshigs tsam yod pa —bya bral gnyis la bsku—ra nas mnga' ris su yang na grags pa'i mtshan can nam/ yang na lde'i mtshan can gyi phyag tu phul zhes gsungs pa ltar bya bral gnyis po mar yul du 'byor nas nub ri na grags pa zhes bya ba zhig (ོsdo+o da pa de'i drung du bya bral gnyis phyin par khong ji/sa spyan tsam yang ma gzigs par 'bul thabs ma byung ba gle ru yong / de'i tho rengs rgyal po'i zhal nas de ring nga'i zhal blta ba la bya bral ste da pha dang / mon ti shi 'ong bas sus kyang ma khogs shig gsungs pa ltar bya bral gnyis byung bar rgyal pos bya bral sa/nyis la bsu ba mdzad cing / bya bral gnyis kyis tsong kha pa chen po'i sku skyes phul bas shin tu mnyes nas sangs rgyas byi bstan pa rin po che la dpes nas dpe thub kyi dgon pa ma brtsigs lhun gyis grub pa de lta bu btab nas dge 'dun gyi sde mang po btsugs/de'i sras blo gros cha/chog ldan/ rgyal po 'di'i dus su gu ge nas dmu khrab zil pa ma mo'i mun sgrib/ khrab chung dkar ru/ lha khrab dkar pos gtsos khrab bco brgyad/ ral gri nam mkha' khrag ldag 'brong rtse ring /glog dmar me gsod la sogs pa'i ral gri bco brgyad/ ske gri bdud grinag po/ dam gri gzhung brgyad rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i ske gri bco lnga/lha g.yu 'od ldan/ lha g.yu dkar po gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i g.yu bco lnga/nyu39

sga ma ji khri steng / bkra shis 'od ldan sogs sga nyi shu/ chibs gro bo lnga bcu dang / ngang pa lnga bcu/ 'ol ba nyi shu/ khra bo sum cu/ 'bri zal mo nyi shu/ g.yag kham pa nyi shu/ lug la sogs pa'i dpya khral mang po 'bul bzhes gnang ba dang / mnga' ris skor gsum chab 'og tu bsdus nas mnga' thang dar rgyas byung bar grags/lha chen grags pa 'bum gyis rab brtan lha rtse dang / te ya sogs la mnga' mdzad de rgyal sa gting sgang brtsigs/de'i sras lha chen bha ra/de'i sras lha chen bha gan/ rgyal po 'di 'khrug pa la 'in tu dga' ba zhig yod pas sher pa dang bsdongs nas gle'i rgyal po grags 'bum lde'i sras blo gros mchog ldan/ drung pa a mi/ sla bstan dar rnams phab nas gle mnga' 'og tu bsdus/de'i sras lha chen lha dbang rnam rgyal dang / bkra shis rnam rgyal/ lha dbang rnam rgyal de sku stobs che la sgyu rtsal la shin tu mkhas pa zhig yod rung / bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi g.yo 'og tu tshud de gcen po'i spyan bton nas/ gdung rgyud kyi phyir btsun mo dang bcas ling sked du bzhugs su bcug bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi sras lha chen tshe dbang rnam rgyal/ rnam rgyal mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal dang gsum yin/ de'i dus su bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis rgyal srid mdzad de/ pu rig yan chad/ gro shod man chad mnga' 'og tu bsdus nas rta khyu bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing /240

sku mkhar gle rnam rgyal rtse mo dang / chu rta'i grong khyer btab/ de skabs hor gyi dmag byung ba la 'thab pas hor mang po bsad/ rnam rgyal rtse mor mgon khang bzhengs/ 'bri gung chos rje ldan ma gdan drungs nas sgang sngon bkra shis chos rdzong btab ste nye 'khor yul khag nas btsun khral bskul te dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ dgon pa mthong ba'i sa mtshams su dar su che btsugs te de'i nang khongs su rkun jag la sogs pa'i nyes can pa chud pa tsam gyis nag nyes las thar ba'i thar pa gling du mdzad/gzhan yang 'bri gung / sa skya/ dge ldan/ lha sa bsam yas sogs su phebs bzhugs kyis rten gsum la gser chab spron 'bul dang / dge 'dun gyi sder mang ja/ bla mar brgya 'bul/ bka' bstan 'gyur gyis mtshon gsung rten gyi glegs bam mang po dang / mchod rten mang po yang bzhengs gnang mādzad/de nas tshe dbang rnam rgyal rgyal srid la dbang bskur nas sku na gzhon dus dmag mdzad pas byang ngam ring / glo bo dang / pu rangs/ gu ge la sogs pa mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ lho phyogs 'dzum lang dang / nyung ti/ nub shing dkar dang / khab gar tshun chod mnga' 'og tu bsdus shing / sa khul de tsho'i sngar gyi bdag po rnams mi gter nyar ba dang / bka' gsung ci sgrub zhu rgyu'i yig dan byas pa/ mkhar rnams la sku tshab bzhag nas mar yul thams cad dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/gu ge nas/ khral dang dpyar/ lo ltar gser zho sum brgya/ dngul/lug tsher mo brgya/ chibs pa gcig/ ru thog nas gser zho nyis brgya 241

drug cu/ lug tsher mo brgya/ chibs pa gcig btsod rkyal pa bcu/mkhar o ldong dang / zhing darīr chen dar chung rnams dang / gzhan yang khral dang dpya' la sogs pa phyogs phyogs nas 'bul mkhan mang po byung yod/ khong gis da dung gtsug lag khang rgya chen po bzhengs pa sogs mes ral pa can lta bu'i phyag rjes shig 'jog par dgongs pa'i mur sku gshegs shing / de rjes rgyal phran lta bu'i mnga' ris rnams kyang phyogs phyogs su gyes/de rjes 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyis rgyal srid mdzad pa de'i dus pu rig gi jo bo gnyis ma mthun nas/ tshe ring ma lig zer ba'i dpung rogs su la dwags nas dmag dpung btang rung / dus kyi 'grib dus dang /rgyal khrims kyi nyams dus la babs pas nang gong dmag dpon a li mir gyi dmag rdol ba dang thug cing / khos g.yo thabs kyis nye ma 'khyol thabs byas pa dang de skabs khul der kha ba chen po babs nas la lung thams cad kha bas bkag nas rgyal po dmag dang bcas pa gar log la yar ba de'i tshe la dwags thams cad la sbal ti (kha che'i chos lugs 'dzin mkhan zhig yin 'dra)zhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab thams cad me la bsregs pa dang / chur dkyur ba/ gtsug lag khang thams cad bshig nas sbal te rnams rang yul du ldogade rjes a li mir sher han gyi sras mo rgyal mo kha tun zhes pa 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi btsun mor phul rjes btsun mo de'i mngal du sras chags shing / skabs der a li mir gyis 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal khri pho42

steng du bzhugs su gsol ba dang / dmag rnams la ston mo byas/ rgyal mo kha tun yang rgyan du mas brgyan nas a li mir gyis 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal la gsol pa/kha sangs yi rma'i lam du//mtsho nas seng ge nar gyis mchongs//rgyal kha tun la thim par mthong //de dang dus mtshungs bu mo 'di//sems can dang ni ldan par gyur// 'di la bu zhig nges par skye//ming du seng ge rnam rgyal thogs//(la dwags rgyal rabs lcags par ma shog grangs me0)zhes zer nas la dwags kyi dmag dang bcas gnang nas rgyal srid la dbang ba yin no//'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal la sras seng ge rnam rgyal dang / nor bu rnam rgyal rim par 'khrungs/ de'i dus su 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi thugs dgongs la/ ngas pu rig tshe ring ma lig gi dpung rogs la dmag dpung btang pa'i rkyen gyis bar skabs la dwags thams cad gzhan dbang du gyur/ da ngas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i thabs shig cis kyang bya dgos/ dgongs/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba bya rgyu skye 'gro'i bde skyid la rag lus gshis/ thog mar mi sde rnams la khral 'ul sogs kyi gtser bsun mi 'byung ba rang gi bu bzhin bskyang dgos dgongs te ltogs phyug lan gsum bsnyams snes 'bangs rnams bde bar bkod par grags — 343

shing 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal 'dis pu rig yan chod/ brang ti man chod mnga' 'og tu bsdus/btsun mo rgyal kha tun gyi sngon du 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sras mo tshe ring rgyal mo khab tu bzhes pa la sras ngag dbang rnam rgyal dang / bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gnyis 'khrungs shing / sras 'di gnyis kyisri kyang dbus gtsang du bzhugs pa'i sku rten la gser chab sgron 'bul dang / 'bras spungs dang / ra lung gi bla mar gser dngul sogs kyi 'bul ba/ dge 'dun gyi sder mang 'gyed sogs rgya chen po bstabs/ 'brug pa sprul sku la dwags su gdan 'dren pa'i pho nya sogs kyang brdzangs so//gzhan yang 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyis la dwags su gra tog gser gsum dang / dkar rgyud gser phreng sos/sa gser dngul zangs gsum la bzhengs pa dang / da dung la dwags khu'apre sbakha5 tiṭari me la bsregs pa'i sku gsung thugs rten gyi tshab rgya cher bzhengs pa'i phyag snges 'jog rgyu'i dgongs pa gtad kyang sku tshe thung bas phyag len la ma 'a khyol par lus/de'i sras seng ge rnam rgyal 'di gzhon nu'i dus nas sku sto/bas che la sgyu rtsal gyi gnas kun la byang chub pa zhig byung ba des gu pe / phyi 'brog dang /gu se/ bcas la snga rjes su dmyo/ga drangs nas rta nor ra luk+to/ la sogs pa mang po lon cing / ru shod bdag mo skal bzang sgrol ma khab tu bzhes/ la dwags su stag tshang ras chen pa gdan drangs nas yab kyi dgongs rdzogs la gser zangs kyi byams pa dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad la sogs pa'i rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs dang / rgyun mchod dge slong gi sde btsugs/244 ri

paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan (rab byung bcu pa'i lcags rta spyi lo 1'a70lor 'khrungs/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me bya spyi lo 1snyo'7lor 'das) gyi drung du yum gyi dgongs rdzogs la gser 'bum dang / dngul 'bum cha tshang / gzhan yang rin po che'i rigs brgya rtsa/ lha sa dang / khra 'brug/ bsam yas sogs gtsug lag khang dang /chos sde che chung la mchod sprin dang / bsnyen bkur rgya che ba/ wam le/ rgod yul/ kha nag gtsang dmar/ skyu dmar nang / me ru/ dar rtse sogs kyi sa khul dang / la dwags stod gsham dang / mnga' zhabs gang yod nas mchod gzhis su sa phud re re bskal pa nam gnas bar phul zhing / stag tshang ras chen la rang zhabs kyi khongs nas sa phud mchod gzhis rgya chen phul ba dang / stag tshang ras chen gyis he mi byang chub bsam gling dgon dang /lce bde theg mchog dgon/ wam le bde chen dgon bcas dgon chen gsum gyis gtsos pa'i gtsug lag khang mang po bzhengs pa'i sbyin bdag gi mthil len mdzad/seng ge rnam rgyal gyi sras bde ldan rnam rgyal/ in+d+ra bho ti/ bde mchog rnam rgyal rim par 'khrungs shing / sras 'di dag las brgyud pa'i gdung rgyud kyis la dwags khul la dbang sgyur gnang bar mnga' thang dar gud ci rigs byung ba sogs kyi lo rgyus phra rags zhib par 'bri rgyu yig tshogs rgyur sam re zhig mtshams 'dir byas shing / zhib cha gzigs par 'dod na bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas bskrun pa'i la dwags rgyal rabs la gzigs par zhu/245

gnyis pa/ bar pa bkra shis lde mgon gyi rgyud pa'i skor/bar pa bkra shis lde mgon gyi sras su shing glang spyi lo9phyo5lor srong nge 'khrungs shing / de rjes 'khor re bcas rim par 'khrungs/ srong nge'i mtshan dngos drang srong lde dang 'khor re'i mtshan dngos 'khor lo lde yin zhes mnga' ris gung thang gi po / ṇi ka'i nang bzhugs pa'i yig rnying nang gsal zhes kaḥthog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus btsad po'i gdung rabs nang gsungs 'dug srong nge gu ge dang / 'khor res pu rangs bzung / srong nges sku tshe'i stod la khab bzhes pa'i sras nā ga rā dza dang /dhe wa rā dza gnyis rim par 'khrungs shing / srong nges dgung lo sum cu pa me sprel spyi lo99snyolo mnga' ris gu ge mtho lding gser gyi lha khang bzhengs/phyis yab mes kyi yig tshang gzigs pas thugs skyo ste rgyal srid gcung 'khor re la gtad nas dgung lo lnga bcu pa spyi lo 101phyolo yab sras gsum ka rtags rang gi blangs/ te dkon mchog gi drung du skra phud phul nas rab tu byung zhes lo rgyusdo/ yig lam 9ragar gsal yang don du lo chen rin chen bzang ngo 'i rab byung gi mkhan po ye shes bzang po las rab tu byung ba dang /mtshan yang ye shes 'od ces pa mkhan po ye shes bzang po'i mtshan gyi ye shes lha bla mari mtshan gyi thog la sbyar zhes mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtshos (bstan rtsis gsal ba'i khyon byed lcags par ma'i shog grangs 73) gsungs pa ni 'thad ldan du mtho nga zhing / lha bla ma ye shes 'od 'dis bstan pa'i me ro gso ba'i thad la mdzad rjes chen po bzhag yod/ de yang sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos sdo spe / gsum rab dbye'i nang /246
