‘‘de tshe bla ma ye shes 'od/ /chos rgyal de yis skyes bu mchog/rin chen bzang po kha cher brdzangs//'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin brlabs pa'i//mkhas mchog de yis sngon med pa'i//chos rnams phal cher bsgyur cing zhus//’’zhes gsungs pa ltar bstan pa phyi dar gyi 'go lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang / lo tsā ba chen po rin chen bzang po nas ngos bzung ba ni/ bstan pa'i me ro smad nas bslangs te stod mnga' ris nas shin tu dar ba de la dgongs pa dang / lha bla ma rab tu byung ba'i me 'brug 'di ni mnga' ris nas bstan pa phyi dar dar zhing rgyas pa'i lo dus kyi thog ma yin pa lung rigs kyis grub pa zhig lags/lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis lo chen rin bzang la sogs pa'i khye'u blo rno ba nyi shu rtsa gcig rgya nar du gser mang po bskur te chos slob tu btang ba'i na nga nas bcu dgu rgya gar du tshad pas krongs/ bod du phyir phebs thub pa lo chen rin chen bzang po dang / lo chung legs pa'i sheṭarga rab gnyis kyis chos lobs te mdo sngags kyi chos mang po bsgyur cing zhus nas gtan la phab pa dang /gzhan yang lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis rgya gar sha ra phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta snyi ka ra warma sogs paṇ+ḍi ta lnga spyan drangs pa'i nang gi dharma pā la nas 'dul ba'i bshad pa dang lag len mdzad pa'i slob ma'i ba/tso bo sa rdu pā la/ gu 247

ba pā la/ pratshwa bā la ste pā la rnam gsu ma la sogs pa slob ma mang du byung ste de rnams las brgyud pa la stod 'dul du grags pa dang / gsang sngags gsar ma dar ba 'di'i thad lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis bdag rkyen gnang ba'i mdzad rjes chen po bzhag yod pa dang / 'dul ba stod 'dul dang /gsang sngags gsar ma'i skor sogs gsham6du bstan pa phyi dar gyi lo rgyus nang dmigs su bkar nas zhu rgyu yin/ de'i skabs bod du stod smad nas 'dul ba'i bstan pa dar te dbus gtsang du'ang dge 'dun gyi sde tshugs pa sogs byung na'ang / bar skabs yun ring tsam bstan pa nyams pa'i rkyen gyis lta spyod rnam dag 'dzin pa nyung zhing / chos log spyod pa mang po byung bar lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis chos log sun 'byin dgos pa'i bka' bcad mdzad kyang rngo ma thogs pa chos dang chos min rnam par dbye bar jo bo rje'i snyan pa sngon nas gsan pa bzhin khong gdan 'dren zhu thub na bstan pa'i sman yon nyag cig tu 'gyur bar dgongs nas lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis rgya brtson 'grus seng ge la gser mang po bskur te rgya gar du btang yang jo bo'i zhal nas bod la 'gro ba la rgyu gnyis te gser 'dod nas bod du 'gro ba yin te nga la ni gser gyi dgos pa med/ yang na bdag pas gzhan gces kyi bsam pas 'gro ba yin te de yang nga la med ces gsungs nas re zhig spyan ma 'drongs/ de rjes garadzilog dang / gu ge gnyis ma 'chams pa g.yul 'gyed byed dgos par thug skabs lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis rgyal srid gcung por sngon nas gtad zin kyang / g.yul 'gyed 'di'i nang rang phyogs la pham 248

kha 'khel na spyi nas rgyal srid kyi dbang ris dang lhag par gar log ces pa tu ra ka'i nang tshan zhig yin stabs kha che'i chos lugs spyod pas nang pa'i chos lugs gong 'phel 'gro bar 'gog rkyen yong srid pa bcas/ bstan srid kyi don chen gazlo po che de 'dra ba btang snyoms su 'jog pa thugs kyis ma bzod par khong sku ngo mar dmag sne khrid de gar log dang 'thab pas pham ste gar log rgyal pos btson du bzung ste khong gi sku srog la nyes skyon mi 'byung ba'i cha rkyen don tshan gnyis bton pa ste/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od la khye da dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'dzi na pa btang ste kha che'i chos lugs la dad pa byas na btson nas gtong rgyu dang / de min khong gi sku lus kyi ljid dang mnyam pa'i gser byung na brtsan nas gtong zer rung khong gis de ltar zhal bzhes ma gnang bas btson du yun ring tsam lus pa la dbon po rnams kyis mnga' ris khul du gser mang po bsgrubs pa dang / dbus gtsang gi rab tu byung ba rnams la yang sham thabs kyi khral te grwa pa nas gser khral bsdus pa bcas bsdoms pas ye shes 'od kyi sku gzugs kyi ljid las da dung dbu'i cha tsam zhig ma ldeng rung / lha bla ma skyob la rings pa'i stabs kyi dbon po byang chub 'od gar log tu phebs te khu bo lha bla ma dang dngos mjal zhus nas nga tshos khyed kyi sku lus kyi ljid dang mnyam pa'i gser rnyed zin gyi da dbu'i ljid tsam gyi gser dgos pa yang 'phral mar bsgrub 'tshol zhus te spyan 'dren zhu bar ngacar chog ces thugs blo bde ched de ltar snyan du gsol kyang ye shes 'od kyi zha' nas/ da nga rgas pas su la yang phan mi thogs pas gser gang rnyed pa de rnamyo/sa bskur te rgya gar 249

nas jo bo rje dang / paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa mang po bod du spyan drongs/ mtho lding du mchod rta4 chen po tshugs/ yab mes kyis bzhengs pa'i lha sa dang /bsam yas sogs la zhig gso bcas mdor na bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i thabs la 'bungs dgos pa'i zhal chems dbon po byang chub 'od la gsungs nas dgung lo bdun cu yas mas te rab byung dang po'i me byi spyi lo 103smolo'i yas mas su gar log rgyal po'i btson khang du sku bhe gshegs/ ——lha bla ma ye shes 'od rab tu byung rjes gcung po 'khor res gu ge rgyal po'i srid dbang bzung zhing / kha char gyi lha khang bzhengs/ 'khor re'i sras lha ldes paṇ+ḍi ta su bhū ti shrī shā n+ta gdan drangs nas sher phyin phyogs kyi bstan bcos bsgyur cing / lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po dbu'i mchod gnas su bkur/ lha lde'i sras 'od lde dang / pho brang zhi ba 'od/ btsun pa byang chub 'od gsum rim par 'khrungs shing / byang chub 'od kyiru/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi 'das kha'i zhal chems ltar nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba rgya gar du chos slob tu phebs pa slar rang yul du 'khor bar khyed kyis jo bo bod du spyan 'dren par 'gro dgos shing / khong spyan 'dren thub na nga dga' ba yin pas phyis/ khyed rang dga' ba los byed/ nged rgyal po'i bka' yang bcag tu mi btub ces gsungs pa khong gis dang du blangs nas bod rab byung dang po'i me glang spyi lo 1༷kā7lor 'khor lnga dang bcas phyag rten gser srang sum cu so gnyis dang / gser ling pa gcig bskur ba rnams lha50

bsnams te rgya gar du phebs pas bi ka ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khang du rgya brtson 'grus seng ge chos slob par bzhugs yod pa dang mjal te khong gnyis kyis jo bo rje bod du gdan 'dren pa'i skor la gros mokhasga byas te re zhig gsang rgya'i ched du nag tsho lo tsā ba slob gnyer du 'ongs pa'i khul byas nas der bzhugs/ de nas bi ka ma la shī la gnas brtan sa/zhan gyis ma tshor bar nag tsho lo tsā ba dang / rgya brtson 'grus seng ges jo bo rje'i sku mdun du bcar te gser gyi phyag rten rnams phul ba dang / bod du dar mas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnubs nas lo mang song rjes bla chen la sogs pa'i drin la brten nas bod du dge 'dun gyi sde mang du 'phel yang sde snod lag len du 'debs par dka' zhing / de dag gi tshul la blang dor gyi gnas ston par jo bo rje khyed lta bu las gzhan pa 'i paṇ+ḍi tas phan thogs par dka' tshul mig mchi mas brnangs bzhin du zhus par jo bo rje bod du phebs pa'i zhal bzhes thob cing / jo bo rjes 'on kyang bi ka la shī la'i gnas brtan ran+ta ār dbang che bas 'o skol bod du gtong dka' bas nag tsho lo tsā bar khyod rang kho bo spyan 'dren skad ma zer bar slob gnyer ba yin pa'i khul gyis/ de nas nga tshos thabs mkhas pa zhig bya dgos gsungs pa ltar re zhig nag tsho lo tsā bas slob gnyer ba'i tshul mdzad pa bcas mthar bi ka ma la shi la'i gnas brtan la nag tshos jo bo rje bod du lo gsum bzhugs nas rgya gar la phar gdan 'dren zhu rgyu'i mna' dam phul te rab byung dang po'i lcags 'brug spyi lo 10bheXlo rgya gar nas bod la phebs rdog thon te bal yul du lo gcig bzhugs/ de nas chu rta 251

spyi lo 1d+ngha43 lor mang 'a ris gu ger phebs/de skabs lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis rta dkar mi dkar sum brgya tham pas gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan la sogs pa'i mchod rdzaru/ thogs te phebs bsur bcar/ de bzhin glu gar dang / bkra shis pa 'i shis pa brjod pa bcas gzab cing rgyas pa'i phebs bsu zhus/ de'i skabs sngar med pa'i rag dung gsar du bzos te jo bo spyan 'dren pa'i phyir 'bud pa de nas bod du dung chen 'bud srol dar la dung chen de la lo paṇa spyan 'dren pa'i dung chen zhes grags/de skabs lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis jo bo rjer zhu rten du gse t+na mang po phul nas thog mar gnad don gsum bka' 'dri zhus pa ste (1) sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rin/ gyis 'jug pa lags sam/ cig car du 'jug pa lags/ —(2) phyi nang gi khyad par gang lags/ (3) dge slong gis rdo rje sngags kyi dngos dbang gong ma rnam gnyis blang du rung ngam mi rung zhes zhus pa'i lan/ (1) rim gyis yin gsungs nas lam sgron mdzad/(2) skyabs 'gro dang / lta ba bka' btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi yod med yin/ (3) gsang ba shes rab ye shes ni tshangs/ par spyod pas blang bar mi bya zhes gsungs so// lha bla ma byang chub 'od 'di'i ring la lo chen rin chen bzang pos dam pa'i chos mang po bsgyur pa dang / lha bla ma'i sku tshe smad rmeri pu rangs pa zhang chung btsun gsal shes rab la bka' bsgo sa nas/ yul dbus kyi paṇ+ḍi ta shrī badz+ra bo sgyi dang / lo tsā ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis dus 'khor 252ci

dang / ma rgyud 9risdu—/'a zhig kyang bsgyu ra yod do//'od ldes kha che snyo na shrī spyan drangs/ 'od lde'i sras rtse ldes paṇ+ḍi ta zhi ba bzang po dang / mkhas pa dzā na shrī/ 'chi ba med pa ra he ta/ pa rnyi ta ga ya dha ra/ btsun mo can/paṇ+ḍi ta pun+ya shrī su/r+ya si ti/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti ki rti/ paṇ+ḍi ta gzhon nu bum pa/ sa/ser gyi go cha/ bal po bha len+d+ra rnams gdan drangs shing rab byung dang po'i me 'brug spyi lo 1༷gyitsalor dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi sde snod 'dzin pa phal cher mnga' ris su 'dus te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bsnye na bkur dang bdag rkyen bla na med pa mdzad nga/ ma zad/ rgya gar nas byon pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta de rnams dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba rnams kyis mdo sngags kyi chos tshul mtha' yas pa bsgyur zhus kyis rgya cher spel/ dper na zangs mkhar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab kyis tshad ma rgyan yang dus der bsgyur pa dang / rwa lo rdo rje grags/ gnyan lo dar ma grags / khyung po chos brtson/ btsan kha bo che/ rngog blo ldan shes rab/ mar thung dad pa shes rab/ dwags po dbang rgyal rnams bsdebs nas chos 'khor la phebs/ de nas dus mi ring bar dge bshes brag dkar bas skyid shod nyang bran pha bong khar bkra shis chos gling btab ste dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/de dag dang dus myo tshungs su bka' gdams gzhung pa glang thang pa rdo rje seng ge/ man ngag pa ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags dang / bya yul ba gzhon nu k+ṣ-i+onod/ rgya ma ri na chen sgang pa rnams kyis bka' gdams lha/ chos 253

bdun ldan gyi brgyud pa'i bstan pa spol/gsang phur rngog lo yab sraṭasdo kyis rig lam nas drangs pa'i bshad nyan/ pa tshab lo tsā ba nyi ma grags kyis dbu ma'i gzhung / nyang stod rgya 'dul 'dzin pa dang / mtsho sna pa shes rab bzang po sogs kyis 'dul ba'i sde snod/ gnyal zhig 'jam dpal rdo rje yab sras kyis phar tshad/rngog a rgyu de was 'dul ba 'gos lugs/ bla ma rngog pa yab sras kyis mar lugs gur brtag sam gsum sogs mkhas grub lo paṇa mang pos mdo sngags gnyis ka'i rig lam rgya cher spel bas bod la sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi grub mtha' mi 'dra ba khag mang po thon pa'i 'go tshugs pa dang / rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab rgya gar du brdzangs pa'i bdag rkyen mdzad pa sogs bod kyi rig gnas ches cher 'phel ba'i bya bar mari 'a bdag 'di nyid kyis mdzad rjes chen po bzhag yod/(rgya bod yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed dang / dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i dgongs pa gzhi rtsa'i thog mthun par mnga' bdag rtse lde'i sku tshe'i smad la khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis rgya gar nas kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī spyan drangs te bod du 'phrin las rgya cher spel bar bzhed pa de ltar na mnga' bdag rtse lde 'di dgung lo ches ring po zhig 'tsho gzhes gnang bar mngon cing / kha che paṇa chen bod la phebs pa'i loni rab byung gsum pa'i shing byi spyi lo 130bhelor yin pa de ni jo bo rje bod du phebs pa'i lo nas lo brgya dang lnga bcu song zhing / rtse lde'i yab ni lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyi gcen po 'od lde yin pas yab sras mi thog gnyis kho nar lo ngo mang po de 254

'odra song bas /ba che paṇa chen bod la phebs pa'i dus ni mnga' bdag rtsi calde'i dus yin min la da dung dpyad dgos pa lta bur mthong lags/ )rtse lde'i sras 'bar lde/ bkra shis lde/ lha lde/ nā ga de wa rnams rim par 'khrungs pa'i rgyud pa las mnga' ris kyi phyogs su gyes nas mnga' ris btsan po phal che ba byung /nā ga de wa'i sras btsan phyug ldes ya rtsedza mnga' bdag mdzad de ya rtse'i rgyal rabs byung /de'i sras bkra shis lde/de'i sras grags btsan lde/de'i sras grags pa lde/ 'dis gse sdo bre bdun cu la 'jam dbyangs kyi sku dang / dngul bre stong phrag bcu gnyis kyis byams pa sogs gser dngul gar blugs dang / ljang pa rdungs kyis lha chen dang mchod rten du ma bzhengs/de'i sras a sog ldes rgya gar rdo rje gdan du chos rgyal mya ngan med cikyis phul ba'i grong bzhi bcu zhe gnyis bar skabs sog poṭashaṃ bzung ba rnams blus nas rdo rje gdan rang la phul zhing mchod pa'i rgyun btsugs/de'i sras 'dzi thar smal dang / a nam/ sma' gnyis yin/ 'ji thar smal gyis dngul gar blugs kyis dmyes rdor lha dgu bzhengs/ a nan smal gyis khya gar rdo rje gdan la nyams gso byas pa dang / gser chos bka' 'gyur bar ba'e/ngas/a nan smal gyi sras re'u smal byis rgya gar gyi rgyal kham sa mang po'i 255

bdag byas lugs bod kyi lo rgyus yig lam phal mo che'i nang bzhed pa gcig mthun du byung ba spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i 'go tsam la yin sid pa 'di ni yab phyis nan smal gyis sog po'i lag nas sngar rdo rje gdan gyi mchod rgyun du gtogs pa'i grong sde nyos te phul ba rnams mu mthud gzhan shor ma'i 'byung ba'i rjes gnon byed pa dang / de dag dang 'brel ba'i nye 'dabs kyi grong khyer 'ga' zhig la dbang sgyur byas par mngon/ de bzhin mnga' ris su dngul dkar zhe gcig las grub pa'i sman bla mched brgyad k+shi snang brnyan bzhengs pa dang / rab byung lnga pa'i lcags khyi spyi lo131d+ngha rī+o tshal pa khri dpon smon lam rdo rjes mngags bcol gyis mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi ston pa rin rdor dang / mjod pa a dzu la sogs pa ched mngags dbus su mngagaṭag te zangs khal bco brgyad la dos re byas pa'i zangs dos brgya dang bzhi dang / gser srang lnga brgya rnams las grub pa ra sa 'phrul snang thi/ jo bo shākya mu ne ri dbu thog tu yo/ser thog phub pa dang / bcu gcig zhal gyi dbu thog tu gser thog chung ngu zhig phub pa 'di ni lha sa ba/tsug lag khang 'dir gse ro zangs kyi rgya phibs nga skrun pa'i thog ma yin/re'u smal gyi sras sam gha smal dang / 'ji thar smal gyi sras a 'dzid smang/ yin/ a (radzid smal gyis gser bre bcu gcig la sgrol ma'i sku bzhengs pa dang / rgyal sa ma thob gong sa skyar lha btsun 'gang ba sto chori ska zhugs tha sdu/nang / phyis rgyal sa 'dzin pa dang khab bzhes/a 'dzid smal gyi sras ka lam/ smal/de'i sras bar btab smal/ 'di ma/sa a rtse rgyal po'i gdung rgyud chad 256

de pu rangs nas mnga' bdag bsod nams sde spyan drangs nas ya rtse'i srid bzung bas pun+ya smal du grags/ de'i sras/ pu ti smal dang / blon po dpal ldan grags pa gnyis kyis sa skya'i chos khri chen rma dang / lha sar bcu gcig zhal la gser thog phul zhes dang / deb ther la lar rgya skyed byas zhes 'khod pa ya rtse rgyal po a nan smal gyis jo bo'i gser thog gi lhag mar bcu gcig zhal gyi gser thog thog ma chung ngu zhig la sa med pa phyis rgya skyed byas par mngon pa bcas bkra shis mgon gyi gdung rgyud las byung ba ya rtse rgyal po'i gdung rabs 'di'i thad yab sras dar / sras bgres gzhon gyi go rim la la'i thad lo rgyus deb ther nang bzhed pa mi mabyun pa cung zad 'dug rung gtso bor bu ston chos 'byung dang / yar lungs jo bo'i bzhed par gzhir bzung / mkhas pa'i dga' ston dang / btsan po'i gdung rabs tshig nyung don gsal sogs nas dgos nges kha skong zhus pa lags so//gsum pa/ lde gtsug mgon gyi rgyud pa'i skor/lde gtsug mgon gyis zangs dkar sgo gsum bcas bzung zhes pa las gdung rgyud gyes rabs mkhas pa'i dga' ston nang lde gtsug mgon gyi sras srong nges dang 'khor re de las gyes pa ya rtse'i rgyal rabs su baned pa/ yig lam gzhan du gdung rgyud 'di dag bkra shis mgon las gyes par bzhed pa'i 'phrul gzhi'am mkhas pa'i dga' ston gyi bzhed pa dmigs bsal 'di las gzhan lo rgyus yig lam mang por lde gtsug mgon gyi gdung rgyud gyes rabs mi gsal ba bar skabs 'di'i skor gyi yig cha stongs pa'am yang na 257

gdung rgyud de'i nang nas mtshan snyan 'bar ba'i mi sna mngon gsal can cher ma byung 'dra bas gdung rabs kyi lo rgyus kyang bag la zha ba lta bu slad dpyad ga/zhi rnyed ris/sa byung na kha skong dgos gal snyam/rig pa ḍigon / (la dwags rgyal rabs)'gro mgon dang / chos mgon/bla chen grags pa ldo/bla chen byang chub sems dpa'/bla chen rgyal po/lha chen ut+pal/ lha chen nag lug /lha chen dge nye dang / dge 'bum/lha chen jo rdor/bkra shig mgon/lha rgyal/rdo dzelha chen jo dpal/lha chen dngos grub/ lha chen rgyal bu rin chen/258

lha chen sas rab/lha chen khri gtsug lde/ tshogrags swā 'bum sde/ grags pa 'bum/blo gros mchog ldan/ lha chen bha ra/ bha gan/lha chen lha dbang rnam rgyal/ bkra shis rnam rgyal/lha chen tshe dbang rnam rgyal/ rnam rgyal mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal/seng ge rnam rgyal/ nor bu rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal/bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal/bde ldan rnam rgyal/ in+d+ra bho ti/ bde mchog rnam rgyal bcas so/bkra shis mgon/srong nge dang / 'khor re/( spyi lo965da 1036yas mas)nā ga rā dza dang / rte wa rā dza/ lha lde//'od ༈/ pho brang zhi ba 'od/ btsun pa byang chub 'od/rtse lde/259

'bar sa/ bkra shis lde/ lha sde/ nā ga de wa/btsan phyug lde/bkra dis lde/grags btsan lde/grags pa lde/a sog lde/ r+sha'adzi dar smal/ a nan smal/a 'dzid smal/ re'u smal/snye /ka lan smal/ sa m+bha smal/bar btab smal/ 'di nas ya rtse rgyal po'i gdung rgyud rdzogs so//260

skabs brgyad pa/ mnga' bdag yum brtan dang de las gyes pa'i gdung rabs skor/dang po/ mang/'a bdag yum brtan gyi sko ra/khri dar ma 'u dum btsan gyi btsun mo chen ma sna snam bzas chu phag spyi lo843 lor lto bor byi/ khye'u se'u tsherga/ ge ba zhig nga la skyes zhes blon 7/ rnams la bstan pas skyes ma thag so yod pa the tshom gyi rgyu yi na med 'on kyang yumyo/ gyi bka' brtan du chug ces brjod pas mtshan yang yum brtan du thob/sa zhes grags/khong nar son pa na dbu ru bzung ba dang / de rjes dbu g.yor 'khrugs/ dkung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun pa sa glang spyi lo8phyordzo lor bod du kheng log byung /mnga' bdag 'dis spa tshab bza' bkra shis mtsho khab tu bzheṭa par sras /phri lde mgon sa//nyem/ 'khrungs pa bcas mthar dgung lo so drug pa sa khyi spyi lo8gyi8 lor sku gshegs/khri dar ma 'u dum btsan po pha spad gsum la bsod nams zad pa'i rgyal po zhes su grags pa'o//gnya ṭag pa/ mnga' bdag yum brtan las gyes pa'i gdung rabs skor/261

mnga' bdag yum brtan gyi sras khri lde mgon gnyen dang /de'i sras rig pa mgon dang / nyi 'od dpal mgon gnyis mchis pa las/1 gcen po rig pa mgon gyi gdung rabs ni/rig pa mgon gyi sras khri lde/de'i sras 'od po/de la sras gsum ste khri lde a tsa ra dang / khri lde lde mgon bcan/mgon brtse7/sa bcaru/ so// /khri lde mgon btsan 'di 'od srungs kyi sras dpal 'khor btsan sku gshegs rjes g.yo ru'i blon 'bangs tshos 'od srungs dang yum brtan gyi rgyud pa 'gal ba cher mi chags pa'i slad du g.yo ru'i srid skyong bar spyan drangs pa dang / khong gis g.yo rur mdzad rjes mi dman tsam ba'ag pa'i skor gong du zhus zin pas bskyar bzlos ma dgos so//gcen a tsar la spa tshab rum po rje la sogs pa sras lnga yod/spa tshab rum po rje'i sras klu lde dang / lha lde/ spa tshab tsha 'bum lde/mgon btsan/ mgo na nga/rtsegs so//klu lde'i sras 'od po dang / phod po/lha lde la drag pa la sogs pa sras gsum/'bum lde la sras nyi ma dang / zla ba/mgon btsan la sras lha chen dras/ pa/ dar chen drag bra'o tsha dang gsu rme/ mo//mgen brtsegs la'ang sras mang du byung bar gras/sa/262

'od po'i sras khri lde la yang sras gsum yod pa'i nang nas gcen gnyis chung ngu nas 'das shing / gcung lha lde btsan/ lha lde btsan la sras rgyal phu yon bdag dang / lha btsun ston pa/rgyal phu yon bdag la gcen dbang phyug khri la sogs pa sras lnga/dbang phyug khri'i sras thog po/de'o sras so na dza ro/de'i sras so na si bu bla ma mgon sogs sras po brgyad dang / sras mo brgyad/ ci —so na'i sras 'bum dar yin/ de'i bu rgyud yar stod kyi btsan po smon lam rgyud lha bug pa can pa/ thang la brag pa la thug cing / lha bug pa can 'di grwa pa mngon shes dang thog mnyam zhing khong la bu med nas grwa pa mngon shes la bde mchog gi dbang zhus pas lo dus su bu byung bas grwa pa mngon shes la bum pa'i mgul rgyan du g.yu chang bu can che chung dang / stod bdud 'dul dbang yon la sku li ma can/ gtang rag la gser khri phyi dar can/dngul skyog sha ba can/ ral gri phud kyu can/ khrab sdig pa can bcas phul bar grags/'od po'i sras gsum gyi tha chung mgon brtsegs la sras gnyis te ho re dang / khri dpal lo//ho re'i sras ne du khri gtsug /ne du khri gtsug la sras lnga yod pa bcas de rnams ni gcen rig pa mgon gyi rgyud yin no//2r+ṣa3

2 gcung po nyi 'od dpal mgon gyi gdung rabs ni /nyi 'od dpal mgon gyi sras mgon spyod/ tsāde'i sras tsha la na ye shes rgyal mtshan/de'i sras khri pa/ yab sras 'di gnyis kyis bsam yas gtsug lag ju khang gi zhabs tog mdzad pa dang / mkhas pa lde'u'i chos 'byung nang /de nas dam pa'i chos kyi me ro ni//khri chung khri lde tsha la gsum gyi ring //mtshan bzhi ldan pa'i dgongs pa gsal gyis bslangs/ / (lcags par ma shog grangs shā90 )zhes 'khod pa lta ra 'od srungs/ kyi sa/dung rgyud 'od lde nas gyes/ pa khri chung dang / yum brtan gyi gdung rgyud gcen rig pa mgon gyi sras khri lde/ tsha la na ye shes rgyal mtshan 'di gsum byon pa'i dus mtshungs pa de'i tshe bod dbus sa/tsa nga na bka' gdamyo/sa pa bya ba rtsa ba bzhi sna yul la yod pa bsrung ba dang / dgag dbye bya zer nas dbyar zla gsum gsum bsrungs la/ de min mi bsrungs ba gcig dang gnyis kyi rtags tsaji 'dzin pa las med pa la de'i dus su btsan po de nyid kyis dbus gtsang gi mi rnams la thar pa'i don 'byung bar bzhed pas/ sdo ma pa mtshan nyid pa blang sa ga na yod rtsad bcad pas/ dang po rje dar mas bstan pa bsnubs nas dmar gtsang g.yo gsum mar bros pa las mched pa mdo khams smad na 'dug ces gsan/ (chos 'byung me tog snying po lcags par ma shog grangs 4bhe3)pa ltar deb ther la lar khong yab sras gnyis dbus gtsang nazhe smi rmi bcu mdo khams su brdzangs nga 'i bdag rkyen mdzad par grags sogasku/ smad 264

'dul dar bar mdzad rjes rlabs po che bzhag yod/ bstan pa'i me ro smad nas ji ltar gso ba sogs bstan pa phyi dar gyi lo rgyus ched bkar gyi brjod par bya'o//pod kyi lo rgyus yig lam mang por 'khod par yum bstan rgyud kyi gdung rabs rim par byon pa'i nang nas bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bskyar du dar ba dang / gtsug lag khang la sri zhu sogs mnga' bdag 'di nyid kyis mdzad rjes gzengs su thon pa bzhag yod pa ma zad/ khong ni legs sbyar gyi skad la shin tu byang bas kha rag spyos kyi lo tsā ba yang khong gi slob ma yin/ jo bo rje ma phebs gong gi lo nyi shu'i skabs tsam la paṇ+ḍi ta pad+ma gsang ba bod la byon skabs zhabs lugs grol thig sogs bsgyur pa'i lo tsā yang mdzad ces btsan podza gdung rabs ro rgyus yig lam mang pos yum brtan gyi gdung rgyud rim par chig nyung don gsal nang gsungs 'dug (bris ma shog grangs 13 ba) gna' rabs byi/ bstan dgos pa yang btsan po 'de'i mdzod rjes mngon gsal du mtshon phyir yin cing / de min khri lde mgon btsan las gdung rgyud gzhan rnams kyi lnga phyi'i so/ rim bstan pa tsam las gzhan gsal kha ma mchis pa de ni gtso bor yum brtan gdung rgyud kyis chos phyos/sa su mdzad rjes chen po rang 'jog thub med pas yin snyam/ 'on kyang yum brtan gyi rgyud pas srid phyogs la do snang che ba byas pas dbus khul phal cher yum brtan rgyud kyis 'dzin thub pa byungarmo mod kyang / sngar lo rgyus smra ba rnams kyis chos phyogs kyi mdzad pa kho na gtsigs cher bzung bas yum brtan rgyud kyis srid bskyangs pa'i lo rgyus mang po bag la zha bar 265

mngon/ btsad po tsha la na ye shes rgyal mtshan 'das lo'i thad bstan rtsis kun btus nang me glang spyi lo977 lo'i snga phyi 'dir 'das par gsungs pa bstan rtsis nang 'di'i skabs lo rgan drug cu gcig gi phyi ba'i skyon yod pa bsal na spyi lo91gyi lo'i yas mas la gshegs par sems/khri pa'i sras a tsa ra/ dge slong / bla ma bo rnyi rā dza'o/a tsa ra'i sras mgon ne/de'i sras bkra shis/ lha btsun sngon mo/ dbang lde/ bka' gdams pa'o//bkra shis bsnyun gyis zin/ lha btsun sngon mo rab tu byung /dbang lde la sras gzugs rum pa/ 'od lde mgon/ dge po/ brtan pa/ seng ge dang lnga bcas byung /a tsa ra'i rgyud pa phreng po ba dang / lcang rgyab pa/ blag pa lam pa/grib pa/ snye thang pa/ lum pa btsad po bcas su grags/dge slong gi rgyud pa spel bzhi ba/ —bornyi rā dza'i rgyud pa 'on/ rdo/ chab thang / bsam yas btsad po sogs mang du 'phel ba bcas yum brtan gyi gdung rgyud gyes rabs cung zad zhib par 'khod pa mkhas pa sde'u'i chos 'byung gzhir bzung / nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyi chos 'byung dang / mkhas pa'i dga' ston/ btsan po'i gdung rabs tshig nyung don gsal bcas nas kha skong dgos rigs khol byung gis sgrig pa lags so//266 —

mnga' bdag yum brtan/khri sde mgo/na gnyen/ gcen rig pa mgon/ gcung nyi 'od dpal margon/ khri lde//'od po/khri lde a tsa ra/ khri lde mgon btsan/ mgon brtsegs/spa tshab rum pa rje sogs lnga/klu lde/ lha lde/ spa tshab tsha 'bum lde/'od po dang / phod po/gcung lha lde btsan sogs sras gsum/ rgyal phu yon bdag lha btsun ston pa/gcen dbang phyug khri sogs sras lnga/ thog po/ khri dar/ so na dza ro/so na de'i ༈ bla ma mgon sogs sras brgyad dang / sus mo brgyad/'bum dar bcas so d+kugong du gsal ba'i khri lde mgon btsan gyi sras/267

lha chen drag pa/ dar chen drag bra'o tsha bcas so//gong du gsal ba'i mgon brtsegs kyi sras/ho re dang / /khri dpal/ne du khri gtsug sras lnga yod pa bcas so//gong du gsal ba'i lha lde'i sras/drag sa la sogs pa sras gsum yod/gong du gsal ba'i spa tshab tsha 'bum lde'i sras/ nyi ma dang / zla ba gnyis so//gcung nyi 'od dpal mgon gyi gdung rabs/mgon spyod/ tsha la na ye shes rgyal mtshan/khri pa/a ca ra/ dge slong / bla ma bo ti rā dza/mgon ne/bkra shis/ lha btsun sngon mo/ dbang lde/ bka' gdam/sa pa/gzugs rum pa/ 'od lde mtho/na/ dge po/ brtan pa/ seng ge bcas so//268

skabs dgu pa/ bod du bstan pa phyi dar gyi lo rgyus skor/bstan pa phyi dar gyi lo rgyus 'chad tshul thad la'ang sngon byon mkhas pa'i bzhed pa gcig gyur med pa shin tu rnyog 'dzing can zhig yin stabs mkhas pa so sos rang rang gi lung dang rigs pa'i sgrub byed la brten nas lo rgyus yig larīri/ nang 'god gnang snu/dzad pa rnams la nges par do gal dgos pa los yin/ 'on kyang lo rgyus dkyus gcig tu sgrig skabag lo tshigs mthud thub pa bya rgyu rna gnad don gtso che shos kyi gras shig yin pas skabs 'dir kaḥthog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus mdzad pa〈〈bod rje btsan po'i gdung rabs tshig nyung don gsal〉〉dang / mang those klu sgrub rgya mtshos mdzad pa〈〈bstan rtsis gas la ba'i nyin byed 〉〉gnyis dpyad gzhi gtso bor bzung thog bu ston rngo+o ri / 'byung dang / deb sngon sogasdosmi/ la'ang zhib tu dpyad de brtsams par don tshan gsum yod/ dang po/ dar mas bstan pa bsnubs skabs dmar g.yo gtsang gsum mdo khamyo/sa su/ bros phebs pa'i skor dang bla chen po'i rnam thar mdor ngasdus skor/ gnyis pa/ bstan pa phyi dar las 'dul ba'i bstan pa smad nas/ dar tshul/ gsum pa/ 'dul bstan stod nas dar tshul lo//dang po/ dar mas bstan pa bsnubs skabs dmar g.yo gtsang kasum mdo khams su bros phebs pa'i sko ra dang / bla chen po'i rnams thar mdor 269

bsdus skor/ skabs 'dir dpyad pa'i lo tshigs ltar na dar ma 'u dum btsan pos chu phag spyi lo8bhe3 lor dbus gtsang yongs su bstan pa bsnubs pa'i dus skabs der g.yo ru gan pa byang thang gi dmar shākya mu ne dang / lho 'brog gi g.yo dge ba'i 'byung gnas/ 'jad 'khyel gyi gtsang rab gsal bcas dge slong gsum dpal chu bo ri la sgom pa'i dus/ ad dan cig pa dang / lha lung 'tshag po/ zha snga khyams po bya ba btsun pa gsum gyis khyi/ khrid nas rnga brdungs/ rol mo dkrol/ mgo la bya sgro btsugs/ sham thabs snga slog phyi slog byas nas ri dwags la mda' 'phen pa g.yo dge 'byung gis gzigs pas de la ma rangs nas ban rgan nga 'khrul ba'am btsun pa tshe snyo ba gang yin gsungs pas rngon pa de rnams kyis slob dpon 'khrul pa ma yin btsun pa dbang med du smyo ru bcug pa yin zhes rgyal pos bstan pa bsnubs pa'i lo rgyus zhib tu baya/da thog khyed rang la rgyal po'i bka' chad ma phog pa bsod nams che ste da khyod rang yang bros na legs pa'i gtam bshad pas dge slong gsum pos gos re bas dril nas sprang chas su zhugs/ dam chos 'dul ba dre'u'i khal gcig bkal nas rgyal khrims mi gcig pa'i sa char bstan pa dar bar bya dgongs nas nyin mo gab cing mtshan mo byon te mnga' ris su byon pa der ya/nga bstan pa spel ma thub par byang lam nas hor yul du bros phebs te hor gyi dge bsnyen shes rab go cha bya ba gcig yod pa de la ming shākya shes rab zhes bya bar btags pa phyag phyi ra khrid de mdo smad lho ngos be re'i sa cha de'u tshwa mtsho brgyud rma lung rdo rje'i brag dan tig shel rgyu lha70

yang dgon du byon/ sngar gyi btsun chas/ kho nar bzhugs pa yu si de'i mi rnamasashaṃ kyis mthong bas a pa la/ rgyal po sdig can gyi khrims kyis ma phog pa'i btsun pa'ang 'di na gda' zer ba thos nas skrag ste de'i nags khrod du bros phebs nas 'tsho ba med pa bsnyun te bzhugs pa la dge bsnyen ma gcig gis 'tsho pa bag re btegs/ de'i dus su khong gsum dang bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal mjal ste de la brten nas dbus gtsang du 'dul ba'i bstan pa mi nub pa'i sa bon de bskyed bsrings thub pa yin no//de yang bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal ni chu byi'i spyi lo833 lor tsongakha bde khams su 'khrungs/ khong gi mtshan gyi rnam grangs la skya bo'i skabs kyi mtshan ka ra 'phan/ bon bslabs pas bon gyi ming mu zu gas la 'bar/bstan pa'i smre ro bslangs pas bla chen/ rab byung skabs mkhan slob kyi mtshan las dras pas dge ba gsal dang bzhi 'o//khong dgung lo bcu gnyis chu phag spyi lo8shi3 lor dar mas bstan pa bsnubs/ sku nar son rjes zhing dbon dben par non 'jam dpal la bzlas lung zhus/ khang rin chen rdo rje zhes bya ba la byang chub mchog tu sems skyed/ skyi'i rgyal ba'i gtsug tor la dbu tshad kyi bstan bcos gsan/nam dga' ldan byang chub la yo sa/ gsan/de rjes dgung lo nga bzhi pa shing stag spyi lo89bhelor dan tig tu phebs nas mkhas pa mi gsum dang mjal te rab byung bsnyen rdzogs chig rdzogs gnang zhing / skabs de'i mkhan po su yin skor la bzhed pa mthun min dpyad dgos par snang yang re zhig mkhan slob kyi mtshan la sa dras pa'i 371

tshul la brtag ste nyang ral chos 'byung dang / mkhas pa lde'u'i chos 'byung ltar g.yo dge 'byung gis mkhan po dang / gtsang rab gsal gyis slob dpon/ dmar shākyas gsang ston gnang zhing / bsnyen rdzogs skabs yul dbus su dge slong bcu dang / mtha' 'khob tu dge slong lnga tshang dgos pa'i kha skong thad/ skabs der lha lung dpal rdor dar rtse mdo'i tshong 'dusasu bzhugs par las kyi kha skong gnang ba zhus pas ngas bstan pa'i don du rgyal po sdig cam/ bsad stabs sdom pa med pas las kyi kha skong mi rung mod/'on kyang ngas kha skong 'tsho'/ ba'i grogs bya'o gsungs nas rgya'i ha shang ke dbang dang / gyim phag ginyis khrid de dad pa'i dge 'dun gyi kha sko nga mdzad nas rab byung bsnyen rdzogs chig rdzogs gnang ste mtshan yang ma khan slob kyi mtshan las dras te dge ba gsal du btags shing / phyis ca/khyen rlabs che la bstan pa'i rtsa bar gyur pas mtshan bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal du grags/de nas byang phyogs su phebs nas cang in rtse mkhar mi nyag snya'i yul du byon te/ go rong seng ge grab/se/ nga / 'dul ba gsan pas 'dul ba lung sde bzhi bstan bcos dang bcas pa bla chen po la gnang nas/ bu /khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa tshul bzhin du gsal bar gyis shig kho bo ni rgas pas yun ring du mi 'tsho'o gsung skad/de nas dbus su zhang chen ngo dge ba bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar chos la/san par phebs bzhed nas mdo khams klong thang 'jig rten sgron du byon pa'i tshe/ mang ra g.yu mtsho zhes bya bar dbus nas rgyal pos pho nyar mngags 272

pa des dbus su mu ge chen po byung bas khyed kyis bshul yang mi bgrod pas ma phebs shig kwa 'od mchog grags pa lho baljo/ du chos mang po gsan nas khams su byon no zer ba gsan pas slar log ste/ shar dzāgs su lha rtse hig tig ces bya bar sngon gyi lha rten mang po bzhugs pa'i darnga / r+shadun gyi gnas shig tu kwa 'od mchog grags pa dang mjal nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'bum ṭika la sogs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa la sogs pa mngon pa'i theg pa chen po lo bcu gnyis kyi bar gsan/ de rjes mnal lam du re zhig gdul bya rgya cher yong mi thub pa'i mtshan ma dang / the'u rang spun dgus dan tig tu 'byon par gsol ba bzhin dan tig tu phebs nas skabs der cig car 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhes bya ba dase/ ba'i phyogs ci yang mi byed pa'i log rtog can mang du mchis pa'i lta ba sun 'byin pa'i lha khang dang mchod rten dpag tu med pa bzhengs te tshon dang bzo la sogs pa yang rang gis mdzad de 'dus byas kyi dge ba'i rtsa bar brtson par mdzad/bla chen po'i dam pa'i spyod pa de lta bus yid rab phro gas nas spa gor g.yung drung zhes bya ba de 'khor mang po dang bcas dan tig tu byon pa dang / bla chen pos dam pa'i chosku 'dul ba nas gsungs pa'i bslab pa'i gzhi rnams brjod pas sngar rang nyid kyi cig car 'jug pa'i spyod lam de lta bur gnong zhing 'gyod nas tshul bzhin du rab tu byung ba dang / de'i rjes su bar gnas grags pa zhes bya ba yang rab tu byung bas khong gnyis la spa bar gnyis su grags pa dang / de bzhin ja ba grags pa dang / btsun chen cog ro shes rab 'byung gnas gnyis la ja cog gnyis/ gzhad dpal 273

gyi rdo rje dang / srags rgya mtsho gnyis la gzhad srags gnyis/ 'al pa rdo rje dbang phyug dang / bsnubs lab shi dpal gyi dbang phyug gnyis la 'al bsnubs gnyis/ zong mchog chos skyong dang / 'tshur shes rab mchog la zong 'tshur gnyis zhes sogs slob ma snyan grags can mang po 'dus pa dang / khong gi mdzad pa 'dul ba'i bstan pa'i gsos su che ba byung zhing /bla chen po'i slob ma mchog drug ni spa bar gnyis dang / ja cog gnyis/'al bsnubs gnyis bcas la ngos 'dzin par snang / mang thos klu sgrub kyi bzhed pa ltar na bla chen po rab byung bsnyen rdzogs bzhes nas lo bco lnga song ba bla chen dgung lo nga bzhi pa shing stag spyi lo89bhelor dbus gtsang mi bcu'i rab byung bsnyen rjogs kyi mkhan po mdzad pa de nas dbus gtsang du 'dul ba'i bstan pa dar ba'i rtsa lag chen por gyur pa yin cing / de ltar bla chen pos dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa dgu lor dan tig tu byon pa nas lo sum cu so lnga dan tig tu bzhugs mthar dgung lo brgyad cu gya bzhi pa shing phag spyi lo915 lor sku gshegs pa lags so//de ltar dar mas bstan pa bsnubs rjes dbus gtsang na sdom pa dang bshad pa'i gdam ngag bka' chad nas med/ gtsug lag khang thams cad kyi lde mig btsun gzugs dbu gtsug phud can sham thabs gong ba can gyon pa 'ga' re yod pa'i ming la gnas brtan dgra bcom par btags pas 'dzin/ mchims smad na chen po rgyal ba dang zhang lcam 'bre chung ba gnyis kyis klog shes pas mi shi ba'i dge bar byis pa dang / bu chung shi ba la sum brgya pa dang / mi che ba shi ba la bde chen 'don/ mi de gnyis shin tu shes 274

rab che zer zhing / de min dbus gtsang na bka' gdams pa bya ba rtsa ba bzhi sna yul la yod pa srung ba dang / dab/ga dbye bya zer nas dbyar zla gsum gsum srung la/ de min mi srung ba gcig dang gnyis rtags tsam 'dzin pa las med/ dus der mdo smad na mkhan slob kyi bka' rgyud bar ma chad par yod pa'i gtam dbus gtsang du khyab pa yum brtan gyi gdung rgyud bsam yas btsad po tsha la na ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis dbus gtsang gi mi rnams la thar pa'i don 'byung bar bzhed de sdom pa mtshan nyid pa blangs gang na yod brtsad gcod gnang bas dang po rje dar mas bstan pa bsnubs skabs dmar g.yo gtsang gsum mdo khams su bros pa las mched pa'i sdom rgyun mdo smad yod pa'i gnas tshul de gsan rjes dbus gtsang nas dad pa can bskul te mdo smad du rdzong ba'i bdag rkyen gnang lugs dang / ‘‘bka' gdams kyi yig lam 'gar dbus gtsang mi bcu mdo khams la rnyed pa 'tshol du phyin pa 'dod pa bzhin ma 'grub pas yid phyung ste 'o cag zari zing gi ched du 'di ltar dka' ba spyod pa bas 'di phyi thams cad du bde ba'i chos bya'am zhes bgros nas rab tu byung bar kha 'chams/ 'on kyang rang cag la mukhan por 'bul rgyu'i phyag rten med ces glengs pas khong tsho'i nang nas chos rgyus che ba 'gas gros 'go bton te me tog mang du 'thus nas bla ma 'byon pa'iru mdun du me tog gtor/ phyag byas nga/sa khyed rnams gnas yin nam mi mthong rgya can 'ga' zhig 'dug gsungs nas mnyes bzhes snang / ’’(mkhas pa'i dga' ston lcags par ma shog grangs 473) 'khod nga/ gnad don 'di'i thad bzhed pa khag gnyis 'byung ba gang zhig 'thad ce na/27 5

bzhed pa phyi cha༈ skabs de'i lo rgyus dngos dang 'tshams pa yin/ rgyu mtshan ni btsad ngo tsha 'a na ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi dus ni dbus gtsang du kheng log byung ba'i dus mjug khong gi dbang bsgyur sa khul ni dbu ru'i sa cha cha shas tsam las dbus gtsang yongs la khyab mi thub pa dang / dbus gtsang mi bcu sdom pa blangs nas dbus su 'khor skabs rgyab brten bcol yul sa/nga zhig legs pa'i skor mol bgros kyis mthar bsam yas btsad por brten rgyu 'akab lugs nyang chos 'byung na gsal ba bcas kyis so/ /gang ltar skabs der dbus gtsang gi mi bcu ste/ dbus rtsa/ tshar byi klu mes/ shes rab tshul khrims/ sum pa ye shes blo gros/ 'bring ye shes yon tan/ ras/ shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ rba tshul khrims blo gros/ gtsang nas lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug tshong btsun shes rab seng ge/ mnga' ris pa 'o brgyad spun gnyis/ u pa ta ka ra dang bcu bcas lags so//gnyis pa/ 'dul ba'i bstan pa smad nas dar tshul skor/1 lo tshigs skor/ de yang / 〈〈bod rje btsan podza gdung rabs tshig nyung don gsal/ 〉〉 las/ bod 'dir bstan pa phyi dar du grags pa dge 'dun 'dul ba'i sde snod byung ba yang (1) grub thob o rgyan pas phag gru yi rgad po zhig gi ngag rgyun la brten nas bstan pa snga dar (lcags bya spyi lo8bhe1) nyams nas/ phyi dar bar lo nyer lnga'am sum cu (spyi lo8a+yo'ayang na870)tsam mdzad pa dang / rje gtsug lag phreng bas chu glang (spyi lo8rdzo3)lo la dbus gtsang gi mi bcu las klu mes tshul khrims shes rab/ mkhan bu gru mer dang bcas pa mon mkhar 'bras bur phebs pa 'di phyi dar gyi thog mar 276

klu mes rnams 'dod gsung zhing / mkhan chen dharma shrī yang nyin snang du phyi dar 'das lo 'di dang mthun par byas te lcags bya (spyi lo841) nas lo nga gnyis 'das pa'i chu glang (spyi lo893) yin no//(2) bu ston chen pos dbus kyi rgad mo zhig gi ngag rgyun la brten te lcags bya (spyi lo8bhe1) nas phyi dar gyi bar bdun cu'am don gsum (snga ma lcags rta spyi lo910 phyi ma chu bya913) dag tu bzhed pa/(3) 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis lcags bya(spyi lo841)nas bar stong bdun cu don bdun sa stag (spyo lordzo18)la bstan pa phyi dar gyi dbu yin par bzhed pa/ (4) sa skya'i bla ma dam pas ni/ rgyal po bka' chems las/dpal zhes bya ba'i dge slong gis/ /sdig can rgyal po sgrol bar 'gyur/ / de nas lo 'khor brgyad kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa med par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa la dgongs te lcags bya nas bar stong lo skor brgyad byung bas/ de la lo rgan gcig dang lo rkyang so brgyad ste khyon dgu bcu go brgyad yin la sa khyi(spyi lordzo38)la phyi dar byung bar bzhed/(5) nol pa paṇ+ḍi ta smon lam tshul khrims kyis lcags bya nas lo brgya dang brgyad kyi bar 'dul bstan ma byung bas phyi dar thog ma ru/ bya(spyi lordzo49) yin par bzhed do//de ltar 'dul bstan dge 'dun gyi sde phyi dar gyi lo grangs 'dod tshul 277

rim pa lnga las snga ma ni/ —grub thob o rgyan pa sa lug lor yar lungs su byon skabs ral pa tsan grongs nas de yi badra lo nyis brgya dang bcu bdun song bar dgongs pa'i lug lo 'di ni karma ṅgeshi gshegs pa'i chu lug (rab byung lnga pa'i chu lug spyi lo138kā) de yin par snang bal chu lug(spyi lo138kā) de nas yar la bgrangs bas rje spyan snga 'khrungs pa'i shing lug(spyi lo11gyi5) bar brgya dang dgu/ de nas yar phag gru 'khrungs pa'i lcags rta (spyi lo1110) bar re snga/ de nas jo bo rje bod du phebs pa'i chu rta (1༷bhe3) bar re brgyad/de rnams dril ba'i lo maru+on sum pas dpyad mi bzod kyang / 'on te lcags bya nas ster lnga 'am sum cu lhag tsam na phyi dar tshugs tshe shing bya'am chu 'brug lor zhes pa 'di ni kaḥthog tshe dbang nor bus yongs grags ltar bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal chu byi spyi lo833lor 'khrungs par bzhed pa yig nor gyis shing bya zhes byung ba yin/ gal srid bla chen 'khrungs lo shing bya spyi lo8a+yo5lor babs pa de nas lo brgyad song ba ste bla chen dgung lo brgyad pa chu 'brug spyi lo873lor babs pas de skabs rab tu byung bar bshad 'grig rung / mkhan bu skyong ba'i dus la mi slebs pas gsung rgyu dngos ni bla chen gyi 'khrungs lo yongs grags ltar chu byi spyi lo8kākra lor 'khrungs dgung lo bzhi bcu chu 'brug spyi lo8gyi3lo'i skabs la bzhed pa yin/ 'dod pas bla chen po rang nyid rab tu byung ba'am/ des mkhan bu skyong ba'i dus lta bur bzung na 'dul bstan dbu brnyes par song bas rung bar sems so 278

gnyis pa ni/ klu mes kyi dngos slob bam/ de nas yun rilnge ma song ba'i yi ger gsal na khungs che zhing / dbus gtsang gi mi lnga'am bcus bla chen po rang nyid la sdom pa blangs bar byas tshe dus snga phyi 'grig rung de lta min na 'dod pa gsum par dpyad bzhin no//gsum pa ni/ kha cig lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug dang / tshong btsun shes rab seng ges dge 'dun gyi sde gnas gzhi tshugs pa la dgongs skad kyang / klu mes kyis bla chen po'i slob ma mtshur shes rab mchog la sdom pa blangs bar klu mes kyi dngos slob ba shi gnas brtan gyis smras pa dang /gzhan yang klu mes dang sum pa ni dus mtshungs par ba shi gnas brtan gyis 'di skad du/ bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen klu mes shes rab tshul khrims dang / sum pa ye shes blo gros gnyis kyi dang po kho nar klung shod 'byim pa'i lung du gnas btsugs pas ma tshugs te/ de nas bya yi lo la mor snyel btsugs zhes bris yod par snang zhing / 'brom ston gyis dbus kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la jo bo bsu bar bskul ba'i yi ger/ dang po'i dge slong lugs 'byin dpon btsun chen ye shes blo gros dang / zhes gsungs pas snga dar chu glang spyi lo9lā3 lor byas tshe 'di skabs jo bo bod du chu rta (spyi lo1sgro43) lor phebs skabs lo dgu bcu lon cing de gong dge slong sgrub pa'i lo tshigs kyang lon dgos pa sbrags na brgya dang bcu lhag tu nges par 'gyur bas klu mes—kyang sku tshe yun ring bzhugs par grags pas sum pa yang de mthun sku tshe yun ring bzhugs na las 'grig dka' bar shes shing /gong gi mkhan rabs nyid dang / lo grangs spyir btang gi dpyad na phyi dar 279

dbu sa stag (spyi lordzo18)nyid du mi 'gal te/ de yang bla chen po'i dngos slob kyi mkhan bu kha shas gtsug lag khang brtsigs pa'i nus pa med kyang chu glang (spyi lo8rdzo3)lor phebs/ na nas lo nyer lnga lon pa'i sa stag (spyi lo918lor byang chub sems pa'i smon lam gyi mthu chen po mnga' ba klu mes dang sum pa sogs byon nas dge slong gi dge 'dun sde 'phel zhing gtsug lag khang rgya cher brtsigs par byas na 'thad par rig go/bzhi pa ni/ re zhig lha sar dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde ma tshugs pa la dgongs zer/lnga pa ni/ klu mes kyi bya(sa bya spyi lordzotrerdzo)lo la mor sgyel gyi gnas gzhi brtsigs pa la bstan pa phyi dar gyi lo mgor 'khrul ba yin zhes gsungs so//de ltar bstan pa phyi dar gyi dbu chu glang (spyi lo89tī)gi lo yin na lo chen rin bzang rab tu ma byung ba'i lo bcu bdun gyi gong dang / sa stag (spyi lo918) yin na rab tu byung nas lo brgyad 'das te lo chen gyi rnam thar khri thang dzñā nas bris par sa rta (spyi lo898)la 'khrungs nas bcu gsum lcags rta (spyi lo910)la rab tu byung bar bshad pas so// gang ltar 'brom gyis phyi dar du bzhed pa'i sa stag (spyi lo918) de nas lo drug cu rtsa bzhi 'das pa chu rta (spyi lo981lor babs pa'i lo 'di ni yongs grags ltar na jo bo rje sku bltams pa'i lo yin pa las mnga' ris su phebs pa'i chu rta de min pas skabs 'di'i lo tshigs la lo rgan drug cu gcig nyung ba'i skyon)la jo bo rje mnga' rir phebs// skar rtsis pa rnams 280

kyi rab byung dang po (spyi lo—101gyi)tshugs nas lo bco lnga song bar(spyi lo 1041lor babs pas rang bzhed lo tshigs dngos ni dar gyi stag nas lo drug cu rtsa bzhi min pa lo brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi song bar bzhed pa de mtshon)shes so/ /zhes 〈〈bod rje btsan po'i gdung rabs tshig nyung don gsal〉〉 (bris ma shog grangs1'an nas 17 na bar) nang du gsungs pa ni lo rgyus deb ther mang po'i bzhed par dpyad pa gting zab gnang ba'i sdom tshig ches legs po zhig yin pas skabs 'dir yig tshogs la ma 'dzem par cha tshang lo tshigs gsal po yong ched snga phyi'i 'gros dang bstun nas spyi lo gang la babs pa dang / gnad don cha shas la yang bskyar dpyad pa dgos rigs bcas mchan bu'i rnam pas gug rtags nang bcug yod/kaḥthog rig 'dzin chen pos dpyad bsdur mdzad pa'i snying po rang bzhed 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis bstan pa nub pa lcags bya spyi lo841 nas bstan pa med pa'i bar stong lo bdun cu don bdun pa sa stag (spyi lo918)lo 'di bstan pa phyi dar gyi dbu yin par bzhed pa de ni ches khungs dang ldan pa zhig yin pa ni lo rgyus dkyus gcig tu bsgrigs skabs lo tshigs mthud mi thub pa'i 'gal ba med la sa chen rgyal rabs sogs lo rgyus mang po dpyad gzhir mdzad de bkod pa mang thos klu sgrub kyi bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyin byed kyi lo tshigs sogs dang rtsa ba'i bzhed pa gcig gyur yin/de yang bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyin byed las/ ‘‘bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo bco lnga/ (deb sngon gyi bzhed pa ltar 281

na bla chen dgung lo zhe dgu pa lcags byi spyi lo88༷ lo dan tig tu phebs pa'i lo der rab byung bsnyen rdzogs chig rdzogs byas par rtsis na de nas lo bco lnga lon pa'i tshe shing stag (spyi lo894) lor babs pa bstan pa bsnubs pa'i lcags bya (spyi lo 8bhe1 lo nas lome3 song ba) lon pa'i tshe dbus nas klu mes tshul khrims shes rab/ 'bri rje yon tan rdzi dkar gnyis/ gtsang nas lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug dang / tshong ge shes rab seng ge gnyis te chos la 'jug pa'i sgo ltar na dbus gtsang mi bzhi'am/ bu ston ltar na dbus nas klu mes/ 'bring ye shes/ yon tan/ rag shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas/rba tshul khrims blo gros/ sum pa ye shes blo gros dang lnga/ gtsang nas mgur mo rab kha ba lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug shab sgo lnga ba tshong btsun shes rab seng ge/ mnga' ris pa 'o brgyad spun gnyis/ bo dong pa u pa de kar ba dang lnga ste bcu'am/ yang na dbus nas klu mes dang sum pa gnyis/ gtsang nas lo tshong gnyis/ mnga' res nas ba shi rdzi dkar ba gnyis te drug gis khams su byon te bla chen gyis mkhan po dang / gtsang dang g.yos las gsang gi slob dpon/ dmar dang ha shang si/sa dus dang kha skong sogs byas te tshigs gsum bar ma chad du chig rdzogs byanu/ nas sdom pa blangs/ slar dbus gtsang du byon te 'das lo sum stong dang gcig log pa bstan pa bsnubs pa'i lcags bya nas lo don bdun 'das pa'i don brgyad pa sa pho stag gi lo'am (spyi lo9bhe8) dpal 'khor btsan gyis rgyal srid bzung nas lo bcu bzhi lon pa'i sa pho stag gi tshe/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sogs las kyi cho ga dang / klog pa thos bsam gyi 'go tshugs pas phyi dar gyi dbu brnyes lha83

so zhis kho bo smra ste ’’ (bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyin byed lcags par ma shog grangs phyo')zhes dang / yang dpal 'khor btsan gyis rgyal srid bzung ba'i lo'i skor ‘‘bstan pa la rma phyung ba'i lcags bya naṭashaṃ drug cu rtsa lnga lon/de nas lo bcu bzhi pa sa pho stag la mi bcus dbus bsam yas su byon nas bstan pa'i 'go btsugs so/ /de tsam la dgongs nas 'brom ston pas kyang phyi dar gyi mgo sa pho stag nas bzung ba yin no/ /zhes shes par bya'o//(de'i tshe mi bcus gnas gzhi gsar du ma tshus/sa kyang rab byung bsnyen rdzoṭa kyi 'go tsam tshug/sa pas phyi dar gyi dbu brnyes zhes bya‘ོro)de'i tshe rgyal po yum brtan gyi rgyud pa mnga' bdag ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis bstan pari bdag rkyen cher mdzad pas/ bstan pa'i me ro smad nas bslangs pa la khri ye shes rgyal mtshan bka' drin che bar grags so// mi (bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyin byed lcags par ma shog grangasal+ya7)zhes gsungs pa ltar phyi dar dbu brnyes pa'i lo tshigs ni sa pho stag spyi lordzo18lor dbus gtsang mi bcus bla chen nas rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa zhus te bas ma yas su byon pa dang de nas rim bzhin rab byung bsnyen rdzo gas kyi sdo/d+dha pa rgya cher spel ba dang / de rjes dge 'dun gyi sde'am gnas gzhi spel ba'i 'go tshugs pa yin/1 dbus gtsang mi bcu'i sdom pa bzhes yul gyi mkhan po su yin skor/de yang bstan rtsis gsalka ba'i nyin byed las/ ‘‘mi bcus sdom pa blangs pa'i yul bla ma chen po nyid la thus/ pa dang / grum ye shes rgyal mtshan 283

las blangs zer ba dang / mtshur shes rab mchog las blangs zer ba'i lugs gsum byung ba las/dang po ni/ ma ltar bu ston lugs te/ mi bcus bla chen la mkhan po zhus pas/ kho bo bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo lnga las ma lon pas mi rung gsung ba la/ gtsang na re dmigs bsal la btub lugs las/ bla chen gyis mkhan po mdzad gsungs te/ de lta bu'i dmigs bsal gyi khungs gsal po btsal dgos so/ /(sde yang mdo rtsa las/ bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo lnga lon zhing / lhan cig sbyar ba tha ma dang ldan na gnas ma bcas pa yang ljongs/ rgyur rung ngo zhes pa 'dis thon par kho bo sems so )lugs gnyis pa la grum gyi mkham/ po su yin snya/ma na/ bla chen/ spang gong ye shes g.yung drung / grum ye shes rgyal mtshan/ de nas klu mes sogs yin zer/ 'ga' zhig zhi 'tsho/ ba/ rasto/ g.yo dge 'byung / bla chen/ sgro mañdza shrī/ grum ye shes rgyal mtshan/ klu mes zhes zer ro/ /rgyal po rabs 'phreng las/ bla chen gyis khams kyi sog po mi drug la ldom pa phogade'i nang tshan btsun che na sher 'byung gis grum la/ des klu mes la phog zer/ sog po mi drug ni/ spang gong ye shes g.yung drung / gsar gnas bstan grags gnyis te spang gsar gnyis/ 'al pa rdo rje dbang phyugabasnubs dpal gyi dbang phyug gnyis te 'al bsnubs gnyis/ ja pa grags pa dang /btsun chen shes rab 'byung gnas gnyis te ja btsun gnyis so//lugs gsum pa/ deb sngon las/ bla chen shing pho byi lo bltams/g.yo dmar gtsang gsum las bsnyen par rdzogs/ go ring seng ge grags la 284

'dus ba gsan/ skyi rgya la gtsunyaka dzal la dbu tshad gsan/ nam dga' ldan byang chub la mo ga gsan/ kwa 'od mchog grags pa la 'bum ṭika dang mngon pa sogs gsan/ lo zhe dgu pa la dan tig tu byon so lnga bzhugs te brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa shing mo phag smu dga' ldan du gshegs so/ /shing phag de bstan pa bsnubs pa'i lcags bya nas don lnga pa yin/ de'i mkhan bu sngar gyi sog po mi drug dang / gzhan yang / gzhad dpal gyi rdo rje dang / srags rgya mtsho ste gzhad srags gnyis dang / zong mchog chos/ skyong dang / mtshur shes rab ma chog gnyis te zong mtshur gnyis dang bcu byung / mtshur la mi bcus sdom pa blang zhes bshad do/ /de rnams dpon b.ri yig cha ltar bris zhes zer ro/ / (bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyin byed lcags par ma shog grangs smogyi)zhes 'khod pa ltar dbus gtsang mi bcu'i sdom pa bzhes yul bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal nyid dam/ yang na de'i slob ma grum ye r+shas rgyal mtshan nam/ mtshur shes rab mchog su yin gyi bzhed pa gsum byung ba las/ bzhed pa dang po dbus gtsang mi bcus bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal nyid las sdom pa bzhes pa de 'thad par mthong /de yang gong du 'phros pa ltar bla chen pos dan tig tu mkhas pa mi gsum dang mjal ba'i lo de gar rab byung bsnyen rdzogs gnang bar cha bzhag pa'i lo bco lnga pa shing stag(spyi lo8rdzo4)lor dbus gtsang mi bzhi'am/ mi bcur sdom pa gnang bar bzhid pa dang / phyogs mthun pa kaḥthog rig 'jin chen pos kyang / ‘‘de yang phyi dar la 'dul ba'i sdom rgyun gsum byung ba sde pa gzhi yod smra ba 'ba' zhig pa snang zhing / de las 285

stod 'dul ni ha cang 'phel ba ma byung bar mngon la smad 'dul du grags pa'i mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho nas brgyud pa 'a di nyid gong du bshad pa'i chu glang (spyi lo8rdzo3)lo la dbu brnyes sa stag (spyi lo918) nas dar bar gyur te rab byung gsum pa'i shing byi (spyi lo13d+nghabhelor babs pa ste kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī bod du phebs pa'i lo de yin) bar gyi lo nyis brgya dang don gnyis ring dge bsnyen dang rab byung dge tshul dge slong rnams sdom rgyun 'di kho nar brten pa shas che zhing / bka' gdams kyi dge bsnyen 'brom dang / dge slong khu rngog gnyis/ sku mched tra/sum/ bang ri thang pa/ sha ra ba/ snar thang pa sogs mtha'—yas pa dang / bka' brgyud kyi 'byung khungs chen po dwags po lha rje dang / khams pa mi gsum 'bri stag 'brug pa sogs kyis mtshon bgrangs bar dka' ba dang / snying ma yi zur chen/ 'dzam 'gro ba'i mgon po/ kaḥdam pa bde gshegs sogs 'byams klas pa dang / gzhan du mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor yang rdo rje gdan pas lung bstan pa la brten glang ri thang pa la bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad pa dang / bka' gdams gsar mar grags pa gangs ri'i khrod 'dir 'dul 'dzin rnams kyi gtsug nor mkhan chen zhi ba 'a tsho yi gdung 'tsho ba shar tsong kha pa chen po yang smad 'dul gyi sdom rgyun 'dzin par grags pas mtshon no//’mi (btsan po'i gdung rabs tshig nyung don gsal bris ma shog grangs17 na)zhes gsal ba'i dum bu 'dir lo tshigs kyi gnad tsam ma zad/ stod 'dul smad 'dul dar che chung / 'dul ba'i sdom rgyun gang zhig dar khyab byung ba'i skor dpyad gzhi ha cang gal che bas 286

chacang drangs shing / skabs don lo tshigs thad bla chen po dan tig tu phebs pa'i lo nas lo bco lnga song ba'i lo shing stag spyi lo894lor babs pa dang / skabs 'dir smad 'dul chu glang spyi lo8rdzo3lor dbu brnyes par gsungs pa gnyis dbar lo khyad gcig las med pa de bla chen po dan tig tu phebs te mkhas pa mi gsum mjal ba de nas snod du rung min lo gcig brtags nas de'i phyi lo rab byung bsnyen rdzogs chig rdzogs gnang bar cha bzhag na lo tshigs yongs su gcig gyur 'byung ba 'dis smad 'dul dbu brnyes pa'i lo tshigs de nyid khungs ldan yin par mtshom rnga/ ma zad/dbus gtsang mi bcu'i sdom pa bzhes yul yang bla chen nyid la thug pa gsal por mtshon cing / de yang bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyiṭa/ mkhan po dang / grum ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis slob dpon/ sgro mañdzu shrīs gsang ston mdzad pa lags/ gal srid dbus gtsang mi bcu'i sdom pa bzhes yul bla chen gyi slob ma su zhig 'a/ dzas 'dzin byas tshe dogs pa chags pa'i gnad don 'di 'dra zhig yong srid pa ste/ dbus gtsang mi bcu bod nas mdo khams su sdom pa bzheṭaṭa par byon skabs bla chen dgung lo drug cu re bzhi las son med pa dang / de nas da dung dgung lo nyi shu 'tsho gzhes gnang bas skabs der bla chen 'tsho zhing gzhes pa dang / mkhan bu skyong thub pa'i gnas tshul cha tshang 'dzoms bzhi zha du bla chen nas sdom pa mi zhu ba bla chen gyi slob ma nas sdom pa zhu dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhan med/ mkhas pa lde'u dang / nyang nyi ma 'od zer/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba/ stag tshang rdzong pa dpal 'apyor rgya mtsho sogs kyis ma dzad pa'i chos 'byung dang /287

yig tshang du yang dbus gtsang mi bcus bla chen dngos las sdom pa bzhes pa'i bzhed pa gcig gyur lags so//kā bstan pa phyi dar gyi srol btod pa sde dbus gtsang mi bcu slob rgyud dang bcas pa'i gyes rabs skor/dbus gtsang mi bcus bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal las tshig sa gsum rim nod du sgrub pa chig rdzogs su bsnyen par rdzogs nas klu mes kyis grum ye shes rgyal mtshan la 'dul ba gsan par lo gcig bzhugs pa las de byings rnams dbus gtsang du yar phebs pa'i grabs mdzad/skabs der mkhan pos slob ma rnams la phyis kyi phrin las skyo nga stangs skor zhal bskos gnang bar/ klu mes mkhas shing btsun pas mkhan po gyis/ 'bring skyong mkhas pas gnas brtan gyis/ lo ston mthu che bas bstan pa srungs/ tshong btsun blo rno bas ston pa gyis la chos shod/ sum par sgrub pa gyis gsungs kyang phyis de ltar ma byung bar grags/de'i tshe rag shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas kyi gcung dang / rba tshul khrims blo gros kyi sa/cung po phu bo gnyis bsur 'ongs pa khams klong thang du mjal bas gcung gnyis dad de lo ston gyis mkhan po byas/ phu bo gnyis kyis slob dpon byas te rab tu byung bas de phyin rba rag gnyis gcig tu sdeb pa'o//de nas lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gis khyed rnams re zhig 'dan ma'i yul 'dir bzhugs/ ngas tshong pa dang 'akrogs te dbus gcang du phyin la bsta na pa dar bar nus na bsdad kyi khyed rnams kyang yar phebs/ mi nus 288

na log 'ong gsungs nas 'dan ma'i tshong pa dang 'grogs te byon pas tshong pa sum 'phrang nas ldog rtsis byed par lo ston gyis 'di nas ma ldog par gtsang du song 'i/ga tshong 'khos legs po 'ong / gtsang gi ma gur mo rab kha na nga'i pha li na nga gtsug na bya ba yod pas khong la khyod kyi bu rab tu byung nas dbus su 'byor yod lugs shod ces mngags nas btang bas khong tshor tshong legs po byung ba de nas mgur mo rab khar tshong 'dus chags pa de'i ming phyis tshong 'dus mgur mo (da lta gzhis rtse grong khyer khongs rgya mtsho chus ) grags pa'i sa gnas de yin/de'i phyi lo klu mes kyis mkhan po la kho bo dbus gtsang du phyir log pa lags pas mchod gnas shig zhu byas pas bon po'i zhwa 'obs zhu phog nas sa ser btab pa bzhes 'phro zhig gnang nas zhwa mo 'di gyon la nga rtag tu dran par gyis zhes gsungs te gnang ba de klu mes kyis dbus su tshad pa tsha bas rgyab bltab ste gsol bas zhwa sna ring du grags pa de byung ba phyis/ dbus gtsang mi bcu las mched pa phal che bas zhwa de gsol ba yin pa dang / de rjes bka' gdams gzhung pa ba dang / man ngag pa gnyis la'ang zhwa mo de las gyes pa'i dbyibs cung zad mi 'dra ba te yod cing / dwags po sgom tshul gyis de'i rgyab bltab ste gsol bas slob dpon sgom tshul gyi zhwa mo'am sgom zhwar grags pa'o//de nas khong rnams dbus su phebs skabs thog ma gang du phebs te su zhig la brten sa legs skor gros bsdur gnang ba'i snying por/ lha sa ni sngon mkhas btsun gyi gdan sa yin yang glang dar gyis chad pa ga/cod sa yin 289

pas 'gro ga la phod/ de bas chos 'khor bsam yas yin pas de drag de na tsha la na zhes bya ba'i btsan po zhig bzhugs pa de la rgyab brten bcol na legs par gros 'chams nas thog mar dbus gtsang mi bcu bsam yas su phebs te tsha la na ye shes rgyal mtshan dang mjal 'phrad zhus par khong gis sne len gzab pa dang bcas khyed tsho'i nang gi 'go byed mkhan su zhig lags zhus par klu mes yin byas pas bsam yas dbu rtse'i lde mig chag pa gang phyag tu phul/ de nas 'khor sa'i sgo phye bas nang 'dre tsher dang skya 'gal gyis gang / de'i yal ga'i chus skya ris thams cad byil/ rnga khang na dbus mtha'i ka ba ling bcu gnyis yod pa'i bzhi phring thag chad/ gzhan kun ser gas gang / 'khor sa bar pa na wa tshang bcas shing / de'i nang dkor nor gyis gang 'dug pa gzigs/ dbu ce 'i lder bzo'i phyag dang dbu rgyan thams cad la bya tshang bcas/ dbu rgyakhyo/ rnams kyang bya lud kyis rul/ klu mes kyis dkor mdzod gzigs rje sa sgo thams cad sbrul mdud la sogs pa'i 'phrul thag byas rgya btab/ phyir rdzab zhal byas nas sde mig thams cad btsan po la phyir phul nas nga mkhan por bskos pas dkor la 'bag dogs pas nga 'di mi 'dzin gsungs/ khams sa/sum zangs khang gling phul bas kyang ma bzhes so/ /bu tshal gser khang gling lo tshodā gnyis la phul yang ma bzhes par so sor gdul bya re yod gsungs lo tshong gnyis gtsang la yar bzhud/ rag shi la dge rgyas phul ba dang / de rjes bu tshal yang phul/ de rjes klu mes la ka chu phul bas dbu ru g.yon ru'i lam ste gas bya gsungs nas bzhes te klu mes kyis dbu rtse gso ba'i chas rkyen rta khal mang po 290

bsnams nas dbu rtse nyams pa rnams gsos te dbu rtse'i lde mig rnams rba rag gnyis la gtad/ rag shis bu tshal bzung / rbas dge rgyas bzung /'bring gis khams gsum bzung zhes lo rgyus yig lam nang gsal por 'khod pa 'di'i thog nas bsam yas gtsug lag khang skor la bstan pa bsnubs pa nas bar skabs sri zhu med par nyams chag ci che byung ba dbus gtsang mi bcu bsam yas su byon pa'i rjes nas bzung gzhi nas nyams gso dang sri zhu rim bzhin byung ba de yang mtshon/de nas dbus gtsang mi bcu'i nang gi dbus pa lngas gnas gzhi rim bzhin brtsigs pa yin te/ de yang klu mes kyis dbu rur la mo chag de'u btab/ mi chos kyi sa khul du ba lam gnas brtsigs/ sa bya(spyi lo949lor)la mor 'gyel brtsigs/ de'i phyi lo(lcags khyi spyi lordzo'0)glan ye shes 'bar dang / rngog byang chub 'byung gnas rab tu byung / de'i phyi lo (lcags phag spyi lo9me1)yer pa ba rang btab/ gru mer tshul khrims 'byung gnas sogs bco brgyad rab tu byung / tshong 'dus gnas bzhengs shing / phyis tshe spong gis se ra phug par bzhukas nas thang du byon pa'i lam grongs te klu mes dang gru mer gnyis ka'i gdung mchod rten 'od 'bar na ma nyams par bzhugs/ klu mes kyi mkhan bu zhang / rngog glan/ gru mer bzhi la ka ba bzhi zer ba dang gzhan yam shud sogs mang du byon/klu mes kyi slob ma ka ba bzhi'i ya gyal zhang sna snam rdo rje dbang phyug ni/sna snam jo sras dang / zhang lcad+dha/ sgro la ma'i sras su shing phag spyi lordzo15lor nyams dga' mor 'khrungs/291

dgung lo bco brgyad pa chu sbrul spyi lordzo33lor ra ba blum por klu mes las rab tu byung ste de rjes ra chag btab/dgung lo so bdun pa chu byi spyi lordzome3lor rgyal lug lhas kyi lha khang ('phan por lngod ) bzhengs/de rjes rgya gar du 'dul ba'i bshad pa 'tshol du byon pas rdo rje gdan pa dang mjal nas 'dul ba gsan cing rgya gar du yang 'dul ba gsungs/dgung lo gya lnga pa lcags byi spyi lo1༷00 lor sku gshegs/rgyal lug lhas btab pa nas lo drug pa me sbrul spyi lordzo5gyi lor gru mer gyis klu mes la zhus nas sol nag thang po che btab/rgyal lug lhas kyi gdan rabs ni/ klu mes sku gshegase pa'i rjes kyi gdan sa dang po ni glan tshul khrims byang chub yin/ khong shing 'brug spyi lo 944lor 'khrungs/dgung lo lnga bcu nga bdun pa lcags byi spyi lo100༷ lor rgyal gyi gdan sa mdzad nas lo bzhi bcu zhe gnyis bzhugs/ dgung lo dgu bcu go dgu pa rab byung dang po'i chu rta spyi lo1༷43lor sku gshegs shing / glan tshul byang 'di ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen pu to ba'i mkhan po yang yin/ de rjes kyi 'bring ston ni me khyi spyi lo98a+yolor 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga bdun pa rab byung dang po'i chu rta spyi lo1041lor gdan sar phebs nas gdan sa lo bcu bdun bskyangs te dgung lo don bzhi pa rab byung dang po'i sa phag spyi lo1d+ngha྾9lor sku gshegs/de rjes kyi rma bya rna ra ba lcags byi spyi lo1000 lor 'khrungs/ dgung 292

lo drug cu re gci nga/ / ṇa/ rab byung dang po'i lcags byi spyi lo 10snyo0 lor gdan sar phebs nas lo bcu gdan sa bskyangs te dgung lo bdun cu pa rab byung dang po'i sa bya spyi lo 1059lor sku gshegs/de rjes kyi rgyal tsha byang chub ye shes me lug spyi lo100gyi lor 'khrungs/dgung lo drug cu re bzhi pa rab byung dang po'i lcags khyi spyi lo1070lo nas gdan sa lo bcu bskyangs te dgung lo bdun cu don gsum pa rab byung dang po'i sa lug spyi lo10gyi9 lor sku gshegs/de rjes 'brom ston sa rta spyi lo1018 lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug cu re gsurma pa rab byung dang po'i lcags sprel spyi lo1d+ngha80 lo nas gdan tre sa lo bzhi bskyangs te dgung lo drug cu re bdun pa rab byung dang pori chu phag spyi lo1083 lor sgu gshegs/de rjes rab byung dang po'i shing byi spyi lo108bhelo nas rab byung gnyis pa'i chu sprel spyi lo1093 bar lar gyis gdan sar dbyar thog gcig ring bzhugs pa ma gtogs lo dgu gdan sa stongs/de rjes dge bshes tshul khrims 'phags pa ngan lam pa rab byung dang po'i lcags rta spyi lo1030 lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug cu re bzhi pa rab byung gnyis pa'i chu mo bya spyi lo10rdzo3 lo nas gdan sa lo bdun bskyangs te dgung lo bdun cu pa rab byung gnyis pa'i sa yos spyi lo1d+ngha9rdzolor sku gshegs/de rjes lcags 'brug spyi lo1100 nas chu lug spyi lo110shā bar lo 293

bzhi gdan sa stongs/ de rjes rgyal ba khyung tshang thod dmar ba rab byung dang po'i chu lug spyi lo10bhe3 tsha ra 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug cu re gnyis pa rab byung gnyis pa'i shing spre'/ spyi lo110bhelo nas gdan sa lo bcu gnyis bskyangs te dgung lo bdun cu don gsum pa rab byung gnyis pa'i shing lug spyi lo 111me'o ra sku gshegs/de rjes me sprel spyi lo111smo nas sa khyi spyi lo1118 bar lo gsum gdan sa stongs/de rjes rgyal ba ye grags sa dmar ba rab byung dang po'i me sprel spyi lo 10྾smolor 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug cu re bzhi rab byung gnyis si 'i sa phag spyi lo1119lo nas gdan sa lo dgu bskyangs te dgung lo bdun cu don gnyis pa rab byung gnyis pa'i me lug spyi lo113a+yolor sku gshegs/ri bar 'dir sa sprel spyi lo1138 lo 'di gdan sa stongs/ de rjes dge bshes gla na rab byung dang po'i sa sprel spyi lo10phyo8 lor 'khrungs/dgung lo drug cu re gnyis pa rab byung gnyis pa'i sa bya spyi lo1139 nas gdan sa lo gsum bskyangs te dgung lo drug cu re bzhi pa rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags phag spyi lo11kā1lor sku gshegs/de rjes dge bshes ri 'dul gyis chu byi spyi lo1133lo gcig gdan sa mdzad/de rjes skam skam pa dge bshes skyon rab byung dang po'i sa bya spyi lo 1༷tsa9lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug cu re lnga pa chu glang spyi lo11྅3lo lha94

nes gdan sa lo brgyad bskyangs te dgung lo bdun cu pa rab byung gnyis rwapa'i lcags sprel spyi lo1140lor sku gshegs/de rjes dge bshes lcang ri ba rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags 'brug spyi lo 1100lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo zhe gnyis pa rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags bya spyi lo11byu1lo nas sa stag spyi lo11'a8 bar gdan sa lo bco brgyad bskyardzas/de rjes glang ston sher seng gis rab byung gsum pa'i sa yos spyi lo 1159nas shing sprel spyi lo 11smobhebar gdan sa lo drug bskyangs/de rjes zhang ston 'tshem pas rab byung gsum pa'i shing bya spyi lo11a+yomenas me bya spyi lo1177 bar gdan sa lo bcu gsum bskya ngas/de rjes rab byung gsum pa'i sa khyi1178 nas chu byi spyi lo1191bar lo bco lnga'i ring gdan sa stongs shing / sa khyi de nas lo gsum pa rab byung gsum pa lcags byi spyi lo1180lor hor dmag bod du lhags nas rgyal lha khang me bsregs btang ba'i skor/ lo rgyus deb ther khag nang bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba mang po zhig mchis pa dper na/ deb ther sngon por/ ‘‘sa khyi nas lo gsum pa lcags pho byi ba la hor dkye /ga bod du lhags/ lha khang mes bsregs/ btsun pa so ston gyiṭa/ thog drangs ser skya lnga brgya tsam bsad/hor dor tog 'gyod nas gser bre dngu74 bre mang po byin nas lha khang gso ba'i bkod pa byas/ lha khang bar pa zhang lhas gsos/ dar gyi lha khang gso ma thub/ bya graganu/ ‘haṃ/ khang gsos pa'i rten gyi gtso bo thub pa bzhings/rab gnas legs/ (deb sngon lcags par ma shog grangs 13༷)zhes 295

gsal ba dang / mkhas pa'i dga' ston nang / ‘‘zhang nas mkhan rabs bcu drug la lo nyis brgya nyer brgyad 'das pa na(spyi lo118༷)hor dmag gi thog ma dor tog gi dmag byung bas rgyal lha khang bsregs/ btsun pa so ston sogs lnga brgya tsam baprongs/ slar dor tog gis gser bre dngul bre mang po rgyur sbyar te gsos/ ’’zhes (mkhas pa'i dga' ston lcags par ma shog grangs 474) dang / paṇa chen bsod grags kyis mdzad pa'i rgyal rabs 'phrul gyi lde mig las// ‘‘hor jing gir rgyal pos rgyal sar byon nas lo nyi shu lon pa lcags pho byi ‘ba/ lo la dmag dpon la khyi dang / dor rta gnyis kyis mtho/sa byas hor dmag khrag khrig mang po bod du btang ste grong khyer phal cher bcom/ 'bri gung sgom pa shag rin hor dmag gis bzung ba'ang 'di res yin/ ra sgreng dang rgyal lha khang du dge 'dun mang po bkrongs pa yin zhes deb sngon las 'byung yang ra sgreng las khungs gzhan gsal ba ma mthong bas brtag go lcags byi 'di chos rje sa skya pa'i nga dgu pa (sa paṇa ni rab byung gsum pa'i chu stag spyi lo118kralor 'khrungs pas dgung lo nga dgu pa rab byung bakhye/ pa'i lca sa/sa byi spyi lo134༷ lor babs) yin (rgyal rabs 'phrul sde lcags par ma shog grangs 'a3)zhes dang / lnga pa chen pos dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs nang paṇa chen ba so da grags kyi bzhed pa 'di 'thad ldan min pa'i sgrub byed du/ ‘‘rwa sgreng dang rgyal lha khang du hor dmag gi/sa dge 'dun du ma bkrongs pa'i gling log de ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen po to ba dang dus mtshungs pas dus tshod 'di dag las snga bar mngon no//’’ (dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs lcags par ma shog grangs 90)296

zhes gsungs pas gnad don 'di'i lo tshigs thad bzhid pa mi 'dra ba byungh+ru ba'i skor dpyad na/ deb ther sngon po dang mkhas pa'i dga' sto na nang 'khod pa'i lo khams spyi lor phab skabs lo rgan drug cu gcig gi snga phyi'i khyad par la brten nas paṇa chen bsod grags kyi dgongs pa 'di dang mthun che snyam yang / zhib par brtag na rtsa ba nas mthun thabs med/de'i rgyu mtshan yang rgyal lug lhas kyi gdan sa gnyis pa klu mes kyi gdan tshab glan tshul khrims byang chub ni pu to ba'i mkhan po yang tran zhes deb sngon dang / mkhas pa'i dga' ston gnyis kar gsal po 'khod pa des na glan tshul khrims byang chub ni shing 'brug spyi lordzobhebhelor 'khrungs/ chu rta spyi lo10bhe3lor gshegs/ pu to ba rin chen gsal ni rab byung dang po'i lcags lug spyi lo10kā1 lor 'khrungs/ rab byung gnyis pa'i shing bya spyi lo1105lor gshegs pa des na po to ba'i rab byung gi mkhan po glan gyis mdzad pa'i lo rgyus 'di ni yid rton rung bas lcags byi de ni rab byung gsum pa'i lcags byi spyi lo1180 lo yin pa las rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags byi spyi lo114༷ lo min pa kha tshon gcod thub/ 'on kyang deb sngon dang /mkhas pa'i dga' ston/ rgyal rabs 'phrul lde bcas kyi nang gsal ba hor gyi dmag dpon dor rta zhes pa bod du lhags pa'i lcags byi ni spyi lo1340lor yin pas gong gi deb ther khag gi lo tshigs dang mi sna'i ming 'gal ba zhig chags pa dang / yang deb ther sngon por/ pyol lha/ khang gi lo rgyus mjug sgril kha'i lo tshigs kyi sdom tshig tu/ ‘‘sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug gis drug cu rtsa bdun bzhes pa chu bo rta'i lo la jo bo rje mnga' res su phebs/297

don gnyis bzhes pa me mo phag la bsam yas su phebs zhes bya'o// (deb sngon lcags par ma shog grangs 131) zhes 'khod pa jo bo rje'i lo rgyus dang sbyar na hor dmag bosau/ du lhags pa'i lo ni spyi lo 1340 lor babs pa bcas gnad don 'di la da dung nan tan gyis dpyad dgos pa'i don du snang zhing / lnga pa'i dgongs pa rgyal dang / rwa spreng bcom pa'i dus po to ba dang mtshungs zhes gsungs pa'ang ches snga bar mthong bas deb theb dmar po'i mchan 'grel nang jing gir rgyal po'i lo rgyus skabs ‘‘rang lo zhe lnga pa rab byung gsum pa'i me stag spyi lo130snyo lor bod dbus gtsang du slebs/ sde srid jo dga' dang tshal pa'i dpon rigs sogs mi grangs sum brgya'i bsu ba dang sne len rgya cher byas’ (deb ther dmar po'i deb ngosakā08) zheru/ kasal bar gzhigs na hor dmag bod du lhags pa'i thog ma hor jing gir rgyal pos rgya bod dbang du bsdu ba'i dus te jing gir lo bco brgyad tsam la hor dmag bod la thog mar btang 'dra ba dang / de rjes rang lo zhe lnga pa rab byung gsum pa'i me stag spyi lo1kra0smolor bod du yong skabs sde srid jo dga' dang tshal pa'i dpon rigs kyis bsu ba dang sne len rgya che byas pa'i lo rgyus ltar jing gir ngo ma bod du ma yong gong dpung dmag bod du btang 'dra ba chos rgyal dang / rwa sgreng bcom pa zhig yin shas kha ba las/ go dan gyis btang ba'i hor dmag dor rtas rgyal lug lhas bcom par byas na lo rgan drug cu sa/cig phyi rags pa'i skyon gyis bstan pa phyi dar gyi lo rgyus khyon yongs kyi lo tshigs mthud thub dka' ba mkhas pa rnams kyi sa da dung da pyad par 'tshal zhes zhar la 'phros nas da ni gdan 298

rabs dkyuṭashaṃ la 'jug par bya ba ni/de rjes dge bshes gnas brtan gyis rab byung gsum pa'i chu glang spyi lo1193 nas me 'brug spyi lo 11rdzosmo bar gdan sa lo bzhi bskya/ngas/de rjes glang ston seng ge 'bum gyis rab byung gsum pa'i me sbru la spyi lo 1197 nas rab byung bzhi pa'i sa yos spyi lo131rdzo bar gdan sa lo nyi shu rtsa gsum bskyangs/de rjes mkhan po bar pas rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags 'brug spyi lo 1130 nas sa byi spyi lo1338 bar gdan sa lo dgu ba skyangs/de rjes byang chub sems dpas rab byung bzhi pa'i sa glang spyi lo13kra9nas me rta spyi lo11bhepyolo bar gdan sa lo bco brgyad bskyangs/de rjes kun spangs lha ri bas rab byung bzhi pa'i me lug spyi lo1347nas shing byi spyi lo13a+yo4lo bar gdan sa lo bco brgyad bskyangs/de rjes dzñā na pra dzñā rab byung gsum pa'i shing rta spyi lo11gyi4lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo so bag/nyiṭage pa rab byung bzhi pa'i shing glang spyi lo1kra.a+yo5nas lcags yos spyi lo 1391 bar gdan sa lo nyi shu rtsa bdun mdzad/dgung lo lnga bcu nga dgu pa rab byung lnga pa'i chu 'brug spyi lo1393 lor gshegs/de rjes mkhan chen 'jam dpal ye shes snying po rab byung bzhi pa'i shing stag spyi lo13'a4lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo bzhi bcu pa chu sbrul spyi lo 139kā lo gdan sa lo gcig mdzad/ dgung lo bdun cu don bdun pa rab byung drug pa'i lcags rta spyi lo1kle30 lor sku 4 /shegs/299

de rjes mkhan po ye shes bsod nams rgya mtsho rab byung lnga pa'i lcags rta spyi lo1phre70 lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo nyer lnga pa shing rta spyi lo1394lo nas gdan sa lo nyi shu rtsa drug bskyangs te dgung lo nga gcig pa rab byung lnga pa'i lcag〈 smu spre la spyi lo1310 lor sku gshegs/de rjes kun spangs chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan rab byung lnga pa'i chu rta spyi lo 1383 lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo so / brgyad pa sa lug spyi lo 1319lo nas rab byung drug pa'i lcags rta spyi lo1330 lo bar gdan sa lo bcu gnyis bskya ngas/ dgung lo dru ga cu re brgyad pa rab byung drug pa'i sa mo glang spyi lo134rdzolor sku gshegs/de rjes kun spangs pa'i dbon po spyan snga bsos namyo/sa grags pa sogs rim par byung ba yicha/ no//klu mes kyi mkhan bu ka ba bzhi'i ya gyal rngog byang chub 'byung gnas kyis lcags phag spyi lordzolā1 lor yer par ba rang bzung / g.yu sgro khang dmar/ bzad kyi lding pa/ chu shul na bo/ spus5 sde lho gong / yol thang /lab so/ gra' d+dha/ thang / kha rab so gcig lcags phag spyi lordzo51lor gzhu kun dga' ra ba/ tsha mirga/ sogs brtsikas/ rngo ga gi mkhan bu zhig gis lho nub tu lha mdo brtsi gas/ pa las 'bre tsho zhes mang du mched/ de rnams la rngog skor du grags/klu mes kyi mkhan bu ka ba bzhidza nang gses glan ye shes shes rab kyis rgya sar sgang / glag mda'/ tshal chung bcas bzung ba rnams la glan tsho'am glan skor du grags/300

gru mer tshul khrims 'byung gnas kyis gtso bo mdzad cing khu'i brnye mi gsum sogs kyis me sbrul spyi lo957 lor sol nag thang po che brtsigs shing / klu mes sku ngo ma yang thang po che 'dir bzhugs pa yin/ 'di las mched pa la thang skor du grags shing / phyis gru mer gyis mkhan bu khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gis bzung ba yin/khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung ni/ lcags mo phag spyi lo1011lor 'khrungs/ khong dang rngog legs pa'i shes rab/ 'bre chen po rnams kyis khams su byon nas/ jo bo se bcun la chos mang du gsan te/ mkhas par gyur nas 'brom ston pa mnga' ris su jo bo rje mjal bar byon pa'i phyi lo dbus su phebs/ khu ston thang po cher bzhugs nas phar phyin gyi bshad pa mdzad/ grwa pa mang du 'phel/ dwags po dbang rgyal gyis kyang khong la phar phyin bslabs pa bcas kyis mkhas par gyur nas phyis khyung po grags se zhes bya ba mkhas pa'i nga rgyal gyis jo bo rnge la chos ma gsan pa de dang 'gran bshad mdzad par grags/ khong dgung lo drug cu re lnga pa rab byung dang po'i shing yos spyi lo1༷75lor sku gshegs /de rjes gdan sa dbon po 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad/khu sto na btson 'grus g.yung drung gshegs pa'i lo der khu sher brtson 'khrungs/ khong gis 'bre chen po'i zhabs la gtugs nas phar phyin gyi ṭīka che chung gsum mdzad cing / bshad nyan gyis/ slob ma mang du ba3ོngas/mkhas pa chen po zhang g.ye ba yang khong gi slob ma yin/ dgung lo dru2 / cu re dgu pa rab byung gnyis pa'i chu phag spyi lo11bhekā lor sku gshegs/301

thang po che gru mer gyi mkhan rgyud rim par byon pa'i tha ma mkhan po tsorgyal tsha zhes bya ba de nas mkhan rabs chad de shul gyi khang nor rnams bla —brang pa bzang po dpal gyis bsdus/ phyis thang po che ni bla brang pa dang /gser khang pa/ phu pa gsum gyis bskyangs pa dang / gzhan yang klu mes kyi mkhan bu rgyal ba 'od la sogs pa mang pos gnas gzhi 'dzin te bstan pa'i gsos su che ba'i mdzad pa ji snyed bskyangs yod cing / klu mes las gyes tsho shin tu mang rung rgetso che ba zhang skor rngog skor/ glan skor/ thang skor bcas bzhi yin no/ /sum pa ye shes blo gros kyis 'bro sa thang du dme ru brtsigs rung dge 'dun gyi sde ma 'phel/ phyis klu mes dang / sum pa/gnyis gcig tu bsdebs nas gdung ma gnyis zer la gong du bshad pa ltar klu mes kyi mkhan bu ka ba bzhi/ klu sumyo/ gyi mkhan bu glan ye shes byang chub/tshal chung gi gnyos tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ 'phangs dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ gzi rlung gnyis/ klu mes kyi gcung dge ngoca/ gyis mon mkhar 'gan bzhengs/ mkhan bu min yang grags che bas grangs su bgrangs pa sgye ston rdo rje shes rab kyis gzhung sgro mkhar btab pa 'dis mtshon mkhan bu cung che ba phyam so gnyis/ de bas chung ba gral rma dpapipe tu med pa zhes grags shing / rgyal dkor nor/ gzhu kun ra bza' mi/ thang po che dge bshes/ gra thang lha khang gis khyad par 'phags pas khyad 'phags sde bzhir grags/ba tshul khrims/ sko gros kyis yungs 'gur brtsigs/ de nas lan pa'i spyil bu bzung / rba'i mkhan bu mal sems dpa' shes rab kyis sto da lung 302

cha thog brtsigs/ thag ma lha khang dang mon gra bzung / rba'i gcung gisagye re'i mda' grong brtsigs/ gzho'i 'chad kha bzung ste de rnams la rba tshor grags/rag shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas kyis srang 'og gi lha khang brtsigs/ka tshal dang zhwa bzung / rag shi'i gcung pos dge rgyas bzung / de'i mkhan bu mtha' bzhi rgyal 'phags yin/ de'i mkhan bu zhang shes rab 'phags kyis lan pa rta bres brtsigs te de rnams la rag tsho dang rag shi'i gcung tsho zer dze'abring ye shes yon tan gyis ngan lam spyi mo brtsigs pa las 'bring tsho stod pa mched/ de nas dkar chu dang snye thang brag sna bzung / de'i lam stegs su brang ra mo che brtsigs/ de las 'bring chu+o smad pa mched/ klu gong nas 'bring tsho bar pa byung ste de rnams la 'bring tsho zer ba bcas dbus pa mi lnga'i nang nas klu sum sde pa gcig tu rtsis te dbus kyi sde pa bzhir grags pas dbus khul 'dul bstan dar rgyas la mdzad rjes chen po bzhag yod/ 'on kyang dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i dkyil tsam dang /bcu gnyis pa'i 'gor sde pa bzhi po mchod gzhis bdag dbang sogs kyi gnad don la brten nas 'gal ba dza drag po chags te phan tshun dmag 'khrug yun ring tsam bya dgos byung bas bsam yas dang / lha sa gtsug lag khang sos/ṭa/ la nyams chag ci che byung ba dwags sgom tshul khrims snying pos tsho pa phan tshun gyi dmag 'khrug 'dum sgrig mdzad pa dang / dwags sgom tshul khrims snying po dang / rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis gtsug lag khang 303

dang / bsam yas la nyams gso legs par gnang ba ma zad/ dwags sgom tshul khrims snying pos gung thang bla ma zhang la lha sa gtsug lag khang la dri zhu dang / bdag skyong gnang rgyu'i 'gan dkri gnang ba phyis dus tshod mi thung tsam ring tshal pas lha sa skyong ba'i srol rgyun gnang pa bcas so//gtsang pa mi lnga'i nang gi lo ston la mkhan bu nyi shu rtsa bzhi zhes grags kyang sde zin pa la rgya shākya gzhon nus la stod mar la thang brtsigs/ de las 'bring mtshams kyi bul tog lha khang sogs gyes/ skyo shes rab rdo rjes don mo ri brtsigs/ stag lo gzhon nu brtson 'grus kyis/ stag lo lha khang brtsigs/a mes zhu gcig gis mas phring dang / brag dmar bzung / lar shākya yon tan gyis gzus po bzung / li blo gros gzhon nus jo mo brtsigs/glag byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis chu mig brtsigs/ de rnams las mched pa la rgya mtsho nas glag tsho'i bar so so ra grags shing / 'ga' shes rapa bla mas bsnyems dang / rngog ye shes 'byung gnas kyis spang dkar lha lung brtsigs kyang de gnyis ka glag tsho'i khongs su thim/ glang btsun byams pas 'om phugs brtsigs/ de nas gtsang 'gram bzung ste bum thang / chag sa/ kri gong / mgos ston/ phrol ma sogs glang tsho stod smad du gyes/mgo ba ye shes ba/yung drung ṣ+ka/sa sbre lha khang bzung /lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas kyis zhwa lu brtsigs te rgya gar la byon/sdom pa bskyar nas bzhes/ lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas la slob ma ka bzhi gdung drug tu grags pa byung ste zhwa lu brgya skor mched/kyi ye shes dbang pos shangs mkhar lung dang / gye re glang ra de'i 304

las stegs su mu shangs kyi ro skam brtsigs/ 'di nas kyi tsho stod smad bar gsum du gyes te glang ra nas mched pa la glang skor dang / nyug gi u lung nas gyes pa la u tsho zhes kyi tsho smad par grags/ kyi'i slob ma la mes de'i mkhan bu rnams las spang gi 'khris dang zha tshul 'phags kyis bya rgyus bzung /kong bo thar pa rin chen la mkhan bu bzhi'i gzu ston 'phan grags kyis sgre'i lce mtshams dang rgyan mkhar stag lung bzung / de las mched pa gzu tshor grags/lce btsun dkar pos ang yig dang / g.yung ston dza ris ba 'or bzung yang mched pa med/ shab rtses shab rtse lha khang brtsigs te de rnams la kong tsho zer zhing spyir de thams cad la kyi tsho bar par grags/yang a mes kyis la bris kyi kha chad nas sad kyi la steng bzung / der stod kyi mkhan bu rnam bzhi byung ba'i khri ston brtson 'bar gyis shong sna bzung / sa rbad btsun chung gis brang chung bzung / rgya ston argyu de was spo ru sna bzung / 'dar shākya gzhon nus sar phug bzung ste khri tsho/bra tsho/ rgya tsho/ sar tsho nes khral tsho bzhi byung ba la kyi tsho stod par grags/de las gyes pa gzhon nu 'byung gnas kyis rgyan mkhar thur la bzung bas thur tsho dang kyi btsun dpal yes 'brung kun ra bzung ngo //tshong tsho'i sde ni tshong btsun shes rab seng geṭa/ sngo gling bzung / de'i mkhan bu las/ khral tsho dgur gyes te tshong tsho stong pa tā/ skal skor dang rgya na skor gnyis/ bar pa la gnas gsar dang gnas rnyeng gnyis te bzhi byung /305

smad pa la rba tsho/ nyan tsho skor/ bya chos skor/ smon gro skor/ dwo tsho ste khral tsho lnga yod/de yang a mes tshong btsun gyis rtsis kyi yang dbem/ bzung / de la rtsis lha khang nyan tsho stag tshal gyis bya chos myo khar po che smon gro gser gyi sgong thog rnams phul nas bzung / rang gi mkhan bu la so sor gtad pas tsho lnga byung ste de la rtsis lha khang rba yon tan blo gros la gtad de bskyangs pas rba tshor grags/ rba'i mkhan bu yol chos dbang gis skyegs gnas nying bzung nas rba tsho stod pa mched/ yol thog 'bebs kyi/sa lcang ra dang / stag pa jo btsun gyis ce re bzung nas rba tsho bar par grags/ rtsis nas rba tsho smad pa mched do//nyan tsho rwa blo gros bzang po dang / khams pa la gtad/ rwas ngur smrig bzung bas rwa tsho byung / khams pas lcags mkhar bzung bas khams tsho zer te de gnyis nyan rngo+o skor ro//bya chos rmako/ ra po che rgya tshul seng la gtad/ des kong po ye 'byung la gtad/ des da mu'i gnas mo che dang mnyam du bskyangs pas bya chos skor ro// smon gro mar pa rdo rje ye shes la gtad/ des mkhan bu sne po grags pa rgyal mtshan la gtad nas slar dong mkhar phug bzung / phyis stag tshal dkyus thang bzhengs nas a mes la phul/ mar pas bran ma sgang brtsigs/ de gsum dang lan 'gro ba'i stag tshang dang bzhi la smon gro'i ma dang mnyam pa'i bu bzhir grags te smon gro skor ro//306
