gser gyi spong thog zhang tshor khrod pa la gtad/ des gser gyi brag shod brtsigs/ btsan po sdings/ rtsis kyi yang dben ra sog mtshar la/stag tshal mkhar po che bzung nas mkhan bu rba dge mthong la gtad/ des rong ba do bzung nas ma/ban bu 'bre btsun sngon mo la gtad/ de rnams la dwo tsho zer te khral tsho 'dus nas 'dun ma byed pa na de dag gi btsun chung gsum byung ba la dpon po gar song dris pas 'das zer bas 'o ne dwo phrug tu 'dug pa zhes byas te der chags skad/de ltar dbus gtsang gi mi bcu mdo khams su phebs te bla chen la sdom pa bzhes kyang dbus nas sum pa dang / gtsang nas 'o brgyad spun gnyis/u dkar bcas bzhi la rjes 'jug gi rgyun ca/ched pa med pas dbus gtsang mi drug gam/ yang na rba rag gnyis gcig tu bsdebs nas mi lngar yang grags pa lags so//dzo dbus gtsang mi bcu'i khongs su mi the ba 'a 'bre'i sde gnyis byung / de yang 'a zha mgo bo che'i bu 'a ye shes g.yung drung gis khams la sdom pa len du phebs/ khong gis khams su bla chen gyi mkhan bu kre po mchog bla la sdom pa zhus par ngas chu gtor btang nas yong chog gsungs te mkhan po de khar sku 'das/ mkhan po'i gsung de ka la sdom pa thob par bzung bas dge tshul chu gtor mar grags/ 'a zha des sna nam 'dre brngas dang 'u yug mda'i ra shag dang de'i lam stegs stag gi gnas po che bzung / de'i mkhan bu she'u sna nam pas lhan gyi ba so thang / 'khor re skyi sgang / nyang ro bud mdo/ 'khor re ba khor/ lhan gyi dre shong rnams bzung / de'i mkhan 307

bu sog tshul khrims bla mas kyang ba so thang bzung / de'i mkhan bu spang 'dul 'dzin gyis stag gi spen can bzung / de'i ma/yan bu snubs rin chen grags kyis khu lung lha gral dang / 'u yug gsal sgang so gas bzung ste 'a tsho'i skor ro//yang 'bre gzhon tshul gyis khams su phebs te khri kha mkhar snar bla chen gyi mkhan bu ya zi bon ston la sdom pa zhus par der bas gsungs te de kar 'das/ mkhan bu'i gnang ba thob pa des/ de+o/ma pa thob par byas pas der bas kyi bsnyen rdzogs su grags/ khong gtsang du phyir phebs nas rta nag phu'i bya tshang dang / shangaji rī kyi bye phurga/ ba/zung / de nas 'jad kyi gnas brgyad mched pa de rnams ni 'bre tsho yin no//de ltar dbus sa/tsang gi mi drug 'a 'bre dang bcas pa las gyes pa ni smad 'dul du grags pa yin la/ de'i sdom rgyun ni ston pa/ shā ri'i bu/ dgra gcan zin/ klu sgrub/ legs ldan 'byed/ dpal sbas/ ye shes snying po/ bo ti sa rwa rnams yin par bzhed par mi mthun pa med cing /de phyin la 'dod lugs du ma snang ste mkhan chen zhi ba tsho/ rba rat+na/ li sangs rgyas ye shes/ kwa 'od mchog grags/ de nas g.yo dmar gtsang gsum du rim par 'dod pa dang / kha cig zhi ba 'tsho/ ka ma la shi la/de nas g.yo dge 'byung du 'dod pa/ la la rba rat+na'i mkhan0bu smar g.yo gtsang gsum du 'dod pa/ 'ga' zhig dzi na mi tra'i mkhan rgyud du 'dod pa sogs bzhed tshul mang tsam mchis pa bcas smad 'dul gyi lo rgyus re zhig de tsam lags so//308

gsum pa/ stod 'dul skor/ 'dul ba stod nas dar ba'i bdag rkyen gtso bo lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis mdzad pa yongs grags khong gi lo rgyus cung zhib pa gong du gsal zhing / skabs 'dir lha bla mas stod 'dul dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i skor ni mdo rgyud nas lung bstan par grags pa'i skyes bu dam pa des rang gi srid gcung srong nge la gtad nas rang dang /sras gnyis shākya'i bstan pa la rab tu byung /skabs der khong gi mchod gnas ser po zhes bya ba zhig yod pa de dang / sa sgang gi 'brog mi 'gras te sa sgang gi 'brog pas mchod gnas ser po la sogs pa bsad par lha bla mas nga'i mchod gnas bkrongs pas stong 'dod gsungs te dong rtse wang gi gser sa phul ba'i gser sa de'i bug pa re nas gser bre khal bcu longs pa re byung nas spu rangs su kho char dang /sil chog tu rta po dang / rna ra yul du nyar ma dang / dbu rig tu sha ling /gu ger mtho ling gi gtsug lag khang bcas bzhengs shing / mtho ling gi gtsug lag khang de'i lcags ri'i nang tshud du gañdzir btsugs pa'i lha khang drug cu rtsa bzhi yod par grags so//de rjeṭaṭa bstan pa 'phel zhing / skabs der lag len byed pa'i chos lugs 'gar the tshom gcod pa'i phyir mnga' ris skor gsum na blo rno la shes rig dang ldan pa'i byis pa mang po'i nang nas khye'u lo bcu las mi 'da' ba nyi shu rtsa gcig gi blo gros brtag pa ste dang po gzhung 'dzin pa/ de nas don la spyod pa/ mnyam par 'jog pa la sogs brtags te rab 'bring tha gsum du phye ba'i rab bdun dang / g.yog bdun/ nying g.yog bdun 309

re bcas bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig gi pha ma nor gyis tshims par mdzad de blus pa dang / rgyal khrims btsan pos kyang mi btang du mi btub par mdzad de de dag la gser phye mang po bskur nas rgya gar du rgyal po la phyag — rten dang / paṇ+ḍi tar chos kyi zhu rten byed bcug ste rgya gar nas kun snying gi chos tshol la shog ces dang / dam pa'i chos 'dul ba tshol la shog ces/'dus pa rnam gnyis kyi chos tshol la shog ces zhal bkod rnam pa gsum dang / kha che paṇa chen dharmā pā la dang / rin chen rdo rje gnyis gser la ma rtseg par spyan drongs pa gyis shig ces bka' bsgos te brdzangs pas khye'u bcu dgu tshad pas grongs/ zhang zhung gi lha bzo rin chen bzang po dang / spu rangs kyi legs pa'i shes rab gnyis las gzhan tshos bod la phan thogs pa ma byung / khong gnyis rgya gar du bzhugs ring gsan bsam lhod med gnang bas mkhas par gyur te dang po kho char du byon/ sgra legs par sbyangs/tsan dha ha ring la gsang ba 'dus pa lugs gnyis zhus/ 'jig rten gsum snang gi dkyil 'khor du lan bdun zhugs pas nyams rtogs khyad par can 'khrungs shing khong gnyis rgya gar du lan gsum byon pa dang / skyes sbyangs kyi yon tan khyad par can mnga' bas phyi nang gi rig gnas kun la nang byan chud cing lo chen rin chen bzang po dang / lo chung legs pa'i shes rab ces mtshan yongs su grags/ khyad par gsang sngags la mchog tu mkhas shing / gsang 'dus 'phags skor dang ri/ ye shes zhabs/gtsug dgu/ rdo rje 'byung ba la sogs pa'i rgyud sde'i skor mang po bsgyur gnang mdzad pas bod du gsang sngags gsar ma zhes bya ba lo chen rin chen 310

bzang po nas 'go tshugs pa ma zad/ lhag par khong gis lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi bka' ltar kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta bharma pa la dang / pra ta ka ra warma dang /pad+ma ka ra warma la sogs pa'i mkhas pa mang po bod du spyo drangs shing /paṇ+ḍi ta dharma pā las rab tu byung ba mang po bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang /'dul ba'i bshad pa dang lag len rgya cher spel gnang mdzad pa'i mkhan bu'am slob ma'i nang nas dge slo/nga sā dhu pā la dang / jo bo gu ṇa pā la/dge slong pradzñā pā la zhes bya ba pā la rnam gsum gyis slob ma'am mkhan bu mang du bskya ngas pa'i nang nas pradzñā pā la'i mkhan bu zhang zhung pa rgyal ba shes rab ste des dharma pā la las nyams len dang bram ze 'dutshwa'adzin pre ta ka ra nas phyag len bslabs pas sgrub brgyud kyi bla ma gnyis/ shrī dzā na bha dra dang / shrī su burdi sharnyi la gzhung gi bshad pa gtso bor gsan pas bshad rgyud bla ma gnyis zhes grags pa bcas mnga' ris stod du 'dul ba'i bstan pa rgya cher dar bar mdzad pa de rnams la 'dul ba stod 'dul du grags nga/ yin/de rjes lha/ sde'i ring la kha che paṇa chen su rtu ti shrī shārnyi spyan drangs/lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis sku tshe'i ca/jug la rang gi rgyal srid gcung kho rer snga sa nas gtad zin kyang skabs der phyi nang rngo+os lugs gang zhig dar spel gtong ba'i gnad don la brten nas gar log dang dmag 'khrug bya dgos byung bas nang pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung skyob kyi ched du khong ngo mas dmag sne khrid de gar log dang 'thab pas pham ste/ gar log rgyal pos btson du bzung ste yun ring rab btson du bzhugs dgoṭ+wāṃg byung / skabs 311

der gar log rgyal pos lha bla mar khyod dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'dzin pa gtong na nged kyis btson 'di nas gtong ba yin/ de min khyod rang btson ma/sa blu bar sri sa/ ril po'i ljid dang mnyam pa'i gser dgos lugs sogs kadung rabs nang smras pa ltar dbon po rnams kyis mnga' ris khul nas gser mang du bsgrubs pa dang / dbus gtsang gi rab tu byung ba rnams la ya/nga sham thabs kyi khral blangs te dbu'i tshod tsam ma gtogs sku lus kyi ljid dang mnyam pa'i gser rnyed pa'i mtshams dbon po byang chub 'od kyis gar log tu phebs nas da nged rnams kyis khyed kyi sku lus dang mnyam pa'i gser rnyed kyis da dbu tsaca/ zhig dgos pa ring por ma thogs pa thabs tshol zhus te khyed spyan 'dren du 'ong zhus pas/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis nga rgas rnga/sa su la yang phan mi thogs pas/ gser rnyed pa de rnams kyis rgya gar nas paṇ+ḍi ta mang po spya gi drongs la dam pa'i chos legs par tshugs pa gyinu/ shig ces/ zhal chemyo/sa kyi tshul du gsungs pa gong du lha bla ma'i skabs 'phrod pa ltar dboru| po byang chub 'od kyis/ paṇ+ḍi ta mang po spyan drangs/ chos kyi bshad pa mang du btsus/sa thub pa byung mod/ byang chub 'od kyi dgongs pa la da lta bod kyi yul 'dir rab tu byung ba mang yang /sngags la sbyor sgrol la sogs pa log par spyod pa mang po snang ba dang / de mi spyod kyang stong pa nyid sa/cig pu kho nas 'tshang rgya zhes zer zhing myo/nga du ston pa dang / so sor thar pa'i bstan pa dar yang byang chutse sems dpa'i spyod pa la slob pa nyung bar gzigs nas phyogs lhung ngam nyes pa de dag zhi bar byed nus pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po zhig btsal bar bzhod pa la/ sngar spyan 312

drangs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyang de dang de la khyad par 'phags med kyi bod khams spyi'i bstan pa la rngo thogs pa ma byung zhing / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha ni gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa'i snyan pa gsan thos byung bas khong bod du spyan 'dren thub pa byung na/ phyogre/sa lhu nga ngam nyes pa de dag sun dbyung bar nus shing / bstan pa la phan pa rgya chen po yong bar dbongs nas rgya brtson 'grus seng ge spyan 'dren par btang yang spyan ma 'drongs/sla ra ya nga bod rab byung dang po'i me byi spyi lo 103a+yo tsam la lha bla ma ye shes 'od gar log rgyal po'i btson khang du sku gshegs pa'i lo phyi ma ste rab byung dang po'i me glang spyi lo 103gyi lor yul gung thang pa nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bu zhes bya ba rten dge slong du bzhugs pa zhig yod pa de rgya gar du slob gnyer la phebs te rgya brtson 'grus seng ges mgo gnyer mdzad nas jo bo rje la sogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta 'ga' zhig la chos mang du gsan pa dang / lo tsā ba'i mtshan thob pa slar gung thang du phebs pa la lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis khyed kyis jo bo rje mnga' ris su spyan 'dren par 'gro dgos/ gal te khyed kyis jo bo rje spyan 'drongs te kho bo dga' bar bgyis na phyis khyed dga' ba ngas byed pa yin/ nged rgyal po'i baḍa/—/'a ya nga bcag tu mi btub gsungs pa dang du blangs/ lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis gser ling ba gcig la shing srang bcu drug yod pas thog drangs gser 4ོna che ba dang bcas dpon g.yog mang rab rgya gar du brdzangs shing / lam du chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa byung ba rnams kyang thabs mkhas pas zhi bar byas te bi ka ma la shrī lar mtshan mo zhig la bstol/ der bod kyi skad du kha ton 313

byas pa rgya brtson 'grus seng ge sgo khang steng na bzhugs pas rga/san te khong tsho mjal 'dzoms byung ba dang / de'i sang rgya brtson 'grus seng ges nag tsho jo bo'i spyan sngar khrid/ gser ling ba des gtso byas pa'e gser mang po maṇ+ḍal rten du spungs nas rgya brtson 'grus seng ge rig snga ra bod du bstan pa khyad par 'phags pa yod pa glang dar mas bsnubs/ de nas lo shin tu mang po song ba na bla chen po'i drin la brten nas dge 'dun gyi sde mang bar bzhugs shing / dge 'dun gyi sde de rnams la sde snod kyi mkhyen pa chen po yod kyang / sde snod lag len du gdab tu ma btub/ da bod kyi rgyal po'i dgongs pa bskang ba dang / rab tu byung ba rnams la chos lag len la gdab tu btub pa zhigayong bar jo bo nyid bod du snyon na phan thogs nges la/ paṇ+ḍi ta gzhan gyis phan thogs par dka' ba'i gnas lugs rnams nag tsho dang bcas pas nan tazun gyis zhus par/ jo bo rje'i zhal nas/ khyed rnams bden nga'i ched du bod kyi rgyal po'i gser mang po yang song / gdan 'dren pa'i mi mang po byung ba yang tshad pas gum/ bod kyi rgyal po la ngo yang gnong ba yod/ da kho bos brtags te bod la phan na cis kyang 'gro/'on kyang bi ka ma shi la'i gam/sa brtan gyis 'o skol bod la gto nga ba dka' bas thabs mkhas pa zhig bya dgos/ de la nag tsho rang yang kho bo spyan 'dren pa skad ma zer bar slob gnyer la 'ongs pa ska/ da gyis la slob ji—/nyer mdzod gsung ba k+ṣiṃ zhin du nag tsho lo tsā bas slob gnyer byed cing bsdad/de nas jo bos yi dam gyi lha dang / rdo rje gdan na grub ji/'i rnal 'byor ma yo da pa de la dri ba mdzad pas lha dang mkha' 'akro na ma zu ji/ par 314

bod du cis kyang song / spyir bstan pa la phan thogs pa dang / khyad par du u pa si ka zhig la brten nas phun thogs te 'ong / tshe ni lo nyi shus thung bar 'gyur gsung bar bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs na tshe thung yang bla dgongs nas bod la 'byon par chas/ 'phral du rdo rje gdan la bskor ba mdzad pa dang / bal yul du rang byung gi mchod rten gzigs pa la 'byon pha'i tshul gyis bod du chas pa'i tshe bi ka ma shī la'i gnas brtan shrītshol mā kar na re/ nag tsho la khyod 'dir slob gnyer la 'ongs pa red bsam yang don du nga'i paṇ+ḍi ta bku bar 'dug da paṇ+ḍi ta nyid kyang bzhud pa la dgyes pa 'dra bas/ kho bos gegs mi byed par btang gis bod du lo gsum las ma bzhugs/ de rting tshur gdan 'dren zhu dgos gsungs pa nag tshos khas blangs pa ltar jo bo rje dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa rab byung dang po'i lcags 'brug spyi lo 10bheX lor rgya gar nas phebs te bal yul du lo gcig bzhugs shing chu rta spyi lo 1༷bhe3 lor mnga' ris su phebs par lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas te mtho lding gi gtsug lag khang du spyan drangs te lha bla ma dang / snod ldan gyi skyes bu mang por shin tu gsang ba'i sgo nas dbang bskur ba dang /gdams ngag mang du gsungs/ skabs der byang chub 'od kyis bod na chos dang mi mthun pa 'di dang 'di lta bu mchis pas de dag gi gnyen por 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos shig mdzad par zhu zhes zhus pas byang chub lam gyi sgron ma zhes bya ba skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa ji lta ba bzhin ston pa'i bstan bcos de mdzad/sto byi15

de yang dang por skyes bu chung ngu'i lag len 'chi ba rjes su dran te tshe 'di las blo log pa zhig med na chos pa'i khongs su mi tshud/ phung po 9sdo bdag tu 'dzin na thar pa mi thob/ byang chub tu sems ma bskyed na theg pa/ chen po'i lam du mi tshud/ theg pa chen ngo 'i lam de yang thabaṭa/ dang sheri rab ma 'brel na stong pa nyid gcig pu bsgoms par+sā 'tshang mi rgya bar bka' brtsal pas sgom nyams can du 'dod pa rnams kyi dregs pa bsal/ de tho/ na nyid rig pa zhig yin na ma gtogs dbang gnyir/ pa dang gsum pa la dngos kyi lag len byar mi rung bar bka' bstsa'ari bus sgra ji bzhin pa'i sbyor ba dang sgrol ba rnams/ mi rung ba gsal por bstan/ las 'bras la rtsis su mdzad pas paṇ+ḍi ta las 'bras pa bya bar yang grags shing / khong ge mtshan de gsan pas ming tsam gyis kyang gzhan la phan thogs ribya ba de yin gsungs nas dgyes/de'i tshe lo chen rin chen bzang po'i dgongs shā / la jo bo rje yo na tan kho bo la/sa che ba dka' mod/ 'on kyang lha bla mas spyan drangs pas zhabs tog cig zhu dgos dgongs nas rang gi bzhugs gnas mtho lding gtsug lag khang du spyan drangs pa der rgyud sde geng 'og gi lha rnamasani thog gi rem rngu byas nas bris yod pa de rnams la jo bos so sor bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa re mdzad de stan la bzhugs nga ra da lta lha rnams la bstod pa mdzad mi de rnams dang thog sus mdzad ces bka' 'dri zhus par de rnams kho bo rang gis 'phral du bkyis pa yin gsungs pas lo chen rin chen bzang po thugs rgyal chag ste 'jigs shum ste song / de nas jo bos lo chen la/ khyed kyis 316rte

chos ci dang ci mkhyen gsungs par rang gis mkhyen pa rags rim tsam zhus pas e/ khyed lta bu bod na bzhugs 'dug pas kho bo bod snye 'ong mi dgos pa 'dug gsungs/ thugs kar thal mo sbyar/ yang jo bo rjes/ lo tsā ba chen po/ rgyud sde de rnams kyi don stan thog gcig tu dril te gang zag gcig gis nyams su len na ji ltar bgyi gsung bar lo chen gyis/ so so nas bshad pa bzhin byed lags mod zhus pas/ 'o/ lo tsā ba nal kho bo bod du 'ong dgos nges su 'dug de rnams gcig tu bsdoms nas nyams su len dgos pa yin gsungs nas gsang sngags 'asrul gyi me long bya ba'i bshad pa mdzad pas lo tsā ba yang shin tu thugs ches par gyur te 'di ni mkhas pa chen po bas kyang chen po'o snyam du dgongs nas brgyad stong pa dang / nyi khri snang ba/ brgyad stong 'grel chen la sogs pa sngar bsgyur ba mang po la zhus dag zhus/ jo bo rjes kho bo dbus su 'gro bas lo tsā gnang bar 'byon dgos gsungs pas de'i tshe lo chen rin chen bzang po dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa lnga pa yin pas dbu zhwa phud nas kho bo'i mgo bo 'di bzhin du song bas khyed kyis phyags phyi mi nus zhes zhus par/ 'o na/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bzod dka' zhing sems can mtha' dag gi don gnang dgos pas da ni sgrub pa zhig mdzad par zhu gsungs pas lo chen gyis kyang de ‘star gnang ba'i khas len zhus te sgo sum rim du mdzad de zhi bar ma gshegs gong sgrub pa la gcig tu gzhol bas nyams rtogs khyad par can 'khrungs/de rjes 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas dang mjal ba la sogs pa'i jo bo rje'i lo rgyus gal che ba gsham du grwab mtha' khag gi skabs brjod byi17

par bya'o/ /de ltar jo bo rje bod du phebs nas lo bcu gsum ring bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen mdzad de mthar shing rta spyi lo 1054 lor sku gshegs/yang lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi sku dus bal po pad+ma ma ru rtse bya ba chos bag tsam mkhyen pa gcig la sems bskyed thob cing byams snying rjes rgyud brlan pa zhig byung bar lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis chos zhu gsungs pas ngas mkhas par mi shes/ rgya gar na mkhas pa yod/ ngas spyan 'dren chog zer bar gser bskur nas btang bas khong gis paṇ+ḍi ta smri ti dang / a tsargya phra la ring ba gnyis spyan drangs nas yong ba'i lam bar bal yul du lo tsā ba ma ru rtse pho log glang thab kyi bsnyun gzhis gshegs stabs paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis pos bod skad mi ma khyen rung bod la phebs pa'i lam du mnga' ris dpal mo dpal thang nas jag pas khrid de bran du bkol thog bros kyi dogs nas btsong ste rin za'o zhes rta nag tu khyeng rje shag btsan bya ba la btsongs pas smri tis lug rdzi lo 'ga' gnang dgos byung / de rjes smri tis glan tshul khrims snying po la rin po che spungs pa gsungs pas khong grub pa thob par shes nas rta nag tu bzhugs par zhus pas zhal bzhes ma gnang ba khams su byon te yol rir bzhugs rjes lo 'ga' song nas bod skad byang ste sgra rang 'gyur du chos gzhung dang / sgrub thabs/ gdams ngag rin po che spungs pa la sogs pa mang po gsungs/ lo gong ye shes rin po che la mngon pa mdzod rtsa 'grel dang / smra sgo mtshon cha sogs rang 'gyur du gsungs/ de nas cog ro zhang btsun dang / g.ya' ston shes rab grags/ pa tshab ri khrod pa dang /zangs kha mdzod khur la sogs pa brgyud smṛ tis 'gyur ba'i chos rnams byi18

dbus su dar zhing / gzhan yang 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang / de'i sgrub thabs cha lag dang bcas pa/rnal 'byor rgyud dkyil 'khor la sogs pa mang po rang 'gyur du gsungs pa bcas smṛ ti mthar gling yul du sku gshegs pa'i sku 'bum byas te yul de la dran pa thang du grags/ phra la ring bas gtsang rong du rdzogs chen pa rong pa chos bzang grongs pa la grong 'jug byas pas rong pas chos mang po rdol shes su byung ste gzhan phan chen po byung bar grags/ sngar khong gnyis kyi lo tsā ba sku gshegs pas lha bla mas smṛ ti bod du byon pa ma mkhyen pa dang /chos mang po bsgyur yang khams su lus pas lha bla ma'i thugs bzhed gang ba byung med/mkhas pa sde'u sogs chos 'byung la lar gsang sngags gsar ma'i 'gyur 'go smri tis btsugs par bzhed pa ste lo chen rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur las smṛ ti'i 'gyur snga bar gsung mod/ 'on kyang deb ther sngon po 'a/sa/ ‘‘gsang sngags gsar ma'i 'gyur gyi 'go jo bo smṛ tis btsugs so zhes bya ba yod mod kyi des dbus gtsang du ni 'gyur ma mdzad la/ khams su dus phyis mtshan yang dag par brjod pa sgeg pa rdo rje'i skor dang / dpal gdan bzhi pa dang / gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor la sogs pa mang du bsgyur med kyi/ de bas lo chen rin chen bzang pos gsang sngags kyi 'gyur mdzad pa snga bar snang ste 'brom ston pa jo bo se btsun gyi g.yog byed pa'i dus smṛ ti la lo tsā bslabs so zhes 'byung la de dang nye bar 'brom gyis mnga' ris su byon pa'i tshe lo chen gyis lo brgyad cu rtsa lnga bzhos pa'i phyir ro//’ (deb sngon 319

lcags par ma shog grangs/ 3me5)zhes pas mtha' chod grub pa des na gsang sngags gsar mari 'gyur 'go lo chen rin chen bzang pos mdzad par som nyi ci yang ma dgos so//bstan pa phyi dar gyi 'dul ba'i bstan pa stod smad gang nas dar snga ba'i skor mkhas pa'i bzhed tshul mi mthun pa yod kyang / lo tshigs kyi nges pa'i thog ne+es bshad na 'dul ba'i bstan pa smad nas dar snga ba yin ste/ de yang kaXthog rig 'dzin chen pos lo chen rin chen bzang po rab myotu byung ba'i lo tshigs la dpyad pa gong du zhus zin pa des 'dul ba smad nas dar snga ba yin pa'i sgrub byed nus ldan byas chog pa bcas bstan pa phyi dar gyi lo rgyus re zhig de tsam mo// 320

skabs bcu pa/ bstan pa phyi dar skabs mkhas grub lo par+ṣa rim byon skor/bstan pa phyi dar skabs mkhas grub lo paṇa rim par byon pa'i skor chos 'byung rtse khag nang brgyud rim dang ldan pa mang po 'khod pa'i nang nas zhus chen tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i bstan 'gyur dkang chag ngo mtshar chu gter 'phel ba'i zla ba gsar pa 'di nyid nang bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs byon pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyi mtshan tshigs bcad du sdeb pas blta bde ba dang / lo tshigs skabs sum pa chos 'byung dang / mang thos klu sgrub kyi bstan rtsis/ deb sngon sogs la zhib tu dpyad/ lo tsā ba rnams kyi mdzad pa'i skabs deb sngon dang / mkhas pa'i dga' ston/chos 'byung bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen sogs nas kha bskangs/lo tsā ba'i 'khrungs 'das lo tshigs skor da yod dpyad gzhir gzhigs te cung zhib cha che bas phyogs sgrig byas pa la/dang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta rim par byon pa'i skor/ bstan 'gyur dkar chag las/bud+dhā pā la (sangs rgyas skyong ) snyarma pā la(chos skyong ) dung / pradzñā pā la(shes rab skyong ) dang ni legs par bshad/thad+dhā ka ra warma (dad byed go cha) pad+ma sbas/— 321

musnyi mi tra(grol ba'i bshes gnyen)sangs rgyas dpal zhi ba/shes rab go cha dpal ldan a ti sha/(de'i dbon po)dā na shrī dang dran pa ye shes grags/phra la ring ba sumyu ya tha dang /(kha che)dzñā na shrī(zhi ba bzang po)dang tsan+d+ra 'o hu la (dgra gcan zla ba)/('bum phrag gsum pa) rnyi ra pā la (bstan skyong ) atu mya da sha(mnyam med bcu pa)/blo mchog grags pa a ma ra tsan+d+ra('chi med zla ba)/thig le bum pa gzhon nu bum pa dang /gser gyi go cha dam pa rgya gar ba/dza yā nan+da ga ya rnya ra'i zhabs/don yod rdo rje kha che zla ba mgon/stong nyid ting 'dzin rdo rje ye rdor ba/shes rab gsang ba mahā dza ba dang /stobs kyi zla ba man+d+ra ka lak+ṣa/ karma badz+ra dang ni dza mā ri/dpa' bo rdo rje sgra gcan 'dzin sbas pa/rnam snang rdo rje madzñā gho ṣa dang /smuyo bī ti(nyi ma grags)pra dzñāshri dzñā na/gi gā dha ra(mkhas 'dzin)dang ni nor sbas dang /322

kun bzang dpa1the dang nikhyu laṅka t+t+waṃ7 /'gro bshes das/'a dang burta shrīdhā na/shākya shrī bzang rab 'byor zla ba dang /su ga ta shrī dā na shī la dang / dza ya rat+na dang ni saṃ gha shrī/blo bzang snying po kā la tsan+d+ra dang /dzi na gusta ma hā bo rnyi pa/dza bha ma shrī 'jig rten gsum kun dga'/longs spyod rdo rje dang ni rat+na shrī/ (bal po)ma hā pa na badz+ra krirti dang /ka ya shrī dang bal po grags pa dpal/ku mā ra dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i dpal/sā rnyu khrirti bi na ya shrī dang /shi la shrī dang maṅga la shrī dang / bi ma la shrī dār pan ātsār+ya/rgyal ba'i lha dang lagyi ka ra/a nardo shrī rā hu la shrī dang / zangs gling pa dang khrirti paṇ+ḍi ta/sha ri pu tra nags kyi rin chen dang /burta gusta zhes bya la sogs so//gong gsal tshigs bcad du sdebs pa ltar paṇ+ḍi ta bdun cu don 3lha3

gsum bod du byon te sangs rgyas/ kyi bstan pa dang / bod kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas la mjad rjes bsub thabs med pa bzhag yod cing / khong rnams kyi lo rgyus zhib par gzigs 'dod na/ mkhas pa'i dga' ston nang gsal ba'i lo paṇa gyi dum bu sogs la gzigs shig /skabs 'dir bstan pa snga dar/ phyi dar gnyis la paṇ+ḍi ta bod la phebs pa'i bsdur tshad skor/ bstan pa phyi dar la byon pa ni/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis (spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i 'gor) bud+dhā pā la bod du sa/dan drangs pa nas paṇa chen nags kyi rin chen bod du rab byung bdun pa'i me rta spyi lo 1bhe3phyo bar ha lam lo 43sgro skor song ba'i ring byon pa dang / bod sil bu'i dus skabs te lha bla ma ye she sa 'od kyis/ bud+dhā pā la spyan drangs pa nas 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i dus mjug paṇ+ḍi ta lal+lī ka ra(shong ston lo tsā ba/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis gdan drangs pa yin rung /laspyo ka ra bod du nam phebs kyi lo tshigs ltar bzhag shong lo'i 'khrungs 'das lo tshigs kyang gsal po zhig ma shes mod/'on kyang 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i bka' bzhin thong los lak+shi ka ra gdan drangs pa yongs grags ltar de'i 'gros la bltas na spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i mjug tsam la yin sri da pa des na lha bla ma ye shes 'od nas 'di bar lo ngo bzhi brgya la nye bar paṇ+ḍi ta drug cu re drug dang / de rjes/ paṇ+ḍi ta bdun tsam phebs par mngon/ bod du paṇ+ḍi ta phebs pa'i bsdur tshad la cha bzhag na bstan pa snga dar skabs rgya gar gyi pa zhi ta thoka mar slob dpon ku sa ra nas rig byed 'od zer bar rim par 3lha4

byon pa bsdoms pas paṇ+ḍi ta nyi shu rtsa bzhi zin rnga/ nas sangs rgyas sa/sang ba dang / sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis gangs ti ser byon te bzhugs pa mes ag tshom gyis spyan drangs kyang ma byon pa phud dbus gtsang rang du phebs pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis yin/ (mkhas pa'i dga' ston lcags par ma shog grangs 'a1༷)bstan pa phyi dar ram bod sel bu'i dus paṇ+ḍi ta drug cu re drug byon pa des na bstan pa snga dar las phyi dar gyi dus paṇ+ḍi ta bzhi cu zhe bzhis mang ba ste bstan pa snga dar gyi brgya cha300phrozin yod/gnyis pa/ bstan pa phyi dar skabs lo tsā ba rim par byon pa yang bstan 'gyur dkar chag las/dus der snga phyir byocha/ ba 'i lo tsā ba/chen po lha sa'i bla ma ye shes 'od/rin chen bzang po grags 'byor shes rab dang /seng dkar shākya 'od('bro)dang zhi ba 'od(lha)/legs pa'i shes rab (rngog)brtson 'grus seng ge(rgya)dang /tshul khrims rgyal ba (nag tsho)phu yi dngos grub dang /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ('brom)shākya blo gros mtshan/chos kyi shes rab dad pa shes rab (mar thung )dang / dge ba'i blo gros(rma)tshul khrims 'byung gnas(ga rod)ོ/tshan/chos kyi brtson 'grus(khyung po)stag lo gzhon brtson pa/mgar ba chos bzang she'u rdo rje'i lha/rab zhi bshes ga nye na blo ldan shes rab (rngog)can/325

ligos pa'i shis rab(pu hrang )'phags pa shes rab(zangs dkar )dang /shākya ye shes('brog mi)dga' ba'i rdo rje gzu/gyi ljang dbu dkar chos kyi yon tan dang /chos kyi rin chen chos kyi blo gros(lho brag mar pa)mtshan/gnyan lo dar ma grags dang 'gos lhas btsas/gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer shes rab brtsegs(klog skya)/blo gros grags (mal gyo)dang bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa(se rtsa)/rong pa chos bzang rdo rje dbang phyug(yol lcags)dang /byang chub shes rab (mang ngom)rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags/khe'u gad 'khor lo grags dang gsal ba grags(spang zho)/ding ri chos grags rgyus kyi smon lam grags/ pa tshab nyi grags ba ri rin chen grags/shes rab grags('bro)dang rwa chen rdo rje grags/kre bo shes dpal bkra shis rgyal mtshan pa/ba reg thos dga' rma ban chos 'bar dang /mtshur ston dbyig gi rgyal mtshan mtshur dbang nge/kun dga' rdo rje(dpyal pa)dang ni kun dga' grags(dpyal)/mar do chos dbang chos kyi snying po dang /chos kyi ye shes(kam)dbang phyug rgya mtsho(phyugs mtshams)dang /tshul khrims yon tan khe'u gad yon tan dpal/326

bosod nams bzang po sum pa dpal mchog gi /rdo rje dang ni nyi ma rdo rje dang /dge bsnyen ne tso(khu)klog skya gzhon nu 'bar/lha ston ye shes rgyal mtshan byang chub 'byung /chos kyi blo gros(glan)ting nge 'dzin bzang po(cog gru)/shes rab ye shes rig pa gzhon nu dang /gzhon tshul dang ni khu yi mdo sde 'bar/shes rab brtson 'grus dang ni g.yung drung 'od/bsod nams rgyal ba shes rab bla ma(cog gru)dang /mya nga na med dpal(cog gru)la chings yon tan 'bar/bsod nams mos pa dge tshul khyung grags pa/tshul khrims brtsegs pa dang ni lha btsun pa/lha btsan mu ni rā dza sangs rgyas bskyangs(rngog) /rgyal gyi lo tsā rdo rje rgyal po(sbal)dang /de wa rin chen chos kyi rin chen(lha)dang /tshul khrims 'od zer dge slong bya yi gdong (kyur)/da byid lo tsā dang ni phur bu 'od/tshul rgyal(pa tshab)shes rab legs dang dharma grags(nag tsho)/mar pa blo gros bzang po se lo tsā/ zla ba grags pa gnyal mi ye shes chos/ chos kyi zla ba dge slong shes rab bskyabs/327

nag tsho shir rgyan 'a zha rgya gar brtsegs/gnyan ston bsod nams ba ri chos grags dang /ong po lo tsā gzhon nu shes rab dang /'gar ba shes 'byung 'jam dpal gzhon nu dang /shes rab 'od zer dang ni dga' ba dpal(lce)/ye shes 'byung gnas shākya brtson 'grus pa/rwa pa chos rab rdo rje rgyal mtshan(lo btsun chung ) dang /zha ma dge bsnyen seng rgyal lce bkra shis/chag lo dgra bcom dpyal pa chos kyi bzang / byams pa'i dpal(gnubs)dang sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/chos rje dpal(chag lo)dang shes rab 'od(dpyal pa)dang zhang /grub pa dpal dang shes rab rin po che(glo bo) /'u ru dar ma seng ge mi mnyam bzang (lho brag) /shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan blo gros brtan(shong ) /au tra na pa rin chen dpal dang khams/blo gros rgyal po ldan ma tshul seng dang /ra sa gzhon brtson shu ke grags rgyal mtshan/nyi ma rgyal mtshan(thar lo)dpang lo blo gros brtan/sgra tshad smra ba rin rgyal blo gsal(dbus pa)dang /legs pa'i blo gros yar lungs grags rgyal mtshan/rin chen grub (bu ston) dang rin chen rnam rgyal ba/328

blo gros dpal (jo nang ) dang kun spangs grags pa'i mtshan/byang chub rtse mo(lo chen) bo dong grags rgyal mtshan/snar thang sam/ gha shrī dang skyabs ma/chog dpal/shes rab rin chen(chos 'khor sgang )'gos lo gzhon nu dpal/rin chen chos rgyal(chag lo)bsod nams rgya mtsho dang /chos skyong bzang po(zha lu)tā ra nā tha dang /ngag dbang phun tshogs la sogs skad gnyis smra/mang pos bka' dang bstan bcos 'di snyed cigabasgyur dang bshad pas gtan la phab par mdzad/ces lo tsā ba brgya dang lnga bcu nga bdun rim par byon pa bsdoms tshig gi tshul du bkod cing / lo tsā ba gtso che ba'i 'khrungs 'das lo tshigs dang mdzad pa rags bsdus tsam da yod dpyad gzhir gzhigs te bkod pa 'di lta ste/lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi skor gong du zhus zin pa dang / —lo chen rin chen bzang po ni/ mnga' ris gu ge'i sku waṃ ge'i snyung waṃ rat+na zhes par sa rta spyi lordzo58 lor bltams/ dguri lo bcu gsum pa lcags rta spyi lo97d+ngha lor mkhan po ye shes bzang po las rab tu byung /kha cher lan gsum byon te paṇ+ḍi ta shādha ka ra warma dang / ka ma la gusta/ dzin mi tra sogs paṇa grub bdun cu don lnga bsten nas mdo sngadzi/sa1 kyi chos tshul mtha' dag la mkhas par gyur/ dgung lo zhe dgu pa me rta spyi lo 100snyolor paṇ+ḍi ta zla 'od bzang po dang / sbyin se/ ka ma la rak+ṣi ta las bsnyen byilha9

par rdzogs/ mnga' bdag lha lde btsan gyi bla ma mdzad de lha sdes pu hrangs gzher gyi gnas gzhi phul bar gtsug lag khang mang po bzhengs/ sher phyin phyogs dang / yo ga /'dus pa sogs mdo sngags kyi chos mang du bsgyur cing / lta ba dbu ma pa'i lugs ltar bskyangs pa 'di nas bzung bod du gsang sngags gsar ma 'gyur 'go tshugs/ lha bsnyen dang gtor ma brgya rtsa/ sā tsha/ yan lag bdun pa/ ting 'dzin gyi dbang rnams bye ba re dang / 'jam dpal mtshan brjod saṃ skṛ ta'i skad dang / bod skad du 'bum phrag re/ gzhan la yon byin te 'bum phrag gcig bcas bton cing / yo ga'i bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad/ dgung lo gya lnga'i skabs jo bo rje mnga' ris su byon skabs dang por jo bo rjer phyag ma mdzad kyang phyis su lha khang gi lha re re la bstod pa re mdzad pa la dad nas mjal te gdam ngag gsan cing / jo bos sgrub pa la bskul bas sgrub khang gi sgo gsum rim la dam bca' gsum bris te rtse gcig gis sgom mdzad pas grub pa thob ste mthar dgung lo dgu cu go brgyad pa rab byung dang po'i shing lug spyi lo 1055lor sku gshegs/lo chen rin chen bzang po la slob ma mang du yod kyang lo chung legs pa'i shes rab/ gur shing brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ grab pa gzhon nu shes rab/ gyi nor dz+dza na dang bzhi la thugs kyi sras bzhi zer/ pu rangs pa an ston grags rin/ rgya ye tshul/ dgung pa dge bshes/ mar yul ba dkon mchog brtsegs bzhi ni lo chen dang lo chung gnyis ka'i spob ma yin no//byi30

lo chung grags 'byor shes rab ni/ lo chen rin chen bzang po'i slob ma'i gras yin pa khong gis kyang tshad ma dang / ma rgyud bde mchog gi skor bsgyur ba sogs 'phrin las che zhing / la las lo chen rin chen bzang po sogs khye'u nyi shu rtsa gcig rgya gar du phebs pa'i gras su khong yang yod par bzhed/rngog legs pa'i shes pob ni/ khri srong lde'u btsan gyi blon po rngog chen po'i rgyud pa yar 'brog de'i phyi rol gyi mtsho chen po'i 'gram du grong chags pa'i sngags rnying ma ba'i dge bshes rdo rje gzhon nur sras lnga yod pa'i che bar sku 'khrungs/ 'bring ye shes yon tan las rab tu byung / sde snod slob pa'i phyir du khams su byon nas jo bo se btsun gyi slob ma mdzad/ phu ston la sogs pa dge bshes rnams dang 'grogs te jo bo rje dang mjal zhing / de nas rab byung dang po'i shing bya spyi lo1kyabhe5lor dbus su phebs nas bshad grwa btsugs te slob ma mang du bskyangs/ jo bo rje snye thang na bzhugs pa'i tshe jo bo rje nas chos mang du gsan/ thugs rgyud shin tu bzang bas jo bo'i slob ma su dang yang mi mthun pa med par grags/ rngog gi bskul ma zhus pa bzhin jo bo rje dang / nag tsho lo tsā ba gnyis kyis rtog ge 'bar ba bsgyur/ yang rngog gis zhus pa bzhin jo bo rjes dbu ma'i man ngag de yang mdzad/ dang por brag nag gi rtsar dgon pa zhig btab cing / phyis jo bos lung bstan pa bzhin rab byung dang po'i lcags phag spyi lo 1༷71lor gsang phu ne+e'u thog btab/ khong ni jo bo rje'i slob ma snyan grags can dbus kyi khu rngog 'brom gsum gyi ya gyal dang / bka' gdams kyi mes 331

po jo 'brom yab sras gsum gyi ya gyal yang yin no//rgya brtson 'grus seng ges rgya gar la lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi bka' sgo ltar jo bo rje spyan 'dren par phebs pa'i skor gong du rags tsam zhus zirna cing / jo bo rje dang mnyam du phebs skabs bal yul du rab byung dang po'i lcags 'brug spyi lo 10bhed+ngha lor sku gshegs/ khong gi mes po'i rgyud ni srong btsan sgam po'i sku dus jo bo spyan 'dren pa'i gyad mi lha dga'i rgyud dang khri srong skabs kyi rgya sang shi dang / sba gsal snang gnyis spyang 'di'i rgyud yin par grags/ nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba ni lcags phag spyi lo 1011 lor mnga' ris rdzong dga'i lha gdong zhes pa'i sa char nag tsho'i gdung rgyud du 'khrungs/ rab tu byung ba'i mtshan la tshul khrims rgyal ba dang / 'dul ba mkhas par mkhyen pas 'dul ba 'dzin par yang grags/ rgya brtson seng la mngon pa gsan/ dgung lo nyer bdun pa rab byung dang po'i me glang spyi lo 1037 lor jo bo rje spyan 'dren par rgya gar la byon pa de nas jo bo rje lo bcu dgu'i bar tshul bzhin du bsten cing / jo bo rje bod du spyan drangs pas bod khams yongs la bka' drin che ba dang / skabs der bod ston thams cad kyis kyang slob dpon zhes bya bar brjod/ nag tsho snye thang nas mnga' ris su byon khar jo bos bslab bya mang po mdzad pa dang / dam tshig gsum bkod kyi sku phyag tu bzung nas byin rlabs mdzad/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa dang / gsang 'dus rgyud dpe/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs skor sogs sbas chos nyi shu gnang / lung bstan mang du mdzad de jo bo nyid 332

kyi sku mthe bong tsam se ldeng la bris te ga'ur bcug nas dpung par btags/de rjes nag 4ོsa p+ta na a ka ra dang / bal po sharnyi bha dra/ nag po dmyo/ tshig rdorje la sogs pa bsten nas 'gyur yang mang po mdzad/ de rjes jo bo rjes lung bstan pa bzhin sgrub pa mdzad pas nyams rtogre/sdo/ khyad par can 'khrungs par grags shing / dgung lo nga dgu pa rab byung dang po'i shing 'brug spyi lo1༷phyo4lor sku gshegs/rngog blo ldan shes rab ni/ rngog chos skyabs kyi sras su rab byung dang po'i spo phag spyi lo10'a9lor 'khrungs/ gzhon nu'i dus nas khu bo rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyi drung du byon zhing / khu bo dang gzus kyi slob ma sbo chung ba tshul khrims shes rab gnyis la bsten nas rab tu byung ba dang /khong gnyis la gsan pa mang du mdzad pas khong gi shes rab la khu bo mnyes nas dgung lo bcu bdun bzhes pa'i tshe kha cher slob gnyer la brdzangs/de'i tshe rwa lo/ gnyan lo/ khyung po chos brtso na/ rdo ston/ btsan kha bo che rnams dang 'grogs nas byon pas mnga' bdag rtse ldes dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi sde snod 'dzin pa snyan grags can rnams mnga' ris su spyan drangs nas me 'brug lo'i chos 'khor mdzad pa dang thug cing / rtse sde'i sras dbang phyug ldes yon bdag bya bar chad nas kha cher byon/ paṇ+ḍi ta sadz+dza na dang prad ra hi ta bha dra la sogs pa drug tsam bsten/ 'ar skabs rgyags chad de kha che nas gser slong bya ba'i yi ge mnga' riṭaṭa sngi/ btang ba las dbang phyug ldes gser mang po yang bskur/ tshad spe rgyan sgyur cig phywa ba'i zhu ba yang byung bas/ paṇ+ḍi ta skal ldan rgyal po dang / rngog gis 333

bsgyur cing der kha cher lo bcu bdun ring yang dag par sbyangs te slar bod du byon/ de nas bod du yang paṇ+ḍi ta 'bucha/ phrag gsum pa dang / su ma ti bīrti gnyis la chos gsan zhing bal por yang yud cig byon nas a ru ra badz+ra dang / ba ran+d+ra ru ci la sogs pa la gsan pa yang mdzad nas bod du dam pa'i chos mang po bsgyur ba'i grangs tshad skor gro lung pas/dam chos sgyur la mnga' bsnyes pa//rgyal yum gnyis dang bstan bcos gzhung //'bum phrag gcig dang khri phrag gsum// stong phrag bdun ni lhag bcas bsgyur//ces gsungs pa'i bsgyur grangs ni sho lo ka'i grangs la ngos 'dzin dgos/khong gis lha sa dang / bsam yas/ gnyal sgang sogs su gzhung chen po'i bshad pa rgya cher mdzad skabs mkhas btsun gyi dge 'dun khri stong mang po 'dus pa bcas mthar dgung lo lnga bcu nga gcig pa rab byung gnyis pa'i sa glang spyi lo1109lor bsam yas ma ri'i drung du sku gshegs/spu rangs legs pa'i shes rab bam/ lo chung legs pa'i shes rab kyis bde mchog gi chos skor mang po rgya gar nas spyan drangs sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu gzhol bas sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du byon par grangs shing /spyir lo chen rin chen bzang po'i slob ma lo chung ste gnyis ka la spu rangs lo chung zhes gras/sa shing / gnyis ka'i mtshan legs pa'i shes rab tu 'dod pa du ma byung yang / snga ma'i mtshan ni grags 'byor shes rab dang / phyi byibyi4

ma'i mtshan legs pa'i shes rab yin la sku lus 'dis mkha' spyod du gshegs pa ni phyi mar snang zhes dpa' bo gtsug lag phring bas gsungs so//zangs dkar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab ni/ mnga' ris zangs dkar du 'khrungs/ kha che dgon pa ba dang / kha che dzñā na shrī sogs bsten/rnam sras kyi chos skor rgya gar nas sbyan drangs/ lha sa'i sprang tshang bton/lhas dang bsam yas/ mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bco lnga tsam la zhig gso phul phyin mdzad/ sgyur nyi ma dang spal ti sems dpa' chen po sogs zangs dkar gyi bu bzhi byung / phyis chu mig ring mor 'das zhes grags/'brog mi shākyayishes ni/ chu sbrul spyi lo9rdzo3lor mang mkhar du sku 'khrungs/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi chos 'byung ltar na smad kyi lde gsum po krom pa lha rtser bzhugs pa'i dus rgyan gong du lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug la bka' bstsal te mkhan po rgya shākya gzhon nu/ slob dpon se ye shes brtson 'grus/ gsang ston nyang rdo je rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i dge slong bdun/ dge tshul gnyis/ dge bsnyen gcig dang bcu spyan drangs te grom pa rgyang du dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs pa'i dus su rab tu byung /skabs der rab byung sum brgya tsam 'dus pa'i nang nas 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes/ stag lo gzhon nu brtson 'grus/ leng gzhon nu gsumamakhan slob rgyal po dang bcas pas rgya gar du chos slob tu btang / bstanapa'i rtsa ba yin pas 'dul ba/ bstan pa'i snying po yin pas phar phyin/ba༈na pa'i nyang khu yin pas gsang sngags slobs shig ces bkas rab tu cha byi35

gdams pa las/ 'brig mis mkhas pa sgo drug dang dpa' bod spyo rje las mdo rgyud pye/ zab don bzhes/ khyad par pyi sa da ya dh+wa ra bod du byon pa la gser srang lnga brgya phul te kye rdor rgyud gsum/ ra li/ a ra li bzhi la sogs pa'i rgyud dang / gsung ngag rin ngo/ che'i bdud rtsi bzhes nas bstan pa spel ba'i slob ma'i gtso bo man ngag tshar ba gsum/ rgyud tshar ba lnga/ grub pa thob pa bdun sogs byung / gsung ngag rin po che sogs kyi bstan pa la bka' drin che/ 'brog mis rgya gar dang bal yul du lo bcu gsu 8 tsa6/ bzhugs/ dgung lo nga gnyis pa chu lug spyi lo1043lor mang mkhar myu/ gu lung btab cing / ga ya bha ra dang mjal nas lo gsum ring gsung ngag gsan pa dang / de nas dgung lo drug cu re gsum yan la 'chad stan spel bar mdzad pa dang / de nas zhi bar ma gshegs bar sgrub pa gtso bor mdzad/ mthar dgung lo brgyad cu gya lnga pa rab byung dang po'i shing stag spyi lo1074lor sku gshegs/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes 'di ni dpal ldan sa skya pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i chos rgyud kyi chu 'go yin no//lho brag mar pa chos kyi blo gros ni/ yab mar pa dbang phyug 'od zer dang / yum rgyal mo 'od zer gnyis la sras ming sring bzhi yod pa'i tshigs gnyis par chu byi spyi lo1013lor lho phu chu khyer du klu/ 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas slob dpon klu brgyad pa zhig las yi ge 'bri klog gsan sbyo nga mdzad/khong gzhon nu'i sma// bas spyod pa shin tu mi srun pas slob dpon dang gros/sa po gcig min pa su'i khyim du yang mi tshud pas yab kyi dgongs pa la khong 336

gzhan zhig tu slob gnyer la btang na shed —bye ba srid dacha/ snyam nas dkung lo bco lnga pa'i thog rje 'brog mi'i drung du rta bzang po seng ldeng gi sga can gcig gis sna drangs pa'i 'bul ba mang po bskur nas brdzangs par khong ni lo tsā shes 'dod che bas/ lo tsā bslabs pas legs par mkhyen/de rjes khong gi dgongs par rje 'brog mi'i chos rnams la yo byad mang si+o da gos pa 'di ni rgya gar nas byung ba yin/ da nga rang yang chos slob par rgya gar la 'gro snyam pa'i thugs 'dun shugs chen 'khrungs te rgya gar la phebs chas 'aritshol bar rang yul du phebs nas gser btsal bas gser srang bco lnga tsam zhig rnyed pa de'i khar/ las stod klog skya jo sras kyis gser dang zhwa lham/ tshun chad bskur te rgya gar la brdzangs/ khong bal por byon pa'i tshe gnyos kha rag pa dang chabs cig byung bas gnyos kyis zhal nas khyod la gser ci yang mi 'dug pas nga'i g.yog gyis/ chos nga dang mnyam du zhus chog gsungs rung / khong gis de 'dra rang ma gnang ba bal por lo gsum ring bal po spyi ther ba la dpal gdan bzhi pa la sogs pa rgyud 'ga' gsan cing / de rjes bal po ban+de pas 'go 'dren mdzad de pudzi ha rir rje nā ro pa'i drung du bskyal cing / dge tshul shes rab seng ge zhes bya bas kyang nā ro par zhu sna gnang bas khong gi thugs la btags te kye rdo rje'i dbang rang yang lan bdun bstsal/ gzhan rgyud sgrub thabs rdzogs rim gyi man ngag rnams kyang legs par gnang / rgya gar nub phyogs su la k+ṣe tra'i grong du bla ma thar pa lam ston nam ye shes snying po la gsang 'dus rgyud rkyang gi lugs rnams legs par gsan/ slar nā ro pa'i drung du byon 337

nas sgron gsal ba'i bshad pa legs par gsan/ ma snya mā yā yang dbangabyin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa rdzogs par gnang / de nas bod du byon te/ lha mo rudud sol ma la brten nas byang phyogs su phyug po 'ga'i sri'u gso ba mdzad pa'i sri'u re re la gsos pa'i yon (gser) srang bcu bcu phabs/ nam ra'i gser kha rdol ba dang 'dzoms pa dang / tsam lung gi mar pa mgo yags bya ba des rus gcig pa'i zhen gyis dbang zhus shing /nye 'bangs dang bcas pa la gser 'bul du bcug pas phyag tu gser mang po byung rjes mar pa mgo yags kyis skyid rong gi la tshun phebs skyel zhul te bal yul brgyud slar yang rgya gar la byon nas yul dbus su phebs pa'i tshe nā ro pa spyod pa la gshegs zin nas mjal ma thub rung / nā ro pa spyod par gshegs khar slob ma rnams la rten skal so sor gnang ba'i nang du mar pa'i skal ba yin zer ba zhig kyang 'jog gnang mdzad pa thob/skabs der bla ma gzhan la chos 'dra gsan cing / kye rdor rgyud la gzigs rtogs mdzad pa na nā ro pa tshol ba'i 'dul pa shugs chen 'khrungs te rgya gar gyi shar phyogs dang / lho phyogs kyi yul gru du mar phebs shing /gso ri ba la sogs pa'i grub thob mang po dang yang mjal/ rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma gzhan 'ga' re la yang gdams pa sna tshogs gsan pa bcas dad 'dun shugs drag gi sgo nas nā ro pa btsal bas nam zhig nags gseb cig tu mjal te gser rnams phul bas thams cad sa la gtor bar cung yid ma ches pa na/ nā ro'i zhabs kyi mthe bong sa la reg pas sa de gser du song / zhal nas kyang thams cad gser gling yin no gsungs 338 —

te mi snang bar gshegs/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe gnyis pa'i skabs slar yang bod du byon skabs bal yul du bla ma pham mthing ba la sogs pa'i bla ma rnams kyi drung du nā ro pa'i yon tan dang / rang nyid kyi ngang tshul rnams klur blangs te bla ma mched grogs rnams kyang dgyes par mdzad cing / bod du phebs rjes yul sa bzung / bdag med ma yang btsun mor bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang btsun mo ma phyag rgyar sdo ba brgyad tsam yod pa bcas btsun mo dgu po 'di ni kye rdor gyi lha mo dgu dang sbyor ba yin zhes grags/de rjes mi tre pa'i bsngags pa gsan pas thugs 'phrog ste slar yang rgya gar la byon nas rgya gar shar phyogs su mai tre pa dang mjal/ rgyud kyi gsan pa mang po yang mdzad/ phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag gis mngon sum gyi rtogs pa 'khrungs te/ rje mnga' bdag chen po'i bka' drin gyis/ /gzhi chos nyid skye bar med par rtogs/ /sems stong pa nyid la sbar zin byas/ /mi kho bo'i spros pa de nas chod/ /ces gsungs nas slar yang bod du phebs/de rjes bal yul du chos gsan par lan gnyis byon nas bla ma rnams las chos mang po gsan/ de nas phyir byon pa'i lam du bal po rdzong pas sho gam 'dod pa'i phyir bod rnams skyel bas der zhag 'ga' zhig bzhugs pa'i rmi lam du bud med cig gis phrag pa la khur nas dpal gyi ri la sa ra ha pa'i drung du bskyal/ sa ra has gdam ngag gnang zhing byin gyis brlabaca/ pas snang srid thams cad ro gcig pa'i myong ba yang dag pa 'khrungs par grags/de nas las stod du klog skya ston pas bsnyen bkur zhus pa dang /339

gtsang rong du phebs skabs mes tshon pos zhing zho gcig gi sa tshos dang bur ltang gis bkang ste phul nas chos zhuṭa ge pas/ kye rdo rje'i rgyud bshad pa dang bcas te legs par gsungs pa dang / lhag par du gdam ngag gnas bas mes tshon po la 'od gsal gyi ye shes yang dag par 'khrungs/de nas gro bo lung du phebs nas slob ma mang du bskyangs pa la/ dol pa gag ston/ gre'i mi'u chung / chu gong dpal le/ dge bshes khe gad bcas thugs kyi sras bzhir grags pa dang / gzhan yange slob ma dbu che bcu zhes bya ba byung ste mjal ba la snga ba'i klog skya 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan/byang tsam lung gi mar pa mgo yags/ rngog gzhung pa/ 'tshur dbang nge /mes tshon po/ lha rje se rings/ rgya ston zhig po/ mar pa bya ze ba/myang sgom sprang nyag rje btsun mi la rnams so//de rnams las gzhung gi rngog chos sku rdo rje la bshad rgyud kyi bka' babs/ dol gyi tshur ston dbang nge la 'pho ba'i bka' babs/ gtsang rong gi mes tshon po la 'od gsal gyi bka' babs/ gung thang gi mi la ras pa la bde drod kyi bka' babs bcas slob ma'i mchog gam ka chen bzhi yang zer te snga ma gsum gyis bde kye sogs bshad pa'i srol bzung ba dang / rje mi las bka' babs bzhi'i gdams pa'i bcud sgrub pa'i srol bzung ba yin no//rngog chos sku rdo rjes dang por rta bzang zhig phyag rten du bsnams te lho brag tu mar pa mjal bar phebs pa la mar pas khyod kyi 'di chos zhu ba'i zhu rten yin na ni chung / zhal mjal ba'i rten yin na ni che zhes gsungs par grarga/sa shing / skabs der dbang dang gdamasaci pa 'ga' re gnang / phyis 340

ri bor spyan drangs nas 'bri gnag bdun cu spra dang / khyi dang / she ma/zo ba gcig rnams kyang phul bar kye rdo rje/ bshad pa'i rgyud gur/ dpal gad na bzhi pa/ ma hā mā yā rnams gnang ba ma zad/ zab khrid kyis kyang bskyangs/de lta bu'i mar pa lo tsā bas 'phags yul du bla ma brgya rtsa brgyad dang /bshad srol 'dzin pa lnga bcu/ snang ba 'gyur nges bcu gsum/ khyad par 'phags/ pa'i bla ma bzhi rnams bsten pa las phyi ma khyad par 'phags pa bzhi ni byang phu la ha rir nā ro pa bsten/ rgyud kye rdo rje bsre 'pho gsan/ nub lak+ṣi trar dpal ye shes snying po bsten/ rgyud gsang 'dus dang sgyu lus 'od gsal gsan/ lho dug mtsho khol mar dpal zhi ba bzang po bsten/rgyud ma hā mā yā dang / dbyibs rnal 'byor gsum gsan/ shar chu bo gasgo'ici 'gram du mai tre pa bstan/ rtud bstod pa glu dbyangs dang / phyag chen gsan pa bcas dpal dwagari4 po 0ka' rgyud ces pa'i grub mtha' chen po'i srol 'byed pa'i mdzad pa bla na ma/ mchis pa bskyangs mthar dgung lo gya bzhi pa rab byung gnyis dzopre'e shing phag spyi lo 1༷9lālor sku gshegs/gnyan lo dar ma grags kyis rgya gar du lo bcu gnyis bzhugs/ paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti bsten/ paṇ+ḍi ta pukhye shrī gdan drangs te spyod 'jug 'grel chen dang / sgrol ma/ chonu/ skyong la sogs chos mang du bsgyur/ khyad par du mgon po zhal bzhi pa smyan drangs/ phyis rwa lo dang mthu 'gran pas gnyi ga gshegs skad/d+dha/gos lha sa bcas kyis (mar pa dang byon dus mtshungs pa) rgya gar du 34/

lan gsum byon/ paṇ+ḍi ta bdun cu don gnyis la chos/ zhus/ khyad par du zhi ba bzang po dang sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po la sogs pa bsten cing /gsang 'dus 'phags skor/ bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ gdan bzhi/ma hā mā yā/ kye rdo rje'i rgyud gsum la sogs pa bsgyur/khong ni rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi blon po mgos khri bzang yab lhag ste bod kyi 'phrul blon mdzangs mi bdun gyi drug pa de'i rgyud pa ste de yang mgos khri bzang yab lhag gi sras mgos khyung rgod rtsal dang rdo rje rtsal/mgos khyung rgod rtsal gyi sras mgon ri sprin dang / g.yung dpal/ don rin/ shes rab 'phel dang bzhi/ mgon ri sprin gyi sras mgos nam dar dang / don rin/ rgyal rgyal dang gsum/ mgos nam/ dar gyi sras mgos g.yung drung skyabs/ ye shes skyabs/ btsun gcung dang gsum/mgos btsun chung gi sras mgos khug pa lhas btsas 'di yin/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi chos log sun 'byin pa la lo chen rin bzang gi rjes su mgos khug pa lhas btsas 'di bka' drin che ba yin te sdom gsum rab dbye las/de dag 'das pa'i 'og tu yang //chos log 'ga' zhig 'phel ba'i rgyus//lhas btsas zhes bya'i lo tsā ba//des kyang sngags log sun 'byin pa//zhes bya'i bstan bcos mdzad nas ni//chos dang chos min rnam par dbye//zhes gsungs pa ltar lags so//byi4nyu

gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis rab byung dang po'i me yos spyi lo 1d+ngha3gyilor bod du dus 'khor thog mar bsgyur ba de nas bod du rab byung rtsi ba'i 'go tshugs shing / khong gis da dung bdud rtsi/ bde mchog la sogs pa'i skor yang mang du bsgyur/klog skya shes rab brtsegs kyis mtshan brjod dang sgrol ma'i skor/ dbu ma 'jug pa sogs bsgyur/mal gro blo gros grags kyis rgya gar nas mgon po'i chos skor du ma spyan drangs te mgen po'i dngos slob rgya gar gyi slob dpon aṇa 7sa la gsan pa gri khug lcags par ma smyul pa nyi ma 'bar la gnang nas phyis ber nag can du grags/ bram ze mchog sred nas shārta ka ra/ lo chen rin bzang / brag seng pa yon tshul la gsan pa gri gug gcer bu ni sa chen kun snying la gnang ste phyis gur mgon du grags so//rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags pa ni/ mdo khams smad mi nyag gi yul du 'khrungs/ phe'u gad pa 'khor lo grags dang / spang zho gsal ba grags dang mnyam du paṇ+ḍi ta a bha ya ka ra gusnya bsten nas dus 'khor/ phreng ba skor gsum/ thub pa dgongs rgyan/ man ngag snye ma bcas bsgyur ba dang / rgya gar rdo rje gdan du ston pa'i rgyal tshab kyang mdzad/rgyus smon lam grags kyis paṇ+ḍi ta gzhan la phan pa bsten te sdom 'byung bsgyur ro//pa tshab nyi ma grags ni 'phan yul pa tshab stod du rab byung dang po'i shing lug snyi lo 19'amelor 'khrungs/ gzhon nu'i dus kha cher byon te bye4 3

salje na'i sras gnyis la sogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta mang po la chos lo nyi shu rtsa gsum gsan sbyong mjad nas/ bod du phebs pa'i tshe spu hrangs pa'i dge 'dun spyis g.yu bo che phag skur zer ba zhig phul na sa mdzod byi/ 'grel pa gang ba spel gyis mdzad pa de bsgyur bar zhus pa bzhin bsgyur/ 'phan yul du phebs dus gdul bya ha cangaspyomi che ba la dge ba'i bshes gnyen sha ra bas rang gi grwa pa mang po khong la dbu ma slob tu btang ba de nas dbu ma'i 'chad nyan legs par tshugs te slob ma mak+to du bskyangs/ rtsa 'jug gzhi gsum/rig pa drug cu pa rnams kyi 'grel pa slob dpon zla bas mdzad pa legs par bsgyur/ phyis ra mo cher paṇ+ḍi ta ka na ka warma dang lhan cig tu yul dbus kyi dpe dang mthun par bcos/yang slob dpon zla bas mdzad pa'i stong nyid bdun cu pa'i 'grel chen sngar a bha ya dang / snur dharma grags kyes bsgyur ba de'i khrod nas bam po gnyis lhag tsam paṇ+ḍi ta mu di ta dang lhan/ du bsgyur bcos pa dang gsang 'dus 'grel pa sgron gsal gyi bsgyur bcos kyang yang dag pa mdzad/ 'dus pa'i skor mang po bsgyur pa dang / 'chad nyan yang mdzad/ slob ma rnams kyi nang nas gtsang pa sar sbos/ rma bya byang chub ye shes/ dar yon tan grags/ zhang thang sag pa ye shes 'byung gnas bcas la spa tshab kyi bu ba zhir grags shing / slob ma bzang po de rnams la brten nas dbus gtsang du dbu ma'i bshadwa pa dang / bye brag tu slob dpon phywa pa'i seng chen rma bya byang brtson gyis spa tshab la dbu ma dang / 'dus pa gnyis ka gsan te yar lung gi stod smad du cho sa gzhi spos shing / dbu ma'i bshad ba yun 344

ring mdzad/ btsan thang pa rgyal ba dpal la sogs pa'i slob ma mang po byung zhing dbu ma shin tu dar bar mdzad pa bcarurna so /ba ri rin chen grags ni/ khams su 'khrungs/ khong gis paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje spyan drangs te don zhags dang / srung ba lnga/ rnam rgyal ma/ rnam 'jom gyi skor/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa la sogs pa bsgyur/ don zhags la gtso bor mdzad nas thugs rje chen po zhal gzigs/ rgya gar du mu stegs kyi rgyal pos mi brgya phrag glud du gsod pa gser gang yod kyis blus shing / gtso bor don zhags kyi sko/ra la 'phrin las che ba lags/'bro shes rab grags kyis kha cher byon pa dang / paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba mgon po spyan drangs te dus 'khor cha lag rgyas pa dang / rdo rje snying 'grel/ phyag rdor bstod 'grel la sogs pa bsgyur/rwa chen rdo rje grags kyis bal po thugs rje chen po bsten nas dgra nag 'jigs byed skor gsum dang / ho ru ka mngon 'byung gi rgyud la sogs pa bsgyur to//ba reg thos pa dga' dang / rma chos 'bar/ mtshur dbyig gi rgyal mtshan gsum gyis rgya gar phyag na rdo rje bsten nas phyag rgya chen po'i grub pa'i skor dang / snying po'i skor/ do ha skor gsum dang / do ha mdzod/mai tre pa'i bde mchog la sogs pa bsgyur/dbyal pa kun dga' rdo rjes bal po hang du dkar po bsten nas paṇ+ḍi ta stong nyid ting nge 'dzin spyan drangs te man ngag mang po zhus so//mar pa do pa chos kyi dbang phyug ni/ ya 'brog do nang du rab byung 345

dang po'i chu rta spyi lo 1071 lor 'khrungs shing / bde mchog gi skor mang du bsgyur ro//sum pa dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rjes rdo rje gdan du sgrol ma dang /phas/ mo las blo sbyong snyan rgyud gsan pas rtogs pa 'khrungs shing / bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho gtso bor spyan drangs so//rwa pa chos rab ni/ rwa lo rdo rje grags kyi dbon po yin/ khong gis paṇ+ḍi ta sa masnya shrī spyan drangs te dus 'khor/ phag mo mngon 'byung / mgon su mngon 'byung la sogs pa bsgyur to//chag lo dgra bcom gyis rgya gar du byon nas/ rgyal b.ri/ lam 'jug la sogs pa bsgyur/gnubs sam khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal lam tshul khrims shes rab ni/ rab byung gsum pa'i chu sbrul spyi lo 117kālor 'khrungs/ thog mar rab byung gsum pa'i sa rta spyi lo 1198 lor/ bod du shrī dza gat+ta mi tra a nasto zhes me tra dzo ki spyan drangs te bde chen ral gcig skor dang /sems nyid ngal gso'i skor/ bsten pa'i gru la sogs pa bsgyur to//de nas kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta burta shrī snyan spyan drangs te mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa shes rab sgron ma dang / rgyal ba'i lam 'jug dang / thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa la sogs pa bsgyur to/ /de nas rab byung gsum pa'i shing byi spyi lo 1304lor bod du kha che shākya shrī bha dra spyan drangs te dpyal chos bzang gis nā ro'i 'grel chen bsgyur te de'i bshad bka' man ngag dang bcas pa gnang / byams pa'i dpal gyis 'dul ba me 346

tog phreng rgyud dang / rdo rje phreng ba/ bde mchog la sogs pa bsgyur/bstan pa snga dar dang / phyi dar bar gyi lo tsā ba'i bsdur tshad skor/bstan pa snga dar skabs thu mi sam bho ṭa nas nam mkha' skyong gi bar lo tsā ba lnga bcu nga brgyad byung yod cing / bstan pa phyi dar skabs lo chen rin bzang nas jo nang tā ra nā tha phan lo tsā ba brgya dang lnga bcu nga bdun byung yod pa nas sa phaṇa tshun chad lo tsā ba sum cu so lnga byung ba phud pas bod sil bu'i dus rang la byon pa lo tsā ba brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gnyis zin pa de bstan pa snga dar gyi brgya cha 210phrozin pa dang / de rjes kyi lo tsā bas bstan pa snga dar gyi brgya cha 60phrozin pa bcas so//bstan pa snga dar ni srong btsan sku dus nas glang dar ma phan lam tsam lo nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / dar mas bstan pa nas sa skya'i dbang sgyur 'go ma tshugs bar lo bzhi brgya bcu gcig sa skya'i dbang sgyur 'go tshugs pa nas lo chen chos skyong bzang po ma gshegs bar lo nyis brgya bdun cu don gnyis song bas cha snyoms bstan pa snga dar skabs lo bzhir nye ba rer lo tsā ba re byon pa dang / sil bu'i lo gsum dang phyed ka ma zin tsam rer lo tsā ba re/ de rjes lo brgyad la nye ba rer lo tsā ba re byon pa yin no//gsum pa/ dus rabs so so'i lo paṇa gyi bsdur tshad nas bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas la shugs rkyen gang zhig byung yod pa/gong gsal dus rabs so so'i lo paṇa gyi bsdur tshad grangs 'bor nas gsal por mthong thub pa ni bod sil bu'i dus bod du lo paṇa mang byi47

co/sa byon pa de'i thog nas btsan po'i rgyal rabs kyi bka' drin la brten — nas bod la sangs rgyas chos lugs dar ba dang chabs cig mi rigs kyi rig gzhung 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i btsan po rnams kyi dgongs pa de dmangs sems kyi gtad phyogs 'ba' zhig tu bsgyur ba dang / dgongs pa de dag rjes 'jug rnams kyis rang rtogs kyi sgo nas rgyun 'dzin lhod med byed pa'i bya spyod cig la bsgyur ba de mtshon/ bstan pa snga dar skabs bod du paṇ+ḍi ta rim par byon pa rnams rtsa ba'i cha nas btsan po che ge mos garnan zhu gnang ba sha stag las mang tshogs rang 'gul gyis gdan zhu byas pa ha lam med 'dra bas skabs der gzhung phyogs gcig pu'i nus par tshad yod pas skabs der paṇ+ḍi ta bod du gdan zhu bya rgyur shugs ma thub kyi tshad bkag yong srid pa ni gtso bo'i phyogs dang / sangs rgyas chos lugs dang bon po'i bar chos lugs grub mtha'i 'gal ba des kyang btsan po'i dgongs pa lag bstar bya rgyur 'gog rkyen yong srid pa dang / 'gog rkyen byung ba'i gnas tshul mang dag gleng du yod pa de yang gnad don phal pa'i gras su gtogs yod /bstan pa phyi dar skabs rgya gar nas paṇ+ḍi ta gdan zhu bya rgyu'i skor skabs de'i dbang 'dzin kha 'thor du gnas pa'i rkyen gyis gu ge rgyal pos bkas mngags pa lta bu gzhung phyogs nas gdan zhu byas pa nyung shas las ma che ba mkhas pa che se/ mos thabs shes yod rgu rtsal sprugs kyis chos lugs dang / mi rigs ris/ gnas gong 'phel gtong ba'i slad du rang nyid rgya gar la phebs te gsan bsam gnang pa dang / bod du paṇ+ḍi ta gdan zhu 348

gnang yod/'on kyang skabs der paṇ+ḍi ta bod la gdan zhu gnang ba dang / rgya gar la phebs te gsan bsam gnang rgyu de lhag bsam tsam la brten nas gnang thub pa zhig rtsa ba nas min/ de'i skor sngon byon mkhas pa'i mdzad rnam mang po'i nang 'khod yod pa nas rtogs nus pa ma zad/ chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa'i nang bstan par/ ‘‘skabs der bod nas rgya gar dang / ne pā la/ karmir bcas la phebs mkhan lo tsā ba tshos ma mthar yang lo bdun bzhugs dgos pa dang / 'ga' zhig lo nyi shu tsam bzhugs mkhan byung yod pa'i slob yon dang / 'gro song thad lo gcig gam yang na lo gsum ldang ba bsnams dgos pa dang / de rdzogs mtshams slar yang bod du phebs te gser gang mang thabs shes gnang nas bskyar du slob sbyong gnang bar phebs dgos/ bstan pa phyi dar skabs kyi tsha/ tsā ba mi grangs brgya dang lnga bcu nga gsum gyis phyi rgyal la slob sbyong gnang ba'i lo grangs cha snyoms lo dgu dang / lo re'i 'gro song gser srang brgyad cu re btang bar cha bzhag na lo dgu'i ring 'gro gron du gser srang chig 'bum chig khri dgu stong brgya dang drug cu tham pa song ’’lugs 'khod pa ltar gser phyir gyar ba'i grangs 'khor che tsam yin rung / khong tsho phyi rgyal la phebs nas slob sbyong gnang ba'i 'bras bu bod la khyab spel gyis bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas gong 'phel song ba'i rin thang ni bsamyo5 badzad las 'das pa ma zad/ da lta yang 'dzam gling mi rigs kyi nang du sa/na' rabs kyi rig gnas shin tu phun sum tshogs po su la'ang smon mi dkaus pa 'di byung ba 349
dron canapa rlabamu

skabs bcu gamyug pa/ bod sil bu'i dus dar ba'i sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi grub mtha' khag gi skor/dang po/ bka' gdams pa'i skor /1 bka' gdams zhes pa'i grub mtha'i sgra bshad la mi 'dra ba 'ga' mchis kyang / ches yongs su grags pa dang don la sbyor ba ni/ rje tsong kha pa chen pos spyan snga rin chen 'phel la bka' gdams zhes bya ba'i don ci yin bka' 'dri gnang bar spyan sngas rgyal ba'i bkaX' las yi ge na gcig kyang bzhag tu med par gdums ngag tu go ba la zer ba yin zhus pas de yin zhes mnyes pa chen po mjod pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi bka' sde snod gsu ma gyi don thams cad ma lus pa a ti sha'i gdams pa skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim par bsdus nas nyams su len pas na bka' gdams pa zhes bya ba yin/de la 'dir bka' gdams bstan pa'i shing rta chen po jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha gdan drangs pa'i skor gong du gsal zhing / jo bo rjes bod du bstan pa'i dag ther dang bka' gdams kyi srol phye ba'i mdzad pa gtso che ba rnams khong gi mchog tu gyur pa'i thugs sra sa ba—ka' gdams bstan pa'i srol 'byed pa po 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi lo rgyus dang sbrags 'phros na/'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ni/ yab sku gshen yag gzher — 351

'phin dang / yum khu 'od bza' gnyis kyi sras su shing 'brug spyi lo10sgro4 lor stod lung gi phu rtsa skye mo'i sa char sku 'khrungs/ yum snga mo nas grongs rjes yab kyis ma yar gcig bzhes pa de dang thugs ma mthun pa ma yar dang 'thab pa bas gzhan du 'byon pa dga' bar dgongs nas dgung lo bcu gsum tsam la gzhu ru zhang po'i sar byon te lo bzhi bzhugs ring dge bshes g.yung chos mgon bya bas klog yig bslabs/dgung lo bcu bdun lor jo bo se btsun khams nas rgya gar la byon pa dang mjal bas dad pa skyes te se btsun nas thugs rje chen po yi ge drug pa'i gdams pa zhus/se btsun bal yul nas phyir log byon skabs 'brom dang mjal bas 'brom gyis phyag phyir 'khrid par zhus pas khyed sang phod tshong pa dang 'grogs la shog da res khri na byis pa brkus nas khrid zer du 'ong gsungs/de nas 'brom gyis rgyal gyi zhang sna nad+dha rdo rje dbang phyug las dge bsnyen 3 sdom pa mnos te mtshan rgyal ba'i 'byung gam/sa su gsol//dgung lo bcu dgu pa chu khyi 'i spyi lo 1d+ngha33 lor se btsun mjal bar mdo khams 'dan ma'i yul du tshong pa dang 'grogs nas byon te se btsun dang mjal 'dzoms byung ba de nas bzung bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas tshul bzhin du bsten te/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa bas bla ma madre da pa phan che bar dgongs te rang gi bla ma se btsun gyi nang gi zhabs tog phye 'thag pa yan chod dang / phyi rol du rta phyugs mang po yod pas nyin par de rnams kyi rji bo mdzad/ nub mo rta bzang la zhon 'khor gsum tsher ma 352

'dra ba byas te me' 'tshe mdzad/de'i tshe bla ma se btsun gyi spyan sngar mdo sngags kyi chos gzhung myo/tha' yaca/ pa la sbyang brtson gnang ba dang / lhag par klu sgrub yab sras kyi gzhung dbu ma'i skor dang / byams chos sde lnga/ thogs med sku mched kyi gzhung sogs spyod phyogs rnadu /ca/ la sbyang brtson mthar phyin pa mdzad/ dge 'dun byi nga ma'i khrod du bgro gleng mdzad par sus kyang la'o/ 'dom/ spobs par ma nus nas mkhas pa'i phul du phyin par grags shing / de'i lo dge 'dun rnams kyis mkhas pa chen po 'di lta bu rta bong gi rji bo dang yos 'thag pa so0/sa ngan las la bkol du phangs pas da phyin chad ngan las gnang ma dgos pa chos grwar phebs chog pa dgos zhes bla ma se btsun la zhus nas de bzhin du gnang / de'i dus khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung dang / rngog legs pa'i shes rab gnyis kyang chos grwa der bzhugs pas khu rngog 'brom gsum zhes pa'ang thog ma khams su grags pa yin/de nas 'brom gyi dgongs par chos rnal ma zhig byed na 'di tsam gyis chog gam mi chog rgya gar mkhas pa 'i/ga la brten par bar du lo tsā ba mi dgos pa bya dgongs nas paṇ+ḍi ta sgra'i tshes ma dang / smri ti dzñā na kirti phyogs der byon pa la saṃskṛ ta'i skad dang yi ge yang bslabs pas legs par mkhyen cing / de dus 'brom gyis paṇ+ḍi ta sgri ti la rgya gar na da lta paṇ+ḍi ta che ba ji skad bya ba yod dris pas/ che bgres nā ro pa dngasu/ shārnyi pa bya ba gnyis yod pa da tsam bzhugs yod min mi shes/ da lta bzhugs nges pa paṇ+ḍi ta dri paṃ ka ra bya ba rgyu95 rigs las rab tu byung ba zhig yod pa de rang che ba 353

yin sa/sungs pas de dang mjal la rings pa zhig byung / de ltar 'brom gyis mdo khams su bla ma se btsun gyi spyan sngar dgung lo so dgu'i bar lo nyi shu bzhugs shing / mdo sngags kyi chos mang du gsan te mkhas pa'i phul du phyin nas dge bsnyen chos 'phel du grags pa byung /de nas jo bo rje mnga' ris su phebs pa gsan pas se btsun la mnga' ris su 'gro ba'i gnang ba zhus par dgyes bzhin du dpe cha rta khal gcig gnang nas mnga' ris su jo bo mjal bar byon pas byang lam du sleb tsa na mnga' ris kyi lha bla ma khu dbon gyis jo bo rje lha cig bya ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po zhig gdan drangs nas yod pa ring por mi thogs pa rgya gar la phyir log phebs kyi yod skad bcas jo bo'i mtshan thos pa gyis thugs rang dbang med par g.yos te dad gus bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'khrungs/de nas jo bo 'jal du byon pa'i lam bar sog chu khar phebs pa na khang pa gcig na ku di ri 'dug par 'di na ci yod dris par/ 'phrang kha ber chung gi yab ber chen gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs dang / sring po rnams bsdu ba'i chang yod pa yin zer bas/ thag ring nas byon pas der skyem bskrur byon par 'phrang kha ber chung gis khyod chos grwa nas 'ongs pa'i dge bsnyen zhig 'dug ste nga yang 'phrang kha ber chung bya ba'i mi chen zhig yin/ khyod kyis de nas nga la yar phyag wa 'khyug pa 'dra ba zhig gyis zer bas 'brom gyis kyang de bzhin du mdzad/ der ber chung chos gtam la dga' bas chos gtam mang po byas pa'i tshe 'brom gyis khong gi tshig sna re nas brdungs pas khong the tshom snyes nas khams na 'brom ston pa zer ba'i byi54

dge bsnyenachos mkhan zhig yod pa go thos byung ba de khyod e yin zhes dris par/ yin pa'ang srid gsungs pas khong ha las te khong rang sdod sa'i gdan grum rtse de phyung ste 'brom la bting / rta bzang po gcig gi thur mda' dar yug gis byas nas phul/ sngon du phyag blangs pa dang bgro gleng byas pa'i bzod gsol zhus/ ra sgrong gi sa cha 'dir dgon gnas phyag btab ste mchod gnas mdzad par zhus par 'brom gyis nga da res sdod mi khom/ stod mnga' ris su rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po zhig byon zer ba thos pas de mjal bar 'gro gsungs par 'o na rjes su nga'i mchod gnas gnang dgos zhus par/ 'brom gyis gtsigs kha gsum 'dzin dgos pa ltar byas na de ltar byed gsungs par de ci lags zhus par/ phod mdo'i mkhar 'di bshig la gtsug lag khang zhig bzhengs/ sha zan dang rtsam zan gyi 'khrug pa de bsdums/ nga'i rjes su 'di phyogs rngog legs pa'i shes rab bya ba 'ong gi de la chos tshugs/ de ma byung na g.yon ru na khu ston blo rnon po bya ba yod/ de spyan drongs la chos tshugs gsungs par khong gis gzhan de ltar zhus chog sha zan gyi 'khrug pa 'di la nga re ba yin/ sngar yang 'bri drug cu tsam zos zin/ 'on kyang kham tsam med/ bsdums byas pas chog zer nas gtsigs gsum po khas blangs/de nas 'bromarme 'phan yul du byon te rgyal gyi zhang chen po dge bsnyen gyi bslab pa'i slob dpon yin pas phyag 'tshal byon/ de ska bas ka ba shākya dbang phyug dang yang mjal nas kho bo da lan mnga' ris su paṇ+ḍi ta mjal du 'gro/ de dbus su spyan 'drongs pa srid na de'i dus su yi ge gtong ba yin 355

pas/ khyed kyis mi chen rnams kyi 'dun ma mdzasdo— wa bsu ba la phebs dgos zhus par khong gis kyang de ltar khas blangs/ de nas mnga' ris su 'byor te jo bo rje dang mjal nas phyag rten du gser phul/ jo bo rjes 'brom gyi dbu thog phyag bzhag nas saṃskṛ ta'i skad du shis brjod mdzad cing byin gyis brlabs pa dang / dbang bskur yang legs par gnang /de nas 'brom ston pas jo bo rjer dri ba gsum mdzad pa ste/ rgya gar na paṇ+ḍi ta ji lta bu bya ba bzhugs yod/ nga'i snga ma'i chos de lam du song ma song / jo bo'i sku mdun du bsdad na ji ltar mchi bya ba bcas zhus par/jo bo'i zhal nas rgya gar na paṇ+ḍi ta mang po bzhugs yod pas nga bod du 'ong tsa na shar phyogs lha ga la na'ang nyin re bar ma chad par grub thob re 'byon gyi yod/ khyod kyi snga ma'i chos de lam du ye ma song / bla ma'i zhabs tog lam du song tsā/ da khyod 'di rang du sdod/ nga'i lha mo sgrol mas khyed lung bstan pa yin gyi nga'i bka' rgyud 'di la byin rlabs yod gsungs/ de'i nub mo dbu sngas sbrel te gleng mol yang zhus chog pa byung / de nas shing bya (spyi lo 10bhe')lor skyid rong la phebs nas der lo gcig bzhugs shing / jo bo rje bal po rdzong la 'byon bzhed na yang 'khrug pas lam 'gags nas phebs ma thub/ 'brom gyis dbus su lha sa dang / bsam yas la sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang rtsa chen mang po yod sa dang / dge 'dun stong phrag mang po bzhugs pa'i bsngags pa brjod pas jo bo rje'i zhal nas/ tshangs par spyod pa grangs mang po de tsam rgya gar na yang med/dgra bcom pa yang mang po yod mchi gsungs nas dbus phyogs su phyag mang 356

po mdzad/ der sgobs pa skyeru rnos shebus su 'byon par zhus pas/ kho bo dge 'dun gyi bka' mi gcog pas dge 'dun gyi bka' byung —na 'gro gsungs / de nas zhang dbang phyug mgon bya ba la/ shing rta'i dbyibs 'dra 'dzam gling gi/ zhes bya ba lam̐ sogs pa dang / ston dus tshun chad 'dir 'byon zhus/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i shog 'phrin brdzangs/ der nag tsho lo tsā ba'i thugs su jo bo dbus su 'byon par bzhed pa rig nas/jo bo'i na bza' la 'jus nas/ nga gnas brtan dang dam tshig gi chad yod pas nga dmyal bar 'gro mi phod pas cis kyang rgya gar du gshegs dgos zhus pas jo bo'i zhal nas/ lo tsā ba/ sgrub par ma nus pa la ltung ba med pa yin gsungs nas dbugs phyung / de nas nag tsho lo tsā bas gser ko gtum gcig dang / lam sgron jo bo'i phyag bris yin pa gcig pu hrangs pa'i ban+de gnyis la bskur nas gser 'di slob dpon gnas brtan la phul la da res jo bo gdan drangs pa yin te bal yul gyi lam 'gags nas phyir log da spyan 'drongs gsung na yang spyan 'dren/ jo bo yang bod la mnyes shing 'gro don yang chen po 'dug pas bzhugs chog gam bya ba dang / bstan bcos 'di ba'i ka ma la shī la'i paṇ+ḍi ta rnams la gzigs su phul cig pa'i 'phrin bskur bas gnyis pos kyang bi ka ma la shī lar slebs te gnas brtan dkon mchog 'byung gnas la gser rnams phul/ jo bo'i lo rgyus dang lo tsā ba'i 'phrin rgyas par gsol bas bstan bcos 'di shin tu legs shing / yi ge yang phyag bris ma nor bar 'dug gsungs te rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la btags nas zhag nyer gcig tu mchod pa rgya chen po mdzad/ der 357

gnas brtan gyi zhal nas jo bo 'byon du re ba yin te chos 'di phebs paṭa / jo bo dang khyad med/ jo bo bod na 'gro don che ba de lhag par dga' zhing / jo bo bod la mnyes pa nga rang la rgyus yod/ da sku na yang mthon por son pas bshul thag ring po la tshur spyan ma drang bar bstan bcos 'di la 'grel pa zhig mdzad nas bskur ba zhu gsungs nas khong gnyis po tshur btang / khong gnyis po bod du 'byor nas zhu 'phrin snyan du gsol bas jo bo nan tar mnyes shing / nag tsho lo tsā ba'i zhal nas slob dpon gnas brtan gyis ri bas kyang lci ba'i khur gcig bskur ba de da sangs song gsungs/jo bos kyang de 'phral lam sgron 'grel pa'i dbu btsugs te slar khong gnyis po la bskur bas paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis nyin lam mang po nas bsu ba byas/rgyal mtshan gyi rtser btags nas mchod pa chen po mdzad do//'brom gyi 'phrin shog de dbus su zhang dbang phyug mgon gyis ka ba la sprad pa ltar ka bas kyang do dam chen bgyis te rgyal gyi zhang chen po la sogs pa rnams la gros zhus nas jo bo dbus su gdan 'dren du 'byon par brtsams pa'i tshe khu ston gyi mtshan der ma gsal bas ma dgyes nas sngon la ཿjo bo ngas mjal ba zhig bya snyam nas byon pas gzhan rnamaṭasdo la'ang des skul lcag chen po thebs/ de nas dbus kyi mi chen rnams mnga' ris dpal thang la phebs pa'i tshe jo bo ston 'khor rnams kyang dpal thang stod du phebs/ der bod ston rnams dbu zhwa sne ring dang / na bza' be+er dang bcas pa'i rta pa mang po rgyang ma nas gzigs par jo bo rjes 'brom ston la/ u pa si ka mi ma yin mang po byung gsungs nas dbu btums/ de 358 —

nas bod ston rnams kyis zhabs drung du nye ba na chibs las babs te ber dang dbu zhwa bzhag snam sbyar myon pa sha stag tu byas nas byung ba la jo bo yang dgyes nas dge 'dun la spyi phyag mdzad/ de nas dbus su phebs skabs gan pa byang thang du phebs dus lha sa'i thad kyi ri rme phyag mdzub gtad nas pha gi na ci yod gsungs par lha sa'i gtsug lag khang yod pa lags zhus par de ga yin pa 'dra/ nam mkha' nas lha'i bu dang bu mo mang pos mchod pa byed kyi 'dug gsungs par grags shing / de nas bsam yas su phebs skabs lha btsun bo ti rā dzas zhabs tog legs par mdzad cing / bod ston mang po zhig kyang der 'dus/ skabs der khu ston gyis yul yar lung bzang ba'i bsngags pa brjod pas khong gi bzhugs gnas thang po cher phebs par zla ba gcig tsam bzhugs shing / der 'brom yang phebs/khu ston gyi zhabs tog tshul bzhin du ma byung bas dpon slob rnams de nas bros stabs su zhal gyes te myang po'i gru la zhugs te gtsang po'i sum cha tsam du phebs pa na khu ston rjes snyeg tu byon te khong gi sar yang bskyar phyir log 'byon pa'i re ba zhus kyang zhal gyis ma bzhes par dbu zhwa phyir 'phangs nas byin rlabs kyi rtenasnyodu gnang /de rjes slar yang bsam yas su phebs nas dpe dkar gling du bzhugs/ der lo tsā ba gnyis kyis nyi khri snang ba dang / slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyisnga mdzad pa'i theg bsdus kyi 'grel pa sogs 'gyur mang po mdzad/bsam yasau su rgya gar gyi dpe cha mang po yod pa gzigs pa'i nang na skabs der rgya gar na yang med pa'i dpe cha mang po gzigs par sngon bod du bstar/ 359

pa dar ba 'dra ba rgya gar du yang 'byung ba dka'/ dpe 'di 'dra ba rnams kyang slob dpon pad+mas mi ma yin gyi gnas nas blangs sam gsungs/de nas snye thang du phebs/ chos nyan pa mang po 'dus/ khur du dgon pa ba la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la 'phral gyi zhabs tog dang /gdams ngag gnang nas skom grwa btsugs/ snye thang du chos nyan mang po 'dus pa la mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan tshar gcig gsungs pa bsdus se ba zhig las ma gnang bas mi rnams sems ma tshims pa la rgyas pa zhig gnang bar de la phyag dar ston pas zin bris btab par phar phyin khams lugs mar grags shing / nyi khri snang ba gsungs pa la nyan mi dge bshes bcu bzhi tsam las ma byung zer/ 'brom la skyes bu gsum gyi khrid kyi gdams pa rnams kyang snye thang du gnang /de nas rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis lha sar spyan drangs/ skabs der lha sa'i gtsug lag khang khyad par 'phags pa gzigs nas 'di dag ji ltar bzhengs pa'i lo rgyus 'ong thang dgongs pa'i tshe/ lha sa'i snyon ma zer ba'i mkha' 'gro ma zhig gis lung bstan pa bzhin gtsug lag khang gi ka ba shing lo can gyi gseb nas srong btsan sgam po'i bka' chems ka 'khol ma gter nas bzhes par grags shing / de nas bzung bka' chems bka' 'khol ma ni bod kyi chos 'byung lo rgyus zhib 'jug gi dpyad gzhi gal chen du 'dzin/jo bo rje bod du bzhugs ring 'bul ba byung ba rnams chag khri mchog la sogs pa'i slob ma rnams kyis rgya gar du bla ma dang dge 'dun la 'bul bra byi60

lan gsum bskyal/de nas yer par phebs nas rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis zhabs tog mdzad cing / theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i 'grel pa slob dpon thogs med kyis mdzad pa de lo paṇa gnyis kyis bsgyur/der bzhugs pa'i bar du 'brom gyis pha tshan rnams la gser slong la byo na pa nas phyir byon te yer par 'brom gyi 'bul mo cher grags pa de yang na dzad cing / 'brom ston pa gser slong la byon dus zla ba gcig dang //ku ston gyis1 spyan drangs dus zla ba gcig ste zla ba gnyis ma gtogs dang po jo bo mjakhasdo ba nas zhi bar ma gshegs bar 'brom ston gyis jo bo rje dang skad cig kyang 'bral ma myong gsungs/de nas jo bo rjes 'brom ston la/ khyod kyi gnas gzhi chung ngu zhig brtsigs/ nga'i bstan pa rnams khyod la gtod pa yin gsungs par spyir padag 'khos chung / bye brag tu rten dge bsnyen du song bas bya ba chen po sgrub mi nus zhus par/ jo bos/ bslab pa bzhin gyi bya ba rnams ji lta ba bzhin du gyis/ ngas byin gyis rlob pas sems khral mi dgos gsungs pa ltar phyis 'brom ston pas rab byung dang po'i me sprel spyi lo 1d+ngha5snyolor rwa sgreng btab pa nas bzung jo bo rje'i bzhed srol dar spel byung ba'i chos lugs la bka' gdams pa zhes su grags pa bcas mthar jo bo rje snye thang du rab byung dang po'i shing rta spyi lo10'abhelor sku gshegs/de nas 'brom ston pa gtso bor gyur pa'i jo bo rje'i slob ma rnams kyis jo bo'e gdung bzhu ba'i rjes ji ltar bya snyam r+bhags khral gnang bzhin par 361

sanas pa la ka ba shākya dbang phyus/ byon nas gdung dang / rgya dpe/ gser gling pa'i dngul gdung sogs rten gtsigs che ba rnams 'brom la phul/ khu rngog sogs slob ma gzhan rnams la'ang rten skal re gnang /re nas jo bo'i 'das mchod rgya cher mdzad pa la sogs legs par grub ste mthar 'brom ston pa dgung lo nga dgu pa rab byung dang po'i shing 'brug(spyi lo1sgro.a+yo4)'o/ra sku gshegs/de ltar bka' gdams kyi gzhung lugs khyad par can de ni jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha nas dbu brnyes/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung ga/nas kyis srol phye/ bka' gdams sku mched gsum ste po to ba rin chen gsal (1031da 1105)dang / spyan snga ba tshul khrims 'bar (1038da 1103) phu chung pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan(1031da 1106)gsum gyis rgyas par mdzad/ glang ri thang pa rdo rje seng ge(1054da 1123)dang / sha ra ba yon tan grags (1070da 1141)bya 'chad kha ba ye shes rdo rje(1201da 1275)sogs/ kyis de las kyang rgyas par mdzad pa bcas bod sil bu'i dus su bka' gdams pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i dgon sde du mas dbus gtsang gi ljongs thams cad khyab par gyur/ bka' gdams kyi gdan sa lte bu byang gi rwa sgrong dang / gtsang gi snar thang gnyis nye rabs bar ma nyams par bzhugs yod pa las de min mang po zhig ni dus phyis btsun mas bzung bar snang / chos lugs grub mtha'i thad phyis bka' gdams gsar ma ste ri bo dge lugs pa'i srol 'dzin pas rtsa ba'i bka' gdams kyi bzhed srol bun mong ma yin pa dang ri bo dge ldan 36lha

pa'i bzhed srol gnyis gcig tu 'dres pa las bka' gdams pa'i bzhed srol ma 'dres par 'dzin pa ni phal cher med par mngon/1 bka' gaṭ+wāṃms pa'i grub mtha' thog mar dar ba'i rkyen/ bar du 'phel rgyas song ba dang / mthar grub mtha' de bka' gdams gsar ma dang gcig tu 'dres pa'i skor/thog mar dar ba dang 'phel ba'i tshul/ glang dar skabs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnubs pas bar skabs dbus gtsang gi yul gru gang sar thub pa'i bstan pa ming gi lhag ma tsam du gyur zhing bstan pa'i me ro stod smad gnyis nas gsos pas dbus gtsang gi khyon du dge 'dun gyi sde 'phel rgyas chen po byung yod/ 'on kyang skabs der 'ga' zhig 'dul ba la mos pa'i blos gsang sngags khyad du gsod pa dang / 'ga' zhig gsang sngags la mos blos 'dul ba khyad du gsod pa sogs bstan pa phyogs re bar gyur khar/ phal mo che ni grub mtha'i kha 'dzin gyi bshad pa tsam las thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa nyams len khyer shes pa lta zhog phyogs mthong gi go ba tsam chags pa'ang dkon zhing / lhag par bud med spyod pa la sbyor ba dang / dgra la sogs pa'i sems can gsod pa la sgrol ba zhes sbyor sgrol du grags pa'i chos log spyod pa sogs byung bar lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang /pho brang zhi ba 'od/ lo chen rin chen bzang po sogs kyis chos log sun 'byin gyi yi ge bris nas bkram pas kyang phan pa cher ma thon/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis gnas tshul de lta bur gyur pa thugs kyis ma bzod par rgya gar nas paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bstan pa la tshad mar gyur pa zhig gdan drangs/ te 363

dag ther mdzad pa las lhag pa'i thabs gzhan med par dgongs pa de khong 'ayo+o bzhugs skabs mngon gyur ma byung rung / phyis dbon po byang chub 'od kyis khu bo ye shes 'od kyi dgongs pa de de bzhin du 'grub pa'i slad du jo bo rje dpal ldan a tir+sha sha bod la spyan drangs te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dag ther mdzad par gsol ba btab pa la brten nas mdo sngags kyi gnad thams cad bsdus nas nyams su len pa'i rim par dril ba gzhung byang chub lam gyi sgron ma gsung rtsom dang 'brel bstan pa'i dag ther bla na ma mchis pa mdzad pa'i bzhed srol de dag phyi rabs bu slob rnams kyis rgyun 'dzin gnang bas thub pa'i bstan pa dri ma med pa gong nas gong 'phel 'gro ba'i sman yon nyag cig tu gyur pa dang / skabs der mkhane / grub lo paṇa gyi nang nas jo bo rje las lhag pa gzhan du ma dmigs pas de'i bzhed srol ni kun gyis tshad mar 'dzin yul nyag cig tu gyur pa bcas ni bka' gdams rma 'i grub mtha' thog ma'i 'byung rkyen dang de dag rim par 'phel rgyas byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de las gzhan du ma dmigs/mtha' ma bka' gdams pa'i grub mtha' de dag bka' gdams gsar ma ste ri bo dge lugs pa dang gcig tu 'dres te bka' gdams pa'i grub mtha' thun mong ma yin pa zhig ngos 'dzin rgyu med pa de ni spyir jo bo rje bod la phebs nas khong gi bzhed srol la skabs de'i bla ma danye ba'i bshes gnyen gyis slob sbyong gnang ba dber na/ bka' rgyud kyi mese po mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo spos dang / 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa/ 'bri gung skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ lhag par rje btsun tsong kha pa chen 364
