po bca 8 ) kyis ngo bo rdze dang / khong gi dngos rgyud kyi slob ma rnarma r+shashrī nas bka' gdams gsan sbyo nga gnang thog de dag gi nying khu rang rang gi baned pa dang sbyar nas gzhan la rgya cher ston gnang mdzad pas phyikā kyi grub mtha' thams cad kyi sdi mo lta bur gyur pa dang / phyis grub mtha' gzhan khag gi shing rta'i srol 'byed mkhan gcig las gcig lhag mang po byon pa rnams kyi dngo/ngas pa'i rjes su 'jug pa'i dngos rgyud kyi bu slob kyang gcig las gcig mang ba rnamyo/sa kyi sa —rang rang gi bruzhed srol grub mtha' khag mang thon pa dang / lhag par rje tsong kha pa chen pos lam sgron la gzhi mdzad bar skabs jo bo'i sa/dmas pa la ma rtogs log rtog gi dri ma zhuganu/ pa rnams bsal nas byang chub lam gyi rim ge mdzad pas jo bo rje'i bzhed sro la de bas cha tshang du gyur te rjes 'jug rnams kyis de ltar nyams le/na ga/nang bas bka' gdams pa'i grub mtha' kho na a 'thas kyi 'dzin dgos/ pa'i rgyu mchan ma mthong bas ri bo dge 'u/gas pa'i bzhed srol dar ba dang du sa mtshungs bka' gdamatra4 pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa rnarngu /sa kyang rim ba'i/na dge lugs pa'i phyag len nyam sa su bzhes pa dang / bka' gdams pa 'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i nang nas bka' gdams kyi mes po rnams kyi rjes su mtshan snyan dang ldan pa yang mang po ma byon pa dang / lhag par bka' gdams pa'i chos/ kyi che ba'am khyad par 'phags pa ni rgyal ba'i gsur/ rab la spong len mi ri ze 7 ngar thams cad gang zag sa/cig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen du mdzad pa'i rkye 5/ gyirnga ga chos lugs la phyogs ris kyi a 'thas mi mdzad pa bcas kyis bka' po/dmas pa'i lugs de chos lugs grub mtha' gzhan 365

dang / lhag par ri bo dge lugs pa'i bzhed srol dang 'dres par snang zhing / 'jig rten gyi phyogs nas bshad na bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams ni 'du 'dzi la ches mi dgyes pas bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa khag la mchod gzhis rgya che dang 'brel ba'i dbang ris gang yang med la/ skabs der bod la chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs rnal ma zhig da dung tshugs med pa'i rkyen gyis srid dbang dang 'brel ba ni de bas med rkyeno rang lugs kyi grub mtha' mtha' gcig tu srung dgos don med pa de ni rjes su rim bzhin chags pa'i chos lugs grub mtha' gzhan dag dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos lags shing / grub mtha' mthar dag bka' sa/dmas pa las 'phros pa'i skor dpa' bo gtsug lag phrang bas gsang phu'i gdan rabs kyi mjug tu bka' gdams pa'i spyi ba sdoms su/ ‘‘mdor na dpal ldan gas/nga phu 'di ni bod kyi klog pa po'i chu bo thams cad kyi 'byung gnas gangs ri lta bu yin la phyis kyang ma khas pa chen po g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal/ de'i slob ma rong ston shes bya kun rig dang / snye thang bde ba can du spyangs sa mdzad cing red mda' pa gzhon nu blo gros kyi slob ma shar tsong kha pa chen po rnams so so'i rgyud 'dzin gyis bod yul khyab par gnas shing bka' gdams kyi lta grub 'dzin pa deng sang mi snang yang 'di thams cad bka' gdams pa las 'phros pa ni yin la/ rje sgam po ba phyin gyi dwags rgyud pa rnams ni bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres zhes zab mo lta ba dang rgya chen spyod pa'i gzhung gnyis bka' gdams dngos 'dzin pa yin no //(mkhas dga' lcags par ma shog grangs 73lā)zhes gsungs pa ltar 366

lages /྅ bka' gdams bstan pa'i spyi bab dang / chos kyi rnam grangs skor/ 'brom gyi zhal nas/ bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis khyer shes pa nga'i bla ma zhes pa dang / rnal 'byor pa chen pos gdams ngas/ kru nang byam/ chud pa ni/ be'u bum lag mthil tsam zhig la ngeṭaṭa pa rnyed pa pa mi zer gyi/ gsung rab thams cad gdams ngag tu go ba 'a zer ba yin /zhes dang / sgom pa rin chen bla mas/ 'dul ba sngarga/sa kyi grong/sa/sngags 'dul ba'i grogs su 'khyer shes pa nga'i bla ma'i bka' brgyud min pa med ces gsungaṭa / pa ltar spyir rgyal ba'i bka' tāsku/ spong len mi byed nga ra thams cad gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyem/ du 'dzin pa bka(ra gdams pa'i khyad chos yin pas bka' gdams su ma 'dus pa'i chos med na'ang / yongs su grags pa bka' gdams gzhung pa ba dang / gdams ngag pa gnyis sam/ yang na man ngag pa dang gsum du dbye zhing / de lta bu'i bka' gdams pa'i nyams len yang rim pa bzhin gzhung la lta ba 0//tso bor ston pa dang / spyo da pa gtso bor ston pa/ gnyis ka zung 'brel du ston pa sa/sumaciyin/de yang dang po/sna lta ba gtso bor ston pa la yang / jo bo rjes mdzad pa'i bden gnyis la 'jug pa dang / dbu ma'i man ngag sogs yin/gnyis pa/ spyod bsdus sgron me dang / sems bskyed / sdom pa'i cho ga sogs yin/ ba/sum pa ni/ byang chub lamyoshaṃ gyi sgron ma ste pya'/ ba'i bka' 367

sde snod gsum dang / rgyud sde bzhi dgongs 'grel dang bca sa/ rma las yi ge na gcig kyang dor du med par gang zag gcig gi nyams len gyi rir/ par dril nas ston pa'i legs bshad rmad du byung ba de yin te/ rje tsong kha pa chen pos byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i nang bstan par/ ོ bos mdzad pa'i gzhung mang du yod kyang rtsa ba lta bu yongs su rdzogs pa ni lam sgron yin te/mdo sngags gnyis ka'i gnad bsdus nas ston pas brjod bya yongs su rdzogs pa dang / sems 'dul ba'i rim pa gtso bor byas/ pas lag tu bla ra bde ba dang / shing rta chen po gnyis kyi lugs la mkhas/ pa'i bla ma gnyis kyi gdams pas brgyan pas lugs gzhan las khyad par du 'pha5 /sa so zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//bka' gdams gzhung drug tu grags pa ni/ sa rgyam/ gnyis/ bslab spyod gnyis// skyes choms gnyis te drug yin la de las bslab spyod rga/nyis lta spyod zung 'brel dang / gzhan rnams byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gtsobor ston pa'i gzhung yin/ jo bo'i chos 'byuri+o brgya rtsar grags pa yang bka' gdams kyi gzhung yin la rtsa shes dang / stong nyid bdun cu pa dang / rin chen phring ba rnams kyang ngo //gdams ngag la'ang gsum las/(1) lta ba gtso bor ston pa ni/ jo bo nyid kyi mam ngag spyam/ snga/ ba lanu/ brgyud pa'i bden bzhi'i khrid dang / phu chung ba nas brgyud pa'i rten 'brel gyi khrid dang / rnal 'byor ba nas brgyud pa'i bden pa gnyis kyi khrid rnams yin te bden bzhi dang / rten 'brel gyi khrid kyis ni thun mo nga 368

ba'i gang zag gi bdag med dang / bden gnyis/ kyi khrid kyis ni shin tu phra ba'i chos kyi bdag med la 'khrid par mdzad pa yin no//jo bo'i slob cha/ bden gnyis la shin tu mkhas pa ni rnal 'byor ba chen po yin la des grong lung pa dang spyan snga ba la gsungs/ spyan sngas stod lung pa dang / bya yul ba gnyis la lkog chos su gsungs/ stod lung pas lkog chos dang / tshogs chos gnyis kar gsungs shing brtsam chos kyang mang du mdzad/ khong gi slob ma khyung khams kyis kyang ma/nga du gsungs pas dar zhing rgyas/ sangs rgyas dbon gyis kyang yig cha rgyas bsdus du cha/ mdzad/'chad kha bas mdzad pa'i grub mtha'i bstan bcos dang / de'i 'grel pa lha lung gi dbang phyug gis mdzad par phyi nang gi grub mtha'i 'dod tshul rnams bkod nas klu sgrub kyi dbu ma chen mo rab tu mi gnas par 'khrid par mdzad pa bka' gdams pa'i lta ba'i le lag go/de nas jo bo chen po ni dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba 'dzin pa lam sgron rtsa 'grel dang / dbu ma'i man ngag rtsa 'grel sogs kyis shes shing /'bromyo/ gyis kyang jo bo la slob dpon zla grags lugs kyi rtogs pa phul bas thugs dgyes nas phyag tha' mo sbyar/ ngo mtshar che da lta rgya gar shar phyogs na lta ba 'di kho na 'dzin zhes gsungs par grags/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen po to ba sogs sku mched sa/sum gyi lam rim dang gsung sgros su dbu ma'i lta ba zla grags lugs dang mthun shas che ba 'byung zhing / ri rngog lo yab sras ni legs ldan dang zla ba'i gzhung khungs su drangs pa mang du snang na'ang lta ba spyong tshul zhi ba 'tsho yab sras dang mthun shas che'o//369

gser gling pa nas brgyud pa'i blo sbyong 'ga' zhig gi lta ba'i 'gros ni sems tsam rnam brdzun pa'i lugs dang mthun pa'ang snang ngo //(3) spyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i gdams ngag ni/ theg chen blo sbyong gi gdams pa rnams te/ bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang / skyes zin gong 'phel du byas pa'i sa lam bgrod pa'i tshul yin la/ theg chen gyi mdo sde spyi dang / khyad par du mdo sde phal po che dang / dgongs 'grel gyi gzhung klu sgrub kyi rin chen phreng ba dang /rmi lam yid bzhin nor bu'i gtam dang / sems can mgu ba'i tshigs bcad dang / zhi ba lha'i bslab spyod gnyis rnams gdams pa'i khungs yin cing / mdo bstan bcos de dag gi man ngag snying por dril ba/ jo bo'i bla ma dharma rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa'i blo sbyong mtshon cha 'khor lo dang / rma bya dug 'joms/ byams pa'i rnal 'byor gyi gyer sgom rdo rje'i glu/ gser gling pa'i sems dpa'i rim pa dang / rtog pa 'bur 'joms la sogs pa gdams ngag yi ger bkod pa rnams so//don bdun mar nye bar bkod pa'i blo sbyong gi man ngag ni gser gling pas jo bo la gsungs/ des dge bshes ston pa la lkog chos su mdzad/des sku mched gsum la lkog chos su mdzad/ sku mched gsum gyi ring la lam rim tshogs chos su mdzad kyang / blo sbyong lkog chos nyid du mdzad par mngon la/ po to bas kyang glang shar gnyis la sogs pa la skeg chos su gnang ba las glang thang pas dmigs pa'i sa bcad brgyad du mdzad par blo sbyong tshigs brgyad mar grags pa de nyid tshos/sa chos su mdzad par yang bye70

mngon no//glang ri thang pas zhang dang gnyen/ sha bo sgang pa rnams la gsungs shing / de dag gi gdams pa 'dres mar yi ge bkod pa ni be'u bum khra bo nes zer te/ sha sgo sgang pa'i blo sbyong zhes su grags pa yang de nyid yin par bzhed cing / de ni zhang sha ra bas bya 'chad ka ba la lkog chos su mdzad pa de dag 'chad ka bas rang nyid kho nas thugs nyams su bzhes shing / thog mar gdul bya re gnyis la lkog chos su mdzad pa phyis gzhan la rgya cher phan par gzigs nas 'gre phur tshogs chos su gsungs pa de yang /sngon 'gro rten gyi chos sems pa/ dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba/ rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba/ tshe gcig gi nyams len dril nas bstan pa/ blo 'byongs pa'i tshad/ blo sbyong gi dam tshig blo sbyong gi bslab bya bcas don bdun du sa bcad pas blo sbyong don bdun mar grags pa yin/blo sbyong don bdun ma ni/ byang chub lam gyi rim pa rnams dang /glang thang pa'i tshigs brgyad ma/ sha bo sgang pa'i blo sbyong rnams su bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems sgom tshul legs par bstan kyang / blo sbyong don bdun mar gtong len rlung la bskyon pa sogs dmigs pa ri 'phrul zab mo dang / 'khrid rim yang gzhan las rgyas pas 'di nyid khyad par du 'phags so// dge bshes ston pa'i man ngag thun brgyad ma ni khams pa lung pas rtsal du bton te 'chad pas khams pa lung pa'i blo sbyong thun brgyad ma 'is 371

su grags shing / de yang thun brgyad ni zas la brten pa'i blo blong dang / de bzhin du dbugs la brten pa dang / lus gaṅgā'i bye ma rnyed du sprul pa dang /sha khrag la brtenā pa dang / gtor ma la brten pa dang / 'byung ba la brten pa dang / luso yid bzhin nor bur sprul te blo sbyong ba das/ 'chi kha ma'i man ngag ste dmigs thun brgyad du dril nas ston pa'o//kha rag sgom chung pa dbang phyug blo gros kyis kha rag skor gsum bya ba'i chos gsungs/ gdams pa de ni a ro nas sba sgom la brgyud pa'i sems phyogs kyi gdams pa dang / jo bo'i gdams pa rnal 'byor ba dang /dgon pa ba las gsan pa'i blo sbyong gi gdams pa'i chu bo gnyis gcig tu 'dres pa byang chub sems sbyong zhes mtshan gsol te ang yig bdun cu pa zhes pa'i lam rim gyi man ngag tshigs bcad du sdebs pa mdzad/gzhan yang dge bshes ston pa nas brgyud pa'i rten 'brel snying po'i 'khrid kyang snying rje chen po sgom tshul khyad par du ston pas spyod pa'i gdams ngag yin la jo bo'i gzhung la brten nas zhang sha ra bas mdzad pa'i sems bskyed dang sdom pa'i cho ga sogs kyang de bzhin no//(3) lta spyod zung 'brel du ston pa'i gdams pa'i rgyal po ni/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa zhes grags pa'i gzhung ni byang chub lam sgron yin la sngar bshad pa'i spyod pa dang lta ba'i gzhung dang man ngag so so ba de dag kyang lam rimyo/ gyi ya gyal yin pas lam rim gyi khungs su de thams cad 'du ba yin la/ lam rim ni jo bo rje la rgya chen spyod rgyud dang zab mo lta rgyud kyi man ngag gnyis mnga' ba lam gyi lus gcig tu dril nas nyams su 372

len tshul cha tshang ba'i gdam/sa pa yin pas lta spyod zung 'brel gyi gdams pa r+ṣazhes btags/ de lta bu'i lam rim gyi gdams pa ni jo bos 'brom la lkog tu 'khrid par mdzad de ngas khyod min pa gzhan la gtod sa ma rnyed ces gsungs nas 'brom ston par man ngag gtad nas khong bka' gdams bstan pa'i bdag por byin gyis brlabs pas 'brom ston pa 'phrin las rgya che ba yang des yin par grags shing / jo bo yab sras nas dge bshes dgon pa ba/ de nas sne'u zur pa la sogs par rim gyis brgyud pa dang /'brom nas dge bshes spyan snga ba/ des bya yu la ba sogs la brgyud par bka' la/dmas man ngag pa zhes grags/'brom nas dge bshes po to ba dang / de nas sha ra ba sogs la brgyud pa la bka' gdams gzhung pa ba zhes pu'i tha snyad mjad pa bcas gnyis ka 'brom 'o/sa brgyud pa don la 'dra yang gzhung bshad kyi spro sa pa rgya che ba byed mi byed kyi/ sgo nas tha dad du bgrang ba tsam mo rībaka' gdams pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i lam rim gyi gzhung mang du snang pari nga grags che ni be'u bum sngon po dang / dpe chos gnyis te snga ma be'u bum/ sngon po ni dge bshes po to ba'i gsung sgros dol pa shes rab rgya mtshos bsgrigs pa la lha 'bri sgang bas 'grel pa mdzad pa yin/ dpe chos la ni gsum byung ste thog mar grab pas bsgrigs pa ni bsdus pa dang / brag dkar bas de gzhir mdzad nas /rong rang nyid kyis dase/ bshes/ 9ri/ gsan pa'i dpe yang ma nga du bsnan te bsgrigs pa ni rgyas pa/ lce sgom rdzong pas snga ma gnyis las go bde ba'i 'bring pa mdzad pa der dpe chos rin chem/ khru ngas cho 373

pa zhes bya ba yin/ gong du bka' gdams gzhung pa dang / gdams ngag yang na man ngag ste gsum du mdzad pa'i man ngag ni/ spyir gdams ngag dang / man ngag mi 'gal yang dbye ba gsum du mdzad pa'i man ngag ni jo bo yab sras kyi gsang chos bka' gdams glegs bam du grags pa de jo bo rjes khu rngog 'brom gsum la yer pa lha ri snying po'i mgul du gnang ba zhig ste pha 'brom ston pas zhus pa la bka' gdams pha chos dang / bu rngog legs pa'i shes rab dang khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gnyis kyis zhus pa la bka/'a gdams bu chos su grags pa lags/khu stome+e/ brtsom/ 'grus g.yung drung dang po 'brom ston par mi mos pa'i tshul bstan kyang / 'di dus khu ston gyi nga rgyal zhi nas 'brom ston gyi zhabs la gtugs pa ste gleṭa bam nang khu dang dag snang 'brel ba'i tshogs na gsal/'di'i man ngag rnam sa jo bo mya ngan las 'da' khar 'brom la gnang zhing / bka' gdams sku mched gsum la gtso bor gzhung dang man ngag byin zhes zhal chems kyi man ngag de yin cing / sku mched gsum las phu chung ba la yongs su rdzogs pa dang / gzhan gnyis la phal che ba dang /phyogs tsam mnga' ba yin te/ de yang slob dpon nam rin gyis/ yongs su rdzoganu pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan(phu chung ba ) yin/ phal cher 'dzin pa tshul khrims 'bar (spyan snga ba) du gda'/ phyogs tsam gsal ba rin chen gsal ba (po to ba ) yin/ deng sang dus na kho bo nyid du zad/ ces gsungs pa ltar lags/374

ci de yang phu chung ba la ji ltar byung ba ni/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis mnga' ris pa shes rab rgyal mtshan dang / des phu chung ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan la gtad pa yin/de'i cinyams len rjes dran lnga ste//skyabs gnas bla ma dron par mdzod//lus ni lha yi rang bzhin te//ngag ni bzlas brjod rgyun par mdzod//'gro ba ma sri sa pha mar soms//sems kyi gnas lugs stong par dpyad//ces gsungs pa ltar dang snying por gyur pa ni thig le bcu drug gi nyams len yin la/ nyams su blangs pa'i yon tan ni/ 'dul ba nas rdo rje theg pa'i bar stan thog gcig tu nyamasagyisu len pa la mkhas pa/ lta ba ma tho la spyod pa zhib pa zhig 'byung ba/ lha ni bzhi ste/ thub pa/ spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma/ mi g.yo ba yin/ chos ni sde snod gsum ste de rnamanu/ bka' gdams lha chos bdun bya ba yin/bka' gdams pa la sngags kyi gdams pa med dam snyam na/ bshad ma thag pa'i thig le bcu drug gi man ngag kyang ma)ོ sngags zung 'brel yin la/ gzhan yang thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod dang / mi g.yo ba'i skor dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la brten pa'i smyung gnas sogs bka' gdams par dar rgyas che zhing / jo bo'i man ngag thor bu mang po zhig mchims kyis phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa snar thang brgya rtsar grags pa ji75

dang / jo boṭa/ dge bshes lag sor ba la gnang ba'i spyan ras gzigari smu kyi gdam ku/ pa dang / gzhan yang lha bzhi'i khrid sogs bka' gdams pa'i sngagre / rig byi man ngag mang po'i rgyunaphyis kyang bzhus/sa so//jo bo bod du ma byon gong gsang sngags kyi 'ag len tshul bzhin mi byed pa'i phyogs lhung bsal ba'i ched du do ha gsung bar bzhed kyang 'brom gyis bod du 'di mi 'tshams zhesabarmo/ /ga nga 'i tshul sogs ba7/'a gdams gong ma rnams gsang sngags/ spyi 〉nga / khyad par bla med la shin tu dmadog che ba mjad na'ang / dngo sa tshod la jo bo rjes 'brom ston par rngod sde bzhi'i mam/ ngag thamasari/ cad dang / khyad pa ra ba rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa / spru rgyud 'khor lo bde mchoka bla med spyi'i man ngag mthar thug pa grub snying skor gyi man ngag rnamyo sdori rī 7/sang ba'i tshul gyis yongs su rdzogs pa sa/nang bas 'brom ston pa ni mdo sngagaru/ yongs rdzogs kyi bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pa yin la rgyu mtshan de'i thog pyir bka' rga/darma sa pas gsang sngags khrom bsgragre/sa mi mdzad pa ma gtogs gsang snga/gas/ kyi gdamyo/sa si med mi ma yin cing / lhag par bka' gdams pas chos kyi gtso bor byang chub lam gyi sgron ma phyag bzhes gnang bar yang gsang sngas/sa yod dgos te/ de med na bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi nyams/ len du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / lam sgron rang ke tshig la'ang dngos su 'khod pa des gsal por rtos/ṭan tshome bcas so//gong du bka' gdams pa'i grub mtha'i 〉ོ/ra dang / jo 'brom gyi rnam thar ras/sa sa snabacas thu'u bkwan grub mtha' dang / yo ngas 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyiri ga mdzad pa'i lam rim bla rgyud kyi rnam thar sogs 'a sa btus 376

pa re zhig de tsam mo//gnyis pa/ bka' brgyud pa'i skor/bka' brgyud ces pa'i ming thogs stangs skor/ shangs pa bka' brgyud ni mkhas kub khyung po rnal 'byor la ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma gnyis sogs las byung ba'i bka/ 'a babs kyi gdams pa mnga' bas de'i rgyud 'dzin la shangs pa ba7/'a ba rgyud du grags pa dang / dwags po bka' brgyud ni grub mtha' de'i shing rta chen po lho brag mar pa chos kyi blo gros la rdo rje 'chang nas te lo nā ro'i bar du byon pa'i bka' babs kyi gdams pa rnams mar pa la mnga' ba de'i chos/ rgyud 'dzin pa rnams la dwags po bka' brgyud pa zhes bya bar 'bod pa bcas/ shangs pa bka' brgyud dang dwags po bka' brgyud kyi mtshan thogs stangs ni de ltar ro//dang po/ shangs pa bka' brgyud ni/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor las brgyud pa zhig ste/ de yang mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor ni/yab khyung po stag skyes kyi sras su lcags stag spyi lo9rdzo0lor snye mor sku 'khrungs/ gzhon nu'i skabs g.yung drung rgyal ba las bon bslabs/ de rjes rdzogs chen 'byung spre/nas seng ge la rdzogs pa chen po gas na/ de rjes bal yul du byon nas su ma ti las lo tsā bslabs nas rgya gar du byon nas lo lnga bcu tsam gyi ring rgya gar dang / bal yul/ bod bcas su 'byon bzhud myo dza3 cing / rgya bal du bla ma ma /khas/ parka dang grub pa thob pa brgya dang lnga bcu bsten nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung dang man ngag mtha' yas pa thugs su chud cing / thun mong gi bla ma rdo rje gdan pa chen po dang / mai 377

tre+e pa/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ rā hu la ste bzhi dang / thun mong ma yin pa ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu ma dang / su kha sirnyi gnyis bcas drug po de gtso bor mdzad/ ni gu ma ni nā ro pa'i gsang yum yin la 'ja' lus brnyes nas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon la 'byon pa dang mjal/ sgyu lus kyi 'a/ma gyi dbang dang / chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang / sgyu ma lam rim sogs gdams pa mang du gsungs/ mai tre pa las ye shes mgon po'e chos skor gsan/ de nas bod du byon te glang ri thang pa las bsnyen par rdzogs/'phan yul 'jog po ri la bzhugs skabs rgya gar nas bla ma rā hu la gusta badz+ra chos sgo skyel du byon nas rgyud sde lnga'i dbang dang / mgon po'i skor sogs spyi la grags dang ma grags pa'i gdams pa mtha' yas pa gnang /rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags glang spyi lo11phre1lor g.yas ru shangs su byon nas shangs gzhong gzhong gi dgon pa btab pa de nas khong gi bzhed srol grub mtha' de la shangs pa bka' brgyud ces grags pa dang / de dus gzhong gzhong du dge 'dun khri tsho brgyad 'dus par grags/ sku gshegs pa'i dus ni dgung lo brgya dang lnga bcu bzhugs par grags pa ltar na rab byung gnyis pa'i sa lug spyi lo113rdzolor babs/slob ma'i gtso bo ni/ sme'u ston pa/ g.yar po rgya mo che/ rdul ston rin chen dbang / la stod dkon mchog ma khar/ rmog lcob/ pa rin chenabartson 'grus/ zhang sgom chos seng rnams so//shangs chos gtsa bor gyur pa ni/ bde mchog kyai rdor/ ma hā mā yā/gsang 'dus/ rdo rje 'jigs byed de rgyud sde lnga po po so'i dbang dang /378

sdom pa'i dbang / sgyu lus dbang mo che sogs dang / phyag chen ga'u ma zhes pa bde ba dang stong pa ga'u kha sbyor bzhin dbyer med du bsgoms nas 'od gsal mngon du byed pa'i gdams pa'o//gnyis pa/ dwags po bka' brgyud ni/ mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros las brgyud pa zhig ste khong gi mdzad pa gong du song zin pa dang mar pa'i chos rgyud 'dzin pa ka chen bzhir grags pa dang / lhag par chos rgyud 'dir dwags po bka' brgyud ces pa'i mtshan thogs yul ste grub mtha' 'di'i ring lugs rgya cher spel bar gzhan dring mi 'jog pa mnyam med dwags po lha rje dang / khong gi slob rgyud gtso che ba rnams bcas kyi lo rgyus rags bsdus ni/mar pa lo tsā ba'i slob ma snye+o'i ka ba rngog chos sku rdo rje ni/ yab rngog ban chen kha pa dang / yum 'od ldan ma'i sras su rab byung dang po'i me byi spyi lo 1༷3a+yolor gzhung ri bor 'khrungs/khong gzhon nu'i dus yab chos sogs la thos bsam mdzad pas mkhas par gyur cing / pa bza' chos 'tsho khab tu bzhes/ gzhung se lung du dge bshes dgyer chung pa la rnying ma gsan skabs khong gis khyed snying nas chos byed bsam na skyes mchog mar pa lo tsā'i spyan sngar 'dong ngam gsungs pas dad pa lhag med du 'khrungs te de nub rang la chos 'phro dril te nangs par mar pa'i drung du byon te snga rjes su phyag rten gtos che ba phul nas dgyes rdor dang / gdan bzhi/ ma hā mā yā rnams kyi rgyud man ngag dang gdams ngag dpag med gsan/ chos skyong du dud sol ma gnang /379

gzhan yang gnam bye ma lung pa dang / khams /pa shes rab rdo rje la mtshan brjod gsan cing / dgyes rdor lha dgu/ bdag med ma lha/ mo bco lnga/gdan bzhi zhwa mang / ye shes dbang phyug ma/ ma hā mā yā lha lnga/ gur rigs bsdus te rje mar pa las byung ba drug dang / smṛ ti lugs kyi 'jam dpal gsang ldan te bdun la rngog dkyil bdun du grags/ ri bo khyung lding gi lha khang btab/ mthar dgung lo drug cu re bdun pa rab byung gnyis pa'i chu rta spyi lo1103 lor sku gshegs/ khong gi slob ma ba ram rtsa can/ pa lba ba can/ rngog mun pa can/ sum pa khod ka can te can bzhi sogs rim par byon/shar gyi ka chen mtshur ston dbang gi rdo rje ni/ dol gyi mda' na 'ches dang mtshur zhes bya ba'i rigs gnyis yod pa las mtshur gyi rigs sngags 'chang gi rgyud pa mthu che ba zhig gi sras su 'khrungs/ gzhon nu'i dus su dge ba'i bshes gnyen lce pa'i sar slob gnyer la byon/ khong gi khyim yo byad kyis dbul bas mas ma bzod de khyod 'tshar longs byung na nor 'byung bas de'i tshe rig pa bslab pas chog med/ da lta rang gi khyim du 'dug ces bskul bar mkhas pa thams cad dka' ba spyad cing / brtson 'grus bskyed pa las 'byung ba yin pas a mas nga'i chos kyi bar chad ma byed cig nga sangs rgyas pa'i tshe khyed brtse bas mi 'dor ba yin no gsungs te slob gnyer la 'bad pa chen po mdzad/ dus phyis sku bsod rgyas te 'bum bzhengs skyu4'i yig mkhan la da lta gsang ba 'dus pa'i gdams pa su che dris par mar pa lho brag pa che zer ba gsan/ dad pas yid drangs te 380

lho brag tu mar pa'i spyan sngar phebs nas gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud dang gdams pa gnang bar zhus pas mar pa'i zhal nas khyod mthu shin tu che ba zhig yin 'dug pas/ nga'i pha spun mar pa mon nag bya ba 'dis nga la ga nod chen po skyel gyi yod pas khyod kyis mthu zhig gyis dang / mthus nus rīpa thon na gzod khyod la chos ster gsungs pa ltar mtshur ston gyis zla ba gcig mtshams bcad de mthu bsgru bas par rtags khyad par can byung bas zla ba che ge mo'i gnasto stong la kho 'chi bar yod pas kho la dus 'debs zhus/ mar pas kyang rīmar pa mon nag la khyod zla ba 'di 'dra zhig gi gnam stong la sgugs shig gsung ba'i dus btab pa de'i gnam stong gi nyin par kho rtsig pa'i 'khris shig na yod pas de ring bla ma mar pa'i mthu gtong ba'i dus yin zer ba de'i mur khang pa'i pu shu la shing gi pad yod pa rlung gis sgyur ba'i gseb na rdo yod pa /bo'i mgo la phog ste shi/ der bla ma mar pa mnyes nas chos phra mo 'dra ba gnang ste rdzogs par gnang ba zhal gyis bzhes pa ltar phyis mtshur ston gyis dol mdar rang gi gnas su mar pa spyan drangs ska bas richa/ lnga'i man ngag dang / rgyud rkyang gi bshad pa rdzogs par gam/nga ba dang tshogs 'khor sa/cig zhus pa'i tshe rje mar pas rang gi rgya gar du chos btsal lugs dang / dka' ba spyad lugs rnams mgur du bache/sa mthar/rngo+os༈ de ltar dka' ba thugs dgongs la/khyed le lo mi mdzad sgrub par zhu/zhes gsushāno sa nas lho brag tu phebs pa bcas mtshur ston ni mar pa'i slob ma'i ba tsā/ca boḍin grasi sri su gyur pa dang / mchur ston la slob ma mang du 381

yod pa las gtso bo ni khams pa ro mnyam rdo rje dang / mkhon gad pa bīsnyi/'ches ston bsod nams rgyal mtshan gsum yin/ de dag gi dngos dang rgyud pa'i slob ma rnams kyis gsang 'dus mar pa'i chos rgyud rgya cher spel ba lags so//nub kyi ka chen gtsang rong gi mes ston tshon po ni nyang stod stag tshal ba yin/ mtshan la bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhu ba dang / gnas gzhi ra do'i bdag po yin/ khong gi/sa 'bul ba lan gsum gyis rje mar pa mnyes par byas/ ma hā mā yā dang gdams ngag mtha' yas pa gnang / slob ma zhang bsod nams mkha' sogs grub pa thob pa mang du byon/byang gi ka chen te rje mi la ras pa ni/ ldog stag ris na rigs spyi khyung po bye brag mi la yin pa zhig khyim gzhis rgyan du btsugs shing sho brgyab pas pham nas yul thon te la stod mang yul gung thang gi skya rnga rtsa ru chags pa'i yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan dang / yum myang bza' dkar rgyan gnyis kyi sras su rab byung dang po'i lcags 'brug spyi lo1040lor sku 'khrungs shing / gzhon nu'i skabs kyi mtsha na la thos/ pa dga' zhes btags/ khong sku bltams nas ring por ma lon par yab sku gshegs/yum dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa yin par a khu'i bu'i chung ma byed dgos zer bar ma sa/san pas a khu dang a ni khros te nor rdzas thams cad phrogs/ shin tu nyams thag pa'i gnas/ su lhung ba'i tshe dus nam zhig khong la klog slob pa'i slob dpon khyim tshang zhig gis chang ston la gdan drangs pa'i sar chang gsol nas glu len zhing nado la log phebs pas yum khros te/ pha mi la shes 382

rab rgya' mtshan la bu khyod 'dra ba skyes/ nged ma smad kyi 'khos ka 'di tsam la thug par da dung khyod kyis glu gtong rgyu dran nam zhes spyo ba drag po dang bcas mthar yumyoge gyi bka' bskul ba ltar dbunu/ su byon nas mthu ser bslabs te dgra bo thams cad brlag par mdzad/ rdzogs chen pa mdzad dus rong ston lha dgas rje mar pa'i snyan pa brjod pa gsan pas dad pa chen po 'khrungs te mar pa'i spyan sngar de ma thag byon/ rje mar pa la yang man/la lam du bud med gnyis kyis shel gyi rdo rje zhig gtad 3sa 'di khrus la rgyal mamen gyi rtser zhog bla ma'i bka' lung yin zer bu ltari byas pas 'od kyis 'dzarma/ gling khyab pa'i ltas gzigs pa ltar mi la thog ma phebs skabs bla mas bsu bar byon te nga rgyal mi skye ba'i phyir du phru slog pa lta ra mdzad/ mar pas mi lar 'di rkos shig gsungs pa lta ra bka'e thog ma bsgrubs/ skyem chang gnang ba gtsang mar bzhes pas gdams ngag gi snod du dgongs nas rjes su bzung / sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i slad du sku mkhar zlum po/ sog ka/ zla gam/ gru sa/sum rnams rtsig bcug pa slar yang bshigamathar sras mkhar dgu thog zhes su grags pa gru bzhi dgu thog rtse mo rin po che 'bar ba lta bu rtsigs gsungs nas mdo khyams dbu rtse dang bcas pa brtsigs par mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang dbang gral nas lan mang du bton pa soganu/ yid chad chen po bdur+ṣa/ gyi/ nga shaṃ sgrib pa sbyangs/ de nas bla mas yid chad che na po lan dgu thongs na thos pas gro la ba zhig 'ong ba la/da snying rus shig dgos te slad nas 'ong gsungs sngon gyi+o mnal ltas las rdo rje rgyal mtsha na du mtsha na btags te bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang 383

bskur/ lha dang bla mas gsang mtshan bzhad pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba btags par grags/ gdams ngag thams cad chang sprugs su gnang nas sgom du btsug mnal lam du yul gyi khang pa zhig yum grongs/ sring mo 'khyar ba sogs gzigs pas yul la 'byon par 'dod nas khur byon pa'i tshe/ sku mkhar dang skar khung nas bla ma'i dbu la nyi ma shar/ bla ma mnal du song /yum gso'/ 'dren du byung ba'i dbu sngas su gtsang la yar 'gro'i glu phul bas khyod 'gro na btang bas chog ste nga gnyid du song ba dang thug pas phyis mi phrad/ mkhar dang nga' mgo la nyi ma shar bas khyod kyis bstan pa snyi dang bka' brgyud kyi ngastan pa nyin mor byed pa ltar 'ong / bdag med mas zas khyer ba 'dis khyod ting 'jin gyis 'tsho ba'i rten 'brel yin gsungs te gdams ngag thams cad gnang ste sdug thug pa'i dus 'di ltos de bar ma lta gsungs nas shog dril la tham ga brgyab pa zhig gnang / khyod la byin dang gzhan la byin//gal te srang la bcal yod na//sum 'gyur bas kyang mi lha rtsa/ ri//zhes gsungs te bstan pa gtad/ chos la zhes pa'i bar skyel thung mdzad de spyi bor phyag bzhag nas smon lam dang / gnas dang rgyud 'dzin la sos/sa pa'i ma 'ongs lung bsta na du d+dha/ mdza da pa ngacas mar pa'i zhabs drung nas byon te lam du rngog la'ang phyag mdzad/de ltare rje btsun mi las dgung lo suspo cu tsa brgyad pa la mar pa'i drung du byon pa nas dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi'i bar du bzhugs shing / 384

dgung lo zhe lnga pa nas bla ma'i bka' bzhin dka' spyad kyi sgrub pa la gzhol nas zhi bar ma gshegs bar lo bzhi bcu'i ring sku lus sgom thag dang ma bral bar bzhugs par grags/de yang mar pa'i sku drung nas rang yul du phebs pa'i tshe ma nal lam byung ba ji bzhin gzigs pas skyo shas cher skyes te dang por rkang tshugs phug tu 'tsho ba zhing rin la brten nas bsgoms/ de nas brag dkar rta sor grwa'i tshod ma la brten te bcu gnyis cha bzhi'i dam bca' mdzad nas bsgoms tshe sring mo dang mdzes se'i zas skom gyis rkyen byas te khams 'dus pa'i rnam pa ci yang byung tshe shog dril sa/zigs pas/ rlung sems gnyis med kyi gdams ngag byung ste bogaṭa/ su thon/ grub pa thob nas smin khyugs grib ma rdzong dang phan tshun du 'phur zhing bsgoms/ ling ba'i brag tu dbu ma'i mar snar me rlung tshud pa'i rten 'brel brag srin cho/'i cho 'phrul snang ba dang /sman lung chu bar du mgrin pa'i chu mdud zhig pa'i rten 'abhel tshe ring ma'i skor snang / chu la mi bying bas zhu yas dar ca/ dbang phyu ga dang / khyi dang sha ba ma mad ltar dul bas khyi ra ba mgon po rdo rje btul/ gang dkar ti se'i rtser gshegs pa la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis na ro bon chung btul/snyan pa'i gragaṅge pa sa phyogs kun tu khyab cing thugs kyi sras mchog rje sgam po pa la bstan pa gtad de dgung lo gya bzhi pa rab byung sa/nyis pa'i chu yos spyi lo 11ṛ3 wor sku gshegs/slob ma'i mchog/ ni rje sgam po ba dang / ras chung pa/ de bzhin 'bri sgom ras pa/ se ban ras pa/ ras pa zhi ba 'od/ khyi ra ras pa/385

ngan rdzong ras pa/ bde ba skyong / ra rdzi ras pa ste ras pa mched brgyad/ston pa drug ras ma bcu gnyis/ grub thob ma drug sogs bgrangs kyis mi lang ngo — rje btsun mi la'i bu slob rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa dwags po bka' brgyud kyi mtshan thogs yul rje sgam po ba ni/ yab snyi'i rigs las byung ba snyi ba rgyal po dang / yum sho mo bza' che lcam gnyis la sras gsum mnga' ba'i 'bring por rab byung dang po'i sa lug spyi lo10gyi9lor yul gnyal snyir 'khrungs/ gzhon nu'i dus su sman bslabs pas mkhas par mkhyen cing / jo mo zhig kyang bzhes pa de gzhon nur 'das pas thugs skyo ste/dgung lo nyi shu rtsa drug pa la dge ba'i bshes gnyen shab pa gling pa la chig rdzogs mdzad/ dwags po smad du mar yul blo ldan la bde mchog dang rin chen rgyan drug ma la sogs pa'i dbang mang po gsan/de rjes dbu ru byang phyogs su byon nas bya yul ba dang / snyug rum pa/ lcags ri gong kha ba rnams la bka' gdams kyi chos mang du gsan/de nas slob dpon byang chub sems dpa' la sgom pa'i man ngag zhus nas bsgoms pas zhag bcu gsum tsam du mi 'chor ba'i ting nge 'dzin yang 'khrungs/ de rjes rang gi yul du byon nas sgom zhing bzhugs pa'i tshe nya logs na sprang po gsum 'dug pa'i gcig na re/ zan rdog ches pa re dang tshod ma phor pa re bzar yod na dga' ba la zer/ garīg gis smon ne zer na mnga' bdag rtse lde lta bu la smon mod zer/ rgan pa rgecig na re/ smon no rang yin na mi la ras pa bya ba zas gos kyi zhen pa med pa/ nam mkha' la 386

'phur nas phar 'byon tshur 'byon byed pa zhig yod par 'dug de 'dra ba la smon mod zer bas mi la'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis shin tu dad par gyur te sprang po de rnam la bza' btung gang dgos gnang nas rnal 'byor pa de 'dra ba gang na bzhugs dris pas brin snye nam gyi ri la bzhugs pa yin/ la las khong mjal du phyin yang mi mthong / la las mchod rten du mthong ba yin zer ba gsan pa'i dgong mo de gar mi la sgom zhing bzhugs pa'i rmi lam du rnga chen po gcig brdungs pas yul rgya chen por thos pa dang / rag dung gcig bus pas kyang skad shin tu che la bod na 'di la sa che ba'i rag dung med zer ba rmis pas bla ma rje btsun de dang mjal ba'i ltas yin nam dgongs pa byung / de nas mi la mjal ba'i lam du chas shing dbu ru'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'bul du byon nasami la ras pa'i snyan pa gsan pas khong mjal du 'gro zhus pas/ la las nged tsho rang gi gdams ngag gis chog mod gsungs par btud de zhus pas song zhig pa'i gnang ba dang / nged kyi rtags ma bor ba bya dgos gsungs/ 'gongs ston bya ba 'i/0/ dang 'grogs nas rje btsun mjal du byon pas 'gongs ston gtsang tshong 'dus su skung ste lus/ khong sku rkyang mar byon pas rje btsun mi la dang mjal ba la nyi ma phyed dang gnyis tsam yod pa'i bar bsnyun drag po 'grongs su tsha ba gcig byung ba la rje btsun nyid la gsol ba btab pas bsnyun gzhi gyur du gsos/ de narme brin du phebs pa'i tshe btsun pa zhig bsur byung nas sgod bsod nams che/ bla ma khyed 'byon pa na ning nas lung bstan/ da lta nga bsur gtong ba gnang byung zhes gsan pas nga yang skal ldan du 'dug snyam 387

pa'i khengs pa cung zhig 'khrungaṭa/ pas rje btsun gyis zla ba phyed mjal du ma gnang / de nas nyin zhig shog sa/sungs pa ltar byon pas rje btsun pha bong zhig gi steng na bzhugs par gser dum gcig dang / ja thum bu gcig yod pa phul bas gser la 'di dang nga lo mi mthun gsungs nas ma bzhes/ja la yang nga la skol ba'i thab tsha med gsungs nas phyir sa/nang / chang ka pā la gang 'dug pa gnang ba dge slong yin pas 'thung du mi rung snyam byung ba na/ nan gyis brka//'a dwartsar bas lhag ma lus par bsla /sa/ khyod kyi ming la ci zer gsungs par/ bsod nams rin chen bya ba lags zhus pas/bsod nams bsod nams bya ba lan gsum gsungs nas/bsod nams tshogs gnyis bsags las byung //sems can kun gyi rin po che//zhes bya ba mgur du bzhes nas khong la dbus pa ston par sna len gyis gsungs/ de nas gdams pa zab mo rnams bdag la gnang bar zhus pas/ sngar dbang thob bam gsu ngas/ mar yul blo ldan la rin chen rgyan drug dang bde mchog la sogs pa'i dbang mang po thob pa dang / dbu ru bya nga phyos/sa su bka' gdams kyi gdams ngag zang mang du mnyan/ zhag bcu gsum du mi 'chor ba'i ting 'dzin zhig kyang yod zhus pas ha ha zhes bzhad sge+o/ chen po zhig mdzad/ de 'dra ba'i ting nge 'dzin bas gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i lha la bskal pa'i bar du mi 'chor bah+pho ting nge 'dzin yod de des 3cha7 nga rgya ba la mi phan bye ma btsir bas mar khu mi thon pa dang 'dra/ bka' gdams pa la'ang gdams ngag yod de man ngag med/388

bod kyi snying la 'dre zhugs pas jo bo rje gsang sngags 'chad du ma bcugade bcug na da lta bod grub thob kyis gang 'ongarib yi na/ bka' gdams pa la bskyed rim lnga po red po re dang / rdzogs rim snod bcud 'od gsal du bsdus pa re las med/ da khyod rang nga'i gtum rma a thung sgoms dang gsungs/ der gser zho gnyis brin du gnas po gcig la gtad nas khos rgyags skyel bar khas blangs/ pha bong zhig gi rtsar shing dang bal po la bsdus pa'i khang chung zhig byas nas gzod gdams ngas/ zhus pa na khyod la sngar dbang thob pa de tshos go mi chod pa min kyang / nga'i lugs ba'i/na bya dgos gsungs nas phag mo'i byin rlabs kyi bka' zhig gnang ba de nas/ mi la'i gdams ngag rnams bsgoms pas rtags mtha' yas pa rim par byung ba bla ma la zhus pas thams cad la lus kyi gnad 'dir rlung dang khamyo/sa zin pa'i rtags yin/ skyon yang min yon tan yang min da dung sgoms shig gsungs nas bskyangs pas zhag re la rlung thengs res chog pa dang /rlung lag sor gyi rtse mor 'drongs pa byung ba zhus pas/ de yang rlung la dbang thob pa ni min las su rung ba ni yin gsungs/ nyi zla gzas gzung ba'i snang ba byung nas/ da ni da ni bya ba lan gsum gsung zhing mchog tu gtum mo gnang / de'i rtags khyad par can byung ba na khyod pho rgo da rab tu 'dug gsungs/ de ltar mi la'i zhabs drung du zla ba bcu gsu ma song rjes da dbus/ pa ston pa rang dbus su bzhud gsungs shing / zam sna gcig gi bar du gnas der da 'jig rten blos thongs 9sdo sgrub pa 'ba' zhig gyis/ dug gsum rgyas pa'i mi dang ma 'grogs/ de rnams kyi kha rlangs 389

kyis/ rang gi dge sbyor 'grib pa yin pas gnas ri khrod dang dgon pa 'ba' zhig bsten/ da ste lo gsum na khyod la dge sbyor gsha' ma zhig skye/ de'i dus su nga la'ang mthong 'di min na zhig 'ong gsung ba la sogs pa'i zhal bkod mang po gnang / de nas sgam po ba gnyal du phebs/ se ba lung zhes bya ba'i dgon par bzhugs/ der bka' gdams pa'i dge 'dun mang po yod pas 'di rnams kyi chos spyod kyi ram ma bteg na sdig gsog dgongs nas ram bteg cing / de rnams dang spyod lam bstun pas ting nge 'dzin cung zhig 'gribs/ da 'dis mi 'ong bar 'dug dgongs nas lo gsum stan dang ma bral bar sgom pa'i brtson 'grus bskyed pas gzod sems kyi ngo bo mthong / chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid mkhyen/ bla mas gsungs pa'i dge sbyor gsha' ma de 'di yin par 'dug snyam pa dang / bla ma rje btsun de yang chos kyi sku nyid du 'dug pa la rang res grub thob chen po zhig tu gzung 'dug snyam pa'ang byung ba sogs de nas dbe+en pa'i gnas mang por sgrub pa la gcig tu gzhol zhing / mthar 'o de gung rgyal spyi gangs la bzhugs nas sgrub pa gnang ste lo mang rab song ba na nyin gcig mi rgan la thod can gos bzang po gyon pa zhig byung nas ngas 'dir khyed kyi zhabs tog bya snyam pa yin te da nga'i bu dwags lha sgam pos gdan 'dren par ma'adug pas der phebs shig zer nas mi snang bar gyur par grags/de yang rje sgam po ba dgung lo sum cu so gnyis pa rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags stag spyi lo1110 lor rje btsun mi la dang mjal nas mi la'i spyan sngar lo gcig bzhugs te thon khar rje patsun gyis lo bcu gnyis song 390

ba na brin gyi ri la shog cig gsung sa myong ba phyis dben pa bsten jipre'i su skabs dran nas 'byon par dgongs te lam du zhugs nas yar klungaṭ+wāṃri sri phebs pa na rje btsun sku gshegs pa'i gtam thos shing / khyod kyi skal ba yin zer ba'i rten yang phyag tu son/ de nas dben pa bsten nas bsgoms pa dang / 'o de gung rgyal nas sgam por phebs te rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags glang spyi lo 1131lor sgam po'i dgon pa btab nas dgon pa dar rgyas dang / gdams ngag chen po spel bar mdzad pa de nas bzung yongs grags su dwags po bka' brgyud ces pa'i grub mtha' byung ba yin/de la rje btsun mi la ni thabs lam dang phyag rgya chen po logs su mi mdzad pa la rje sgam po bas sngags kyi snod rung rnams la thabs lam gyi gdams ngag bstan/ dbang bskur med kyang pha rol tu phyin pa'i snod du rung ba rnams la phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa btab ste lhan cig skyes sbyor zhes bya ba'i khrid rim mdzad pa de la dwags po'i rtogs chos kyang zer/gsung rab rnams nas bla ma dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid mang du gsung na'ang / slob ma la mtshan nyid mang po mi dgos/ mos gus yod pa gcig pus chog gsungs shing / blun po dang dbul phongs dang sdig can du gyur pa 'tha /'a la yang phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa yun mi ring bar bskyed/bka' gdams kyi bstan pa'i rim pa'i bstan bcos kyang mdzad/gdams ngab/ kyang mang du gsungs pa 'di nas bka' rdzu ga chu bo gnyi sa 'dres su grags te gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa'i snyan grags phyogs thams cad du khyab pa bcas mthar dgung lo bdun cu rtsa lnga pa rab byung 391

gsum pa'i chu bya spyi lo1bhe'3lor sku gshegs/rje sgam po ba'i gsung las skyes nga 'i bu chen rmi nga / sgo rom 'phags pa/ zim shi nga ye shes snying po/ gser sgom ye shes snying po/ raca/ nyi ba chos kyi g.yung drung ste grub nga/ thob pa bzhi/ dwags po sgom tshul/ phag mo gru pa/ 'ba' rom pa/ dus gsum mkhyen pa ste rgyud pa 'dzin pa bzhi/dwags po 'dul 'dzin/ 'gar sgom dkar po/ la yag jo sras/ skye bo ye rdor te de dang nye ba bzhi/ jo ston/ legs mdzes/ gsal byang /gsal yes te nye gnas bzhi ste de dag la sgam po ba'i bu chen bcu drug tu grags shing / gzhan yang rmog cog pa/ khyung tshang ba la sogs pa mang du byon pa bcas mnyam med dwags po lha rje zla 'od gzhon nu'am/ sgam po ba blo gros grags pa'am/ bsod nams rin chen zhes bya ba mtshan gyi rnam grangs su 'dzin pa'i skyes mchog 'di nyid kyis rje mar pa dang / mi la'i bzhed srol rgya cher spel bas dwags po bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir ches cher dar ba 'di'i shing rta'i srol 'byed la mtshon na ring sa nas mar pa dang / mi la/ nye sa nas rje sgam po ba 'di nyid la gtugs pas bka' brgyud kyi mes po mar mi dwags gsum zhes snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs kyi bu mo'i rna ba'i rgyan du spud pa de ltar lags pa'i khong rnams kyi mdzad pa rags bsdus gleng mtshams 'dir byas nas de yang dwags po bka' brgyud la dwags po lha rje dngos la gtugs pa'i bka' brgyud che bzhi dang dwags po lha rje'i dngos slob phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal po la gtugs pa'i bka' brgyud chung brgyad du ngos 'dzin pa'i tshul yang yod 392

mod/ skabs 'dir thu'u bkan grub mtha'i nang dwags po bka' brgyud khag so sor gyes lugs karma bka' brgyud dang / phag gru/ tshal pa/'bri gung ba/ 'brug pa/ stag lung / 'ba' rom/ g.ya' bzang /khro phu bcas su gyes pa'i rim pa ltar phyogs bsgrigs byas par/1 karma bka' brgyud ni/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i slob ma karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'am/ khams pa dbu se zhes bya ba las brgyud pa zhig ste/ de yang karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa ni mdo khams kye shod du yab sgom pa rdo rje mgon dang / yum lha thog bza' sgang lcam ming 'dren gnyis kyi sras su rab byu nga gnyis pa'i lcags stag spyi lo1110 lor sku 'khrungs/mtshan dge 'phel du btags/ dgung lo bcu drug par rngog lo'i slob matre bo mchog gi bla ma dang / chag seng ge grags pa las rab tu byung /mtshan dpal chos kyi grags pa zhes bya ba gsol/ dgung lo nyi shu par dbus su byon/ stod lung se thang du rgya dmar ba dang / phywa pa chos kyi seng ge las byams chos dang dbu tshad/ tha ra ba las bka' gdams/ pa tshab las rig chos/sa/ sa skya pa'i thugs sras gshen rdor bzang las lam 'bras/ sga lo dang a seng las sbyor drug sogs rim par gsan/ dgung lo surnga/ cu par mal 'dul 'dzin las bsnyen par rdzogs/ dgung lo so gsum par mnyam med dwags po lha rje dang mjal te snying po'i don la sgro 'dogs chod rnga/ dang / dwagaru/ po lha rdze'i thugs sras gtso bo'i gras su gyur/ ‘ོro/ rer ras chung pa da nga mjal nas chos drug sogs nā ro mai tre'i gdams ngag ji snyed pa gsan pa dang / gzhan ya nga bla ma mang po las 393

gdamyo/sa pa du ma mnos/ dbe+en gnas mang por sgrub pa mdzad pas grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs/karma pa dgung lo so brgyad phebs pa rab byung gsum pa'i me yos spyi lo 1147 lor khams ri bo cher karma lha steng gi dgon pa btab pa de nas khong gi sku phreng rim par karma pa'i mtshan thogs shing / de rjes shing phag spyi lo1155la mtshur phur karma dgon btab pas karma pa'i gdan sa gong 'og gnyis su grags shing / de rjes shing sprel lor khams su kam po gnas nang dgon btab/ mthar sku gshegs pa'i skor mkhas pa'i dga' ston nang ‘‘de ltar don gnyis mthar phyin dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa chu mo glang (spyi lo1193) gi lo'i zla ba bcu gcig pa stag gi zla ba'i tshes gsum la sgang lo tsā ba zham ring du yod pa la gzhon nu khyod kyis lo shas 'dir sdod la kho bo'i sku gsung thugs rten rnams gcig kyang ma 'thor ba gyis/ ngas kyang chos skyong la bcol bu yin zhes sprul pa'i sku dngos su 'byon par don gyis lung bstan te yar tshes gsum du sku'i bkod pa bsdus/ ’ (mkhas dga' lcags par ma shog grangs 8smordzo)zhes gsal bu ltar dgung lo brgyad cu gya bzhi par sku gshegs pa dang / sprul pa'i sku dngos su 'byon par don gyis lung bstan par gsungs pa ltar sku phreng gnyis pa karma pak+ṣi chos kyi bla ma byon pa 'di ni gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir sprul pa'i sku byon pa'i thog ma yin no// nekarma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'i dngos slob mngon shes kyi bkak+ṣ-ir babs lde chung sangs rgyas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi bka' babs 'bal stag del ba/394

rnam thar gyi bka' babs bra ba bka' gdams pa/ rtogs pa'i bka' babs dbra ye dge chos brtson/ 'gro don gyi bka' babs 'gro mgon ras chen te bka' babs kyi bu lnga/ gya ba gangs pa/ rang byung sangs rgyas/gtsang so ba dkon seng / 'gro mgon ras chen bsnan pa sa rgyud 'dzin gyi bu bzhi/ nam mkha' 'od/ ye shes 'od/ yon tan 'od/ dge 'dun 'od de nye gnas 'od bzhi/ ye shes bla ma/ smon lam bla ma / 'byung gnas bla rme / rgyal mtshan bla ma ste bla ma bzhi/ dge slong brtson 'grus shes rab/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mdog mkhas pa/ rmeng ge jo sras te snga bu bzhi/ gtsang ston tshul seng / tre bo dkon mchog dpal/ rdo rje shes rab/ sgang lo tsā ba ste phyi bu bzhi bcas yongs grags kyi bu chen rnams dang / lho la yag pa byang chub dngos grub la sogs pa gzhan yang mang du mchis so//karma pa'i sku phreng ni/ dang po dus gsum mkhyen pa/ gnyis pa karma pak+ṣi chos kyi bla ma(spyi lo130bhed 1383) gsum pa karma rang byung rdo rje (138bhed 1339) bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje (1྅40da 138kā) lnga pa de bzhin gshegs pa (1kā8tred 1bhe1me) drug pa mthong ba don ldan (1bhe1l+yad 14'a3)bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho (145bhed 1'a0a+yo)brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje (1'a0gyid 1me54)la sogs pa karma pa'i sku phreng rim par byon pa bcas karma pa'i sku phreng na rim dang de dag gi slob ma dang yang slob kyis karma bka' brgyud kyi grub mtha' rgya cher 'dzim/ skyong spel gsum gnang yod/ karma bka' brgyud 'di la nang gses zhwa dmyo/ra nag gi 395

khyad par yod pas gong du zhus pa'i karma pa'i sku phring de rnams ni karma zhwa nag gi rabs yin pa dang / karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'i slob ma tshul khrims dpal gyi skye rgyud zhwa dmar sprul sku mkha' spyod dbang po'i sku skye na rim la karma zhwa dmar du grags pa lags so// rdzo3 phag gru bka' brgyud ni/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i sras kyi thu bo phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal po las brgyud pa zhig ste/ de yang phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal po ni/ gdung rus dbas wa na 'phan thog gi rig/ṭa las byung ba yab dbas wa na a dar dang yum re 'bye bza' btsun ne bya ba'i sras su rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags ti /be+e/ spyi lo111༷ lor mdo khams kyi lho rgyud 'bri lung sne shod kyi stag ngos sab khang bya bar sku 'khrungs/dgung lo dgu par bya khyi lha khang du mkhan po lhing de yan thub bu tshul khrims dang / slob dpon lhing de 'od zer rgyal mtshan las rab tu byung zhing / mtshan la rdo rje rgyal po gsol/ khams su bla ma bcu drug tsam bsten te gsan pa rgya chen mjod pa dang // spyod 'jug la bshad pa 'ga' re yang mdzad/dgung lo bcu dgu pa la dbus su byon nas stod lung du dge bshes rgya dmar ba dang / phywa pa chos kyi seng ge la chos gsan/dgung lo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la zul phur bya 'dul gyis mkhan po/ rgya dmar gyis slob dpon/ ar gyis gsang ston mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang /mkhan slob las 'dul ba/ gsang ston las phar phyin/ myang bran las spyod 'jug sogs gsan pas mkhas pa'i rtse mor son/ gzhan yang dmar 396

chos rgyal dang / dpal chen rga lo/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ 'byim lo tsā ba dang / byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan sogs bsten nas mdo sngags kyi gdams pa mang du rga/san/de rjes sgam por byon nas mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i drung du gdams ngag gas na pas phag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa mchog tu gyur cing / de rjes 'on du phebs nas mtshal sgang du lo ngo lnga tsam gyi bar bzhugs ring slob ma 'dus pa rnams la dwags po'i gdams pa gtso bor gyur pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs mang pos tshims par mdzad/ dge 'dun gre/nga bzhugs pa rnams la rnam pa kun tu dam pa'i chos 'dul ba las mi 'gal badza spyo spyo/—pa 'dzin dgos zhes nan gyis/ gsungs pa dang / gdams ngag btab pa rnams thebs sla zhing bsam gtan gyi sgo mang du skyes pas phyogs thams cad du snyan pa rgya cher 'phel/de yang je sgam po ba de bka' gdams dang / rje btsun mi la'i phyag chen gyi lugs gnyis ka 'dzin pas bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres su grags pa banin mtshal sgang du mdzad pa'i gar gyi nyams dgu yang de dang mthun/de nas der grong yul dang thag nye ba ni mi legs pas dben pa bsten pa thugs la dgengs nas nam 'i/ga dge 'dun rnams la gros med par sa/dan sa rin po cher 'byon pa'i lam du tsha rong btsad po'i sgo drung du byon nas dar ya/ma zhig bskur/ kho bo ni mtshal sgang du sdod pa de lags/ da phag mo gru'i nags pha gir sdod snyam pas spyan ras kyis btsa' bar zhu bya ba'i lan bskur bas btsad po'i po/sung gis nang du tsha ba la byon ze ra/ kho bo 397

thim pa mi 'gong ba'i dam bca' yod pas tsha ba 'di nyid du gnang bar zhu byas pas btsad po rang sgo drung du byon nas tsha ba drangs te gtam yang mdzad/de nas rin chen spungs pa'i mtha' rtsa der gdan phab pas rin po che mtha' /rtsa bar grags/ grwa pa rnams kyang phyir snyegs nas byon/ mang gar skang dang bde gshegs phug par yang thogs te bzhugs/ der rgya sgom rmi ras bya ba zhig sngar nas bsdad yod pa khong gi spyil bur tsha ba la spyan drangs pas khyod kyi spyil bu 'di skyid bya ba lan gsum gsungs pas/ bzhed na phul bas chog zer ba bzhin sa de gnas kyi snying por dgongs nas 'o na kho bo'i kom stan longs shog gsungs/ te spyil bu de nyid gnas bcas pa ste de nas chags pa'i phag mo gru pa'i gdan pa ni rab byung gnyis pa'i sa stag spyi lo 1158 lor phyag btab/ de yang thog ma rmi ras kyis phul ba'i 'jag spyil zhig las med par stag lung thang pas 'jag spyil de glang ma'i spyil bu zhig byed par zhus pas nyin gcig la grub na gyis/ de las ring ba mi rung gsungs nas nyin gcig kho nar glang spyil de bsgrubs/ der phyogs nas grwa pa mang po 'dus par gzim spyil nang bang ba chung ngu nas khal re lhag tsam shong ba zhing/ las med rung gra dmangs la rgyags 'gyed rgyu yang byung bar grags/ stag lung thang pa dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi par phag gru'i spyan sngar phebs pa nas bzung nye gnas mdzad cing / stagā lung thang pas phag grur na bza' 'di bas bzang ba re bzhes par zhu zhus pas khyod kyis kho bo la ci 'dug par mthong / kho bo ni dge 'dun skyong dgos gsung ba bzhin rtag tu dge 'dun gyi sde 'ba' zhig skyong bar mdzad/ de yang byang chub 398

simahwa/ dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan phyi nga/sung dang ma thun par zla ba mar ngo la d+dha/tshams 51 bzhugaru/ pa dang / zla ba yar ngo 'a/ yang snga dro mtshams/ mdzad pa dang / phyi dro khrid dang tshogs chos gsungs/ dge 'dun rnams kyang shin tu dad pas gzim spyi1pre nas kyokusdo khri'i bar gyi lacha/ thams cad du zhwa gos dang dar kha la sogasari/ pa 'dings/ dge 'dun de rnams nas re re gnyis gnyis tsam ma gtogs sgom btab pa thams cad la myong ba phun sum tshogs pa skyes pas phyogs thams cad du phaka mo gru pa'i zhabs drung du sleb pa kho nas chog pa'i snyan parnga she khyab/ yon bdab/ r+sha/ ngasnyen bku/ ra dang 'bul ba gang byung dge 'dun gyi sde'i thug tshul kho nar smin gtong mdzad/ sa/dan sa der sa/ stag nas lcags stag bar lo ngo bcu gsum bzhugs ring grub pa'i skyes mchob/ sku/ slo ba ma mang du byung ba dang / grwa pa brgyad brgya la sa/dugs thogs lnga brgya zhes su grarga//ṭa/ pa pyung zhing / mthar dgung lo drug cu re gcig pa rab byung gsum pa'i lcabasna/〈smu stang ba/ spyi lo1170 lo sdu/ sku gshe sa/ sa/khong bi/ slob ma ni/ mos gus mthar thug stag lung thang pa bkra shis dpal/ rto gas/ pa'i mthar thug sna zhu sa gling ras si d+ma jo rje/ shes rab mthar thus/ spar phu ba blo gros seng ce// nus pa'i mthar thug mchan bu rgya ras rnamyo/sa la mthar thug ji/ bu bzhi zer/ skal ldan ye shes seng ge/rtogs lda d+nghan mi nyag sgom rings/ grub thob nyag ras se bo/ kun ldan gtsang pa ras chung rnam sa la gdams pa'i bu bzhi zer/ chok+to / rnge 'jirga/ rten mgon po/ 'ban dha phurga/ pa/ chos nge phrum/ chos rje gtum rnams la ro gcig rto0/sa pa byed dang bgi zer/ ('di'i phyed ni 'ban snya phug par 399

jo mo mod pas byed du bgrangs pa yin) gshen sgom dkar ba/ myang gshen grong ba/ rdog seng ge kha ba/ rtsi lung ba rnams la thugs kyi sras bzhi zer/ rin po che shug rtsar ba/ lha sa ba dge 'dun skyabs/ gru gu ston pa blo gros seng ge/ rgyan thang ba rnams la yi ge ma'i bu bzhi zer/ bla ma dmar ba/ ye phug pa/ dgyer sgom/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen seng ge dpal rnams la nye ba'i sras bzhi zer/ gzhan yang grub pa thob pa'i skyes bu bgrang las 'das pa byung zhing / gdan sa mthil du 'gro mgon gyi rjes su skyu ra rin po ches cung zad bskyangs/ de rjes rlangs lha gzigs kyi gdung rgyud las byung ba spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas/ rgyal ba thog brdugs pa/bcu gnyis pa rin chen rdo rje sogs rlangs lha gzigs kyi gdung rgyud kyis phag mo gru pa'i gdan sa chos srid gnyis kyis bskyangs pa zhib par mkhyen 'dod na rlangs kyi po ti bse ru dang / lho rong chos 'byung sogs las sherdo sro par bya'o/ /phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal po 'di ni mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i bu slob rnams kyi nang nas rgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma mchog tu gyur pa mang po mnga' nga sa ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad bka' brgyud chung brgyad du gras/sa pa 'di las gyes pa'i rabs yod pa bcas 'phrin las ches che ba byung ba yin no//kā tshal pa bka' brgyud ni/ zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po g.yu brag pa'am skye med zhang brtson 'grus grags pa las brgyud pa zhig ste/ de yang zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po ni yab sngags pa rdo rje sems dpa' dang / yum mang skyid gnyis kyi sras su rab byung gnyis pa'i chu yos spyi lo 113kā lor 400

yul tsha ba grur 'khrungs shing / mtshan la dar ma zhes btags/dgung lo bdun par yum dang / gcen pos klog yig bslabs/dkung lo dgu par bye'u ston pa nas sdud pa dang / mngon rtogs rgyan la sogs pa gsan pa de nas dgung lo bco brgyad bar slob dpon gshen dang / rngog mdo sde sogs bsten nas mdo sngags kyi chos mang du gsan/dgung lo bco brgyad pa la pha tshan gyi brnyas pa byung bas lo gsum mthu bsgrubs nas tshar bcad/de rjes khams su byon nas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gsum par slob dpon blo ston bya ba bsten nas khrims lnga'i sdom pa blangs/dgung lo nyi shu rtsa drug par dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhar sgo ba dang /slob dpon grab mkhar ba/ gsang ston gzung ljang mdo ba rnams las bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mtshan brtson 'grus grags zhes gsol/ de nas lo gcig tsog pu dang stan cig mdzad/ na bza' brje ba'i dus ma gtogs sku rags kyang ma bkrol bar byang chub ltung bshags la pod skor mdzad cing bzhugs/de rjes rga lo'i drung du phebs te gdams ngag mang du gsan/dgung lo sum cu so gsum par mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i slob ma dwags po sgom pa tshul khrims snying po dang mjal te phyag rgya chen po gsan pas bka' brgyud kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ sems kyi ngo bo rjen par gzigs/dgung lo drug cu re gsum pa rab byung gnyis pa'i sheng lug spyi lo 117'a lor gung thang gi gtsug lag khang lha chen dang bcas pa bzhengs/dgung lo don gnyis pa rab byung gsum pa'i chu glang spyi lo 11rdzo3401

lor gung thang gi 'bum mo che bzhengs pa'i lo der sku gshegs/slob ma mang du byung ba'i nang nas gtso bo ni/ nam mkha' 'od dang /kha rag pa 'dul ba 'od/ lha phyug pa nyi zla 'od/ 'bri ra ba shākya 'od de bzhi kas dgon pa btab cing / 'dul ba 'od kyis /ba rag tu klu btul dgon pa btab pas de'i dbon po'i ring la grwa pa khri tsam tshogs zer/gdan sa dngos mnyam med shākya ye shes dang / de nas slob dpon byang chub ye shes/ lha phyug pa nyi zla 'od/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ sangs/ rgyas/ snying po/ sangs rgyas ras pa/ gser khang steng pa sogs kyis bskya ngas shing de'i choyo rgyud la tshal pa bka' brgyud ces grags pa lags so//bhe 'bri gung bka' brgyud skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po pas brgyud pa zhig ste/ de yang skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po ni/ yab 'dru rgyal skyu ra'i gdung las byung ba rdo rje dang / yum btsun ma gnyis kyi sras su rab byung gnyis pa'i chu phag spyi lo 1143 lor khams ldan stod tsong ngu zhes bya bar 'khrungs/ gzhon nu'i dus yab chos phal cher gsan bsam gyis mkhyen cing / dus de shed du yul der nyams nga ba'i mu ge byung bas lhor byon nas phyug po dag la klog dom blangs pa'i yon gyis rang dang gnas pa gso ba mdzad/ dgung lo dgu pa'i skabs dpal phag mo gru pa'i snyan pa gsan pas dad pa 'khrungs te zla ba shar ba na zla ba ya gis nga'i bla ma de mthong ba re dga' snyam pa'ang byung / de nas rim bzhin cha rkyen cung zad gson pa la brten nas bod du byon/dgung lo nyer lnga phebs pa me phag spyi lo11a+yo7 lor 'gro makon phag 402

mo gru pa da nga 'jal te ja dang rta sogs phul bas ja ni bzhes/ rta ni dud 'gro'i 'bul ba mi len gsungs nas ma bzhes/ mtshan la rin chen dpal du btags shing / gdams pa gsan pas chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid mngon sum du gzigs pa'i ye shes chen po ni 'khrungs/ 'gro mgon gyi zhabs drung du phebs nas zla ba sum cu rtsa gnyis na 'gro ba'i mgon po gshegs/ de nas e chung phug par thugs dam la bzhugs pas glo bur du bsnyun mdze drag po zhig byung bar dgongs pa la rdza gseb tu zhugs te gdung mis mi cha/thong bar bya snyam nas 'byon par chas kyang sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal la snying rje chen po 'khrungs pas bsnyun gzhi'i rkyen klu gdon de yang sku lus nas thon te bsnyun gzhi yang drag sngon bla ma rin po ches kyang khyod rab tu byung gsung ba la/ rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba brgyad khal dang 'dra ba'i steng du/ bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba spong ba gong tsha lta bu mi theg dgongs nas ma blangs/ phyis g.ye chung du bcas rang ngo bo gcig pa dang / bkag pa ye bkag gnang ba ye gnang dang chos kyi rgyal pos 'gro ba spyi la bcas pa dang nyams pa las ma blangs pa nyes pa lci ba sogs kyi gnad dgongs pas rab tu mi 'byung 7 med du 'dug par mkhyen nas dgung lo so lnga pa me mo bya 1177 lo la zhang gis mkhan po dang / rtsi lung pas slo ba dpon/ snyal pa 'dul 'dzin gyis gsang ston mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/snyal 'dul las 'dul ba gre/san/ ri’ (chos 'byung mkhas dga' smad cha deb ngos 1344 nang gas la/ )dgung lo sum cu rtsa bdun pa rab byung gnyis pa'i sa phag spyi lo 403

11gyi9 lor 'bri gung du phebs te dgon pa btab pa nas rim gyis je rgyas su song ste dge 'dun mtha' yas pa 'dus/ gnyos rgyal ba lha nang pas chos ston drangs pa'i dus kho nar 'khor lnga khri lnga stong lnga brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga 'dus pa dang / dus gcig la tshul shing len pa'i dge slong 'bum phrag byung zhes grags pa sogs snyan grags kyi dpal 'bar ba bcas mthar dgung lo bdun cu don lnga pa rab byung bzhi pa'i me glang spyi lo1317 lor sku gshegs/slob ma yang spyan snga bzhi/ gnyos/ mgar chos gsum/ dpal chen bcu gnyis sogs mtha' yas kyang / gdan sa skyong ba ni/ spyan snga rin po che/ dbon rin po che/ gcung rin po che/ gnyes rgyal ba lha nang pa/mgar dam pa/ chos sding pa/ dpal chen chos ye/ dbon sher 'byung sogs byung zhing / chos rgyud 'di la 'bri gung bka' brgyud du grags so//5 'brug pa bka' brgyud ni/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i slob ma gling ras pad+ma rdo rje dang / chos rje gtsang pa rgya ras pa las brgyud pa zhig ste/ de yang gling ras pad+ma rdo rje ni/ yab rgyal po skyab be+e bya ba sngags dang sman rtsis kyi yon tan dang ldan pa dang / yum gzus mo dar chung gnyis kyi sras su rab byung gnyis pa'i sa sprel spyi lo1138 lor nyang stong du 'khrungs/mtshan la pad+ma rdo rje zhes btags/ dgung lo dgu la klog bslabs/ dgung lo bcu bdun lor slob dpon gling las dge bsnyen mdzad/ dgung lo so gcig pa nas rgyal ba lo dang / sum pa lo sogs sh+tsaras mched gsum snga phyir lo bco lnga bsten te nā ro pa'i gdams pa nyams su bzhes/ dgung lo 404

zhi gcig pa la phag mo gru pa'i lhan cig skyis sbyor gsan pas chu bo gaṅgā tshun na lta ba bzang bar grags/ dbyar zla gsum phag grur bzhugs/ bud med sngon mo zhig gis mdo rgyud kyi lung gnang ba'i snang ba byung ba de nas mdo rgyud rang dbang du 'grel ba'i spobs pa thob/ bka' 'gyur thugs la zhugs/ dgung lo re gcig pa rab byung gsum pa'i sa sprel spyi lo1188lor sku gshegs/ slob ma'i gtso bo ni gtsang pa rgya ras yin te khong ni/ rab byung gsum pa'i lcags sprul spyi lo 11tsa1 lor nyang stod du khu le'i char sku 'khrungs/mtshan ba/yu da drung dpal du btags/ phyis bla myo/ zhang las rab tu byung ste mtsham/ ye shes rdo rje zhes gsol/dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa la gling ras pa ra lung na bzhugs pa dang mjal/ tsha bre gang tsam gyis phyag rten mdzad nas gsung gleng mang du zhus/de nas dbus su byon/ de rjes sna phur gling ras pa slar yang mjal nas na ro'i chos drug dang / lhan cig skyes sbyor la sogs pa'i gdams pa gsan pas zhag bdun nas ras thub pa byung / dgun 'dag sbyar mdzad nas bsgoms pas rlung phyi nang bsre nus pa sogs ting nge 'dzin gsal stong nam mkha' dang mnyam par 'khrungs/ rje btsun ras chung pas gter du sbas pa'i ro snyomyo/sa skor drug bton/ bla ma zhang gis lung bstan pa ltar klong rdol gyi dgon pa btab/ yi dam gyis lung bstan pa ltar ra lung btab/ gling ras kyis lung bstan pa ltar gnam phur 'brug dgon btab/ gnas 'di'i rmang 'ding dus 'brug sgra drag po thengs 'ga' grags pas dgon 405

pa'i ming la 'brug tuwātags/ de la brten nas grub mtha' 'di'i rgyud 'dzin rnams la 'brug pa zhes thogs pa dang / phyis 'brug pa de la yang lo nas mched pa la smad 'brug dang / rgod tshang pa nas mched pa la stod 'brug dbon sras sogs kyis skyong ba la bar 'brug ces pa'i dbye ba byung /gtsang pa rgya ras 'tsho bzhugs skabs 'brug tu slob ma khri tsho lnga tsam 'tshogs zer bas khong ni 'akro don shin tu rgya che zhing nā ro pa'i sprul par grags pa dang 7/ de'i slob rgyud kyis bya rgod po'i nyin lam bco brgyad du khyab pa dang / bod du mi phyed 'brug pa/ 'brug phyed sprang po/ sprang phyed grub thob ces gragarngag pa phya/nga byung ngo / /mthar dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa gcig rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags lug spyi lo1311 lor sku gshegs/'di la slob ma'i mchog dbon sras dang chos sras gnyis las/ dang po ni dbon sras dar ma seng ge sogs so/ /gnyis pa la/ thog mar che ba spa rkyang gnyis te spa ri ba dang / rkyang mo kha pa gnyis/ bar du che ba brgya 'bras gnyis te brgya legs pa dang 'bras mo ba gnyis/ tha mar che ba lo rgod gnyis te lo ras pa dang / rgod tshang pa gnyis so/ /gzhan ji5nga sku'i sprul pa dam pa sa skor ba/ gsung gi sprul pa dam pa gter khung pa/ thugs kyi sprul pa dam pa ko brag pa/ 'phrin las sprul pa grub thob dgon g.ye dang bzhi sogs mang du byung zhing / chos rgyud 'di la 'brug pa bka' brgyud ces grags pa yin no//5 stag lung bka' brgyud ni/ stag lung thang pa tshen po las brgyud pa zhig ste/ de yang stag lung thang pa ni/ yab gwa zi'i tha/dung gyud las 406

byung ba na/ blon 'bar po dang / yum brab shi bza' dge sum khro mo'i sus su rab byung gnyis pa'i chu khyi spyi lo11bhe3 lor g.yang shod bong ra steng du 'khrungs/ gzhon nu'i dus chos byed par lan 'ga' phebs kyang yab kyis bkagadagung lo bco brgyad pa la mkhan po ga ston bla gang ba shes rab rdo rje dang / slob dpon tshar ston sgo mang pa las rab tu byung zhing / mtshan bkra shis dpal zhes gsol/ rgya gar du 'byon par lan kha shas chas kyang sta bas ma 'grig dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi par phag gru rdo rje rgyal po'i snyan pa gsan nar+sā phag gru'i drung du phebs te nye gnas mdzad cing / phag mo gru pas thugs rtsis che zhing gdams pa rdzogs par gnang / phag mo gru pa gshegs rjes mal gror byon te 'chad ka pa las bka' gdams gsan/zhang sha ra ba las bsnyen par rdzogs/dgung lo so dgu pa la dar sbas rong gsum dang phod mdo bas stag lung du gdan drangs pa lta ra byon te rje phag mo gru pas lung bstan mdzad pa ltar rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags byi spyi lo11di0 lor stag lung dgon btab pa de nas mtshan stag lung thang pa zhes bya bar grags/ rab tu byung phyin chad khyim pa'i khyim du mi 'byon la sha chang mi gsol ba ma zad gzhan la sha chang gi mgron yang mi mdzad/ dgon pa'i gling gseb tu bud med mi gtong ba sogs 'dul ba'i phyag len zhib par mdzad/ sku 'da' khar stag lung du dge 'dun sum stong lhag tsam 'dus/ mthar dgung lo drug cu re dgu pa rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags rta spyi lo131d+ngha lor sku gshegs/407

stag lung thang pa chen po sku gshegs rjes dbon rin chen mgon po gdan bar phebs pa des stag lung gi mchod khang chen mo bzhengs shing dgon sde dar rgyas mdzad/ de'i rjes su sangs rgyas yar byon gdan sar bzhugs/ de skabs gdan sa pher ba'i dbon bkra shis bla ma dang / sangs rgyas dbon gnyis byung ba'i sangs rgyas dbon po grags pa dpal 'od zer bzang po khams su byon nas ri bo che'i dgon pa btab/ de nas bzung stag lung ya thang ma thang gnyis su gyes/ gnyis kar grwa pa sum stong brgyad brgya tsam re 'tsho pya//—se/ pa dang de nas dbus gtsang mdo khams sogs su stag lung pa'i grwa pa dang chos rgyud mang du 'phel ba 'di dag la stas/ lung bka' brgyud ces gragre/sa so//7 'ba' rom bka' rgyud ni/ 'ba' rom pa dar ma dbang phyug las brgyud pa zhig ste/ de yang 'ba' rom pa dar dbang ni/ 'phan yul du 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus sngags chung zhig rtsar byung nas rje sgam po ba'i yon tan mang du brjod de khyed rang de'i drung du phyin pa 'thad zer ba ltar khong dang 'gros/sa nas sgam por phebs shing / de nas bzung ste rje sgam po ba dang bla slob tu gyur te khrid gnang ba la so/gas pas rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa dang / de rjes byang 'ba' rom gyi dgon pa btab/ bde stong phyag rgya chen po la bsre 'pho dang / gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po la gseb lam rig pa rkyang 'ded nyams bzhes mdzad pas slob ma mang du 'dus pa de nas 'ba' rom bka' brgyud ces pa'i grub mtha' de dar zhing / sras kyi thu bo ni ti shrī ras pa yin/ 'ba' rom gyi gdan sa ni khong gi gdung rgyud 408

rim pas bzung ba bcas so//8 g.ya' bzang bka' brgyud ni/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i slob ma zwa ra ba skal ldan ye shes seng ge dang g.ya' bzang chos rje smon lam las brgyud pa zhig ste de yang zwa ra ba ni mon 'gar 'khrungs/ gzhon nu'i dus su ra rdzi mdzad de ra 'tsho ba'i skabs ri kha nas phag mo gru pa'i dgon gyi ri mthong ba tsam gyis sgom rang byung shar/ sgom chen gnyis kyis sgom gyi gnas lugs gleng bar de sgom yin na ngas kyang sgom shes par 'dug snyam zhing /phag mo gru pa'i dgon par byon nas 'gro mgon dang mjal te ngo sprod cig btab pas rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs/ mtshan ya nga skal ldan ye shes seng ger btags/ dus phyis grwa rabs su zwa ra dgon pa btab/khong gi slob ma g.ya' bzang chos smon lam ni/ gnubs kyi gdung las byung ba yab sprang mo lcam dang / yum zhang lcam 'bum skyid gnyis kyi sras su rab byung gsum pa'i sa glang spyi lo11lho9 lor gtsang zhal gyi dmar mor 'khrungs/ sgrin mkhan po chos ston bya ba las rab tu byung / mtshan chos smo na lam du btags/ sha mi smon lam 'od kyi slob ma klub dkar tshul khrims grags las 'dul ba gsan nas 'dul ba'i bshad pa dang lag len gtso bor mdzad pas gnubs 'dul 'dzin du grags/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa la dge 'dun bya zhing pa'i gnyer bzang ba zhig mdzad/ lo der klub da7kar ba gshegs rjes zwa ra ba skal ldan ye shes seng ge'i snyan pa gsan pas zwa rar byon te mjal/ dad pa dpag med 'khrungs shing phyag rgya chen po dang / khyad par snyan brgyud kyi ngo sprod thabs lam nā ro'i chos drug 409

la sogs pa gsan nas khong gi chos rgyud mi 'chad pa'i bsngags pa yang mdzad/dgung lo sum cu pa la 'bum zhing du 'jig rten blos btang gi sgrub pa mdzad/dgung lo so brgyad pa rab byung gsum pa'i me stag spyi lo13༷smo lor g.ya' bzang dgon btab cing / de rjes gnyal stod smad/ mtsho sna/ lho brag yar lung shar nub rnams su yon bdag so sos chos 'khor gyi gtso bor gdan drangs te chos gsungs pa'i chos khri yang lho brag tu bzhi bcu zhe lnga /gnyal du bzhi bcu zhe bdun byung zhing / gnas gzhan du yang chos khri ha cang mang po mchis pa bcas khong gis chos 'khor rgya chen po bskor ba dang slob ma mang po bskyangs te mthar dgung lo drug cu rtsa lnga pa rab byung bzhi pa'i chu sprul spyi lo1phrekā3 lor sku gshegs/khong gi slob ma sgom bzhir grags pa ni/ gnyal smad dpal ri ba sangs rgyas bya sgom/ gor gdong pa sangs rgyas lha sgom/ gser lte ba sa ngas rgyas le sgom/ dgon gsar pa sangs rgyas rgya sgom bcas yin/ chos rgyud de la g.ya' bzang bka' brgyud du grags so//9 khro phu bka' brgyud ni/ phag mo gru pa'i slob ma rin po che rgyal tsha dang / ku/na smyoldan ras pa sku mched las brgyud pa zhig ste/ de nga nga rin po che rgyal tsha ni/ yab gnubs kyi gdung rgyud las byung zhing / yum lha gcig gi sras su rab byung gnyis pa'i sa khyi spyi lo1118 lor shab smad 'dzal du 'khru / si sa/ d+ngha410

dgung lo lnga pa nas yig rtsis bslabs/ gzhon nu'i dus nas 'jig rten gyi phyogs la mi dgyes pa chos la dgyes shing / gnur nyi ma/ slob dpon gan chag pa/ ram sding ba sogs bla ma mang po bste na nas chos mang du gsan/dgung lo bcu dgu par dbus su byon te dmar chos kyi rgyal po/ mes ston kun snying sogs bsten/dgung lo nyi shu rtsa lnga par rang yul du byon te che 'don mdzad pa dang chos 'ga' re yang gsungs/ yab kyi zhal nas da bag ma zhig len dgos gsung ba dang du ma bzhes pas yab kyis kyang de ltar ga na nga si thob cing /de nas yang brag dkar po ba/ zhu don mo ri ba sogs bla ma du ma bsten nas chos mang po gsan/de rjes spu hreng lo tsā ba'i dngos slob dmar chos kyi rgyal pos phag mo grur brdzangs pa ltar gdams ngag mang du ga/san cing / der phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs/dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa rab byung gsum pa'i lcags yos spyi lo 1171 lor mkhan po zhang zhi mdzes las bsnyen par rdzogs/ dge slong bzhi sde re dang 'grogs par dgongs nas zhang btsun dbon chung bya ba nas khro phu'i sa de nyos/ dbu rtse dang bran khang la sogs pa ste khro phu btab nas dge 'dun nyi shu tsam bsdus/ mthar dgung lo bdun cu rtsa brgyad pa rab byung gsum pa'i shing yos spyi lo11rdzolālor sku gshegs/gcung po kun ldan ras pa ni/ rab byung gsum pa'i sa 'brug spyi lo 411

1148 lor 'khrungs/ phag mo grur gcen po'i rgyags skyel du byon pas rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar gsung ba dang thug de 'dra ba zhig ngas kyang bya'o snyam nas chos grwa der mgo lcog lan gsum byas/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru par gdams pa zhus te bsgoms pas rtogs pa khyad par can brnyes/ mthar dgung lo bdun cu pa rab byung bzhi pa'i me glang spyi lo1317 lor sku gshegs/rgyal tsha dang kun ldan ras pa'i dbon po khro phu lo tsā ba byon pa bcas de dag gi dngos rgyud slob ma rnams kyi chos rgyud la khro phu bas/'a brgyud ces grags pa bcas so /dwags po bka' brgyud pa'i lta sgom gyi rnam gzhag dang / khyad par 'byed chos skor/ dwags po bka' brgyud kyi chu 'go mar pa lo tsā ba'i lta ba ni dbu myo/ thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba yin te/ de yang mar pa'i bla ma gtso bo nā ro pa dang / mi tre pa yin zhing / mar pas lta sgom spyod pa dang / rgyud kyi bshad pa gang gi skabs su yang bla ma de gnyis gtso bor mdzad cing /khyad par du lta ba'i sgro 'dogs chod pa'i bla ma mi tre pa yin pa mar pa'i gsung mgur las 'byung ste /‘‘shar chu bo gaṅga'i 'gram du phyin//rje mai tre chen po'i bka' drin gyis//gzhi chos nyid skye ba med par rtogs//sems stong pa nyid la spar zin byas//don spros bral gnyug ma'i ngo bo mthong //412

sku gsum ma dang mngon du mjal//mi kho bo'i spros pa de nas bcad//’mices mi tre pa'i drin las sems don dam par skye ba med par rtogs pas/ sems kyi gnyug ma'i ngo bo zhes pa bden pas stong pa'i sems kyi chos nyid la spar zin byas te/ de nyid rdzogs rim gyi lam zab mo dang sbrel nas bsgoms pas spyir sku gsum dang khyad par chos sku'i ming can 'od gsal ma bu 'phrod pa byung bas spros pa thams cad de la brten nas chod do zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro//mnga' bdag mai tre pa ni dbu ma tsam du ma zad/ dpal ldan zla ba'i lugs gtso bor mdzad pa dang / paṇa chen glo ro pa yang zla grags kyi lugs kho na 'dzin pa/ rje btsun mi la'i mgur rnams su yang lta ba phal cher thal 'gyur ba dang mthun par gsungs pa bcas rje mar pa dang / mi la/ sgam po ba rnams dang / de dag gi slob ma phag mo gru pa/ 'bri gung pa/ gling ras pa/ dusi gsum mkhyen pa/ stag lung pa sogs lta ba'i bzhed pa mthun pa snang phyogs rten 'brel la gtsigs su mdzad pa dang / so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyi dpyad pa mi midor ba'i lugs 'dzin cing / gzhan yang gdul bya'i blo tshod dang bstun pa'i lta ba gzhan yang 'dor bar mi mdzad pa yin no//phyag rgya chen po'i mtshan ni/ rje btsun mi la'i gsung mgur du phyag rgya chen po lta ba'i rdzong zhes sogs phyag chen gyi sgros tsam 'byung yang grags che bar mdzad pa po ni mnyam med dwags po lha the yin te/ dwags po'i gsung 413

las/ lta ba'i ngo sprod dang phar phyin gyi theg pa'i lugs dang sngags milugs gnyis 'byung zhing / gnyis ka la'ang phyag rgya chen po'i gdams ngag gi ming 'dogs par mdzad/ phar phyin theg pa'i lugs la stod nyid la phyag rgya chen por gsungs pa yod tshul mdo'i lung mang du drangs nas bsgrubs pa'i bstan bcos kyang mdzad/dkar po chig thub ces pa'i tha snyad ni bla ma zhang yan la de 'dra'i tha snyad grags mi che mod/ zhang gis dkar po chig thub la gtso bor byas pa'i bstan bcos d+dha/dzad phyin chad la grags che bar gyur/bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyis phyag chen la mdo sngags kyi dbye bas gnyis bzhed pa'i snga ma ni sems kyi ngo bo'i steng du rtse gcig tu 'jog pa'i mi rtog pa bsgoms te gnas pa bsgrubs/ de ltar bsgrubs pa'i dmigs pa la gnas pa'i sems gsal gsal rig rig po de lus kyi phyi na 'dug gam nang na 'dug pa sogs kyi sems 'tshol brgyab pas sems kyi ngo bo gcig kyang ma rnyed pa'i bden med du nges pa'i tshe bden med des khyad par du byas pa'i sems kyi ngo bo'i steng du rtse gcig tu 'jog pa stong nyid ma yin gnag gi tshul du bsgom pa yin zhes de ltar bzhed/phyi ma sngags lugs kyi phyag rgya chen po ni/ rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byas pa las byung ba'i bde chen gyi 'od gsal la bzhed cing / de ni grub pa sde bdum/ dang / snying po skor gsum du grags pa'i brjod bya'i gtso bo rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud sde mtha' dag gi snying po'i snying po nyid do/ /de sgom pa la thog mar gnyug sems mngon du byed dgos shing / de 414

la rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum dgos pas gnyug sems kyi ngo bo gtan la phab ste de'i steng du rtse gcig tu bzhag pas rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum 'byung / de'i stobs kyis lte gsang gi gtum mo 'bar ba la brten nas zhu ba des drangs pa'i dga' bzhi skyes te gnyug sems bde ba chen po'i ngo bor skye/ de yul stong pa nyid dang dbyer med du gyur pa'i bde stong gi ye shes la rtse gcig tu bzhag pas rnal 'byor bzhi rim gyis bgrod de mchog 'grub par 'gyur la de lta bu'i bde ba dang stong pa thabs shes zung du 'brel ba la phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa dkar po chig thub ces pa'i tha snyad mdzad do//phyag rgya chen po nyams su len pa'i gang zag la dbang po rno rtul gnyis las/ rlung dbu mar sdud pa'i lam sgom mi nus pa'i dbang rtul gyis re zhig pha rol du phyin pa'i lus/sa kyi phyag chen sgom par byed pa yin la dbang rnon la'ang gnyis te tshe sngon ma'am tshe stod yan la lam snga ma snga ma la sbyangs nas rlung dbu mar 'jug pa byang ba zhig 0 na na dang po nyid nas sems byi/ ngo bo'i steng du rtse gcig tu bzhag ste bsgom pa nyid kyis rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byas pas gnyug sems mngon sum du nyams su myong bar 'gyur ba 'di la gang zag cig car ba'i tha snyad mdzad cing / tshe snga ma'am tshe stod yan chad la lam snga ma snga ma la ma sbyangs pa zhig yin na lam thun mong ba dang / dbang dang / bskyed rdzogasdorga sogs sngon du 'gro dgos shing /de lta bu la tra/nga zag rim gyis pa'i tha snyad mdzad pa lags so//de ltar bka' brgyud pa la nang gses kyi ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha 415

dado pa'i khyad par gyi 'byed chos ci zhe na/ stag lung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung ngo mtshar rgya mtsho las/ ‘‘mdor na nyan thos kyi nges 'byung / theg chen gyi sems bskyed/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig rnam par dag pa rnams gzhir bzhag pa'i steng du bka' brgyud rin po che'i khyad chos mar rngog gi rgyud bshad/ mi la'i snying rus dang gdams ngag sgam po ba'i ngo bo'i gad dar/ karma ba'i rlung sems dbyer med/ zhang gi lam mchog mthar thug 'ba' rom pa'i bsre 'pho gseb lam/ phag gru'i gsang sngags/ stag lung pa'i rnam thar so dgu/ 'bri gung ba'i sdom gsum gnad gcig gtsang pa/ rgya ras kyi rten 'brel dang ro snyoms/ lo rgod kyi mos gus dang zhen log rnams ni cha mthun khyad 'phags zhes re re la'ang thams cad tshang bar yod mod kyi/ gang la rtsal du bton nas slob ma 'khrid cing skyong bar mdzad pa'i phyir khyad par gyi 'byed chos su bzhag tu rung zhing / yongs rdzogs la yang bka' brgyud rin po che'i bstan pa zhes 'jig rten gsum du snyan par grags so//’’ zhes gsungs pa ltar lags shing /dngos gzhi phyag chen gyi nyams len ga'i/ra bzhag la/ las dang po bas de rgyud la skye ba la med mi rung gi yan lag mang po zhig dgos/ par gzigs nas 'khrid lugs kyi rnam grangs mi 'dra ba mang po mdzad pa ste/ de yang rje sgam po ba ni/ lhan cig skyes sbyor dang / 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon pos lnga ldan/ gtsangachi pa rgya ras pa sogs kyis khrid chen brgyad dang ro snyoms sko/ra drug ri chos rnams 'doms pa'i sgo nas slob ma 'khrid par mdzad pa yin/416

de yang zhib par dbye na/ lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi sgra don ni/ 'gro mgon gyis/ ‘‘sems dang rnam rtog chos sku gsum//dang po lhan cig skyes pa de//gdams pas gcig tu sbyor ba'i phyir//lhan cig skyes sbyor zhes su bshas// ’ zhes gsungs pa ste/‘‘sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku//rnam rtog lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i rlabs//snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od//snang sems dbyer med lhan cig skyes pa'o//mizhis pa'i don mos gus dang zhen log gtso bor byas pa'i ngos nas sngon 'gro sbyor ba bzhi ldan/ dngos gzhi ngo sprod rnam gnyis/ rjes nyams myong snang thog tu skyong ba gsum gyis/ 'chad pa'i sngon 'gro ni spyi dang mtshungs shing / dngos gzhi gnyis ni zhi lhag gnyis la ngo sprod pa'o//lnga ldan ni/ 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal nas/ ‘‘phyag rgya chen po seng ge 'dra ste/ lnga ldan med na mig med yin/ ’’ zhis gsungs pa ltar phyag rgya chen po nyams su len pa la lnga ldan med mi rung yin pas bka' brgyud phyogs la 'di 'phrin las shin tu che ba de yang / byang chub kyi sems bsgo ma pa/ rang lus lhar bsgom pa/ bla ma la mos gus bsgom pa/ mi rtog pa'i lta ba bsgom pa/ bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs pa dang lnga'o//khrid chen brgyad ni/ bla ma sku gsum gyi khrid/ byams snying rje'i khrid/417

rgyu 'bras rten 'brel gyi khrid/ lnga ldan bdud rtsi thigs pa'i khrid/ lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid/ nā ro chos drug gi khrid/ chos brgyad mgo snyoms kyi khrid/ gsang spyod ldog sgom gyi khrid rnams so//ro snyoms skor drug ni/ rnam rtog lam khyer/ nyon mongs lam khyer/na tsha lam khyer/ lha 'dre lam khyer/ sdug bsngal lam khyer/ 'chi ba lam khyer ro//ri chos ni zab chos rgyan bzhi skor gsum zhal gdams kyis brgyan pa zhes bshad pas/ rgyan bzhi ni/ ri chos yon tan kun 'byung / gsang ba datshobang gi gru bo che/ rdo rje lus kyi sbas bshad/ bar do'i khrid dang bzhi'o//skor gsum zhal gdams rgyan la/ dmar khrid gegs sel gyi rgyan/mgur 'bum dkar chag gi rgyan/ sil bu'i sde tshan phran tshogs kyi rgyan bcas so//gsum pa/ sa skya pa'i skor/dpal ldan sa skya pa'i grub mtha' ni 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po las brgyud pa zhig yin la 'khon gyi gdung rgyud ni 'od gsal lha la sa chad pa de'i gdung rgyud rim byon la 'khon gyi gdung rgyud dam/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya pa zhes pa'i snyan grags kyi ba dan srid rtser sgreng ba de dag gi lo rgyus ring po bgrang du yod pa sa skya pa'i gdung rabs khag sogs khungs ldan gyi yig tshang mang por zhib phra gsal bas skabs 'dir yig tshogs kyi rgyur bsamyo/sa re zhig btang snyoms kyis gtso bor dpal ldan sa skya pa'i grub mtha' byung 418

lugs dang / grub mtha' de'i lta spyod sogs kyi skor che long tsam gleng bar bya ba la/dang po/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po dang bla chen 'brog mi bla slob tu 'brel ba dang / gsung ngag rin po che thog mar byung tshul skor/de yang 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po zhes bya ba thugs rab che zhing sa dpyad dang / lugs kyi bstan bcos/ lhag par sngags mtshan nyid thams cad la mkhas pa zhig yod pa de dus nam zhig 'bri mtshams su 'bro yis gson shid gnang bar gdan 'dren zhus pa'i skabs yul der nyin zhag sbrel mar rtsed 'jo dang / ltad mo mang po ston pa'i nang na khrom dkyil du sngags pa mang pos dbang phyug ma nyer brgyad kyi 'bag myon/ phyag mtshan bzung / ma mo ral pa can gyi rngams stabs dang bcas te 'chams byed pa ltad mo che bar byung ba de'i lo rgyus bla ma gcen 'khon rog shes rab tshul /khrims la zhus pas gcen gyi zhal nas da ni gsang sngags 'chol ba zhes pa'i dus byung ba yin/ da phyin chad bod sngags rnying ma la brten nas grub thob tshad ldan mi 'ong / rang re la yod pa rnams gter du sbed/ nga ni na rgas khyod gzhon pas mang mkhar myu gu lung na 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes/ zhu ba shin tu mkhas pa zhig bzhugs yod pas khyed der song la gsang sngags gsar 'gyur slobs shig ces bskul ba ltar 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos mang mkhar myu gu lung du 'brog mi shākya ye shes mjatā bar phebs te khong cho bla slob tu gyur pa dang / 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po ni 'brog mi'i mchog tu gyur pa'i slo ba ma rgyud tshar ba'i gtso bor bzhed pa/ ya nga rje btsum/ grasas 419
