pa rgyal mtshan gyis 'brog mi dang rgyun bzhi'i bla mar bstod pa las/ma dros ye shes zhabs las rgyun bzhi'i bla ma ni//rgyal po rig dang snying po snang ba'i mtha' can te//rig dang snying po'i zhabs las 'bar ba 'bar ba'i mtha'//rgyun bzhi 'dzin pa'i bla chen de la rtag phyag 'tshal//zhes 'brog mi lo tsā ba ma dros pa'i mtsho chen las/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal rga se ston kun rig mnga' ris pa gsa' —ba'i snying po/'khyin lo tsā ba 'od kyi snang ba ste gaṅgā la sogs pa'i chu bo bzhi dang 'dra ba'i rgyud man ngag gi rgyun bla chen sa skya pa chen po'i thugs kyi snod du bzung zhes bsngags pa bcas 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po dang / bla chen 'brog mi bla slob tu 'brel ba nas bod du gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i bstan pa'i rgyun spel ba 'di la sa skya pa'i grub mtha' 'e/sa thog mar gnas kyi ming gang zag la thogs pa dang / slar yang thun mong min pa'i bzhed srol de dag la bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu'i mtshan de thos/sa pa yin no//de ltar 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyi drung nas gsang sngags phyi 'gyur rnams la sbyangs pa mthar phyin mdzad pa dang /gzhan yang 'gos khug pa lhas btsas/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta hang ngu dkar po/rma lo tsā ba rin chen mchog 'dzim pa lo tsā ba sosga/sa mkhas grub kyi bla ma mang du bsten/gyi g.ya' lung chu skyar du ci rigs bzhugs/ bra bo lung du dgon chung gcig btab par sa skya gog por grags pa der lo 'ga' bzhugs pa'i dus nam zhig gi tshe ri rtse nas gzigs pas dpon po ri shi na 420

tu mtho ba la de skor gyi ri thams cad kyis bskor cing mgo bo btud pa lta bu/ g.yas logs sa dkar zhing snum pa seng ge 'gying ba 'dra ba/ chu g.yas skor du 'bab cing rgyun ma chad par 'gro ba/ bkra shis kyi rtags brgyad dang / rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun gyis phyogs kun nas bskong ba'i sa dpyad phun sum tshogs par gzigs te 'khon dkon mchog rgyal ko dgung lo bzhi bcu pa rab byung dang po'i chu glang spyi lo1༷7kā lor sa dkar logs kyi dbus su dpal ldan sa skya'i dgon pa phyag btab pa de la rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/sa dkar po seng ge'i gdong pa 'dra//dpal ldan sa skya seng ge'i lus//'gro drug gi bsam pa 'gengs pa po//rje rdo rje 'chang ṣ+ka/ bzhugs gnas yin//zhes gsungs pa ltar gnas kyi ming gang zag la thogs te 'khon gyi gdung rgyud rim par byon pa la sa skya pa zhes bya bar 'bod pa ma zad/ gdung rgyud de dag las byung ba'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rim par byon pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi sgroskyes bu dam pa bgrang las 'das pas 'jigs bral rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal birlu pa'i bka' srol bod du bla chen 'brog mi 'akyis rgyud pa'i gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i bzhed gzhung dri ma med par 'dzin pa de la sa skya pa'i grub mtha' zhes bya ba'i snyan grags phyogs kyi bu mo'i rna lung la 'god pa de byung ba yin/421

phyis/ grub mtha' ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad sa skya pa'i slob rgyud tha dad gyes par ngor rdzong tshar gsum gyi dbye ba byung / de yang ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang rngatre/ ni bdag chen bzhi thog pa kun dga' rin che na gyi sras su rab byung drug pa'i chu khyi spyi lo1383 lor 'khrungs shing /shar chen ye shes rgyal myo/tshan gyi thugs sras kyi thu bor gyur/ khong gis rab byung bdun gyi sa bya spyi lo1bhe19lor ngor e waṃ chos ldan gyi gdan sa btab pa dang / phyis grub chen bud+dhā pa las lam 'bras gas/na cing de las brgyu/da par ngor lugs su grags/rdzong pa kun dga' rgya tshoro mtshan ni 'khrungs dus ngor chen dasi dus rma nyam zhing / shar chen pa dang / theg chen chos rje'i thugs sras su gyur te bla brang rdzong chung b.ri rjes/ 'brang mdzad pas sa skya'i bstan 'dzin ngor rdzong gnyis sam sngags la mkhas pa kun dga' rnam gnyis su grags/ 'di pari rjes 'brang mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / dbus kyi gong dkar pa so gas byung /gong dkar rdo rje gdan gyi chos sde 'debs mkhan chos spre kun dga' rnam rgyal ni brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po sogs bshes minanyen mja du bsten cing mkhas grub chen por gyur/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpa' ba la bgyud pa'i lam 'bras gsan pas/ de la rdzong lugs su grags/rdo ring kun spangs kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma las lam 'bras gsan pa'i tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho(spyi lo1495da 15a+yo.a+yo) 'a sa thugs sras 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dang / mang thos klu sgrub rgya 422

mtsho gnyis la brgyud par lam 'bras tshar lugs su grags pa bcas rim par byung ngo //gnyis pa/ dpal ldan sa skya pas nyams bzhes sa/nang ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs skor/dpal ldan sa skya pa la mdo sngags chos kyi rnam grangs dpag tu med pa mnga' ba dang / lhag par gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang dang rgyud kyi bshad pa/ man ngag las tshogs sogs bgrang las 'das pa bzhugs pa las lcags ri'i phyir gyi 'da' ba'i gser chos bcu gsum la ngos 'dzin gyi 'dra ba snang yang / tshar lugs ltar na mkha' spyod skor gsum/ dmar chen skor gsum/ dmar chung skor gsum/ 'chi med rdo rje lha mo/ dza dmar/ seng gdong ma/ 'jam dpal nag po ste bcu gsum dang / de'i steng du seng ge sgra bsnan pa la klu pa'i gser chos bcu bzhi yang zer ro//gzhan yang rdor phreng gi dbang dang / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho sogs spyi bka' dang / zur bka'/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang ye shes zhabs lugs/ dus 'khor/ kye rdor bka' babs bzhi/ bde mchog lha nag dril gsum bong nal can/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum sogs gsar ma dang / yab chos yang dag dang phur pa bcas rnying ma dang /mgon po gur dang / zhal bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po/ zhal gyi bka' sdod beg tse/ phur srung gi skor sogs srung ma'i chos skor yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs so//gsum pa/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa byung 423

the1la/dpal ldan sa skya pa'i mdo sngags chos tshul kun gyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa bstan pa'i snying po go/sung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa mdo sngags yongs kyi lam tshang la ma nor ba de nyid ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/dang po/ bdag cag gi ston pas dpal kyai rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyud 'bum pa'i bsdus don slar bzlas pa'i tshul du gsungs pa brtag pa gnyis pa las/dang po gso sbyong sbyin par bya//de rjes bslab pa'i gnas bcu nyid//de la bye brag smra ba bstan//mdo sde pa yang de bzhin no//de nas rnal 'byor spyod pa nyid//de yi rjes su dbu ma bstan//sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas//de rjes kye yi rdo rje bstan//zhes mdo sde dang / rgyud sde thams cadarukyi yang rtse nges don mthar thug dpal kyai rdo rje'i rgyud gsum phyi dgongs don rang stobs kyis bkral ba'i shing rta chen po ni/ rdo the bdag med mas dngos su rjes su bzung bas sa drug gi rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa 'phags pa'i yul gyi grub chen rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bire pa chen po nyid yin la/ de yang 'jam dpal 424

rtsa rgyud las/yi ge snya zhes sdom brtson 'gyur//lho yi phyogs su rnam par grags//sdom brtson de bzhin sngags kyang grub//ces 'byung bas rnal 'byor dbang phyug birlu pa lung bstan par 'brog mi lo tsā ba bzhed do/ /'di'i mtshan snyarma pā la yin pas ming thog ma bstan pa dang / gaṅgā gyen ldog gnyis pa nas tsaṇ+ḍi ka btul ba yan chad lho phyogs yin pas lho phyogs su rnam par grags pa ches che ba dang / sdom brtson gyi sgo nas bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad pa dang / rdo rje bdag med mas byin gyis brlabs nas gsang sngags kyi mchog grub pa thams cad lung bstan dzo lta ba bzhin grub pa ltar nyams rtogs kyi yon tan khyad par can 'khrungs pa'i ngo mtshar gyi mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pas skye bo mang po dad pa'i sa la bkod pa'i nang nas gsung ngag rin po che'i bka' drin thob pa'i slob ma gnyis las dang po ni/ gaṅgā gyen ldog gnyis pa'i dus kyi po/ mkhan rjes su 'brangs r+yā zuḍordzi he ru ka ste/ de nyid skal ldan cig car ba yin pas de'i lam gyi sgo nas bkri zhing / lam gyi cha shas tsam gyis bdag nyid dang rtogs pa mnyam par gyur nas shar phyogs kyi yul sna tshogs sbyang ldan/ pho brang ka ka na'i rgyal po 'dul du btang bas sbrul gyis srab mthur byas nas stag mi zan la chibs/ phyag tu sbrul thogs nas rgyal po btul bar grags la/ 'di las 'phel ba rtsa ba med pa cung zad cig yod/ deng sang rgyud pa'i phyogs 'di pa ba 'grel pa lugs su bzhod pa'o//425

gnyis pa ni/ lho phyogs su ral pa can lnga brgya'i khrod nas gcig rjes su 'brangs pa nag po ba ste/ sngar bstan pa la ma zhugs shing 'jug 'dod yod pa btul te skal dman rim 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pas lam 'bras rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang gnang nas de'i dngos bstan gyi rim pas bkris te rang dang rtogs pa mnyam par mdzad cing / nag po ba de nyid lho phyogs nas 'ongs kyang yul rgya gar shar phyogs pa yin pas shar phyogs nag po ba bya ba yin/de lta bu'i grub chen rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpon slob gsum las gsung ngag rin po che ji ltar brgyud tshul yang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug biwi pas nag po ba la rgyud kyi bshad pa shin tu bsdus pa dang / man ngag snyan rgyud kyi nyams len shin tu rgyas pa gnang / des yul dbus kyi rnal 'byor pa ḍa ma ru sa la gnang / de ni yul nyer bzhi gnas so gnyis thams cad du ḍa ma ru 'khrol zhing spyod sa mdzad nus/ des yul dbus kyi rgyal po seng ge rnam par rtsen pa la gnang / de nyid rtogs pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs pas byis pa mang po'i gseb tu gnyis spang gi spyod pa mdzad bzhin bzhugs pas a wa sbo ti pa zhes grags/ de yan ni sa thob sa dngos yin no/ /a wa dhū ti pas rgyal po'i yi ge pa'i rigs ga ya dha ra la gnang / de ni kye rdo rje'i dkyibhe/ 'khor du dbang bskur zhus pas/ dbang gi ye shes skyes pa de nyid nurme gsu ma gyi bar du bskyangs pas sbyor lam chos mchog chen por gnas par gyur te blo ma ru bar snang la bzhag pa rang 'khrol du byung bar grags pa dang / grong 'jug la thogs pa med pa sogs yon tan du ma dang 426

ldan no//yang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birlu pas ḍordzi he ru ka la rgyud kyi bshad pa shin tu rgyas pa dang / man ngag snyan rgyud kyi nyams len shin tu bsdus pa gnang / des ngo mtshar rdo rje la/ des nags khrod pa la/ des gatho ri pa la/ des dza ya shrī'i la/ des mi thub bla ba la/ des dge slong dpa' bo rdo rje la gdams pa'o//gnyis pa/ bod du gsung ngag rin po che ji ltar byon tshul skor/bod du gsung ngag rin po che byon tshul la gsum ste/ thog mar ga ya snya ras srol btod tshul/ bar du bla chen 'brog mis spel tshul/ mthar rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad tshul lo//thog mar ga ya snya ras srol btod tshul/ bla chen 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes mang mkhar myu gu lung na 'chad nyan mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i nub gcig bla chen la sngar byung myong med pa'i mnal lam ci yin smra mi shes pa byung ba'i skabs der mtshams bcad nas yod pa'i dus su snga dro zhig sgo khang na rwa dung 'bud pa'i skad gsan pas snying sang nge ba zhig byung ba de ni ga ya snya ra gzim khang gi sgo rtsar byon te saṃkṛ ta'i skad du nga paṇ+ḍi ta yin zhes gsungs pas de 'phral nang du gdan drangs nas tsha ba drangs/ paṇ+ḍi tas khyo da rang snod dang ldan na khyod kyi mkhas grub kyi yon tan ngas rdzogs par bya yis/ la/sungs par bla chen gyi thugs dgongs la spyan ras gzigs dang / dge slong dpa' bo rdo rje'i lung bstan thog tu phebs pa yin rkapresdopre che dgongs nas thugs lhag par dgyes shing / phan tshun gsung gleng mdzad 427

pas khong paṇ+ḍi ta chen por nges pa rnyed cing / spyir theg chen dang / py-i brag rdo rje theg pa/ de'i nang nas kyang rnal dzabyor bla med/ khyad par rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birlu pa'i lugs la mkhas par dgongs nas gser srang gang lapa ca/ṇ+ḍal gyi rten gnang ste phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas zhabs spyi bor blangs te rjes su 'dzin par gsol ba btab pas nga ni thugs rje chen pos lung bstan nas khyed 'tshol du 'ong ba yin/ gser mang po yod dam gsungs/ rjes su 'dzin na thugs dgongs rdzogs par byed zhus/paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhal nas/ pu rangs lo tsā ba gzhon nu shes rab kyis gsol ba nan tan 'debs kyin 'dug na'ang / yi dam lha'i lung bstan la brten nas khyed 'tshol du 'ong ba yin/ zla ba gsum nas khong can du 'khor ba'i chad byas yod pa la da phan zla ba gcig tsam song zin la/ da dung bal yul nas dpe cha 'dra len par yang 'gro dgos pas snga na lo gnyis/ phyi na yang lo gsum nas 'dir slebs 'ong bas de bar gser sgrubs gsungs/bla chen gyis 'bul ba bka' bzhin 'bulu bar zhal gyi bzhes te/ da res dbang mang rab cig ma gnang na rten 'brel chugs dgos pas da res kyang lo gcig tsam bzhugs dgos zhus par 'o na pu rangs nas 'bod mi nam byung bar bsdad chog ces zhal bzhes mdzad pa de'i nangs par lha rtse'i brag tu gdan 'dren zhus nas zla ba gcig gi bar du dpon slob 'brel ba brtag pa'i tshul gyis bla ma lnga bcu pa'i 'chad nyan mdzad/ de nas gdams ngag 'ga' zhig gi 'go btsugs te khrid zhu zhing 'gyur mdzad nas 'ga' zhig grub pa la/ zla ba drug slobs dus pu rangs lo tsā4pa ga zhon nu shes rab 4lhabyi

dngo/na g.yog rnams rje ga ya dha ra gdan zhur bcar byung b.ri bla che'o/ 'phros/rgyumis 'o skol chad gnang dgos/ zhus par paṇ+ḍi tas lo gnyis song ba dang phyir phebs te birlu pa'i chos skor yongs rdzogs gnang rgyu zhal gyis bzhes/ 'brog mis kyang de skabs skyid grong du phebs bsur bcar rgyu dang / gser la sogs pa'i 'bul ba tshang bar 'bul rgyu'i khas len zhus/ sngar gdams pa zhus sa rnams kyi yon du gser srang bcu dang / na bza' cha tshang zhig phul zhing bar sbug bar phebs skyel zhus shing / de skabs ga ya dha rar pakhri ta dmar sor grags/de nas bla chen gyis 'bring mtshams gnam thang dkar por phebs pa nas bzung ste chos 'khor bskor bas lo gnyis kyi ring la gser mang po phyag tu 'byor zhing / paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra yang mang yul du phebs te phebs bsur shog ces pa'i gsung 'phrin 'byor pas shin tu dgyes te 'brog mi lo tsā ba dpon g.yog nyi shu dang / btsad po'i blon po dpon g.yog gnyis mchod rdzas 'byor pa gzab pa dang bcas phebs bsur bcar bas skyid grong du bla ma dang mjal/ bkur snyi dang 'bul ba phun sum tshogs pas bla ma yang mnyes shing / de nas dpon slob rnams mang mkhar myu gu lung du phebs/bla ma la chos zhu rgyu 'go 'dzugs pa'i rten du gser srang gsum gyi rten ldan maṇ+ḍal phul ba de nas zhag gsum par sku mtshams bcad de rgyud gsum la sogs pa'i 'gyur dang / lam 'bras 'a sogs pa'i bshad pa dang / khrid bka' rnams lo gsum la grub par mdzad/ khyod la mi dgos kyang nged rang gi byed lugs yin gsungs nas gur mgon gyi gtor ma paṇ+ḍi ta rang gi — 429

dbu thog ru bzhag thang sku rgyab la bkal nas rnal 'byor dbang phyung/ gi chos thams cad dang / gzhan khyod la byin pa'i chos rnams la lhag ma bzhag ri'i dbu snyung bzhes/ paṇ+ḍi ta la bla chen gyis gser srang lnga brgya dang /gla rtsi stong / rnga maspre dkar po mi rab kyi 'dom re yod pa bcu gcig la sogs pa'i 'bul ba phul bas shin tu mnyes nas khyod gzhan ci 'dod gsungs/lo tsā bas rkyen drag po glo bur du byung na brjed kyi dgos pas rdo rje'i tshig rkang lung skor dang bcas pa brjed tho'i yig chung 'khrugs pa bsdebs shing / lam gyi mtshan dmigs bsal dang bcas pa zhig zhu zhus pas/ 'o na 'di ma yin pa'i gnas dben pa gzhan zhig tu mtshams dam par bcad/tshogs 'khor rgyun ma 'chad pa gyis gsungs pa dang / de'i nub mo mtshan phyed tsam nas phur dgon du gdan drangs te paṇ+ḍi ta'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin bsgrubs pas da ci 'dod gsungs par/ bsgrub pa'i lung sbyin tshoms dang bcas pa'i gsung ngag rin po che 'di bod du gzhan la mi gsung ba zhig zhu zhus pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhal nas/ khyod rang lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du 'gro zhing / gdung rgyud kyis bstan pa'i bdag po byed pa zhig 'ong rgyu yin pa la/ bus rten 'brel 'chugs pas da 'pho ba sbyongs shig lus spangs ma thag mkha' spyod du 'gro/ gdams pa tshar ba'i bu rgyud rnams la lo bcu gsum nyams su ma blangs par gzhan rdzol mi spel ba'i bka' rgya sdoms/ zas nor gyi sgo nas snod brtag pa gal che gsungs pas/de ltar zhu bar khas len zhus te lo tsā bas kyang la stod thang chu bar phebs skyel zhus shing / de nas skyid grong bar phebs skyel ba btang ste phaṇ+ḍi ta ga 430 —

yi dha ra lan gcig rgya gar du byon pa de ni ga ya dha ra bod la phebs things dang po de yin no//bod la phebs thengs gnyis pa ni/ 'gos lo tsā bas spyan drangs nas kye rdor rgyud gsum gyi bshad pa dang / gsang lus la sogs pa'i chos mang du gsungs/bod la phebs thengs gsum pa ni/ gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs nas chos mang du zhus/ de nas gyi jo'i slob ma gnyos 'byung po bya bas kha rag tu gdan drangs nas 'bul ba dang / zhabs tog chen po zhus/paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhal nas/ da dge sbyor byed pa la bod 'di chu bzang bsil drod snyoms/ srog chags nyung la zas bcud che bas rgya gar du mi 'gro/ gser mang po'ang mi 'dod/ chos mang po bshad mi khom gsungs nas thugs dam mdzad pa'i zhar la dus 'khor gyi 'gyur zhig mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'brog de yod na pha dang bu gnyis sgrub pa stabs su byed pa yin te/ kho ni mkha' spyod du song 'dug gsungs shing 'bul ba ci byung thams cad dge phyogs su btang nas lo 'ga' song ba dang ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te sku gshegs pa lags so//3 bar du 'brog mi lo tsā bas spel tshul skor/bla chen 'brog mi shākya ye shes la dbus gtsang khams gsum na slob ma dang nying slob bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba las/ mchog tu gyur pa rgyud tshar ba/ man ngag tshar ba/ grub pa thob pa yod pa las/rgyud tshar ba'i slob ma ni/ rnam thar ngo mtshar snang ba sogs las 431

'khon darkon mtshag rgyal po/ dbrad ston dkon mtshog rgyal po/ gyi ljang dbu dkar ba/ shangs kyi brag rtse po nag pa/ mnga' ris capa gsal ba'i snying bo bcas lnga dang / lo rgyus kha cig tu de'i khar nya ri'i zur po che shākya 'byung dang drug tu gsungs/man ngag tshar ba ni/ 'brom des pa ston chung / lha btsun ka ba li/se ston kun rig dang gsum mo//grub sa thob pa'i slob ma ni/ gtsang smad pa gyer sgom se bo/ rta nag pa gsher sgom rog po/ 'phan yul pa dbus pa grod po che ste pho pod/sum dang / 'phan yul gyi mched mo nam mkha'/ mang mkhar stod po ba stod mo rdo rje mtsho/ g.ya' mkhar ba dbrad mo dkon no/ tsha mo rong pa shab pa mo jo lcam rgyal mtshan te mo bzhi bsdoms pas bdun tsam dang / yang lo rgyus kha cig tu pho gsum po'i steng lcog ro gzhong pa 'bre lce shāka brtson dang / phad drug pa phyug gtsang mthong rgol bya ba gnyis bsnan pas grangs dgur bzhed pa yang yod do//da lta'i sa skya ba'i man ngag rin po che 'di ni/ bla chen gyi slob ma man ngag tshar ba rnams kyi nang nas se ston kun rig las brgyud pa yin pas/ bla ma de ni mdog smad kyi phyi 'brum pa se lce tsho bya ba'i rigs/ gre lce bde la shes rab che ba zhig yin pa sngon gyi bag chags sad pa'i stobs kyis g.yag ma smad sum cu tsam khyer nas myu gu lung du byone+e te bla chen 'brog mi la g.yag rnams phul nas gdams ngag zhus par bla chen gyis 'bul ba chen po min kyang lung pa phu gsum 'dzin pa la mkho gsungs nas 'bul ba 432

nems bzhis nas re zhig dbang te tsam ma gtogs gsung ngag ma gnang ba la phyis yun ring bsgugs pa dang / spyod lam gyis mnyes nas gdams ngag yongs su rdzogs pa gnang ba thams cad thugs su chud pas nyams snang bzang po byung zhing // khyad par gegs sel la mnga' brnyes/ slob ma'ang lam 'bras rab tu thob pa zhang ston mched gnyis/ 'bring du thob pa zha ma lcam sring / tha mar thob pa bse sgom byang ye rnams byung ngo / /di la gcen zhacing ston chos 'bar ni bla ma sa skya pa chen pos lam 'bras gsan yul te/zhang ston mched gnyis kyi 'bul ba dang spyod lam sogs kyis bla ma se mnyes nas gsung ngag rdzogs par gnang bas lam 'bras rab tu thob pa zhang ston mched gnyis zhes grags la/ bla ma'i zhal nas nga'i chos 'di zhang ston mched gnyis kyis go/ de'i nang nas kyang zhang ston gzi brjid 'bar (gcen chos 'bar)gyis go gsungs te bsngags brjod kyang mdzad do//bla chen 'brog mi nas brgyud pa'i gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa phyis bka' srol mi 'dra ba bco brgyad du grags pa byung ba rnams/ kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa ni/ rje pe myo/khar chung par lam 'bras rab tu thob pa zhang ston mched gnyis las/ gcen po zhang ston chos 'bar gyis rje btsun sa skya pa chen po de nyid la gnang ba de nas brgyud pa'i lam 'bras sa lugs thun mong ma yin pa 'di nyid yin la de yang dang po rje btsun sa skya pa chen po dge bcur bzhugs pa'i tshe dbugs zhes bya ba'i mdog gi sa char bla ma se chos 'khor gyi gtso bor spyan drangs pa'i skabs shig tu gsung ngag rin po che rtsa ba gsal byed 'phros don sogs kyi khog 4bye3

sgrig lam me ba zhig gnang / de rjes bla ma se dang / bla ma sgyi chu ba'ang sku 'das/ bla ma'i zhal chems bzhin sa chen rab tu byung bar dgongs pa na/bla ma gnam khur pas/ phyis 'byung gi rten 'brel zhig yod pas/ rab byung ma byas pa phan pa che zhes bkas bzlog ste/ sras rgyud kyis chos rgyud dri ma med pa dar rgyas su byed pa'i rten 'brel khyad par can gzigs pa yin gsungs/de nas skabs shig tu bla ma zhang la gsung ngag zhu bar bzhed nas bla ma gnam khar gnang ba zhus te jo sras rgyal po dang gnyis kyis khrab stong ri ba zhig bsnams nas ding du phebs/ khrab phul nas gsung ngag rin po che nan gyis zhus pas thugs dgyes pa'i gsung gleng zhib par mdzad pa dang / ston kar gsung ba'i dus btab/ de nas rje btsun sa chen dgung lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad bzhes pa'i ston de nas gsung ngag rin po che rgyud gsum lam sgor cha lag dang bcas pa lo bzhi la tshang bar gsan cing / mthar sgrub pa'i lung bstsal nas sku'i bkod pa bya dang ri dwags su sprul pa dang /skyil krung gis ding gi gzhung khebs pa sogs bstan par grags/ yi ge shes pa chos min pas sgom la 'bungs/ bsgoms nyams kyis spros pa nang nas chod na/ tshig gi mdud pa phyi nas mi grol ka med yin/ lo bco brgyad kyi bar du chos de yod pa'i ming tsam yang ma zer/ de nas 'chad dam/ yi ge 'bri khyod rang chos kyi bdag po yin no zhes dang / khyed sgrub pha byas na lus ma spangs par phyag rgya chen po thob/ bshad pa gtso bor byas na slob ma grub thob gsum/ bzod thob bdun/ rtogs pa dang ldan pa brgyad cu 434

'byung ba lung bstan par 3/dzad do//gnyis pa ni/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis//ma dros ye shes zhabs las rgyun bzhi'i bla ma ni//rgyal po rig dang snying po snang ba'i mtha' can te//rig dang snying po'i zhabs las 'bar ba 'bar ba'i mtha'//rgyun bzhi 'dzin pa'i bla chen de la rtag phyag 'tshal// 3sa gsungs pa ltar/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba ma dros pa'i mtsho chen po las/'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ se ston kun rig mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khyin lo tsā ba 'od kyi snang ba ste/ gaṅgā la sogs pa'i chu bo bzhi dang 'dra ba'i rgyud man ngag gi rgyun babs bla chen sa skya ba chen po'i thugs kyi snod nye bar bzung ba gong du yang zur tsam 'phros sa ltar lags/ de yang rgyun thog mtha' gnyis ni/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos 'brog mi dang 'khyin gnyis char la dngos su gsan cing / 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po las bla chen sa skya pa kun dga' snying pos gsan pas grub/ rgyun bar pa gnyis ni/se las zhang ston chos 'bar dang / mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po las sgyi chu ba dgra lha 'bar gyis gsan la/ de nyid la sa chen gyis dngos su gsan pas grub pa yin no//nye brgyud ni/ rje sa chen dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe bdun gyi dus su gung thang du dug byung ba'i dug ro langs nas zla gcig tsam bsnyun pas sngar gyi chos thams cad bsnyel/ grogs la 'dri sa ni med/ rgya gar du phebs kyang ci 'dra yod cha med snyam thugs cung zad ma bde nas 'jam dpal brag phug 435

—tsho ca tu sku mtshams bsdams// bla ma la gsol ba drag tu btab pas je zhig nas rje dgon pa ba mnal lam du byon nas chos gsungs/ thugs cung zad spro nas sa/sol ba drag tu btab pas rje dgon pa ba dngos su byon nas chos gsungs pas/ chos thams cad thugs la gsal bar dran/ de nas/ kyang thugs ches spro zhing gsol ba ches cher btab pas/ tho rengs khar rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birlu pa zhabs skyil krung / phyag chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yas su shar phyogs nag po ba zhabs skyil krung / g.yas ba men gyi rwa dung / g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon du ga ya dha ra na bza' dkar po lding dgorge mdzad nas rdor dril thugs kar bsnol ba/ rgyab tu ko ḍa li sa pus mo btsugs nas gdugs 'dzin pa/mdun na bi na pa ste nags khrod pa thal mo sbyar nas bdud rtsi 'bul ba ste gtso 'khor lnga / sa dkar po rgyab yol du mdzad/ ya gi'i mon grog nas ma gi'i 'bal grog gi bar skyil krung gis khyab par mdzad nas 'di rnams thams cad nga dbang gsungs shing / byon nas zhal bstan pas thugs la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin bas ma gyis mi khyab pa 'khrungs/ a la la ste zhes sogs kyi bstod pa mdzad/ de nas zla gcig gi bar du sku mtshams bsdams nas gtso 'khor ci rigs par byon nas bla med kyi rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis sam/ bla med dang 'brel ba'i byin rlabs sogs kyi chos sna bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ khyad par du lcags ri las mi 'da' ba'i zab chos bzhi la sogs pa gsan par grags pa bcas de lta bu'i sgo nas gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i bstan pa dbyar gyi chu gter bzhin 'khon 436

rigs/ sa/tso bor gyur pa'i bstan 'dzid gyi skyes phu dam pa bgrangs kyis mi lang bas rim par spel ba lags so//bzhi pa/ gsung ngag rin po che'i zab khyad skor/ ci de ltar rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs bcud rmathar thug pa/ 'jigs bral/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal birlu pa'i bka' srol/ gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la bka' babs pa'i gsung ngag rin po che lamyo/ 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa 'di nyid la zab pa'i che ba bcu ba/cig dang / snyan rgyud tshad ma bzhi dang ldan par gsungs pa las zab khyad che ba bcu gcig ni/(1) gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag (3) 'bras bu lam dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag (3) gcig shes pas mang po shes/ pa'i gdams ngag (4) skyon yon tan du slong ba'i gdams ngag ('a) bar chad dngos grub tu len pa'i gdams ngag /(a+yo) ting 'dzin ngo shes pas bsam gtan gyi gegs sel ba'i gdams ngag (7) bar chad ngo shes pas bdud kyi gegs sel ba'i gdams ngag /(8) skyon yon tan du slong shes shing bar chad dngos grub tu len pa'i gdams ngag (9) sde snod gsum gyi de kho na nyid phyin ci ma log par shes pa'i gdams ngag (10) gser 'gyur rtsi lta bu'i gdams ngag /(11) rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang gzhung yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'i gdams ngag bcas so// /4 snyan rgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan ni/ 437

(1) bla ma tshari+o ma/ (1) nyams myong tshad ma/ (kā) bstam bcos tshad ma/ (4) lung tshad ma bcas tshad ma bzhi dang / (1) dbang gi chu pho ma nub pa/ (3) byin rlabs kyi rgyud pa ma nyams pa/ (3) gdams ngag gi sarma myo/ log pa/ (4) mos mus kyi bsam pa tshim pa bcas snyan rgyud bzhi'o//de lta bu'i gsung ngag rin po che 'di ni gdams pa gzhin las ches glu/chog tu gyur pa dang / glegs bam na bzhugs pa'i chos sna'i rkang grangs ni/rdo rje'i tshig gi rnam 'grel gnyags ma dang //gsal byed kun gzhi rgyu rgyud gdan sogs dang //lus dkyil 'chi blu bum dbang 'da' kha ma//thig le'i rnal 'byor phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid dang //bzhi pa'i 'da' ka bar do'i nidams ngag dang //lam dbang tshad ma drug dang gdams ngag drug//rten 'brel lnga dang grib bsil yi ge gnyis//thig le'i srung ba yig brgya'i 'don thabs dang //rlung sbyor bha ga'i yi ge 'khor bzhi'i rgya//dbang phyug don brgyad sa phyed mngon rtogs dang //don bsdus ma ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni//rtsa ba nyid kyi steng nas bshad bya'o//de dag las 'phros gud du gsung pa'i chos// 438

'khor 'das dbyer med dbang gzhi'i man ngag gnad//mchog dbang bskur tshul bskyed rim zhus pa dang / / ril phu'i sgrub thabs yum gyi byin rlabs dang //gegs selagyibazhi dang dbang chu sgrub thabs gsum//rtsa ltung 'khrul spong tshogs 'khor sbyin sreg ste//'phros te gsungs pa'i chos sna bcu bdun las//byi ma bzhi po logs su bzhag kyang rung //'bring bsdus lam gnyis gzhung shing chen po bzhi//rtogs bskyed chos lnga lam zab bla ma dang //lung sbyor bzhi dang rgyud pa'i lo rgyuru gnyis//man ngag phra mor bcas pa drug cu 'o//zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// lnga pa/ sa skya pa'i mdo yi lta ba mtha' bzhi'i spros byal skor/sa skya pa'i mdo yi lta ba mtha' bzhi'i spros bral gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshul la bshad bya'i chos kyi che ba brjod pa dang / dbu ma'i lta ba shan 'byed tshul gnyis gsungs pa las/dang po/ bshad bya'i chos kyi che ba brjod pa la gsum ste/ dbu ma'i che ba spyir brjod pa/ gzhi dbu ma byi brag tu bsngags pa/ dpe'i sgo nas gsum char bsngags pa'o//dang po/ theg pa chen po'i dbu ma ni/ rang bzhin dadzo/ sgrub byed dang / dgos pa'i khyad par gsum gyis chos gzhan las mchog tu 439

gyur pa'o//1 rang bzhin phun sum tshogs pa ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis brdar btags pa'i dbu ma zhes pa mtshan gyi don mtha' dang bral ba dang / mthar thug pa/ rjes su 'brel ba'i yon tan gsum las/ (1) dang po mtha' dang bral ba 'jug pa'i yul yang gsum ste/gzhi dbu mar brjod pas bden pa gnyis po phan tshun so sor ltos nas yod med rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba dang / lam dbu mar brjod pas thabs shes rab gnyi sa po sgro 'dogs dang skur pa'i mtha' dang bral ba/'bras dbu mar brjod pas mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i srid pa dang zhi ba'i mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'o// (3) mthar thug pa 'jug pa'i yul yang gsum ste/ dang po bden pa gnyis po ni gzhi'i mthar thug yin te shes bya'i lung thams cad la khyab pa'i chos can dang chos nyid yin phyi dngos po'i lus nyid dang / rtog pas sgro skur gyi mtha' zad par spong bas shes byaske gnas nyid dang / de la 'khrul ma 'khrul gyi nyon mongs dang rnam byang du 'gyur bas nges legs kyi dmigs pa yin pa'o/ /gnyis pa thabs shes gnyis ni lam gyi mthar thug yin te/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad gshegs shing rjes su gshegs pa'i shul yin pa dang / ji skad 'chad pa'i 'bras bu 'grub pa la dgos shing tshang bas nges pa'i rgyu yin pa/ ma mthong ba'i g.yang sa med cing nyamyo/sa su babs pas 'jug pa bde ba'i sgo yin pa'o/ /gsum pa mi gnas/ pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa ni 'bras bu rnams kyi mthar thug pa yin te bdag gi don— 440

grub pa dang gzhan gyi don byed pas skyes bu chen po rnams kyi gnyer bya'i don tshang ba dang / spang rtogs yongs su rdzogs pas de las lhag pa'i don med pa/ 'das pa'i lam gyi sa thob pas slar ldog pa med par gson pa'o//(kā) de dag rjes su 'brel ba ni/ ga zhi lam 'bras bu gsum po de dag phan tshun nges par 'brel ba dang / dgos pa tshang bas 'tsham pa/lag rjes ma 'khrul pa mthun pa'o//1 sgrub byed phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rang bzhin phun sum tshogs pa'i don nges par mi nus so snyam na de dag nges par bya ba la dngos po'i rigs pa dang / yid ches pa'i lung / bla ma'i man cingag gsum yod pas nges par nus te rigs pas ni chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba dag nges par byed/lung gis ni dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba dag dad par byed/ yang rigs pas ni dbu ma'i gzhi dang lta ba nges par byed/ lung gis ni 'bras bu dang spong ba nges par byed/ man ngag gis lam gyi nyams len nges par byed pas gzhan las khyad par du 'gyur ba'o//kā dgos sa phun sum tshogs pa la dgos pa'i ngo bo dang / de rnyed par dka' ba/ de sgrub par nus pa gsum las/(1) don de dag sgrub byed de dag gis 'grub par gzhung dbu mas bstan pa las thob pa'i phan yon la'ang gsum ste/ dang po re zhig 'di thos pa tsam gyis thob pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin sdi 'di thos nas sdang ba dang nyes pas smra ba la sogs pa nyes par spyad pas kyang byang chub kyi rgyu yongs su 'dzin pa dang / dad pa dang mchod pa dang / 'don pa la 441

sogs legs par spyad pa'i bsod nams gzhan bas checib dang / don la the tshom zhu/gas pas kyang 'khor ba'i rgyu la gnod cing lam du chud pas gzhan la yun ring spyad pa bas don che ba'o/ /gnyis pa 'di'i rang bzhin rtogs pas thob pa'i phan yon ni/ ji skad brjod pa'i sgrub byed dag gis dbu ma gsum gyi rang ba—zhin ji lta bar rtogs na dngos po thams cad kyi lugs dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lam dang bstan pa thams cad kyi don shes pas rang gis yang dag pa'i don rtogs pa dang / gnyen po thob pa dang / smra ba rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa'ang yin te gnas gsum la gzhan gyi klan ka bde blag tu spong ba dang / mtha' gnyis la zhen pa rnams brtse bas tshar bcad pa dang / rjes su 'dzin pa'i sgo nas gzhung lugs ngan pa 'dzin par byed pa'o/ /gsum pa 'di la legs par zhugs pas thob pa ni/ lam nyid kyi dus na'ang rgyu'i mthus sems can smin par byed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing sbyong ba/ dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i yon tan rgya chen la spyad pa'o//(3) dgos pa de rnyed dka' ba ni/ de lta bu'i bstan pa 'byung ba dka' ba dang / bstan pa 'jig rten gyi blo dang mi 'phrod pa dang / chos 'di la mos pa tsam yang dag pa'i tshogs mang po la ltos pa'i phyir yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar dkon pa yin te/ de nyid kyis na skye bo mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang chos 'di'i don la blo kha ma phyogs shing / 'dir spyod pa la zhugs pa dag gis kyang 'di ji lta ba ma rtogs par snang bas gsung gi khyad par 'di zlos pa'ang ma yin no//442

(3) sgrub par nus pa ni/ de lta na yang dgos pa de 'jog po'i gtsug nor ltar bsgrub par mi nus pa dag ma yin te/ deng sang skal ba dang ldan pa'i skye bo yod cing / klu sgrub yag sras kyi gsung rab dang / sa skya pa'i lugs rje btsun gong ma'i dgongs 'grel sogs kyis gsal bar 'chad pa'i phyir ro//gnyis pa/ gzhi dbu ma bye bra ga tu bsngags pa ni/ gsung rab thams cad kye brjod bya yin pa dang / shes bya thams cad kyi gnas lugs yin pa/ de rtogs pa na phan bde thams cad kyi gnas yin pa dang gsum gyis shes par bya ba las/1 gzhi dbu ma bden pa gnyis po gsung rab thams cad mibarjod bya yin te/ gsung rab thams cad bsdu na drang nges gnyi sa su 'du zhing /drang don gyi gsung rab ni brjod bya kun rdzob kyi bden pa dang / nges don gyi gsung rab ni brjod bya don dam pa'i bden pa ston pa'i phyir ro//kra shes bya'i chos thams cad dpyad na bden rdzun gang du yang ma grub pa'i stong pha nyid yin zhing / ma dpyad tha snyad du brdzun snang rten 'byung yin pa de sus kyang gzhan du zlog par mi nus pa yin pas na bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa shes bya thams cad kyi gnas lugs yin te yum bar ma las/ mtshan nyid 'di dag lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis dkyugs par mi nus so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags/kā bden pa gnyis kyi don legs par rtogs pa ni/ spyir 'phags pa gsum gyi phan ba de bskrun pa'i yum yin zhing / bye brag tu dus gsum gyi 443

sangs rgyas kyi yum yin te/ sher phyin gyi bstod pa las/sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas rnams dang // tsho nyan thos gsum gyis nges bsten ma//— khyod nyid gcig pu thar pa'i lam//de ltar gzhan dag med par nges/ /zhes dang / — gang slade sangs rgyas 'jig rten gtso//thugs rje can rnams khyod kyi sras// de yi slad du dge ma khyod// sems can kun gyi phyi mo lags//zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//gsum pa/ gsum char dpe'i sgo nas bsngags pa ni/ gzhi dbu ma nam mkha' dang chos mtshungs pa/ lam dbu ma shing rta dang chos mtshungs pa/'bras bu dbu ma yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang chos mtshusprengs pa gsum gyis shes par bya ba las/1 gzhi dbu ma nam mkha' dang chos mtshungs pa ni/ nam mkha' ni khyab cing rang bzhin mid la go 'byed pa ltar/ gzhi dbu ma bden gnyis kyang chos thams cad la khyab cing / kun rdzob snang ba la bden pa'i rang bzhin med/ don dam snang med la bden badzu na gnyis ka'i rang bzhin med cing / bden gnyis ma rig pas 'khor bar go skabs 'byed la/bden gnyis rig pa'i yum gyis zhi ba lam lngar 'jug pa yin te/ de gnyis ka la dgongs nas rim pa ltar 'phags pa sdud pa las/444

serma/nu can tha ma 'bring dang mchog gyur ji rnyed pa//de kun ma rig las byung bde bar gshegs pas gsungs//zhes dang /ye shes tshul sgo thabs dang rtsa ba ji rnyed pa//di kun shes rab pha rol phyin tro mchog las byung //zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// 3 lam dbu ma shing rta dang chos mtshungs pa ni/shing rta ni brtan pa/ bde ba/ mgyogs pa ltar lam tshogs gnyisakyang srid zhir mi lhung bas brtan cing / sdug bsngal dang gnod pa med pas bde la/ myur du sangs rgyas phas margyags pa yin te/ de dag la dgongs nas rim pa ltar 'phags pa sdud pa las/ khams gsum yang dag 'das la rnam par grol ba'ang min/ zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/sdig pa spong phyir sdug bsngal med//mkhas pa'i phyir na mi dga' med//ces dang / 'phags pa snad pa las//zil gyis mi gnon rgyal ba'i byang chub myur du thob//ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro//3 'bras bu dbu ma yid bzhin nor bu dang chos mtshungs pa ni/yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dkon pa phan thogs che/ rnam rtog med pa ltar 'bras bu dbu ma don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i sangs rgyas 445

kyang 'jig rten du byon pa shin tu dkaun/ byon na kun la ches cher phan la/ rnam rtog spyang mi mnga' ba ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ k+ṣi 'byung ba dkon phyir dri me da phyir//mthu ldan byir dang 'jig rten gyi//rgyan rgyur phyir dang mchog nyid phyir/zhes dang / theg bsdus las/ ji ltar tshwar bu mil snyan dag /rtog ba med par rang las byung //de bzhigasangs rgyas 'phrin las dag /rtog pa med par rang las byung //zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// rī gnyis pa/ dbu ma'i lta ba shan 'byed tshul/ spyir rig pa'i gnas lnga dang / bye brag tu bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab rab 'byams/ khyad par theg chen nges don gyi mdo sde dang /rgyud sde phyin phyi ma log par rtogs pas lung gijichos khong du chud cing / dus gcig tu sangs rgyas brgya zhal mthong ba sogs yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis thob pas rtogs pa'i chos thugs su chud pa 'phags mchog klu sgrub dang / de'i gzhung lugs kyi rjes su 'khrangs pa'i 'phags yul gyi dbu ma pa chen po rnams kyis ni gzhu nga gi 'chad tshul dang / tha snyad kyi rnam gzhag la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par mang du mdzad pa'i tshul ni 'khrul pa'i dri ma thams cad zad pa rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dbu ma 'di la kun rdzob 446

kyi 'dod pa dang mi mthun pa lnga yod par gsungs pa ni/dang po/ 'jig rten grags sde spyod pa'i dbu ma pa nyid dpal ldan zla ba grags pas ni 'jig rten lhan skyes kyi blo ngo ma ji ltar snang ba ltar don dang shes pa sogs kyis tha snyad zhal gyis bzhes pa ste/ sa bon la myu gu skye zhes sogs kyi tha snyad tsam 'jig rten na ji ltar grags pa khas len pa'i shes byed du/ tshig gsal dang 'jug 'grel gnyis su/ mdo las/ 'jig rten nga dang lhan cig rtsod kyi/ nga ni 'jig rten dang lhan cig mi rtsod de/gang 'jig rten na yod par 'dod pa de ni nga yang yod par bzhed do//zhes dang / klu sgrub kyis/tha snyad la ni ma brten par//dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi 'gyur/zhes dang / 'phags pa lhas/ji ltar kla klo skad gzhan gyis//gzung bar mi nus de bzhin du//'jig rten pa yi ma gtogs pa//'jig rten gzung bar nus ma yin//zhes gsungs pha rnams lung du 'dren par mdzad do//gnyis pa/ bye brag smra ba dang tshul mtshungs pa'i dbu ma pa ni/'grel byed 'di yin gsal bar mi snang yang / thog mar bye brag tu smra ba'i grub mtha' la gnas pa phyis dbu ma la zhugs pa'i tshe/ de dang tshul mtshungs par 'dod pa nges par dgos te bla ma byams pa'i rnal 'byor bzhin no// 447

sto jilke gsum pa/ mdo sde spyod pa'i dbu ma pa ni/ slob dpom/ legs ldan 'byed de/ phyi don dbang shes la rnam pa gtod byed kyi rgyur gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ni sngar mdo sde pa'i rtog ge la legs par sbongs pa zhig phyis dbu ma la zhugs par snang bas kun rdzob kyi rnam gzhag la de'i 'dres shor ba mang du snang ngo //bzhi pa/ sgyu ma lta bu'i dbu gapa ni/ slo ba dpon dpa' bo ste/khong si/sa don dam byang chub kyi sems sgom pa'i man cingag las/des na ma brtags nyams dga' ste//sgyu ma tsam la brtags pas bslus//sems ni sgyuci ma'i rnam pa ste//byang chub kyis ni sgyu ma 'dra//zhes sogs gsungs pa 'di nges par yod dgos par snang ste/ kun rdzob kyi rnam gzhag rang sde dngos por smra ba gsum dang tshul mtshungs pa yod na dbu ma pa rang lugs kyi kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu khas len pa zhig kyang nges par dgos pa'o//lnga pa/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma pa ni/ ye shes snying po dang /zhi ba ‘ratsho la sogs pa ste/ klu sgrub kyi ye shes sdes phyi don khas len mi len gyi gsal kha ma byung ba legs ldan 'byed kyis phyi don khas blangs pas mdo sde spyod pa dang / ye shes snying pos snang ba sems su gsungs pas rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma byung zhes snga rabs rnams la grags pa yin te de ltar na 'di gnyis ka rang rgyud pa'i dbye ba'o/ /44ni

don dam gyi lta ba bskyed tshul gyi sgo nas thalnga 'gyur ba dang / rang rgyud pa gnyis don dam gyi 'dod tshul la ni khyad par med pas mthar thug tsho dzilta ba'i gnad la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par mdzad pa mi snang ngo //de ltar dbu ma'i lta ba 'dzin tshul mi 'dra ba yod kyang / gangs ri'i khrod kyi thub pa'i rgyal tshab rngog lo la sogs pa dang / rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la sogs pa rnams kyi bzhed pa mthun par/ dbu ma'i don ni yod med dang yin min la sogs pa thams cad dang bra'/ ba yin pas mthar 'dzin pa dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa thams cad spong dgos la/ de la thog mar bden par 'dzin pa'i yul gyi bden pa ma bkag na mthar phyin phyi ma rnams dgag tu med pas gcig dang du bral la sogs pa'i rigs pa rnams kyis phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad bden med du gtan la dbab par bya dgos/ 'di dgag bya rags pa yin zhing / 'khor ba'i rgyu gtso bo yang yin pas gzhung rnams las/ de'i zhen yul bden pa 'gog byed —kyi rigs pa rgyas par gsungs pa yin la/ de bzhag nas bden pa la stong pa nyid du bzung ba/ dper na/ rta la bzhon pa g.yas phyogs su ma lhung yang /g.yon phyogs su lhung ba ltar chad pa'i mthar rilhung ba las ma 'das pas de yang dgag par bya ba yin no//de'i phyir gnyis 'dzin dang gnyis min du 'dzin pa yang bkag dgos pas mtha' bzhi gang du yang rbezung ba'i yul ma rnyed pas/ der 'dzin pa med pa la dbu ma'i lta ba rtogs zhes tha snyad 'dogs pa yin gyi/ dbu ma'i lta ba 'a di'o zhes mtha' gcig tu 'dzin pa gcig byung na stong mi stong sogs 449

ging du badrung yang mthar 'dzin las ma 'das pas dbu ma'i lta ba min par bzhed do//drug pa/ sa skya pa'i sngags kyi lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med ji ltar gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshul/sngags kyi lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med gtan la 'be+ebs pa'i tshul ni/ thog mar khrid yig rnams las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang sems gcig nyid de dang der shar ba yin gyi sems las gzhan pa'i chos cung zad kyang med pa'i tshul lung dang / rigs pa/ man ngag gsum gyis gtan la 'bebs pa las/dang po/ lung ni/ mdo sde sa bcu pa las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras khams gsum po 'di dag ni sems tsam du zad do/ /ges dang / rdo rje gur las/rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i//sangs rgyas med cing gang zag med//rnam par shes pa'i gnas don nam/ / phyi rol gyur pa cung zad med//ces dang / tshad ma rigs gter las/don du snang ba blo nyid yin //snang ba 'di dag phyi na med//bag chags brtan dang mi brtan las//bden dang brdzun pa'i rnam gzhag byed//450

ce'/ba sogs gsungs pha ltar ro// gnyis pa/ rigs pa ni//dngos gcig yid ni tha dad phyir//don ma grub par 'dod pa yin//zhes gsungs pa ltar chu phor pa gang la rigs drug gis mthong snang mi 'dra ba drug 'byung bas kyang snaja ba snyi don du bden par ma thub pa shes pha ltar ro// gsum pa/ bla ma rgyud pas rim gyis bstan pa'i man ngag las 'byung ba ni/ sems la gnyid rdzas nad dang gdon gyis bslad//mig yor rab rib mgal me myur 'khor ba// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//de ltar lung rigs man ngag gsum gyis bstan pa'i tshul la zhib tu bsam pas/ ji zhig na snang ba sems su rtogs pa 'byung ste/ dper na/lan tshwa chu la zim pa na/ chu las zur du lan tshwa phye rgyu med pa bzhin sems las gzhan pa'i chos gang yang mid par rtogs shing / tha na rang gi lus kyang zur du e yod mi shes pa'i nyams 'byung / de la snang sems 'dres pa mtshan nyid pa ni sa brgyad ma thob kyi bar mi 'byung bar gsungs pas/ gong gi de snang sems 'edres pa dngos ma yin kyang / rnal 'byor pa'i gnas skabs kyi nyams kyi 'char tshul tsam yin/snang ba sems su bsgrub pa ni dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs yin/ de 45 1

yang klu sgrub/ 'phags pa lho/ zla ba grags pa gsum kas snang ba sems yin par gsung sa pa dang / mkhas mchog mi pham rgya mtshos dbu ma rgyan 'grel du/ snang ba sems su bsgrub pa 'di ni/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa rnams kyi grub mtha'i khyad chos/ dngos po'i snang tshul gyi yin lugs/ sgom pa'i man ngag gi gnad dam pa/ srid pa'i 'phrul 'khor 'jig pa la bshan pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pha dang / shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa la sogs pa lta bu yin la/ thabs khyad par bas zin na mthar thug rdo rje theg pa'i skabs su'ang man ngag gnad kyi snying po'ang 'di kho na'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar snang ba sems yin zer ba de yang / rang snang sems yin/zer ba yin gyi gzhan snang ni ma yin te/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ rang sems du mar snang ba'i rang gnas su//rang rig sgyu ma'i skyes bu rang ngo shes//rang gzhan 'gag med rten 'brel rang ngos stong //rang byung brjod med thabyings kyi rang zhal stong //zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro//de nas sems la sems kyis lta ba'i tshul gyis bltas pa na/ gsal le/ hrig ge ba ma 'gag par myong ba de nyid la gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid ces bya/ gsal tsam de nyid rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas thog mar skye ba med pas skye ba'i rgyus stong / bar du gnas pa med pas gnas pa'i ngo bos stong / mtha' 'gag pa med pas 'gag pa'i 'bra sa bus stong / kha dog 45nyu

dang dasnibs su ma grub/ lus kyi phyi nang bar gsum gang na yang mi gnas/gang ltar btsal yang mi rnyed/ ci ltar brtags kyang ma grub pa de nyid la stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin zhes bya/ de ltar rang bzhin cir yang ma grub pa'i dus nyid na rang snang gi rtsal sna tshogs 'gag med du 'char bas gdod ma nas med ma myong / rang snang gi rtsal sna tshogs 'gag med du 'char ba'i dus nyid na rang bzhin cir yang ma grub pas gdod ma nas yod ma myong /gdod ma nas yod ma myong ba'i rang bzhin stong pa dang / gdod ma nas med ma myong ba'i mtshan nyid gsal ba gnyis gdod ma nas 'bral ma myong ba'i rang sneng du gsal le ba/ rang stong du sang nge ba/ rang rig tu rjen ne ba/ de nyid so so rang gi rig pa'i ye shes kyis nyams su myong bar bya ba tsam las don dam gshis lugs la ngo bo ngos bzung med/ blos bzung du med/ tshig gis brjod du med kyang / tha snyad kun rdzob tu 'jig rten gyi rmongs pa bsal ba'i phyir gnyis med ces bya/ zung 'jug ces bya/brjod bral zhes bya/ bcos min sems kyi ngo bo zhes bya'o//de lta bu'i gnas lugs des dzakhor 'das thams cad la khyab nas yod kyang / rang ngo rang gis ma shes pa rnams la 'khor ba pa zhes bya/shes pa rnams la mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya/ 'khor 'das zhes pa rtogs mi rtogs kyi ngos nas so sor bzhag pa tsam yin gyi gnas lugs rang ngos nas 'khor ba ngan pa zhig logs su spong rgyu med/ myang 'das bzang po zhig logs nas bsgrub rgyu med/ de legs par rtogs na 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba rtogs pa zhes bya ba yin no//453

de ltar dpal ldan sa skya pa'i sa grub mtha' 'di nyid gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa dang / gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir grub mtha' 'di nyid 'dzin skyong spel gsum la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhas grub nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu byon pa rnams kyis lung dang rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi dang / lhag par bod kyi rig pa'i gnas gong nas gong du spel bar mdzad rjes mi nub pa ba'ag lod/ dper na sa skya gong ma rnam lnga dang / khyad par du sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta zhes srid pa'i khyon la snyan grags ba dan gyis khyab pa des bo da la rig pa'i gnas lnga cha tshang bar mdzad pa sogs rlabs po che'i 'phrin las la brten nas sa paṇa khu dbon hor rgyal po'i mchod gnas su bkur ba da lta yang mi sems nang gsal ler gnas pa bcas dpal ldan sa skya pa'i grub mtha'i skor che long tsam gleng ba 'di ni ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi chos 'byung bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen dang / dpe war sprul sku 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang pos mdzad pa dpal ldan sa skya pa'i lta grub theg pa'i rnam bshad yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ thu'u bkwan grub mtha' sogs las btus pa lags so//454

— nga da ྅rdob 'ordocanabasdo dzi/ dra/zu/the bzapa/matun rgog matre /mdun shog mtshan byang 'bri mkhan tshe don/dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur ba blo rdor/ — (pod sil bu'i byung ba brjod pa shel dkar zeng ba/nor brang o rgyan gyis brtsams/sna bod sngongs mi dmangs daspa skun khang nas par du bskun/bod sngongs shin hwa dpe deb khang nas bkram/mtsho sngon mi rigs par 'debs batho grwa nas par brgyab/ci chodeb da/ 850྾1168 bar1(32yig grangs/ khri251991 lo'i 7par gzhi dang po/ 1991loji zla 7par thengs dang po brgyab/152sa7da 223da 00372da 3(ṣā 78par thangs000 1da 2 000rin gong skor4 00
